  242:   async function updateTeacherStatus(action: "suspend" | "restore") {
  243:     if (!user || !teacher) {
  244:       toast.error("Unable to update this teacher account.");
  245:       return;
  246:     }
  247: 
  248:     setProcessing(true);
  249: 
  250:     try {
  251:       const adminIdToken = await user.getIdToken(true);
  252: 
  253:       const response = await fetch(`/api/admin/teachers/${teacher.id}/status`, {
  254:         method: "POST",
  255:         headers: {
  256:           "Content-Type": "application/json",
  257:           Authorization: `Bearer ${adminIdToken}`,
  258:         },
  259:         body: JSON.stringify({
  260:           action,
  261:         }),
  262:       });
  263: 
  264:       const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";
  265: 
  266:       if (!contentType.includes("application/json")) {
  267:         const responseText = await response.text();
  268: 
  269:         console.error(
  270:           "Teacher status API returned non-JSON:",
  271:           response.status,
  272:           responseText,
  273:         );
  274: 
  275:         throw new Error(
  276:           `The server returned an unexpected response (${response.status}). Check the API route and terminal.`,
  277:         );
  278:       }
  279: 
  280:       const data = (await response.json()) as {
  281:         success?: boolean;
  282:         status?: "active" | "suspended";
  283:         error?: string;
  284:       };
  285: 
  286:       if (!response.ok) {
  287:         throw new Error(data.error || "Unable to update the teacher account.");
  288:       }
  289: 
  290:       setTeacher((current) =>
  291:         current
  292:           ? {
  293:               ...current,
  294:               status:
  295:                 data.status ?? (action === "suspend" ? "suspended" : "active"),
  296:             }
  297:           : current,
  298:       );
  299: 
  300:       toast.success(
  301:         action === "suspend"
  302:           ? "Teacher suspended successfully."
  303:           : "Teacher restored successfully.",
  304:       );
  305:     } catch (error) {
  306:       console.error("Teacher status update error:", error);
  307: 
  308:       toast.error(
  309:         error instanceof Error
  310:           ? error.message
  311:           : "Something went wrong updating the teacher.",
  312:       );
  313:     } finally {
  314:       setProcessing(false);
  315:     }
  316:   }

  128: function extractDuration(message: string): number {
  129:   const match = message.match(
  130:     /\b(\d{1,3})\s*(?:-|â€“)?\s*(?:minute|minutes|min|mins)\b/i,
  131:   );
  132:

  136:     ? duration

  140: function extractYearGroup(message: string): string {
  141:   const yearMatch = message.match(/\byear\s*(7|8|9|10|11|12|13)\b/i);
  142: 
  143:   if (yearMatch) {
  144:     return `Year ${yearMatch[1]}`;
  145:   }
  146: 
  147:   if (/\ba[\s-]?level\b/i.test(message)) {
  148:     return "A Level";
  149:   }
  150: 
  151:   if (/\bgcse\b/i.test(message)) {
  152:     return "GCSE";
  153:   }

  162: function extractExamBoard(message: string): string {
  163:   if (/\baqa\b/i.test(message)) return "AQA";
  164:   if (/\bocr\b/i.test(message)) return "OCR";
  165:   if (/\b(?:pearson\s+)?edexcel\b/i.test(message)) return "Pearson Edexcel";
  166:   if (/\bwjec\b/i.test(message)) return "WJEC";
  167:   if (/\beduqas\b/i.test(message)) return "Eduqas";
  168:   if (/\bcambridge(?:\s+international)?\b/i.test(message)) {
  169:     return "Cambridge International";
  170:   }
  171: 
  172:   return "AQA";
  173: }
  174: 
  175: function extractDifficulty(message: string): AssistantDifficulty {
  176:   if (/\b(?:higher|advanced|challenging|stretch)\b/i.test(message)) {
  177:     return "higher";
  178:   }
  179: 
  180:   if (/\b(?:foundation|accessible|basic|support)\b/i.test(message)) {
  181:     return "foundation";
  182:   }
  183: 
  184:   return "standard";
  185: }
  186: 
  187: function extractQuestionCount(message: string): number {
  188:   const match = message.match(
  189:     /\b(\d{1,2})\s*(?:-|â€“)?\s*(?:question|questions)\b/i,
  190:   );
  191: 
  192:   const count = match ? Number(match[1]) : 10;
  193: 
  194:   return Number.isInteger(count) && count >= 3 && count <= 20 ? count : 10;
  195: }
  196: 
  197: function isQuizRequest(message: string): boolean {
  198:   return /\bquiz\b/i.test(message) && !/\bretrieval\s+quiz\b/i.test(message);
  199: }
  200: 
  201: function detectResourceType(
  202:   message: string,
  203:   mode: AssistantMode,
  204: ): AssistantResourceType | null {
  205:   const normalised = message.toLowerCase();
  206: 
  207:   if (
  208:     normalised.includes("retrieval quiz") ||
  209:     normalised.includes("retrieval questions")
  210:   ) {
  211:     return "retrieval-quiz";
  212:   }
  213: 
  214:   if (
  215:     normalised.includes("exit ticket") ||
  216:     normalised.includes("exit question")
  217:   ) {
  218:     return "exit-ticket";
  219:   }
  220: 
  221:   if (normalised.includes("worksheet")) return "worksheet";
  222:   if (normalised.includes("homework")) return "homework";
  223:   if (normalised.includes("starter") || normalised.includes("bell task")) {
  224:     return "starter";
  225:   }
  226: 
  227:   if (normalised.includes("lesson") || mode === "lesson-planner") {
  228:     return "lesson-plan";
  229:   }
  230: 
  231:   return null;
  232: }
  233: 
  234: function removePlanningWords(message: string): string {
  235:   return message
  236:     .replace(
  237:       /^(please\s+)?(can\s+you\s+)?(create|generate|write|plan|make|produce|design|build)\s+/i,
  238:       "",
  239:     )
  240:     .replace(/^(a|an|the)\s+/i, "")
  241:     .replace(/\b\d{1,3}\s*(?:-|â€“)?\s*(?:minute|minutes|min|mins)\b/gi, "")
  242:     .replace(/\b\d{1,2}\s*(?:-|â€“)?\s*(?:question|questions)\b/gi, "")
  243:     .replace(/\b(?:year\s*(?:7|8|9|10|11|12|13)|gcse|a[\s-]?level)\b/gi, "")
  244:     .replace(
  245:       /\b(?:aqa|ocr|pearson\s+edexcel|edexcel|wjec|eduqas|cambridge\s+international)\b/gi,
  246:       "",
  247:     )
  248:     .replace(
  249:       /\b(?:foundation|standard|higher|advanced|challenging|stretch|accessible|basic)\b/gi,
  250:       "",
  251:     )
  252:     .replace(
  253:       /\b(?:complete\s+)?(?:lesson\s+plan|lesson|worksheet|homework|starter\s+activity|starter|retrieval\s+quiz|retrieval\s+questions|exit\s+ticket|quiz)\b/gi,
  254:       "",
  255:     )
  256:     .replace(/\b(?:for|on|about|covering|focused\s+on)\b/gi, " ")
  257:     .replace(/[.?!]+$/g, "")
  258:     .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
  259:     .trim();
  260: }
  261: 
  262: function extractTopic(message: string): string {
  263:   return titleCase(removePlanningWords(message) || "Computer Science");

  283: function createResourceBuilderAction(
  284:   parsed: ParsedTeachingRequest,

  286:   if (!parsed.resourceType || parsed.quizRequested) {
  287:     return undefined;

  307:     objectives: "",
  308:     additionalNotes: `Create a ${names[parsed.resourceType]} based on the Copilot request. Review and adapt all generated content before publishing.`,
  309:     buttonLabel: `Open ${titleCase(names[parsed.resourceType])} in Builder`,
  310:   };

  374: function getErrorDetails(error: unknown): OpenAIErrorLike {
  375:   return error && typeof error === "object" ? (error as OpenAIErrorLike) : {};
  376: }
  377: 
  378: function isQuotaError(error: unknown): boolean {
  379:   const details = getErrorDetails(error);
  380:   const text = [
  381:     details.code,
  382:     details.type,
  383:     details.message,
  384:     details.error?.code,
  385:     details.error?.type,
  386:     details.error?.message,
  387:   ]
  388:     .filter(Boolean)
  389:     .join(" ")
  390:     .toLowerCase();
  391: 
  392:   return (
  393:     details.status === 429 ||
  394:     text.includes("insufficient_quota") ||
  395:     text.includes("exceeded your current quota") ||
  396:     text.includes("billing")
  397:   );
  398: }

  400: function successfulResponse({
  401:   message,
  402:   source,
  403:   action,
  404:   warning,
  405: }: {
  406:   message: string;
  407:   source: "ai" | "demo";
  408:   action?: AssistantAction;
  409:   warning?: string;
  410: }) {
  411:   return NextResponse.json({ message, source, action, warning });
  412: }
  413: 
  414: export async function POST(request: Request) {
  415:   try {
  416:     const body: unknown = await request.json();
  417: 
  418:     if (!isValidRequest(body)) {
  419:       return NextResponse.json(
  420:         {
  421:           error: "Invalid assistant request.",
  422:           errorCode: "invalid_request",
  423:         },
  424:         { status: 400 },
  425:       );
  426:     }
  427: 
  428:     const { message, mode, conversation, useDemo } = body;
  429:     const parsed = parseTeachingRequest(message, mode);
  430:     const action = createAction(parsed);
  431:     const apiKey = process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY;
  432: 
  433:     if (useDemo || !apiKey) {
  434:       return successfulResponse({
  435:         message: createDemoResponse(parsed),
  436:         source: "demo",
  437:         action,
  438:         warning: !apiKey
  439:           ? "Live AI is not configured, so a demo response was generated."
  440:           : undefined,
  441:       });
  442:     }
  443: 
  444:     try {
  445:       const openai = new OpenAI({ apiKey });
  446:       const model = process.env.OPENAI_ASSISTANT_MODEL || "gpt-5.6";
  447: 
  448:       const response = await openai.responses.create({
  449:         model,
  450:         instructions: [
  451:           "You are CS Master Copilot, an expert UK secondary Computer Science teaching assistant.",
  452:           "Use British English.",
  453:           "Give accurate, practical and classroom-ready support.",
  454:           "Use clear headings and concise sections.",
  455:           "Use correct Computer Science terminology.",
  456:           "Do not invent exam-board requirements.",
  457:           `The interpreted topic is: ${parsed.topic}.`,
  458:           `The interpreted qualification is: ${parsed.qualification}.`,
  459:           `The interpreted exam board is: ${parsed.examBoard}.`,
  460:           `The interpreted difficulty is: ${parsed.difficulty}.`,
  461:           getModeInstructions(mode),
  462:         ].join(" "),
  463:         input: [
  464:           ...conversation.map((item) => ({
  465:             role: item.role,
  466:             content: item.content,
  467:           })),
  468:           {
  469:             role: "user" as const,
  470:             content: message.trim(),
  471:           },
  472:         ],
  473:       });
  474: 
  475:       if (!response.output_text) {
  476:         return successfulResponse({
  477:           message: createDemoResponse(parsed),
  478:           source: "demo",
  479:           action,
  480:           warning:
  481:             "The live assistant returned no text, so a demo response was used.",
  482:         });
  483:       }
  484: 
  485:       return successfulResponse({
  486:         message: response.output_text,
  487:         source: "ai",
  488:         action,
  489:       });
  490:     } catch (aiError) {
  491:       console.error("Live assistant error:", aiError);
  492: 
  493:       const details = getErrorDetails(aiError);
  494:       let warning =
  495:         "The live assistant was unavailable. A demo response was generated instead.";
  496: 
  497:       if (isQuotaError(aiError)) {
  498:         warning =
  499:           "The OpenAI account currently has no available quota. A demo response was generated instead.";
  500:       } else if (details.status === 401) {
  501:         warning =
  502:           "The configured API key was rejected. A demo response was generated instead.";
  503:       }
  504: 
  505:       return successfulResponse({
  506:         message: createDemoResponse(parsed),
  507:         source: "demo",
  508:         action,
  509:         warning,
  510:       });
  511:     }
  512:   } catch (error) {
  513:     console.error("Assistant route error:", error);
  514: 
  515:     return NextResponse.json(
  516:       {
  517:         error: "The assistant request could not be processed.",
  518:         errorCode: "assistant_failed",
  519:       },
  520:       { status: 500 },
  521:     );
  522:   }
  523: }

 1383: function resolveTopicProfile(topic: string): TopicProfile {
 1384:   const matched = TOPIC_PROFILES.find((profile) =>
 1385:     profile.patterns.some((pattern) => pattern.test(topic)),
 1386:   );
 1387: 
 1388:   if (matched) {
 1389:     return matched;
 1390:   }
 1391: 
 1392:   return {
 1393:     id: "generic-computing",
 1394:     patterns: [],
 1395:     displayName: topic,
 1396:     definition: `${topic} is a Computer Science concept that should be defined using its purpose, main characteristics and relationship to a computing system or problem.`,
 1397:     explanation: `${topic} should be explained by identifying what it does, how it works, where it is used and the effect it has on data, software, hardware, users or a wider computing system.`,
 1398:     examples: [
 1399:       `a practical computing use of ${topic}`,
 1400:       `a scenario in which ${topic} solves or influences a problem`,
 1401:       `a comparison between ${topic} and an alternative approach`,
 1402:     ],
 1403:     benefits: [
 1404:       `a relevant advantage of ${topic} in the stated context`,
 1405:       "improved efficiency, accuracy, reliability, security or usability where technically appropriate",
 1406:       "support for solving the identified computing problem",
 1407:     ],
 1408:     limitations: [
 1409:       `a relevant technical or practical limitation of ${topic}`,
 1410:       "cost, complexity, security, reliability or usability constraints where appropriate",
 1411:       "dependence on correct design, implementation and testing",
 1412:     ],
 1413:     misconceptions: [
 1414:       `using the name ${topic} without explaining its technical meaning`,
 1415:       "giving a generic benefit without applying it to the question",
 1416:       "describing an example that does not demonstrate the concept",
 1417:     ],
 1418:     keywords: [
 1419:       "purpose",
 1420:       "process",
 1421:       "input",
 1422:       "output",
 1423:       "benefit",
 1424:       "limitation",
 1425:     ],
 1426:   };
 1427: }
 1428: 
 1429: function specificDefinition(topic: string): string {
 1430:   return resolveTopicProfile(topic).definition;
 1431: }
 1432: 
 1433: function specificExtendedAnswer(topic: string, contextLabel: string): string {
 1434:   const profile = resolveTopicProfile(topic);
 1435: 
 1436:   const benefitOne = profile.benefits[0];
 1437: 
 1438:   const benefitTwo = profile.benefits[1];
 1439: 
 1440:   const limitationOne = profile.limitations[0];
 1441: 
 1442:   const limitationTwo = profile.limitations[1];
 1443: 
 1444:   return `${topic} could be useful in ${contextLabel} because it can provide ${benefitOne}. It may also support ${benefitTwo}. For example, ${profile.examples[0]}.
 1445: 
 1446: However, ${limitationOne}. In addition, ${limitationTwo}. These limitations mean that the organisation should not adopt the approach without controls, testing and review.
 1447: 
 1448: A suitable alternative or safeguard is to introduce the system gradually, restrict access where appropriate, test it using representative data and maintain a fallback process. Staff or users should also receive guidance so that the technology is used correctly.
 1449: 
 1450: Overall, ${topic} should be used when its benefits clearly match the needs of ${contextLabel} and when the organisation can manage the identified risks. A controlled implementation with monitoring and regular review is more appropriate than unrestricted adoption.`;
 1451: }
 1452: 
 1453: function definitionForTopic(topic: string): string {
 1454:   return specificDefinition(topic);
 1455: }

 1866: function createProfileAwareDemoFallback(

 1954: function createConcreteDemoContent(
 1955:   item: AssessmentBlueprintItem,

 2237: function createDemoQuestionSet(request: RequestBody): GeneratedExamQuestionSet {
 2238:   const questionSetId = `${slugify(request.topic)}-${Date.now()}`;
 2239: 
 2240:   const totalMarks = request.blueprint.reduce(
 2241:     (sum, item) => sum + item.marks,
 2242:     0,
 2243:   );
 2244:

 2246:     id: questionSetId,

 2266: function normaliseMarkScheme(
 2267:   item: AssessmentBlueprintItem,
 2268:   markScheme: Array<{
 2269:     description: string;
 2270:     marks: number;
 2271:   }>,
 2272: ): ExamQuestionMarkPoint[] {
 2273:   const cleaned = markScheme
 2274:     .filter(
 2275:       (point) =>
 2276:         point.description.trim().length > 0 &&
 2277:         Number.isInteger(point.marks) &&
 2278:         point.marks >= 1,
 2279:     )
 2280:     .map((point, index) => ({
 2281:       id: `${item.id}-mark-${index + 1}`,
 2282:       description: point.description.trim(),
 2283:       marks: point.marks,
 2284:     }));
 2285: 
 2286:   if (cleaned.length === 0) {
 2287:     return createSpecificMarkScheme(item, [
 2288:       `Credit an accurate, relevant point about ${item.topicFocus}.`,
 2289:     ]);
 2290:   }
 2291: 
 2292:   const currentTotal = cleaned.reduce((sum, point) => sum + point.marks, 0);
 2293: 
 2294:   if (currentTotal === item.marks) {
 2295:     return cleaned;
 2296:   }
 2297: 
 2298:   return createSpecificMarkScheme(
 2299:     item,
 2300:     cleaned.map((point) => point.description),
 2301:   );
 2302: }
 2303: 
 2304: function normaliseLevels(
 2305:   item: AssessmentBlueprintItem,
 2306:   levels: Array<{
 2307:     level: number;
 2308:     markRange: string;
 2309:     description: string;
 2310:   }>,
 2311: ): ExamQuestionLevelDescriptor[] {
 2312:   if (item.marks < 6) {
 2313:     return [];
 2314:   }
 2315: 
 2316:   const cleaned = levels
 2317:     .filter(
 2318:       (level) =>
 2319:         Number.isInteger(level.level) &&
 2320:         level.level >= 1 &&
 2321:         level.markRange.trim().length > 0 &&
 2322:         level.description.trim().length > 0,
 2323:     )
 2324:     .map((level) => ({
 2325:       level: level.level,
 2326:       markRange: level.markRange.trim(),
 2327:       description: level.description.trim(),
 2328:     }));
 2329: 
 2330:   return cleaned.length > 0 ? cleaned : createLevelDescriptors(item.marks);
 2331: }

 2334: const LOW_QUALITY_QUESTION_PATTERNS: RegExp[] = [
 2335:   /\bconnected to\b/i,
 2336:   /\bcalculation involving\b/i,
 2337:   /\bteacher (?:may|should) edit\b/i,
 2338:   /\bteacher should insert\b/i,
 2339:   /\buse two original values suitable\b/i,
 2340:   /\bfinal published version should contain\b/i,
 2341:   /\bapply your knowledge of .+ to the original scenario provided\b/i,
 2342: ];
 2343: 
 2344: function hasLowQualityQuestionWording(value: string): boolean {
 2345:   const cleaned = value.trim();
 2346: 
 2347:   if (cleaned.length < 12) {
 2348:     return true;
 2349:   }
 2350: 
 2351:   return LOW_QUALITY_QUESTION_PATTERNS.some((pattern) =>
 2352:     pattern.test(cleaned),
 2353:   );
 2354: }
 2355: 
 2356: function isGeneratedQuestionUsable(
 2357:   item: AssessmentBlueprintItem,
 2358:   generated: ParsedQuestion,
 2359: ): boolean {
 2360:   if (
 2361:     hasLowQualityQuestionWording(generated.question) ||
 2362:     hasLowQualityQuestionWording(generated.context)
 2363:   ) {
 2364:     return false;
 2365:   }
 2366: 
 2367:   if (
 2368:     !generated.modelAnswer.trim() ||
 2369:     generated.modelAnswer.trim().length < 8
 2370:   ) {
 2371:     return false;
 2372:   }
 2373: 
 2374:   const markTotal = generated.markScheme.reduce(
 2375:     (sum, point) =>
 2376:       sum +
 2377:       (Number.isInteger(point.marks) && point.marks > 0
 2378:         ? point.marks
 2379:         : 0),
 2380:     0,
 2381:   );
 2382: 
 2383:   if (markTotal !== item.marks) {
 2384:     return false;
 2385:   }
 2386: 
 2387:   if (
 2388:     item.marks >= 6 &&
 2389:     generated.levelDescriptors.length === 0
 2390:   ) {
 2391:     return false;
 2392:   }
 2393: 
 2394:   if (
 2395:     item.marks < 6 &&
 2396:     generated.levelDescriptors.length > 0
 2397:   ) {
 2398:     return false;
 2399:   }
 2400: 
 2401:   return true;
 2402: }

 2404: function createTopicKnowledgePrompt(topic: string): string {

 2420: function buildQuestionSet(
 2421:   request: RequestBody,
 2422:   parsed: {
 2423:     title: string;
 2424:     description: string;
 2425:     estimatedTime: string;
 2426:     questions: ParsedQuestion[];
 2427:   },
 2428: ): GeneratedExamQuestionSet {
 2429:   const questionSetId = `${slugify(request.topic)}-${Date.now()}`;
 2430: 
 2431:   const questions = request.blueprint.map((item, index) => {
 2432:     const generated = parsed.questions[index];
 2433: 
 2434:     if (
 2435:       !generated ||
 2436:       !isGeneratedQuestionUsable(item, generated)
 2437:     ) {
 2438:       return createDemoQuestion(item, index);
 2439:     }
 2440: 
 2441:     return {
 2442:       id: `${questionSetId}-q-${index + 1}`,
 2443:       questionNumber: item.questionNumber,
 2444:       topic: item.topicFocus,
 2445:       questionType: item.questionType,
 2446:       commandWord: item.commandWord,
 2447:       question: generated.question.trim(),
 2448:       context: generated.context.trim(),
 2449:       marks: item.marks,
 2450:       difficulty: item.difficulty,
 2451:       assessmentObjective: item.assessmentObjective,
 2452:       markScheme: normaliseMarkScheme(item, generated.markScheme),
 2453:       levelDescriptors: normaliseLevels(item, generated.levelDescriptors),
 2454:       modelAnswer: generated.modelAnswer.trim(),
 2455:       examinerGuidance: generated.examinerGuidance,
 2456:       commonMisconceptions: generated.commonMisconceptions,
 2457:     } satisfies GeneratedExamQuestion;
 2458:   });
 2459: 
 2460:   const totalMarks = questions.reduce(
 2461:     (sum, question) => sum + question.marks,
 2462:     0,
 2463:   );
 2464: 
 2465:   return {
 2466:     id: questionSetId,
 2467:     title: parsed.title.trim(),
 2468:     description: parsed.description.trim(),
 2469:     qualification: request.qualification,
 2470:     examBoard: request.examBoard,
 2471:     topic: request.topic.trim(),
 2472:     difficulty: request.difficulty,
 2473:     generationMode: request.generationMode,
 2474:     questionCount: questions.length,
 2475:     totalMarks,
 2476:     estimatedTime:
 2477:       parsed.estimatedTime.trim() ||
 2478:       `${Math.max(10, Math.ceil(totalMarks * 1.2))} minutes`,
 2479:     copyrightNotice:
 2480:       "Independently generated practice material. It is not an official past-paper question and is not produced, endorsed or approved by any examination board.",
 2481:     blueprint: request.blueprint,
 2482:     questions,
 2483:     createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
 2484:   };
 2485: }

 2487: function createBlueprintPrompt(blueprint: AssessmentBlueprintItem[]): string {
 2488:   return blueprint
 2489:     .map((item) =>
 2490:       [
 2491:         `Question ${item.questionNumber}`,
 2492:         `Topic focus: ${item.topicFocus}`,
 2493:         `Assessment objective: ${item.assessmentObjective}`,
 2494:         `Question type: ${item.questionType}`,
 2495:         `Command word: ${item.commandWord}`,
 2496:         `Marks: ${item.marks}`,
 2497:         `Difficulty: ${item.difficulty}`,
 2498:       ].join("\n"),
 2499:     )
 2500:     .join("\n\n");
 2501: }

 2503: export async function POST(request: Request) {
 2504:   try {
 2505:     const body: unknown = await request.json();
 2506: 
 2507:     if (!isValidRequest(body)) {
 2508:       return NextResponse.json(
 2509:         {
 2510:           error: "Invalid assessment blueprint request.",
 2511:           errorCode: "invalid_request",
 2512:         },
 2513:         {
 2514:           status: 400,
 2515:         },
 2516:       );
 2517:     }
 2518: 
 2519:     const apiKey = process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY;
 2520: 
 2521:     if (body.useDemo || !apiKey) {
 2522:       return NextResponse.json({
 2523:         questionSet: createDemoQuestionSet(body),
 2524:         source: "demo",
 2525:         warning: !apiKey
 2526:           ? "Live AI is not configured, so a curriculum-aware offline paper was generated from the blueprint."
 2527:           : undefined,
 2528:       });
 2529:     }
 2530: 
 2531:     const openai = new OpenAI({
 2532:       apiKey,
 2533:     });

   39: function clamp(value: number, minimum: number, maximum: number): number {
   40:   return Math.min(maximum, Math.max(minimum, value));
   41: }
   42: 
   43: function normaliseString(value: unknown): string {
   44:   return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";

   47: function normaliseStringArray(value: unknown): string[] {
   48:   if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
   49:     return [];
   50:   }
   51: 
   52:   return value
   53:     .map((item) => {
   54:       if (item && typeof item === "object") {

   58:           normaliseString(candidate.description) ||
   59:           normaliseString(candidate.text) ||
   60:           normaliseString(candidate.point)
   61:         );
   62:       }
   63: 
   64:       return normaliseString(item);
   65:     })
   66:     .filter(Boolean);

   81: function normaliseAnswerText(value: string): string {

   90: function isNonAnswer(value: string): boolean {
   91:   const answer = normaliseAnswerText(value);
   92: 
   93:   if (!answer) {
   94:     return true;
   95:   }
   96:

   99:   const placeholders = new Set([
  100:     "na",
  101:     "none",
  102:     "noanswer",
  103:     "notanswered",
  104:     "notapplicable",
  105:     "idk",
  106:     "dontknow",
  107:     "idon'tknow",
  108:     "notsure",
  109:     "unsure",
  110:     "skip",
  111:     "skipped",
  112:     "blank",
  113:     "nil",
  114:     "unknown",
  115:     "noidea",
  116:   ]);
  117: 
  118:   if (placeholders.has(compact)) {
  119:     return true;
  120:   }
  121: 
  122:   return (
  123:     answer === "-" || answer === "--" || answer === "?" || answer === "..."
  124:   );

  143:     "from",
  144:     "give",
  145:     "into",
  146:     "marks",
  147:     "must",
  148:     "question",
  149:     "relevant",
  150:     "should",
  151:     "states",
  152:     "that",
  153:     "their",
  154:     "there",
  155:     "these",
  156:     "this",
  157:     "using",
  158:     "with",
  159:     "would",
  160:   ]);
  161: 
  162:   return Array.from(
  163:     new Set(
  164:       values
  165:         .join(" ")
  166:         .toLowerCase()
  167:         .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-]/g, " ")
  168:         .split(/\s+/)
  169:         .filter((word) => word.length >= 4 && !stopWords.has(word)),
  170:     ),
  171:   );
  172: }
  173: 
  174: function inferCorrectOption(question: RequestQuestion): string | null {
  175:   const source = [
  176:     ...getMarkSchemePoints(question.markScheme),
  177:     question.modelAnswer || "",
  178:   ].join(" ");
  179: 
  180:   const patterns = [
  181:     /(?:correct\s+answer|correct\s+option|answer|option|selecting|select)\s*(?:is|:|-)?\s*([a-d])\b/i,
  182:     /\b([a-d])\s+is\s+(?:the\s+)?correct\b/i,
  183:     /^\s*([a-d])[\).\s:-]/i,
  184:   ];
  185: 
  186:   for (const pattern of patterns) {
  187:     const match = source.match(pattern);
  188: 
  189:     if (match?.[1]) {
  190:       return match[1].toUpperCase();
  191:     }
  192:   }
  193: 
  194:   return null;
  195: }
  196: 
  197: function extractSelectedOption(response: string): string | null {
  198:   const cleaned = response.trim().toUpperCase();
  199: 
  200:   const match = cleaned.match(/^(?:OPTION\s*)?([A-D])(?:[\).\s:-]|$)/);
  201: 
  202:   return match?.[1] || null;
  203: }
  204: 
  205: function looksLikeMultipleChoice(question: RequestQuestion): boolean {
  206:   const questionType = normaliseString(question.questionType).toLowerCase();
  207: 
  208:   const prompt = question.question.toLowerCase();
  209: 
  210:   return (
  211:     questionType.includes("multiple") ||
  212:     questionType.includes("mcq") ||
  213:     /which option|select one answer|choose one answer/.test(prompt)
  214:   );
  215: }
  216: 
  217: function createNonAnswerSuggestion(
  218:   question: RequestQuestion,
  219: ): AIQuestionMarkingSuggestion {
  220:   const markPoints = getMarkSchemePoints(question.markScheme);
  221: 
  222:   return {
  223:     questionId: question.id,
  224:     questionNumber: question.questionNumber,
  225:     suggestedMarks: 0,
  226:     maximumMarks: question.marks,
  227:     confidence: "high",
  228:     matchedMarkPoints: [],
  229:     missedMarkPoints:
  230:       markPoints.length > 0
  231:         ? markPoints
  232:         : ["No assessable response was provided."],
  233:     evidenceFromResponse: [],
  234:     feedback:
  235:       "No assessable answer was provided. Attempt the question and use the command word and mark allocation to structure the response.",
  236:     teacherReviewRequired: false,
  237:   };
  238: }
  239: 
  240: function createMultipleChoiceSuggestion(
  241:   question: RequestQuestion,
  242:   response: string,
  243: ): AIQuestionMarkingSuggestion | null {
  244:   const correctOption = inferCorrectOption(question);
  245: 
  246:   const selectedOption = extractSelectedOption(response);
  247: 
  248:   if (!correctOption || !selectedOption) {
  249:     return null;
  250:   }
  251: 
  252:   const isCorrect = selectedOption === correctOption;
  253: 
  254:   return {
  255:     questionId: question.id,
  256:     questionNumber: question.questionNumber,
  257:     suggestedMarks: isCorrect ? question.marks : 0,
  258:     maximumMarks: question.marks,
  259:     confidence: "high",
  260:     matchedMarkPoints: isCorrect ? [`Selected option ${correctOption}.`] : [],
  261:     missedMarkPoints: isCorrect
  262:       ? []
  263:       : [
  264:           `The correct option is ${correctOption}; the response selected ${selectedOption}.`,
  265:         ],
  266:     evidenceFromResponse: [`The student selected option ${selectedOption}.`],
  267:     feedback: isCorrect
  268:       ? "Correct. The selected option matches the answer identified by the mark scheme."
  269:       : `The selected option is incorrect. Review why option ${correctOption} best answers the question.`,
  270:     teacherReviewRequired: false,
  271:   };
  272: }
  273: 
  274: function demoSuggestion(
  275:   question: RequestQuestion,
  276:   answer: RequestAnswer | undefined,
  277: ): AIQuestionMarkingSuggestion {
  278:   const response = normaliseString(answer?.response);
  279: 
  280:   if (isNonAnswer(response)) {
  281:     return createNonAnswerSuggestion(question);
  282:   }
  283: 
  284:   if (looksLikeMultipleChoice(question)) {
  285:     const mcqSuggestion = createMultipleChoiceSuggestion(question, response);
  286: 
  287:     if (mcqSuggestion) {
  288:       return mcqSuggestion;
  289:     }
  290:   }
  291: 
  292:   const markPoints = getMarkSchemePoints(question.markScheme);
  293: 
  294:   const lowerResponse = response.toLowerCase();
  295: 
  296:   const matchedMarkPoints = markPoints.filter((point) => {
  297:     const pointKeywords = extractKeywords([point]);
  298: 
  299:     if (pointKeywords.length === 0) {
  300:       return false;
  301:     }
  302: 
  303:     const matchedCount = pointKeywords.filter((keyword) =>
  304:       lowerResponse.includes(keyword),
  305:     ).length;
  306: 
  307:     return matchedCount >= Math.min(2, pointKeywords.length);
  308:   });
  309: 
  310:   const missedMarkPoints = markPoints.filter(
  311:     (point) => !matchedMarkPoints.includes(point),
  312:   );
  313: 
  314:   const modelKeywords = extractKeywords([question.modelAnswer || ""]);
  315: 
  316:   const matchedModelKeywords = modelKeywords.filter((keyword) =>
  317:     lowerResponse.includes(keyword),
  318:   );
  319: 
  320:   const wordCount = response.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
  321: 
  322:   /*
  323:    * Demo marking is intentionally conservative:
  324:    * - no marks are awarded purely for writing a longer answer;
  325:    * - at least one question-specific marking point or several model-answer
  326:    *   keywords must be matched before any credit is suggested.
  327:    */
  328:   const hasRelevantEvidence =
  329:     matchedMarkPoints.length > 0 || matchedModelKeywords.length >= 2;
  330: 
  331:   let suggestedMarks = 0;
  332: 
  333:   if (hasRelevantEvidence) {
  334:     if (markPoints.length > 0) {
  335:       suggestedMarks = clamp(matchedMarkPoints.length, 0, question.marks);
  336: 
  337:       /*
  338:        * A developed response may receive one additional provisional mark
  339:        * only when it already matches a marking point and contains enough
  340:        * relevant model-answer vocabulary.
  341:        */
  342:       if (
  343:         suggestedMarks < question.marks &&
  344:         matchedMarkPoints.length > 0 &&
  345:         matchedModelKeywords.length >= 3 &&
  346:         wordCount >= question.marks * 5
  347:       ) {
  348:         suggestedMarks += 1;
  349:       }
  350:     } else {
  351:       const relevanceRatio =
  352:         matchedModelKeywords.length / Math.max(modelKeywords.length, 1);
  353: 
  354:       suggestedMarks =
  355:         relevanceRatio >= 0.5
  356:           ? Math.max(1, Math.round(relevanceRatio * question.marks))
  357:           : 0;
  358:     }
  359:   }
  360: 
  361:   suggestedMarks = clamp(suggestedMarks, 0, question.marks);
  362: 
  363:   const confidence: AIMarkingConfidence =
  364:     suggestedMarks === 0 && !hasRelevantEvidence
  365:       ? "medium"
  366:       : question.marks <= 2
  367:         ? "medium"
  368:         : "low";
  369: 
  370:   return {
  371:     questionId: question.id,
  372:     questionNumber: question.questionNumber,
  373:     suggestedMarks,
  374:     maximumMarks: question.marks,
  375:     confidence,
  376:     matchedMarkPoints,
  377:     missedMarkPoints,
  378:     evidenceFromResponse: matchedModelKeywords
  379:       .slice(0, 4)
  380:       .map((keyword) => `The response uses the relevant term ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…â€œ${keyword}ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚Â.`),
  381:     feedback:
  382:       suggestedMarks === question.marks
  383:         ? "The response appears to address the available marking points. Confirm the accuracy and development before accepting full marks."
  384:         : suggestedMarks === 0
  385:           ? "The response does not yet match a clear question-specific marking point. Use the model answer and mark scheme to add precise, relevant content."
  386:           : "The response addresses some relevant content, but it needs more precise development and clearer links to the remaining mark-scheme points.",
  387:     teacherReviewRequired: true,
  388:   };
  389: }
  390: 
  391: function getFallbackMessage(
  392:   reason: DemoFallbackReason,
  393:   totalSuggested: number,
  394:   totalAvailable: number,
  395: ): string {
  396:   const score = `${totalSuggested}/${totalAvailable}`;
  397: 
  398:   switch (reason) {
  399:     case "selected":
  400:       return `Demo marking was selected. The provisional demo score is ${score}. Demo marking is heuristic, so review every suggestion against the question-specific mark scheme before finalising.`;
  401: 
  402:     case "missing_api_key":
  403:       return `No live AI key was available, so demo marking was used. The provisional demo score is ${score}. Review every suggestion before finalising.`;
  404: 
  405:     case "quota":
  406:       return `Live AI marking was unavailable because the API quota was exhausted, so demo marking was used automatically. The provisional demo score is ${score}. Review every suggestion before finalising.`;
  407: 
  408:     case "rate_limit":
  409:       return `Live AI marking was temporarily rate-limited, so demo marking was used automatically. The provisional demo score is ${score}. Review every suggestion before finalising.`;
  410: 
  411:     default:
  412:       return `Live AI marking was unavailable, so demo marking was used automatically. The provisional demo score is ${score}. Review every suggestion before finalising.`;
  413:   }
  414: }
  415: 
  416: function createDemoResult(
  417:   body: RequestBody,
  418:   reason: DemoFallbackReason,
  419: ): AIExamMarkingResult {
  420:   const answersByQuestion = new Map(
  421:     body.answers.map((answer) => [answer.questionId, answer]),
  422:   );
  423: 
  424:   const suggestions = body.questions.map((question) =>
  425:     demoSuggestion(question, answersByQuestion.get(question.id)),
  426:   );
  427: 
  428:   const totalSuggested = suggestions.reduce(
  429:     (sum, suggestion) => sum + suggestion.suggestedMarks,
  430:     0,
  431:   );
  432: 
  433:   const totalAvailable = suggestions.reduce(
  434:     (sum, suggestion) => sum + suggestion.maximumMarks,
  435:     0,
  436:   );
  437: 
  438:   return {
  439:     mode: "demo",
  440:     suggestions,
  441:     overallFeedback: getFallbackMessage(reason, totalSuggested, totalAvailable),
  442:     strengths: suggestions
  443:       .filter(
  444:         (suggestion) => suggestion.suggestedMarks > suggestion.maximumMarks / 2,
  445:       )
  446:       .slice(0, 3)
  447:       .map(
  448:         (suggestion) =>
  449:           `Question ${suggestion.questionNumber}: relevant knowledge was demonstrated.`,
  450:       ),
  451:     priorities: suggestions
  452:       .filter(
  453:         (suggestion) => suggestion.suggestedMarks < suggestion.maximumMarks,
  454:       )
  455:       .slice(0, 3)
  456:       .map(
  457:         (suggestion) =>
  458:           `Question ${suggestion.questionNumber}: address the missed marking points and use more precise evidence.`,
  459:       ),
  460:   };
  461: }
  462: 
  463: function buildPrompt(body: RequestBody): string {
  464:   const payload = body.questions.map((question) => {
  465:     const answer = body.answers.find((item) => item.questionId === question.id);
  466: 
  467:     return {
  468:       id: question.id,
  469:       questionNumber: question.questionNumber,
  470:       question: question.question,
  471:       context: question.context || "",
  472:       maximumMarks: question.marks,
  473:       assessmentObjective: question.assessmentObjective || "",
  474:       questionType: question.questionType || "",
  475:       commandWord: question.commandWord || "",
  476:       markScheme: getMarkSchemePoints(question.markScheme),
  477:       modelAnswer: question.modelAnswer || "",
  478:       examinerGuidance: getExaminerGuidance(question.examinerGuidance),
  479:       studentResponse: answer?.response || "",
  480:     };
  481:   });
  482: 
  483:   return `
  484: You are an experienced UK Computer Science examiner assisting a teacher.
  485: 
  486: Mark each response only against the supplied question, maximum marks, mark scheme, model answer and examiner guidance.
  487: 
  488: Requirements:
  489: - Treat blank answers and placeholders such as "n/a", "na", "idk", "not sure", "-", "none" and "no answer" as non-responses worth 0 marks.
  490: - Never award more than the maximum marks.
  491: - Do not invent content that is not present in the student's answer.
  492: - Give credit for valid equivalent wording.
  493: - For multiple-choice questions, credit only the correct selected option.
  494: - For calculations, code and objective questions, check accuracy carefully.
  495: - For extended responses, consider development, application, balance and conclusion where the supplied mark scheme requires them.
  496: - Use low confidence for borderline, ambiguous or highly subjective decisions.
  497: - teacherReviewRequired must be true for low-confidence decisions, all responses worth 6 or more marks, and any answer where the mark scheme cannot be applied reliably.
  498: - Feedback must be addressed to the student and must explain how to improve.
  499: - Return JSON only.
  500: 
  501: Assignment: ${body.assignmentTitle}
  502: Topic: ${body.topic}
  503: 
  504: Questions and responses:
  505: ${JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)}
  506: 
  507: Return this exact JSON structure:
  508: {
  509:   "suggestions": [
  510:     {
  511:       "questionId": "string",
  512:       "questionNumber": 1,
  513:       "suggestedMarks": 0,
  514:       "maximumMarks": 1,
  515:       "confidence": "high | medium | low",
  516:       "matchedMarkPoints": ["string"],
  517:       "missedMarkPoints": ["string"],
  518:       "evidenceFromResponse": ["string"],
  519:       "feedback": "string",
  520:       "teacherReviewRequired": true
  521:     }
  522:   ],
  523:   "overallFeedback": "string",
  524:   "strengths": ["string"],
  525:   "priorities": ["string"]
  526: }
  527: `.trim();
  528: }

  530: function parseLiveResult(text: string, body: RequestBody): AIExamMarkingResult {
  531:   const parsed = JSON.parse(text) as {
  532:     suggestions?: unknown;
  533:     overallFeedback?: unknown;
  534:     strengths?: unknown;
  535:     priorities?: unknown;
  536:   };
  537: 
  538:   if (!Array.isArray(parsed.suggestions)) {
  539:     throw new Error("The AI response did not contain marking suggestions.");
  540:   }
  541: 
  542:   const questionById = new Map(
  543:     body.questions.map((question) => [question.id, question]),
  544:   );
  545: 
  546:   const answerByQuestion = new Map(
  547:     body.answers.map((answer) => [answer.questionId, answer]),
  548:   );
  549: 
  550:   const suggestions = parsed.suggestions
  551:     .map((item): AIQuestionMarkingSuggestion | null => {
  552:       if (!item || typeof item !== "object") {
  553:         return null;
  554:       }
  555: 
  556:       const candidate = item as Record<string, unknown>;
  557: 
  558:       const questionId = normaliseString(candidate.questionId);
  559: 
  560:       const question = questionById.get(questionId);
  561: 
  562:       if (!question) {
  563:         return null;
  564:       }
  565: 
  566:       const answer = answerByQuestion.get(questionId);
  567: 
  568:       /*
  569:        * The server enforces zero for placeholders even if a live model
  570:        * mistakenly awards credit.
  571:        */
  572:       if (isNonAnswer(answer?.response || "")) {
  573:         return createNonAnswerSuggestion(question);
  574:       }
  575: 
  576:       const confidenceValue = normaliseString(candidate.confidence);
  577: 
  578:       const confidence: AIMarkingConfidence =
  579:         confidenceValue === "high" ||
  580:         confidenceValue === "medium" ||
  581:         confidenceValue === "low"
  582:           ? confidenceValue
  583:           : "low";
  584: 
  585:       return {
  586:         questionId,
  587:         questionNumber: question.questionNumber,
  588:         suggestedMarks: clamp(
  589:           Number(candidate.suggestedMarks) || 0,
  590:           0,
  591:           question.marks,
  592:         ),
  593:         maximumMarks: question.marks,
  594:         confidence,
  595:         matchedMarkPoints: normaliseStringArray(candidate.matchedMarkPoints),
  596:         missedMarkPoints: normaliseStringArray(candidate.missedMarkPoints),
  597:         evidenceFromResponse: normaliseStringArray(
  598:           candidate.evidenceFromResponse,
  599:         ),
  600:         feedback:
  601:           normaliseString(candidate.feedback) ||
  602:           "Review this response against the mark scheme.",
  603:         teacherReviewRequired:
  604:           candidate.teacherReviewRequired === true ||
  605:           confidence === "low" ||
  606:           question.marks >= 6,
  607:       };
  608:     })
  609:     .filter((item): item is AIQuestionMarkingSuggestion => item !== null);
  610: 
  611:   return {
  612:     mode: "live",
  613:     suggestions,
  614:     overallFeedback: normaliseString(parsed.overallFeedback),
  615:     strengths: normaliseStringArray(parsed.strengths),
  616:     priorities: normaliseStringArray(parsed.priorities),
  617:   };
  618: }
  619: 
  620: function isQuotaError(error: unknown): boolean {
  621:   if (!error || typeof error !== "object") {
  622:     return false;
  623:   }
  624: 
  625:   const candidate = error as {
  626:     status?: unknown;
  627:     code?: unknown;
  628:     type?: unknown;
  629:     error?: {
  630:       code?: unknown;
  631:       type?: unknown;
  632:     };
  633:   };
  634: 
  635:   return (
  636:     candidate.status === 429 &&
  637:     (candidate.code === "insufficient_quota" ||
  638:       candidate.type === "insufficient_quota" ||
  639:       candidate.error?.code === "insufficient_quota" ||
  640:       candidate.error?.type === "insufficient_quota")
  641:   );
  642: }
  643: 
  644: function isRateLimitError(error: unknown): boolean {
  645:   if (!error || typeof error !== "object") {
  646:     return false;
  647:   }
  648: 
  649:   const candidate = error as {
  650:     status?: unknown;
  651:   };
  652: 
  653:   return candidate.status === 429;
  654: }
  655: 
  656: export async function POST(request: Request) {
  657:   try {
  658:     const body = (await request.json()) as RequestBody;
  659: 
  660:     if (
  661:       !body ||
  662:       !Array.isArray(body.questions) ||
  663:       !Array.isArray(body.answers)
  664:     ) {
  665:       return NextResponse.json(
  666:         {
  667:           error: "A valid exam submission is required.",
  668:         },
  669:         {
  670:           status: 400,
  671:         },
  672:       );
  673:     }
  674: 
  675:     const forceDemo = process.env.AI_MARKING_DEMO_MODE === "true";
  676: 
  677:     if (forceDemo) {
  678:       return NextResponse.json(createDemoResult(body, "selected"));
  679:     }
  680: 
  681:     const apiKey = process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY;
  682: 
  683:     if (!apiKey) {
  684:       return NextResponse.json(
  685:         {
  686:           error:
  687:             "Live AI marking is not configured. Demo marking is available only when AI_MARKING_DEMO_MODE=true.",
  688:         },
  689:         { status: 503 },
  690:       );
  691:     }
  692: 
  693:     try {
  694:       const client = new OpenAI({
  695:         apiKey,
  696:       });
  697: 
  698:       const completion = await client.chat.completions.create({
  699:         model: process.env.OPENAI_MARKING_MODEL || "gpt-4.1-mini",
  700:         temperature: 0.1,
  701:         response_format: {
  702:           type: "json_object",
  703:         },
  704:         messages: [
  705:           {
  706:             role: "system",
  707:             content:
  708:               "You are a careful UK Computer Science examiner. Return valid JSON only.",
  709:           },
  710:           {
  711:             role: "user",
  712:             content: buildPrompt(body),
  713:           },
  714:         ],
  715:       });
  716: 
  717:       const output = completion.choices[0]?.message.content;
  718: 
  719:       if (!output) {
  720:         throw new Error("The AI marking service returned no content.");
  721:       }
  722: 
  723:       return NextResponse.json(parseLiveResult(output, body));
  724:     } catch (liveError) {
  725:       console.error(
  726:         "Live AI marking unavailable; using demo fallback:",
  727:         liveError,
  728:       );
  729: 
  730:       const reason: DemoFallbackReason = isQuotaError(liveError)
  731:         ? "quota"
  732:         : isRateLimitError(liveError)
  733:           ? "rate_limit"
  734:           : "live_error";
  735: 
  736:       return NextResponse.json(createDemoResult(body, reason));
  737:     }
  738:   } catch (error) {
  739:     console.error("AI exam marking route error:", error);
  740: 
  741:     return NextResponse.json(
  742:       {
  743:         error:
  744:           error instanceof Error
  745:             ? error.message
  746:             : "The submission could not be marked.",
  747:       },
  748:       {
  749:         status: 500,
  750:       },
  751:     );
  752:   }
  753: }

   44: function isNonAnswer(value: string): boolean {
   45:   const answer = normalise(value);
   46:   const compact = answer.replace(/\s+/g, "");
   47: 
   48:   return (
   49:     !answer ||
   50:     [
   51:       "na",
   52:       "none",
   53:       "noanswer",

   55:       "dontknow",
   56:       "notsure",
   57:       "skip",
   58:       "blank",
   59:       "unknown",
   60:       "noidea",
   61:     ].includes(compact)
   62:   );
   63: }
   64: 
   65: function extractKeywords(values: string[]): string[] {
   66:   const stopWords = new Set([
   67:     "about",
   68:     "after",
   69:     "again",
   70:     "answer",
   71:     "because",
   72:     "computer",
   73:     "correct",
   74:     "describe",
   75:     "explain",
   76:     "from",
   77:     "into",
   78:     "question",
   79:     "should",
   80:     "that",
   81:     "their",
   82:     "these",
   83:     "this",
   84:     "using",
   85:     "with",
   86:   ]);
   87: 
   88:   return Array.from(
   89:     new Set(
   90:       values
   91:         .join(" ")
   92:         .toLowerCase()
   93:         .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, " ")
   94:         .split(/\s+/)
   95:         .filter((word) => word.length >= 4 && !stopWords.has(word)),
   96:     ),
   97:   );
   98: }
   99: 
  100: function demoResult(
  101:   body: RequestBody,
  102:   reason: FallbackReason,
  103: ): LessonExamMarkingResult {
  104:   const maximumMarks = Math.max(1, body.maximumMarks);
  105: 
  106:   if (isNonAnswer(body.studentResponse)) {
  107:     return {
  108:       mode: "demo",
  109:       awardedMarks: 0,
  110:       maximumMarks,
  111:       percentage: 0,
  112:       confidence: "high",
  113:       matchedPoints: [],
  114:       missingPoints: body.markScheme?.length
  115:         ? body.markScheme
  116:         : ["No assessable response was provided."],
  117:       feedback:
  118:         "No assessable response was provided. Attempt the question and use the mark allocation to decide how much detail is required.",
  119:       improvedAnswer: body.modelAnswer,
  120:       teacherReviewRequired: false,
  121:       markedAt: new Date(),
  122:     };
  123:   }
  124: 
  125:   const points = body.markScheme?.length
  126:     ? body.markScheme
  127:     : body.modelAnswer
  128:         .split(/[.;]\s*/)
  129:         .map((point) => point.trim())
  130:         .filter(Boolean);
  131: 
  132:   const response = normalise(body.studentResponse);
  133:   const matchedPoints = points.filter((point) => {
  134:     const pointKeywords = extractKeywords([point]);
  135:     if (pointKeywords.length === 0) return false;
  136: 
  137:     const matchedCount = pointKeywords.filter((keyword) =>
  138:       response.includes(keyword),
  139:     ).length;
  140: 
  141:     return matchedCount >= Math.min(2, pointKeywords.length);
  142:   });
  143: 
  144:   const missingPoints = points.filter(
  145:     (point) => !matchedPoints.includes(point),
  146:   );
  147: 
  148:   const modelKeywords = extractKeywords([body.modelAnswer]);
  149:   const matchedModelKeywords = modelKeywords.filter((keyword) =>
  150:     response.includes(keyword),
  151:   );
  152: 
  153:   const relevant = matchedPoints.length > 0 || matchedModelKeywords.length >= 2;
  154: 
  155:   let awardedMarks = 0;
  156: 
  157:   if (relevant) {
  158:     awardedMarks = clamp(matchedPoints.length, 0, maximumMarks);
  159: 
  160:     if (
  161:       awardedMarks < maximumMarks &&
  162:       matchedPoints.length > 0 &&
  163:       matchedModelKeywords.length >= 3 &&
  164:       body.studentResponse.trim().split(/\s+/).length >= maximumMarks * 5
  165:     ) {
  166:       awardedMarks += 1;
  167:     }
  168:   }
  169: 
  170:   awardedMarks = clamp(awardedMarks, 0, maximumMarks);
  171:   const percentage = Math.round((awardedMarks / maximumMarks) * 100);
  172: 
  173:   const fallbackMessage =
  174:     reason === "quota"
  175:       ? "Live AI marking quota was unavailable, so conservative demo marking was used."
  176:       : reason === "rate_limit"
  177:         ? "Live AI marking was rate-limited, so conservative demo marking was used."
  178:         : reason === "missing_api_key"
  179:           ? "No live AI key was available, so conservative demo marking was used."
  180:           : reason === "selected"
  181:             ? "Demo marking mode is enabled."
  182:             : "Live AI marking was unavailable, so conservative demo marking was used.";
  183: 
  184:   return {
  185:     mode: "demo",
  186:     awardedMarks,
  187:     maximumMarks,
  188:     percentage,
  189:     confidence: maximumMarks <= 2 ? "medium" : "low",
  190:     matchedPoints,
  191:     missingPoints,
  192:     feedback: `${fallbackMessage} ${
  193:       awardedMarks === maximumMarks
  194:         ? "The response appears to cover the available marking points."
  195:         : awardedMarks === 0
  196:           ? "The response does not yet match a clear question-specific marking point."
  197:           : "The response includes some relevant knowledge but needs greater precision and development."
  198:     }`,
  199:     improvedAnswer: body.modelAnswer,
  200:     teacherReviewRequired: true,
  201:     markedAt: new Date(),
  202:   };
  203: }
  204: 
  205: function buildPrompt(body: RequestBody): string {
  206:   return `
  207: You are an experienced UK GCSE Computer Science examiner.
  208: 
  209: Mark the response only against the supplied question, maximum marks, mark scheme,
  210: model answer and guidance.
  211: 
  212: Rules:
  213: - Blank answers and placeholders such as n/a, idk, not sure, none and no answer receive 0.
  214: - Never award marks for answer length alone.
  215: - Never invent content not present in the student's response.
  216: - Accept technically valid equivalent wording.
  217: - Never award more than the maximum marks.
  218: - Return JSON only.
  219: 
  220: Topic: ${body.topic}
  221: Lesson: ${body.lessonTitle}
  222: Question: ${body.question}
  223: Maximum marks: ${body.maximumMarks}
  224: Mark scheme: ${JSON.stringify(body.markScheme ?? [])}
  225: Model answer: ${body.modelAnswer}
  226: Guidance: ${JSON.stringify(body.guidance ?? [])}
  227: Student response: ${body.studentResponse}
  228: 
  229: Return:
  230: {
  231:   "awardedMarks": 0,
  232:   "confidence": "high | medium | low",
  233:   "matchedPoints": ["string"],
  234:   "missingPoints": ["string"],
  235:   "feedback": "string",
  236:   "improvedAnswer": "string",
  237:   "teacherReviewRequired": true
  238: }
  239: `.trim();
  240: }
  241: 
  242: function parseLiveResult(
  243:   text: string,
  244:   body: RequestBody,
  245: ): LessonExamMarkingResult {
  246:   if (isNonAnswer(body.studentResponse)) {
  247:     return demoResult(body, "selected");
  248:   }
  249: 
  250:   const parsed = JSON.parse(text) as Record<string, unknown>;
  251:   const maximumMarks = Math.max(1, body.maximumMarks);
  252:   const awardedMarks = clamp(Number(parsed.awardedMarks) || 0, 0, maximumMarks);
  253: 
  254:   const confidenceValue = clean(parsed.confidence);
  255:   const confidence: LessonExamMarkingConfidence =
  256:     confidenceValue === "high" ||
  257:     confidenceValue === "medium" ||
  258:     confidenceValue === "low"
  259:       ? confidenceValue
  260:       : "low";
  261: 
  262:   return {
  263:     mode: "live",
  264:     awardedMarks,
  265:     maximumMarks,
  266:     percentage: Math.round((awardedMarks / maximumMarks) * 100),
  267:     confidence,
  268:     matchedPoints: cleanArray(parsed.matchedPoints),
  269:     missingPoints: cleanArray(parsed.missingPoints),
  270:     feedback:
  271:       clean(parsed.feedback) || "Review the response against the mark scheme.",
  272:     improvedAnswer: clean(parsed.improvedAnswer) || body.modelAnswer,
  273:     teacherReviewRequired:
  274:       parsed.teacherReviewRequired === true ||
  275:       confidence === "low" ||
  276:       maximumMarks >= 6,
  277:     markedAt: new Date(),
  278:   };
  279: }
  280: 
  281: function isQuotaError(error: unknown): boolean {
  282:   if (!error || typeof error !== "object") return false;
  283: 
  284:   const candidate = error as {
  285:     status?: unknown;
  286:     code?: unknown;
  287:     type?: unknown;
  288:     error?: { code?: unknown; type?: unknown };
  289:   };
  290: 
  291:   return (
  292:     candidate.status === 429 &&
  293:     (candidate.code === "insufficient_quota" ||
  294:       candidate.type === "insufficient_quota" ||
  295:       candidate.error?.code === "insufficient_quota" ||
  296:       candidate.error?.type === "insufficient_quota")
  297:   );
  298: }
  299: 
  300: export async function POST(request: Request) {
  301:   try {
  302:     const body = (await request.json()) as RequestBody;
  303: 
  304:     if (
  305:       !body ||
  306:       !clean(body.question) ||
  307:       !clean(body.studentResponse) ||
  308:       !Number.isFinite(body.maximumMarks)
  309:     ) {
  310:       return NextResponse.json(
  311:         { error: "A valid lesson exam response is required." },
  312:         { status: 400 },
  313:       );
  314:     }
  315: 
  316:     if (process.env.AI_MARKING_DEMO_MODE === "true") {
  317:       return NextResponse.json(demoResult(body, "selected"));
  318:     }
  319: 
  320:     const apiKey = process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY;
  321: 
  322:     if (!apiKey) {
  323:       return NextResponse.json(
  324:         {
  325:           error:
  326:             "Live AI marking is not configured. Demo marking is available only when AI_MARKING_DEMO_MODE=true.",
  327:         },
  328:         { status: 503 },
  329:       );
  330:     }
  331: 
  332:     try {
  333:       const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey });
  334:       const completion = await client.chat.completions.create({
  335:         model: process.env.OPENAI_MARKING_MODEL || "gpt-4.1-mini",
  336:         temperature: 0.1,
  337:         response_format: { type: "json_object" },
  338:         messages: [
  339:           {
  340:             role: "system",
  341:             content:
  342:               "You are a careful UK GCSE Computer Science examiner. Return valid JSON only.",
  343:           },
  344:           { role: "user", content: buildPrompt(body) },
  345:         ],
  346:       });
  347: 
  348:       const output = completion.choices[0]?.message.content;
  349: 
  350:       if (!output) {
  351:         throw new Error("The marking service returned no content.");
  352:       }
  353: 
  354:       return NextResponse.json(parseLiveResult(output, body));
  355:     } catch (liveError) {
  356:       console.error(
  357:         "Live lesson marking unavailable:",
  358:         liveError,
  359:       );
  360: 
  361:       const reason: FallbackReason = isQuotaError(liveError)
  362:         ? "quota"
  363:         : (liveError as { status?: unknown })?.status === 429
  364:           ? "rate_limit"
  365:           : "live_error";
  366: 
  367:       return NextResponse.json(
  368:         {
  369:           error:
  370:             reason === "quota"
  371:               ? "Live AI marking is temporarily unavailable because the configured API quota has been exhausted."
  372:               : reason === "rate_limit"
  373:                 ? "Live AI marking is temporarily rate-limited. Please try again shortly."
  374:                 : "Live AI marking is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.",
  375:         },
  376:         { status: 503 },
  377:       );
  378:     }
  379:   } catch (error) {
  380:     console.error("Lesson marking route error:", error);
  381: 
  382:     return NextResponse.json(
  383:       {
  384:         error:
  385:           error instanceof Error
  386:             ? error.message
  387:             : "The lesson answer could not be marked.",
  388:       },
  389:       { status: 500 },
  390:     );
  391:   }
  392: }

  104: async function verifyFirebaseStudent(
  105:   request: Request,
  106:   studentId: string,

  108:   | { ok: true }

  360: function prompt(body: Body) {
  361:   return `You are CS Master, a supportive UK secondary Computer Science tutor.
  362: 
  363: Student context:
  364: ${JSON.stringify(body.context, null, 2)}
  365: 
  366: Recent conversation:
  367: ${JSON.stringify(body.history.slice(-8), null, 2)}
  368: 
  369: Student message:
  370: ${body.message}
  371: 
  372: Use clear UK English.
  373: Teach through explanation and checking questions.
  374: Do not give unexplained answers to assessed work.
  375: Do not help the learner bypass assessment integrity controls.
  376: Never claim predicted grades are official or guaranteed.
  377: Use only the supplied student context for personal performance claims.
  378: Do not invent exam-board requirements.
  379: Keep under 350 words.
  380: Return JSON only:
  381: {"reply":"string","suggestedPrompts":["string"],"recommendations":[{"title":"string","description":"string","href":"string","type":"lesson|quiz|exam"}]}`;
  382: }
  383: 
  384: export async function POST(
  385:   request: Request,
  386: ) {
  387:   try {
  388:     const rawBody: unknown =
  389:       await request.json();
  390: 
  391:     if (!isValidBody(rawBody)) {
  392:       return NextResponse.json(
  393:         {
  394:           error:
  395:             "A valid tutor request is required.",
  396:         },
  397:         { status: 400 },
  398:       );
  399:     }
  400: 
  401:     const body = rawBody;
  402: 
  403:     const verified =
  404:       await verifyFirebaseStudent(
  405:         request,
  406:         body.studentId,
  407:       );
  408: 
  409:     if (!verified.ok) {
  410:       return NextResponse.json(
  411:         {
  412:           error: verified.error,
  413:         },
  414:         {
  415:           status: verified.status,
  416:         },
  417:       );
  418:     }
  419: 
  420:     if (
  421:       process.env
  422:         .AI_STUDENT_TUTOR_DEMO_MODE ===
  423:       "true"
  424:     ) {
  425:       return NextResponse.json(
  426:         demo(
  427:           body,
  428:           "Demo tutor mode is enabled.",
  429:         ),
  430:       );
  431:     }
  432: 
  433:     const key =
  434:       process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY;
  435: 
  436:     if (!key) {
  437:       return NextResponse.json(
  438:         {
  439:           error:
  440:             "AI Tutor is temporarily unavailable because live AI is not configured.",
  441:         },
  442:         { status: 503 },
  443:       );
  444:     }
  445: 
  446:     try {
  447:       const client =
  448:         new OpenAI({
  449:           apiKey: key,
  450:         });
  451: 
  452:       const completion =
  453:         await client.chat.completions.create(
  454:           {
  455:             model:
  456:               process.env
  457:                 .OPENAI_STUDENT_TUTOR_MODEL ||
  458:               "gpt-4.1-mini",
  459:             temperature: 0.3,
  460:             response_format: {
  461:               type: "json_object",
  462:             },
  463:             messages: [
  464:               {
  465:                 role: "system",
  466:                 content:
  467:                   "You are a careful UK secondary Computer Science tutor. Return valid JSON only.",
  468:               },
  469:               {
  470:                 role: "user",
  471:                 content: prompt(body),
  472:               },
  473:             ],
  474:           },
  475:         );
  476: 
  477:       const text =
  478:         completion.choices[0]?.message
  479:           .content;
  480: 
  481:       if (!text) {
  482:         throw new Error(
  483:           "No tutor response.",
  484:         );
  485:       }
  486: 
  487:       const parsed =
  488:         JSON.parse(text) as {
  489:           reply?: unknown;
  490:           suggestedPrompts?: unknown;
  491:           recommendations?: unknown;
  492:         };
  493: 
  494:       const reply =
  495:         clean(parsed.reply).slice(
  496:           0,
  497:           6000,
  498:         );
  499: 
  500:       if (!reply) {
  501:         throw new Error(
  502:           "The tutor returned an invalid response.",
  503:         );
  504:       }
  505: 
  506:       return NextResponse.json({
  507:         reply,
  508:         mode: "live",
  509:         suggestedPrompts:
  510:           safeSuggestedPrompts(
  511:             parsed.suggestedPrompts,
  512:           ),
  513:         recommendations:
  514:           safeRecommendations(
  515:             parsed.recommendations,
  516:           ),
  517:       } satisfies TutorResponse);
  518:     } catch (error) {
  519:       console.error(
  520:         "Live tutor unavailable:",
  521:         error,
  522:       );
  523: 
  524:       return NextResponse.json(
  525:         {
  526:           error:
  527:             "AI Tutor is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.",
  528:         },
  529:         { status: 503 },
  530:       );
  531:     }
  532:   } catch (error) {
  533:     console.error(
  534:       "Tutor route error:",
  535:       error,
  536:     );
  537: 
  538:     return NextResponse.json(
  539:       {
  540:         error:
  541:           error instanceof Error
  542:             ? error.message
  543:             : "The tutor could not respond.",
  544:       },
  545:       { status: 500 },
  546:     );
  547:   }
  548: }

    6: function present(name: string): boolean {
    7:   return Boolean(process.env[name]?.trim());
    8: }

   10: export async function GET() {
   11:   const firebaseClient =
   12:     present("NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_API_KEY") &&
   13:     present("NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN") &&
   14:     present("NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID") &&
   15:     present("NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_APP_ID");
   16: 
   17:   const firebaseAdmin =
   18:     present("GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS") ||
   19:     (
   20:       present("FIREBASE_ADMIN_PROJECT_ID") &&
   21:       present("FIREBASE_ADMIN_CLIENT_EMAIL") &&
   22:       present("FIREBASE_ADMIN_PRIVATE_KEY_BASE64")
   23:     );
   24: 
   25:   const checks = {
   26:     app: true,
   27:     firebaseClient,
   28:     firebaseAdmin,
   29:     openAI: present("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
   30:   };
   31: 
   32:   const ready = Object.values(checks).every(Boolean);
   33: 
   34:   return NextResponse.json(
   35:     {
   36:       service: "cs-master",
   37:       status: ready ? "ready" : "degraded",
   38:       checks,
   39:       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
   40:     },
   41:     {
   42:       status: ready ? 200 : 503,
   43:       headers: {
   44:         "Cache-Control": "no-store",
   45:       },
   46:     },
   47:   );
   48: }

   56:   id: string;
   57:   title: string;

   59:   topic: string;
   60:   yearGroup: string;

   78: function isResourceType(value: unknown): value is ResourceType {
   79:   return (
   80:     typeof value === "string" && RESOURCE_TYPES.includes(value as ResourceType)
   81:   );
   82: }
   83: 
   84: function isDifficultyLevel(value: unknown): value is DifficultyLevel {
   85:   return (
   86:     typeof value === "string" &&
   87:     DIFFICULTY_LEVELS.includes(value as DifficultyLevel)
   88:   );
   89: }
   90: 
   91: function isValidRequest(value: unknown): value is GenerateResourceRequest {
   92:   if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
   93:     return false;
   94:   }
   95: 
   96:   const request = value as Partial<GenerateResourceRequest>;
   97: 
   98:   return (
   99:     isResourceType(request.resourceType) &&
  100:     typeof request.topic === "string" &&
  101:     request.topic.trim().length >= 2 &&
  102:     request.topic.trim().length <= 150 &&
  103:     typeof request.yearGroup === "string" &&
  104:     request.yearGroup.trim().length > 0 &&
  105:     request.yearGroup.trim().length <= 50 &&
  106:     typeof request.examBoard === "string" &&
  107:     request.examBoard.trim().length > 0 &&
  108:     request.examBoard.trim().length <= 50 &&
  109:     typeof request.duration === "number" &&
  110:     Number.isInteger(request.duration) &&
  111:     request.duration >= 5 &&
  112:     request.duration <= 180 &&
  113:     isDifficultyLevel(request.difficulty) &&
  114:     typeof request.objectives === "string" &&
  115:     request.objectives.length <= 1500 &&
  116:     typeof request.additionalNotes === "string" &&
  117:     request.additionalNotes.length <= 2000
  118:   );
  119: }
  120: 
  121: function createResourceId(topic: string): string {
  122:   const slug = topic
  123:     .trim()
  124:     .toLowerCase()
  125:     .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
  126:     .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "")
  127:     .slice(0, 60);
  128: 
  129:   return `${slug || "resource"}-${Date.now()}`;
  130: }

  558: 
  559:     return NextResponse.json({ resource });
  560:   } catch (error) {
  561:     console.error("AI teaching resource generation error:", error);
  562: 
  563:     if (error instanceof SyntaxError) {
  564:       return NextResponse.json(
  565:         {
  566:           error:
  567:             "The generated resource could not be processed. Please try again.",
  568:         },
  569:         { status: 502 },
  570:       );
  571:     }
  572: 
  573:     return NextResponse.json(
  574:       {
  575:         error:
  576:           error instanceof Error
  577:             ? error.message
  578:             : "The teaching resource could not be generated.",
  579:       },
  580:       { status: 500 },
  581:     );
  582:   }
  583: }

  657:                 >

  665:               </>

  667:           </section>

  167: function matchesFilter(
  168:   assignment: UnifiedAssignment,
  169:   filter: AssignmentFilter,
  170: ): boolean {
  171:   if (filter === "all") return true;
  172:   if (filter === "overdue") {
  173:     return isUnifiedAssignmentOverdue(
  174:       assignment,
  175:     );
  176:   }
  177:   if (filter === "resources") {
  178:     return (
  179:       assignment.kind === "resource"
  180:     );
  181:   }
  182:   if (filter === "quizzes") {
  183:     return assignment.kind === "quiz";
  184:   }
  185:   if (filter === "exams") {
  186:     return assignment.kind === "exam";
  187:   }
  188:   if (filter === "programming") {
  189:     return (
  190:       assignment.kind ===
  191:       "programming"
  192:     );
  193:   }
  194:   if (filter === "completed") {
  195:     return isUnifiedAssignmentComplete(
  196:       assignment,
  197:     );
  198:   }
  199:   if (filter === "submitted") {
  200:     return (
  201:       assignment.kind === "exam" &&
  202:       (assignment.status ===
  203:         "submitted" ||
  204:         assignment.status ===
  205:           "marking")
  206:     );
  207:   }
  208: 
  209:   return (
  210:     assignment.status === filter
  211:   );
  212: }

  371: export default function StudentAssignmentsPage() {
  372:   const { user } = useAuth();
  373: 
  374:   const [assignments, setAssignments] =
  375:     useState<UnifiedAssignment[]>([]);
  376:   const [loading, setLoading] =
  377:     useState(true);
  378:   const [error, setError] =
  379:     useState("");
  380:   const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] =
  381:     useState("");
  382:   const [filter, setFilter] =
  383:     useState<AssignmentFilter>("all");
  384: 
  385:   const loadAssignments =
  386:     useCallback(async () => {
  387:       await Promise.resolve();
  388: 
  389:       if (!user?.uid) {
  390:         setAssignments([]);
  391:         setLoading(false);
  392:         return;
  393:       }
  394: 
  395:       try {
  396:         setLoading(true);
  397:         setError("");
  398: 
  399:         setAssignments(
  400:           await getUnifiedStudentAssignments(
  401:             user.uid,
  402:           ),
  403:         );
  404:       } catch (loadError) {
  405:         console.error(
  406:           "Unable to load student assignments:",
  407:           loadError,
  408:         );
  409: 
  410:         setAssignments([]);
  411: 
  412:         setError(
  413:           loadError instanceof Error
  414:             ? loadError.message
  415:             : "Your assignments could not be loaded.",
  416:         );
  417:       } finally {
  418:         setLoading(false);
  419:       }
  420:     }, [user]);
  421: 
  422:   useEffect(() => {
  423:     void Promise.resolve().then(() => loadAssignments());
  424:   }, [loadAssignments]);
  425: 
  426:   const filteredAssignments =
  427:     useMemo(() => {
  428:       const search =
  429:         searchTerm
  430:           .trim()
  431:           .toLowerCase();
  432: 
  433:       return assignments.filter(
  434:         (assignment) => {
  435:           const matchesSearch =
  436:             !search ||
  437:             assignment.title
  438:               .toLowerCase()
  439:               .includes(search) ||
  440:             assignment.topic
  441:               .toLowerCase()
  442:               .includes(search) ||
  443:             assignment.className
  444:               .toLowerCase()
  445:               .includes(search) ||
  446:             assignment.teacherName
  447:               .toLowerCase()
  448:               .includes(search) ||
  449:             assignment.resourceType
  450:               .toLowerCase()
  451:               .includes(search);
  452: 
  453:           return (
  454:             matchesFilter(
  455:               assignment,
  456:               filter,
  457:             ) && matchesSearch
  458:           );
  459:         },
  460:       );
  461:     }, [
  462:       assignments,
  463:       filter,
  464:       searchTerm,
  465:     ]);
  466: 
  467:   const summary = useMemo(
  468:     () => ({
  469:       total: assignments.length,
  470:       resources: assignments.filter(
  471:         (item) =>
  472:           item.kind === "resource",
  473:       ).length,
  474:       quizzes: assignments.filter(
  475:         (item) =>
  476:           item.kind === "quiz",
  477:       ).length,
  478:       exams: assignments.filter(
  479:         (item) =>
  480:           item.kind === "exam",
  481:       ).length,
  482:       programming:
  483:         assignments.filter(
  484:           (item) =>
  485:             item.kind ===
  486:             "programming",
  487:         ).length,
  488:       notStarted:
  489:         assignments.filter(
  490:           (item) =>
  491:             item.status ===
  492:             "not_started",
  493:         ).length,
  494:       inProgress:
  495:         assignments.filter(
  496:           (item) =>
  497:             item.status ===
  498:             "in_progress",
  499:         ).length,
  500:       submitted:
  501:         assignments.filter(
  502:           (item) =>
  503:             item.kind === "exam" &&
  504:             (item.status ===
  505:               "submitted" ||
  506:               item.status ===
  507:                 "marking"),
  508:         ).length,
  509:       completed:
  510:         assignments.filter(
  511:           isUnifiedAssignmentComplete,
  512:         ).length,
  513:       overdue:
  514:         assignments.filter(
  515:           isUnifiedAssignmentOverdue,
  516:         ).length,
  517:     }),
  518:     [assignments],
  519:   );
  520: 
  521:   if (loading) {
  522:     return (
  523:       <main className="flex min-h-[70vh] items-center justify-center px-6 py-10">
  524:         <div className="text-center">
  525:           <Loader2 className="mx-auto h-10 w-10 animate-spin text-blue-600" />
  526: 
  527:           <p className="mt-4 font-semibold text-slate-600">
  528:             Loading your assignments...
  529:           </p>
  530:         </div>

    1: "use client";

   15:   const router = useRouter();
   16: 
   17:   const {
   18:     user,
   19:     profile,
   20:     refreshProfile,
   21:   } = useAuth();
   22: 
   23:   const [code, setCode] =
   24:     useState("");
   25: 
   26:   const [joining, setJoining] =
   27:     useState(false);
   28: 
   29:   async function handleJoin() {
   30:     if (!user?.uid) {
   31:       toast.error(
   32:         "Sign in before joining a school.",
   33:       );
   34:       return;
   35:     }
   36: 
   37:     try {
   38:       setJoining(true);
   39: 
   40:       const result =
   41:         await acceptSchoolInvite({
   42:           code,
   43:           userId: user.uid,
   44:         });
   45: 
   46:       const refreshed =
   47:         await refreshProfile();
   48: 
   49:       toast.success(
   50:         "You have joined the school successfully.",

   54:         refreshed?.role === "teacher" ||
   55:         result.role === "teacher"
   56:       ) {
   57:         router.replace(
   58:           "/teacher/school",
   59:         );
   60:       } else {
   61:         router.replace(
   62:           "/dashboard",
   63:         );
   64:       }
   65:     } catch (error) {
   66:       console.error(
   67:         "Unable to join school:",
   68:         error,
   69:       );
   70: 
   71:       toast.error(
   72:         error instanceof Error
   73:           ? error.message
   74:           : "You could not join the school.",
   75:       );
   76:     } finally {
   77:       setJoining(false);
   78:     }
   79:   }
   80: 
   81:   if (profile?.schoolId) {
   82:     return (
   83:       <div className="mx-auto max-w-2xl">
   84:         <Card className="rounded-3xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 p-8">
   85:           <p className="text-sm font-black uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-emerald-700">
   86:             School membership active

   90:             You already belong to a school
   91:           </h1>
   92: 
   93:           <p className="mt-3 leading-7 text-emerald-800">
   94:             Your account is already attached to a CS Master school organisation.
   95:             A transfer workflow will be added separately rather than allowing one
   96:             join code to silently move you between schools.
   97:           </p>
   98:         </Card>
   99:       </div>
  100:     );
  101:   }
  102: 
  103:   return (
  104:     <div className="mx-auto max-w-2xl space-y-6">
  105:       <Card className="rounded-3xl border border-blue-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-50 to-indigo-50 p-8">
  106:         <p className="text-sm font-black uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-blue-700">

  144:           />
