   21: 
   22: function getLoginMessage(
   23:   error: unknown,
   24: ): string {
   25:   if (
   26:     !error ||
   27:     typeof error !== "object"
   28:   ) {
   29:     return "Login failed. Check your email and password.";
   30:   }
   31: 
   32:   const code =
   33:     "code" in error &&
   34:     typeof error.code === "string"
   35:       ? error.code
   36:       : "";
   37: 
   38:   switch (code) {
   39:     case "auth/invalid-credential":
   40:     case "auth/user-not-found":
   41:     case "auth/wrong-password":
   42:       return "The email address or password is incorrect.";
   43: 
   44:     case "auth/invalid-email":
   45:       return "Please enter a valid email address.";
   46: 
   47:     case "auth/too-many-requests":
   48:       return "Too many login attempts. Please try again later.";
   49: 
   50:     case "auth/network-request-failed":
   51:       return "Firebase could not be reached. Check your internet connection.";
   52: 
   53:     default:
   54:       return error instanceof Error
   55:         ? error.message
   56:         : "Login failed. Check your email and password.";
   57:   }
   58: }
   59: 
   60: export default function LoginPage() {
   61:   const router = useRouter();
   62: 
   63:   const [email, setEmail] =
   64:     useState("");
   65: 
   66:   const [password, setPassword] =
   67:     useState("");
   68: 
   69:   const [
   70:     submitting,
   71:     setSubmitting,
   72:   ] = useState(false);
   73: 
   74:   const [error, setError] =
   75:     useState("");
   76: 
   77:   async function handleLogin(
   78:     event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>,
   79:   ) {
   80:     event.preventDefault();
   81: 
   82:     setSubmitting(true);
   83:     setError("");
   84: 
   85:     try {
   86:       const cleanedEmail =
   87:         email

   92:         await loginUser(
   93:           cleanedEmail,
   94:           password,
   95:         );
   96: 
   97:       const uid =
   98:         userCredential.user.uid;
   99: 
  100:       const profileSnapshot =
  101:         await getDoc(
  102:           doc(
  103:             db,
  104:             "users",
  105:             uid,
  106:           ),
  107:         );
  108: 
  109:       if (
  110:         !profileSnapshot.exists()
  111:       ) {
  112:         throw new Error(
  113:           "Your user profile could not be found.",
  114:         );
  115:       }
  116: 
  117:       /*
  118:        * Use the raw Firestore profile here because login routing
  119:        * happens before AuthContext has necessarily refreshed.
  120:        */
  121:       const profile = {
  122:         uid,
  123:         ...profileSnapshot.data(),
  124:       } as UserProfile;
  125: 
  126:       if (
  127:         profile.role === "admin"
  128:       ) {
  129:         router.replace("/admin");
  130:         return;
  131:       }
  132: 
  133:       if (
  134:         profile.role === "teacher"
  135:       ) {
  136:         router.replace("/teacher");
  137:         return;
  138:       }
  139: 
  140:       /*
  141:        * IMPORTANT:
  142:        * Teacher applicants remain role="student" until approved,
  143:        * so accountIntent must be checked before student onboarding.

  145:       if (

  164:       }
  165: 
  166:       router.replace(

  168:       );
  169:     } catch (caughtError) {

  171:         getLoginMessage(
  172:           caughtError,
  173:         );
  174: 
  175:       setError(message);
  176: 
  177:       const code =
  178:         caughtError &&
  179:         typeof caughtError ===
  180:           "object" &&
  181:         "code" in
  182:           caughtError &&
  183:         typeof caughtError.code ===
  184:           "string"
  185:           ? caughtError.code
  186:           : "";
  187: 
  188:       const expectedAuthenticationErrors =

    3: import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
    4: import {
    5:   useRouter,
    6:   useSearchParams,
    7: } from "next/navigation";
    8: import {
    9:   doc,
   10:   getDoc,
   11: } from "firebase/firestore";
   12: 
   13: import QuizPlayer from "@/components/quiz/QuizPlayer";
   14: import Card from "@/components/ui/Card";
   15: import Button from "@/components/ui/Button";
   16: import Skeleton from "@/components/ui/Skeleton";
   17: 
   18: import { useAuth } from "@/contexts/AuthContext";
   19: 
   20: import { curriculumRegistry } from "@/data/curriculum/curriculumRegistry";
   21: 
   22: import {
   23:   getCurriculumQuizByTopic,
   24:   getCurriculumQuizzes,
   25:   getCurriculumTopicsWithoutQuizzes,
   26: } from "@/data/quizzes/quizRegistry";
   27: 
   28: import { db } from "@/lib/firebase";
   29: 
   30: import type { Quiz } from "@/types/quiz";
   31: import type {
   32:   ExamBoard,
   33:   Qualification,
   34: } from "@/types/user";
   35: 
   36: type SavedQuizQuestion = {
   37:   id?: string;
   38:   type?: string;
   39:   question?: string;
   40:   options?: string[];
   41:   correctAnswer?: string;
   42:   explanation?: string;
   43:   xpReward?: number;
   44: };
   45: 
   46: function normaliseLookupValue(
   47:   value: string,
   48: ): string {
   49:   return value
   50:     .trim()
   51:     .toLowerCase()
   52:     .replace(/&/g, "and")
   53:     .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, " ")
   54:     .trim();
   55: }
   56: 
   57: /*
   58:  * Query strings may contain either:
   59:  *
   60:  *   /quiz?topic=binary
   61:  *
   62:  * or a human-readable adaptive-learning topic:
   63:  *
   64:  *   /quiz?topic=Binary%20Numbers
   65:  *
   66:  * Resolve both forms through the canonical curriculum registry.
   67:  */
   68: function resolveCurriculumTopicId(
   69:   value: string,
   70: ): string | null {
   71:   const cleaned =
   72:     normaliseLookupValue(value);
   73: 
   74:   if (!cleaned) {
   75:     return null;
   76:   }
   77: 
   78:   const match =
   79:     curriculumRegistry.find(
   80:       (topic) => {
   81:         const searchable = [
   82:           topic.id,
   83:           topic.title,
   84:           ...(topic.aliases || []),
   85:         ].map(
   86:           normaliseLookupValue,
   87:         );
   88: 
   89:         return searchable.includes(
   90:           cleaned,
   91:         );
   92:       },
   93:     );
   94: 
   95:   return match?.id || null;
   96: }
   97: 
   98: export default function QuizPage() {
   99:   const router = useRouter();
  100:   const searchParams =
  101:     useSearchParams();
  102: 
  103:   const {
  104:     profile,
  105:     loading: authLoading,
  106:     profileReady,
  107:   } = useAuth();
  108: 
  109:   const topicParam =
  110:     searchParams.get("topic");
  111: 
  112:   const assignmentId =
  113:     searchParams.get(
  114:       "assignment",
  115:     );
  116: 
  117:   const [
  118:     selectedQuizId,
  119:     setSelectedQuizId,
  120:   ] = useState<
  121:     string | null
  122:   >(null);
  123: 
  124:   const [
  125:     generatedQuiz,
  126:     setGeneratedQuiz,
  127:   ] = useState<Quiz | null>(
  128:     null,
  129:   );
  130: 
  131:   const [
  132:     loadingGeneratedQuiz,
  133:     setLoadingGeneratedQuiz,
  134:   ] = useState(false);
  135: 
  136:   const [
  137:     loadError,
  138:     setLoadError,
  139:   ] = useState("");
  140: 
  141:   const qualification =
  142:     profile?.qualification as
  143:       | Qualification
  144:       | undefined;
  145: 
  146:   const examBoard =
  147:     profile?.examBoard as
  148:       | ExamBoard
  149:       | undefined;
  150: 
  151:   /*
  152:    * The visible Quiz Centre is now derived from the
  153:    * student's selected curriculum.
  154:    */
  155:   const curriculumQuizzes =
  156:     useMemo(() => {
  157:       if (
  158:         !qualification ||
  159:         !examBoard

  162:       }
  163: 
  164:       return getCurriculumQuizzes(
  165:         qualification,

  167:       );
  168:     }, [
  169:       qualification,
  170:       examBoard,

  172: 
  173:   /*

  188:         qualification,
  189:         examBoard,
  190:       );
  191:     }, [
  192:       qualification,
  193:       examBoard,
  194:     ]);
  195: 
  196:   const builtInQuiz =
  197:   selectedQuizId &&
  198:   qualification &&
  199:   examBoard
  200:     ? getCurriculumQuizByTopic(
  201:         selectedQuizId,
  202:         qualification,
  203:         examBoard,
  204:       )
  205:     : null;
  206: 
  207:   const selectedQuiz =
  208:     generatedQuiz ||
  209:     builtInQuiz;
  210: 
  211:   useEffect(() => {
  212:     if (
  213:       authLoading ||
  214:       !profileReady
  215:     ) {
  216:       return;
  217:     }
  218: 
  219:     if (!topicParam) {
  220:       void Promise.resolve().then(() => {
  221:         setGeneratedQuiz(null);
  222:         setSelectedQuizId(
  223:           null,
  224:         );
  225:         setLoadError("");
  226:       });
  227:       return;
  228:     }
  229: 
  230:     /*
  231:      * ----------------------------------------------------------
  232:      * BUILT-IN CURRICULUM QUIZ
  233:      * ----------------------------------------------------------
  234:      *
  235:      * Resolve both canonical topic IDs and human-readable topic
  236:      * names/aliases.
  237:      */
  238:     const resolvedTopicId =
  239:       resolveCurriculumTopicId(
  240:         topicParam,
  241:       );
  242: 
  243:     if (
  244:       resolvedTopicId &&
  245:       qualification &&
  246:       examBoard
  247:     ) {
  248:       const curriculumQuiz =
  249:         getCurriculumQuizByTopic(
  250:           resolvedTopicId,
  251:           qualification,
  252:           examBoard,
  253:         );
  254: 
  255:       if (curriculumQuiz) {
  256:         void Promise.resolve().then(() => {
  257:           setSelectedQuizId(
  258:             resolvedTopicId,
  259:           );
  260: 
  261:           setGeneratedQuiz(
  262:             null,
  263:           );
  264: 
  265:           setLoadError("");
  266:         });
  267: 
  268:         return;
  269:       }
  270:     }
  271: 
  272:     /*
  273:      * ----------------------------------------------------------
  274:      * GENERATED / TEACHER-ASSIGNED QUIZ
  275:      * ----------------------------------------------------------
  276:      *
  277:      * A generated quiz does not have to exist in quizLibrary.
  278:      * Its Firestore document ID is supplied through ?topic=.
  279:      *
  280:      * This preserves the existing teacher assignment workflow.
  281:      */
  282:     let cancelled =
  283:       false;
  284: 
  285:     async function loadGeneratedQuiz() {
  286:       setLoadingGeneratedQuiz(
  287:         true,
  288:       );
  289: 
  290:       setLoadError("");
  291: 
  292:       setSelectedQuizId(
  293:         null,
  294:       );
  295: 
  296:       try {
  297:         const quizSnapshot =
  298:           await getDoc(
  299:             doc(
  300:               db,
  301:               "generatedQuizzes",
  302:               topicParam as string,
  303:             ),
  304:           );
  305: 
  306:         if (cancelled) {
  307:           return;
  308:         }
  309: 
  310:         if (
  311:           !quizSnapshot.exists()
  312:         ) {
  313:           setGeneratedQuiz(
  314:             null,
  315:           );
  316: 
  317:           /*
  318:            * If this looked like a genuine curriculum topic but
  319:            * no built-in quiz exists yet, give the learner a
  320:            * meaningful message rather than pretending a generated
  321:            * quiz should exist.
  322:            */
  323:           if (
  324:             resolvedTopicId
  325:           ) {
  326:             setLoadError(
  327:               "A quiz for this curriculum topic has not been published yet.",
  328:             );
  329:           } else {
  330:             setLoadError(
  331:               "The assigned quiz could not be found.",
  332:             );
  333:           }
  334: 
  335:           return;
  336:         }
  337: 
  338:         const data =
  339:           quizSnapshot.data();
  340:

  342:           SavedQuizQuestion[] =

  348:

  352:               (question) =>
  353:                 typeof question.question ===

  356:                   question.options,
  357:                 ) &&
  358:                 typeof question.correctAnswer ===
  359:                   "string",
  360:             )
  361:             .map(
  362:               (

  365:               ) => ({
  366:                 id:
  367:                   question.id ||
  368:                   `${quizSnapshot.id}-question-${index + 1}`,
  369: 
  370:                 type:
  371:                   "multipleChoice" as const,
  372: 
  373:                 question:
  374:                   question.question ||
  375:                   `Question ${index + 1}`,
  376: 
  377:                 options:
  378:                   question.options ||
  379:                   [],
  380: 
  381:                 correctAnswer:
  382:                   question.correctAnswer ||
  383:                   "",
  384: 
  385:                 explanation:
  386:                   question.explanation ||
  387:                   "Review this topic with your teacher.",
  388: 
  389:                 xpReward:
  390:                   typeof question.xpReward ===
  391:                   "number"
  392:                     ? question.xpReward
  393:                     : 10,
  394:               }),
  395:             );
  396: 
  397:         if (
  398:           questions.length ===
  399:           0
  400:         ) {
  401:           setGeneratedQuiz(
  402:             null,
  403:           );
  404: 
  405:           setLoadError(
  406:             "This quiz does not contain any valid questions.",
  407:           );
  408: 
  409:           return;
  410:         }
  411: 
  412:         const loadedQuiz:
  413:           Quiz = {
  414:           id:
  415:             quizSnapshot.id,
  416: 
  417:           /*
  418:            * Prefer stored curriculum metadata if the generated
  419:            * quiz has it. Fall back to the document ID for legacy
  420:            * generated quizzes.
  421:            */
  422:           topicId:
  423:             typeof data.topicId ===
  424:               "string" &&
  425:             data.topicId.trim()
  426:               ? data.topicId.trim()
  427:               : quizSnapshot.id,
  428: 
  429:           title:
  430:             typeof data.title ===
  431:               "string" &&
  432:             data.title.trim()
  433:               ? data.title.trim()
  434:               : "AI Generated Quiz",
  435: 
  436:           description:
  437:             typeof data.description ===
  438:               "string" &&
  439:             data.description.trim()
  440:               ? data.description.trim()
  441:               : "Complete this quiz assigned by your teacher.",
  442: 
  443:           estimatedTime:
  444:             typeof data.estimatedTime ===
  445:               "string" &&
  446:             data.estimatedTime.trim()
  447:               ? data.estimatedTime.trim()
  448:               : "10 minutes",
  449: 
  450:           questions,
  451:         };
  452: 
  453:         setGeneratedQuiz(
  454:           loadedQuiz,
  455:         );
  456:       } catch (error) {
  457:         console.error(
  458:           "Failed to load generated quiz:",
  459:           error,
  460:         );
  461: 
  462:         if (!cancelled) {
  463:           setGeneratedQuiz(
  464:             null,
  465:           );
  466: 
  467:           setLoadError(
  468:             "The assigned quiz could not be loaded.",
  469:           );
  470:         }
  471:       } finally {
  472:         if (!cancelled) {
  473:           setLoadingGeneratedQuiz(
  474:             false,
  475:           );
  476:         }
  477:       }
  478:     }
  479: 
  480:     void loadGeneratedQuiz();
  481: 
  482:     return () => {
  483:       cancelled = true;
  484:     };
  485:   }, [
  486:     topicParam,
  487:     qualification,
  488:     examBoard,
  489:     authLoading,
  490:     profileReady,
  491:   ]);
  492: 
  493:   function selectBuiltInQuiz(
  494:     topicId: string,
  495:   ) {
  496:     if (
  497:       !qualification ||
  498:       !examBoard
  499:     ) {
  500:       return;

  502: 
  503:     const quiz =
  504:       getCurriculumQuizByTopic(
  505:         topicId,
  506:         qualification,
  507:         examBoard,
  508:       );
  509: 
  510:     if (!quiz) {
  511:       setLoadError(
  512:         "This quiz is not available for your selected curriculum.",
  513:       );
  514: 
  515:       return;
  516:     }

  518:     setSelectedQuizId(
  519:       topicId,
  520:     );
  521: 
  522:     setGeneratedQuiz(null);
  523: 
  524:     setLoadError("");

  526:     router.push(
  527:       `/quiz?topic=${encodeURIComponent(
  528:         topicId,
  529:       )}`,
  530:     );
  531:   }

  709:               {examBoard} Â·{" "}

  764:                   â±{" "}

  786:             ),

  788:         </div>
  789:       )}
  790: 
  791:       {unpublishedQuizTopics.length >
  792:         0 && (

  799:             More quizzes are coming

   16: function getRegistrationMessage(
   17:   error: unknown,
   18: ): string {
   19:   if (!error || typeof error !== "object") {
   20:     return "Registration failed. Please check your details.";
   21:   }
   22: 
   23:   const code =
   24:     "code" in error &&
   25:     typeof error.code === "string"
   26:       ? error.code
   27:       : "";
   28: 
   29:   switch (code) {
   30:     case "auth/email-already-in-use":
   31:       return "An account already exists for this email address.";
   32: 
   33:     case "auth/invalid-email":
   34:       return "Please enter a valid email address.";

   41: 
   42:     default:
   43:       return error instanceof Error

   45:         : "Registration failed. Please check your details.";
   46:   }

    1: "use client";
    2: import Link from "next/link";
    3: import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
    4: import Card from "@/components/ui/Card";
    5: import Skeleton from "@/components/ui/Skeleton";
    6: import RevisionPlanCard from "@/components/revision-plan/RevisionPlanCard";
    7: import { useAuth } from "@/contexts/AuthContext";
    8: import { getStudentInterventions } from "@/services/interventionService";
    9: import type { Intervention } from "@/types/intervention";
   10: export default function RevisionPlanPage() {
   11:   const { user } = useAuth();
   12:   const userId = user?.uid;
   13:   const [items, setItems] = useState<Intervention[]>([]);
   14:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
   15: 
   16:   const load = useCallback(() => {
   17:     if (!userId) {
   18:       return Promise.resolve();
   19:     }
   20: 
   21:     return Promise.resolve()
   22:       .then(() => {
   23:         setLoading(true);
   24:         return getStudentInterventions(userId);
   25:       })
   26:       .then((loadedItems) => {
   27:         setItems(loadedItems);
   28:       })
   29:       .finally(() => {
   30:         setLoading(false);
   31:       });
   32:   }, [userId]);
   33: 
   34:   useEffect(() => {
   35:     void load();
   36:   }, [load]);
   37:   if (loading)
   38:     return (
   39:       <div className="space-y-6">
   40:         <Skeleton className="h-48" />
   41:         <Skeleton className="h-96" />
   42:       </div>
   43:     );
   44:   const active = items.filter((i) => i.status === "active");
   45:   const completed = items.filter((i) => i.status === "completed");
   46:   return (
   47:     <div className="space-y-8">
   48:       <Card className="border-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900 to-teal-800 text-white">
   49:         <div className="flex flex-col gap-6 md:flex-row md:justify-between">
   50:           <div>
   51:             <p className="text-sm font-bold uppercase text-teal-100">
   52:               Personalised learning
   53:             </p>
   54:             <h1 className="mt-2 text-4xl font-black">Revision Plan</h1>

   56:               Complete your targeted lesson, quiz and exam-practice steps.
   57:             </p>
   58:           </div>
   59:           <div className="flex gap-3">
   60:             <Link
   61:               href="/assignments"
   62:               className="rounded-xl border border-white/20 px-5 py-3 font-bold"
   63:             >
   64:               Assignments
   65:             </Link>
   66:             <Link
   67:               href="/dashboard"
   68:               className="rounded-xl border border-white/20 px-5 py-3 font-bold"
   69:             >
   70:               Dashboard
   71:             </Link>
   72:           </div>
   73:         </div>
   74:       </Card>
   75:       {active.length ? (
   76:         <div className="space-y-6">
   77:           {active.map((i) => (
   78:             <RevisionPlanCard
   79:               key={i.id}
   80:               intervention={i}

    2: 
    3: import Link from "next/link";

    5: import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
    6: import {
    7:   AlertTriangle,

    9:   FileText,
   10:   Target,
   11: } from "lucide-react";
   12: 
   13: import RichAnalyticsOverview from "@/components/analytics/RichAnalyticsOverview";

   17: import Skeleton from "@/components/ui/Skeleton";

   19: import { getTeacherStudentAnalytics } from "@/services/analytics/teacherAnalyticsService";
   20: import type { TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow } from "@/types/teacherAnalytics";
   21: 
   22: export default function TeacherStudentAnalyticsPage() {
   23:   const params = useParams<{
   24:     studentId: string;
   25:   }>();
   26: 
   27:   const studentId = params.studentId;
   28: 
   29:   const {
   30:     user,
   31:     profile,
   32:     loading: authLoading,
   33:   } = useAuth();
   34: 
   35:   const [row, setRow] =
   36:     useState<TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow | null>(
   37:       null,
   38:     );
   39: 
   40:   const [loading, setLoading] =
   41:     useState(true);
   42: 
   43:   const [error, setError] =
   44:     useState("");
   45: 
   46:   const [refreshKey, setRefreshKey] =
   47:     useState(0);
   48: 
   49:   useEffect(() => {
   50:     let cancelled = false;
   51: 
   52:     async function load() {
   53:       if (authLoading) {
   54:         return;
   55:       }
   56: 
   57:       if (
   58:         !user?.uid ||
   59:         (
   60:           profile?.role !== "teacher" &&
   61:           profile?.role !== "admin"
   62:         )
   63:       ) {
   64:         setLoading(false);
   65:         return;
   66:       }
   67: 
   68:       try {
   69:         setLoading(true);
   70:         setError("");
   71: 
   72:         const result =
   73:           await getTeacherStudentAnalytics({
   74:             teacherId: user.uid,
   75:             studentId,
   76:           });
   77: 
   78:         if (!cancelled) {
   79:           setRow(result);
   80: 
   81:           if (!result) {
   82:             setError(
   83:               "This student is not enrolled in one of your classes or analytics data is unavailable.",
   84:             );
   85:           }
   86:         }
   87:       } catch (caughtError) {
   88:         console.error(
   89:           "Unable to load student analytics:",
   90:           caughtError,
   91:         );
   92: 
   93:         if (!cancelled) {
   94:           setError(
   95:             caughtError instanceof Error
   96:               ? caughtError.message
   97:               : "Student analytics could not be loaded.",
   98:           );
   99:         }
  100:       } finally {
  101:         if (!cancelled) {
  102:           setLoading(false);
  103:         }
  104:       }
  105:     }
  106: 
  107:     void load();
  108: 
  109:     return () => {
  110:       cancelled = true;
  111:     };
  112:   }, [
  113:     authLoading,
  114:     profile?.role,
  115:     studentId,
  116:     user?.uid,
  117:     refreshKey,
  118:   ]);
  119: 
  120:   if (authLoading || loading) {
  121:     return (
  122:       <div className="space-y-6">
  123:         <Skeleton className="h-40 rounded-3xl" />
  124:         <Skeleton className="h-96 rounded-3xl" />
  125:       </div>
  126:     );
  127:   }
  128:

   62: function priorityLabel(priority: TeacherActionPriority): string {
   63:   if (priority === "high") return "High";
   64:   if (priority === "medium") return "Medium";
   65:   if (priority === "monitor") return "Monitor";
   66:   return "No flag";

   69: function gradeGapLabel(value: number | null): string {
   70:   if (value === null) {
   71:     return "Target not set";
   72:   }
   73: 
   74:   if (value > 0) {
   75:     return `+${value} above target`;
   76:   }
   77: 
   78:   if (value === 0) {
   79:     return "On target";
   80:   }
   81: 
   82:   return `${Math.abs(value)} below target`;
   83: }

   85: function confidenceLabel(value: string): string {
   86:   if (value === "insufficient") return "Insufficient";
   87:   if (value === "low") return "Low";
   88:   if (value === "medium") return "Medium";
   89:   if (value === "high") return "High";
   90:   return value || "Unknown";

   87: function dueLabel(
   88:   assignment:
   89:     UnifiedTeacherAssignment,
   90: ): string {
   91:   if (!assignment.dueDate) {
   92:     return assignment.status ===
   93:       "active"
   94:       ? "No deadline"
   95:       : "No deadline was set";
   96:   }
   97: 
   98:   if (
   99:     assignment.status ===
  100:     "closed"
  101:   ) {
  102:     return `Closed Â· due date was ${formatDate(
  103:       assignment.dueDate,
  104:     )}`;
  105:   }
  106: 
  107:   if (
  108:     assignment.status ===
  109:     "cancelled"
  110:   ) {
  111:     return `Cancelled Â· due date was ${formatDate(
  112:       assignment.dueDate,
  113:     )}`;
  114:   }
  115: 
  116:   if (
  117:     isUnifiedTeacherAssignmentOverdue(
  118:       assignment,
  119:     )
  120:   ) {
  121:     return "Overdue";
  122:   }
  123: 
  124:   const today = new Date();
  125:   const due =
  126:     new Date(
  127:       assignment.dueDate,
  128:     );
  129: 
  130:   today.setHours(
  131:     0,
  132:     0,
  133:     0,
  134:     0,
  135:   );
  136: 
  137:   due.setHours(
  138:     0,
  139:     0,
  140:     0,
  141:     0,
  142:   );
  143: 
  144:   const difference =
  145:     Math.ceil(
  146:       (due.getTime() -
  147:         today.getTime()) /
  148:         (1000 *
  149:           60 *
  150:           60 *
  151:           24),
  152:     );
  153: 
  154:   if (difference === 0) {
  155:     return "Due today";
  156:   }
  157: 
  158:   if (difference === 1) {
  159:     return "Due tomorrow";
  160:   }
  161: 
  162:   return `${difference} days remaining`;
  163: }

  304:   ) {
  305:     return copied.sort(
  306:       (
  307:         first,
  308:         second,
  309:       ) => {
  310:         if (
  311:           !first.dueDate &&
  312:           !second.dueDate
  313:         ) {
  314:           return 0;
  315:         }
  316: 
  317:         if (!first.dueDate) {
  318:           return 1;
  319:         }
  320: 
  321:         if (!second.dueDate) {
  322:           return -1;
  323:         }
  324: 
  325:         return (
  326:           first.dueDate.getTime() -
  327:           second.dueDate.getTime()
  328:         );
  329:       },
  330:     );
  331:   }
  332: 
  333:   return copied.sort(
  334:     (
  335:       first,
  336:       second,
  337:     ) =>
  338:       (second.createdAt?.getTime() ??
  339:         0) -
  340:       (first.createdAt?.getTime() ??
  341:         0),
  342:   );
  343: }

   39: function defaultAcademicYear(): string {
   40:   const now = new Date();
   41: 
   42:   const year =
   43:     now.getFullYear();
   44: 
   45:   /*
   46:    * Treat August onward as preparation for the new UK academic year.
   47:    */
   48:   const startYear =
   49:     now.getMonth() >= 7
   50:       ? year
   51:       : year - 1;
   52: 
   53:   return `${startYear}/${startYear + 1}`;
   54: }

   56: function qualificationLabel(

   62:     "A_LEVEL"

   66: 
   67:   return qualification || "Not set";
   68: }

   42: function normaliseErrorCode(error: unknown): string {
   43:   if (
   44:     typeof error === "object" &&
   45:     error !== null &&
   46:     "code" in error &&
   47:     typeof (error as FirestoreLikeError).code === "string"
   48:   ) {
   49:     return ((error as FirestoreLikeError).code as string).toLowerCase();
   50:   }
   51: 
   52:   return "";
   53: }

   55: function normaliseErrorMessage(error: unknown): string {
   56:   if (error instanceof Error) {
   57:     return error.message.trim();
   58:   }
   59: 
   60:   if (
   61:     typeof error === "object" &&
   62:     error !== null &&
   63:     "message" in error &&
   64:     typeof (error as FirestoreLikeError).message === "string"
   65:   ) {
   66:     return ((error as FirestoreLikeError).message as string).trim();
   67:   }
   68: 
   69:   return "";
   70: }
   71: 
   72: function isExpectedUnavailableError(error: unknown): boolean {
   73:   const code = normaliseErrorCode(error);
   74:   const message = normaliseErrorMessage(error).toLowerCase();
   75: 
   76:   return (
   77:     code === "permission-denied" ||
   78:     code === "firestore/permission-denied" ||
   79:     code === "not-found" ||
   80:     code === "firestore/not-found" ||
   81:     message.includes("missing or insufficient permissions") ||
   82:     message.includes("do not have permission") ||
   83:     message.includes("not found")
   84:   );
   85: }

   87: function getMarkbookErrorMessage(error: unknown): string {

  107: async function getStudentIdentity(studentId: string): Promise<StudentIdentity> {
  108:   try {
  109:     const snapshot = await getDoc(doc(db, "users", studentId));
  110: 
  111:     if (!snapshot.exists()) {
  112:       return {
  113:         uid: studentId,
  114:         name: "Unnamed Student",
  115:         email: "",
  116:       };
  117:     }

  122:       normaliseString(profile.name) ||
  123:       normaliseString(profile.displayName) ||
  124:       normaliseString(profile.fullName) ||
  125:       "Unnamed Student";
  126: 
  127:     const email = normaliseString(profile.email).toLowerCase();
  128: 
  129:     return {
  130:       uid: studentId,
  131:       name,
  132:       email,
  133:     };
  134:   } catch (error) {
  135:     reportUnexpectedLoadError(

  138:     );
  139:

  141:       uid: studentId,
  142:       name: "Unnamed Student",
  143:       email: "",
  144:     };
  145:   }

  260: 
  261:   const [quiz, setQuiz] = useState<GeneratedQuiz | null>(null);
  262: 
  263:   const [generating, setGenerating] = useState(false);
  264: 
  265:   const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  266:

  272: 
  273:   const [copilotPrefilled, setCopilotPrefilled] = useState(false);
  274: 
  275:   useEffect(() => {
  276:     const topic = searchParams.get("topic");
  277: 
  278:     if (!topic?.trim()) {
  279:       return;
  280:     }
  281: 
  282:     void Promise.resolve().then(() => {
  283:       setSettings({
  284:         topic: topic.trim(),
  285:         qualification:
  286:           searchParams.get("qualification")?.trim() ||
  287:           initialSettings.qualification,
  288:         examBoard:
  289:           searchParams.get("examBoard")?.trim() || initialSettings.examBoard,
  290:         difficulty: normaliseDifficulty(searchParams.get("difficulty")),
  291:         questionCount: normaliseQuestionCount(searchParams.get("questionCount")),
  292:       });
  293: 
  294:       setQuiz(null);
  295:       setSavedQuizId(null);
  296:       setGenerationMode(null);
  297:       setQuotaUnavailable(false);
  298:       setCopilotPrefilled(true);

  303:     process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production" ||
  304:     process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_DEMO_TOOLS === "true";
  305:

  307:     if (generationMode === "demo") {
  308:       return "Demo quiz";

  310:

  312:       return "AI-generated quiz";
  313:     }
  314:

  316:   }, [generationMode]);
  317: 
  318:   function validateTopic(): boolean {
  319:     if (!settings.topic.trim()) {
  320:       toast.error("Please enter a quiz topic.");
  321: 
  322:       return false;
  323:     }
  324: 
  325:     return true;
  326:   }
  327: 
  328:   async function handleGenerate() {
  329:     if (!validateTopic()) {
  330:       return;
  331:     }
  332: 
  333:     setGenerating(true);
  334:     setQuiz(null);
  335:     setSavedQuizId(null);
  336:     setGenerationMode(null);
  337:     setQuotaUnavailable(false);
  338: 
  339:     try {
  340:       const response = await fetch("/api/ai/generate-quiz", {
  341:         method: "POST",
  342:         headers: {
  343:           "Content-Type": "application/json",
  344:         },
  345:         body: JSON.stringify({
  346:           topic: settings.topic.trim(),
  347:           qualification: settings.qualification,
  348:           examBoard: settings.examBoard,
  349:           difficulty: settings.difficulty,
  350:           questionCount: settings.questionCount,
  351:         }),
  352:       });
  353: 
  354:       const data = (await response.json()) as ApiErrorResponse;
  355: 
  356:       if (!response.ok) {
  357:         if (response.status === 429 || data.errorCode === "quota_exceeded") {
  358:           setQuotaUnavailable(true);
  359: 
  360:           toast.error(
  361:             "The AI account currently has no available quota. You can generate a demo quiz instead.",
  362:           );
  363: 
  364:           return;
  365:         }
  366: 
  367:         throw new Error(data.error || "The quiz could not be generated.");
  368:       }
  369: 
  370:       if (!data.quiz) {
  371:         throw new Error("The server did not return a quiz.");
  372:       }
  373: 
  374:       setQuiz(data.quiz);
  375:       setGenerationMode("ai");
  376: 
  377:       toast.success("Quiz generated successfully.");
  378:     } catch (error) {
  379:       console.error("Quiz generation error:", error);
  380: 
  381:       toast.error(
  382:         error instanceof Error
  383:           ? error.message
  384:           : "The quiz could not be generated.",
  385:       );
  386:     } finally {
  387:       setGenerating(false);
  388:     }
  389:   }

  263:     null,
  264:   );
  265: 
  266:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  267: 
  268:   const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  269: 
  270:   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  271: 
  272:   const [success, setSuccess] = useState<string | null>(null);
  273: 
  274:   useEffect(() => {
  275:     const unsubscribe = onAuthStateChanged(auth, (user) => {
  276:       setCurrentUser(user);
  277:       setAuthLoading(false);
  278:     });
  279: 
  280:     return unsubscribe;
  281:   }, []);
  282: 
  283:   const loadResource = useCallback(async () => {
  284:     await Promise.resolve();
  285: 
  286:     if (!currentUser || !resourceId) {
  287:       setLoading(false);
  288:       return;
  289:     }
  290: 
  291:     setLoading(true);
  292:     setError(null);
  293: 
  294:     try {
  295:       const resourceReference = doc(db, "teacherResources", resourceId);
  296: 
  297:       const resourceSnapshot = await getDoc(resourceReference);
  298: 
  299:       if (!resourceSnapshot.exists()) {
  300:         setError("This teaching resource could not be found.");
  301:         setResource(null);
  302:         return;
  303:       }
  304: 
  305:       const data = resourceSnapshot.data() as EditableResourceDocument;
  306: 
  307:       if (data.teacherId !== currentUser.uid) {
  308:         setError("You do not have permission to edit this resource.");
  309:         setResource(null);
  310:         return;
  311:       }
  312: 
  313:       setResource(data.content);
  314:     } catch (caughtError) {
  315:       console.error("Failed to load editable resource:", caughtError);
  316: 
  317:       setError(
  318:         caughtError instanceof Error
  319:           ? caughtError.message
  320:           : "The resource could not be loaded.",
  321:       );
  322:     } finally {
  323:       setLoading(false);
  324:     }
  325:   }, [currentUser, resourceId]);
  326: 
  327:   useEffect(() => {
  328:     if (!authLoading) {
  329:       void Promise.resolve().then(() => loadResource());
  330:     }
  331:   }, [authLoading, loadResource]);
  332: 
  333:   function updateTopLevelField<K extends keyof GeneratedTeachingResource>(
  334:     field: K,
  335:     value: GeneratedTeachingResource[K],
  336:   ) {
  337:     setResource((current) => {
  338:       if (!current) {
  339:         return current;
  340:       }
  341: 
  342:       return {
  343:         ...current,
  344:         [field]: value,
  345:       };
  346:     });
  347: 
  348:     setError(null);
  349:     setSuccess(null);
  350:   }
  351: 
  352:   function updateStringArrayItem(
  353:     field: StringArrayField,
  354:     index: number,
  355:     value: string,
  356:   ) {
  357:     setResource((current) => {
  358:       if (!current) {
  359:         return current;
  360:       }
  361: 
  362:       const updatedItems = [...current[field]];
  363:       updatedItems[index] = value;
  364: 
  365:       return {
  366:         ...current,
  367:         [field]: updatedItems,
  368:       };
  369:     });
  370: 
  371:     setSuccess(null);
  372:   }
  373: 
  374:   function addStringArrayItem(field: StringArrayField) {
  375:     setResource((current) => {
  376:       if (!current) {
  377:         return current;
  378:       }
  379: 
  380:       return {
  381:         ...current,
  382:         [field]: [...current[field], ""],
  383:       };
  384:     });
  385:   }
  386: 
  387:   function removeStringArrayItem(field: StringArrayField, index: number) {
  388:     setResource((current) => {
  389:       if (!current || current[field].length <= 1) {
  390:         return current;
  391:       }
  392: 
  393:       return {
  394:         ...current,
  395:         [field]: current[field].filter((_, itemIndex) => itemIndex !== index),
  396:       };
  397:     });
  398:   }

  400:   function updateSection(
  401:     index: number,
  402:     field: keyof ResourceSection,
  403:     value: string | string[],
  404:   ) {
  405:     setResource((current) => {
  406:       if (!current) {
  407:         return current;
  408:       }
  409: 
  410:       const sections = [...current.sections];
  411: 
  412:       sections[index] = {
  413:         ...sections[index],
  414:         [field]: value,
  415:       };
  416: 
  417:       return {
  418:         ...current,
  419:         sections,
  420:       };
  421:     });
  422: 
  423:     setSuccess(null);
  424:   }

  430:       }
  431: 
  432:       return {
  433:         ...current,
  434:         sections: [...current.sections, createEmptySection()],
  435:       };
  436:     });
  437:   }

  443:       }

  448:           (_, sectionIndex) => sectionIndex !== index,

  609:       if (!current || current.assessmentQuestions.length <= 1) {
  610:         return current;
  611:       }
  612: 
  613:       return {
  614:         ...current,
  615:         assessmentQuestions: current.assessmentQuestions.filter(
  616:           (_, itemIndex) => itemIndex !== index,
  617:         ),
  618:       };
  619:     });

  622:   function validateResource(): string | null {
  623:     if (!resource) {
  624:       return "The resource could not be loaded.";
  625:     }
  626: 
  627:     if (resource.title.trim().length < 2) {
  628:       return "Enter a valid resource title.";
  629:     }
  630: 
  631:     if (resource.topic.trim().length < 2) {
  632:       return "Enter a valid topic.";
  633:     }
  634: 
  635:     if (!resource.overview.trim()) {
  636:       return "Enter a resource overview.";
  637:     }
  638: 
  639:     if (resource.learningObjectives.some((item) => !item.trim())) {
  640:       return "Learning objectives cannot contain blank items.";
  641:     }
  642: 
  643:     if (resource.successCriteria.some((item) => !item.trim())) {
  644:       return "Success criteria cannot contain blank items.";
  645:     }
  646: 
  647:     if (
  648:       resource.sections.some(
  649:         (section) =>
  650:           !section.title.trim() ||
  651:           !section.teacherInstructions.trim() ||
  652:           !section.studentTask.trim(),
  653:       )
  654:     ) {
  655:       return "Every section requires a title, teacher instructions and student task.";
  656:     }
  657: 
  658:     if (
  659:       resource.assessmentQuestions.some(
  660:         (question) =>
  661:           !question.question.trim() ||
  662:           !question.answer.trim() ||
  663:           question.marks < 1,
  664:       )
  665:     ) {
  666:       return "Every assessment question requires a question, answer and valid mark value.";
  667:     }
  668: 
  669:     return null;
  670:   }
  671: 
  672:   async function handleSave() {
  673:     const validationError = validateResource();
  674: 
  675:     if (validationError) {
  676:       setError(validationError);
  677:       setSuccess(null);
  678:       return;
  679:     }
  680: 
  681:     if (!resource) {
  682:       return;
  683:     }
  684: 
  685:     setSaving(true);
  686:     setError(null);
  687:     setSuccess(null);
  688: 
  689:     try {
  690:       const cleanedResource: GeneratedTeachingResource = {
  691:         ...resource,
  692:         title: resource.title.trim(),
  693:         topic: resource.topic.trim(),
  694:         overview: resource.overview.trim(),
  695:         learningObjectives: resource.learningObjectives.map((item) =>
  696:           item.trim(),
  697:         ),
  698:         successCriteria: resource.successCriteria.map((item) => item.trim()),
  699:         keywords: resource.keywords.map((item) => item.trim()).filter(Boolean),
  700:         priorKnowledge: resource.priorKnowledge
  701:           .map((item) => item.trim())
  702:           .filter(Boolean),
  703:         sections: resource.sections.map((section) => ({
  704:           ...section,
  705:           title: section.title.trim(),
  706:           duration: section.duration.trim(),
  707:           teacherInstructions: section.teacherInstructions.trim(),
  708:           studentTask: section.studentTask.trim(),
  709:           assessment: section.assessment.trim(),
  710:           resources: section.resources
  711:             .map((item) => item.trim())
  712:             .filter(Boolean),
  713:         })),
  714:         differentiation: {
  715:           support: resource.differentiation.support
  716:             .map((item) => item.trim())
  717:             .filter(Boolean),
  718:           core: resource.differentiation.core
  719:             .map((item) => item.trim())
  720:             .filter(Boolean),
  721:           stretch: resource.differentiation.stretch
  722:             .map((item) => item.trim())
  723:             .filter(Boolean),
  724:         },
  725:         misconceptions: resource.misconceptions
  726:           .map((item) => ({
  727:             misconception: item.misconception.trim(),
  728:             correction: item.correction.trim(),
  729:           }))
  730:           .filter((item) => item.misconception && item.correction),
  731:         assessmentQuestions: resource.assessmentQuestions.map((question) => ({
  732:           question: question.question.trim(),
  733:           answer: question.answer.trim(),
  734:           marks: Math.max(1, Math.round(question.marks)),
  735:         })),
  736:         homework: resource.homework.trim(),
  737:         teacherNotes: resource.teacherNotes.trim(),
  738:       };
  739: 
  740:       await updateTeacherResourceContent(resourceId, cleanedResource);
  741: 
  742:       setResource(cleanedResource);
  743:       setSuccess("Your resource changes were saved successfully.");
  744: 
  745:       window.setTimeout(() => {
  746:         router.push(`/teacher/resources/${resourceId}`);
  747:       }, 800);
  748:     } catch (caughtError) {
  749:       console.error("Failed to save resource changes:", caughtError);
  750: 
  751:       setError(
  752:         caughtError instanceof Error
  753:           ? caughtError.message
  754:           : "Your changes could not be saved.",
  755:       );
  756:     } finally {
  757:       setSaving(false);
  758:     }
  759:   }
  760: 
  761:   if (authLoading || loading) {
  762:     return <EditPageSkeleton />;
  763:   }
  764: 
  765:   if (error && !resource) {
  766:     return (
  767:       <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-4xl px-4 py-10 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
  768:         <Link
  769:           href="/teacher/resources"
  770:           className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-700"
  771:         >
  772:           <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
  773:           Back to Resource Library
  774:         </Link>
  775: 
  776:         <section className="mt-8 rounded-3xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-8 text-center">
  777:           <AlertCircle className="mx-auto h-10 w-10 text-red-600" />
  778: 
  779:           <h1 className="mt-4 text-2xl font-bold text-red-950">
  780:             Resource unavailable
  781:           </h1>
  782: 
  783:           <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-800">{error}</p>
  784:         </section>
  785:       </main>
  786:     );
  787:   }
  788: 
  789:   if (!resource) {
  790:     return null;
  791:   }
  792: 
  793:   return (
  794:     <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl space-y-6 px-4 py-6 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
  795:       <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
  796:         <Link
  797:           href={`/teacher/resources/${resourceId}`}
  798:           className="inline-flex w-fit items-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-700"
  799:         >
  800:           <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
  801:           Cancel editing
  802:         </Link>
  803: 
  804:         <button
  805:           type="button"
  806:           onClick={handleSave}
  807:           disabled={saving}
  808:           className="inline-flex w-fit items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-100 transition hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-slate-300 disabled:shadow-none"
  809:         >
  810:           {saving ? (
  811:             <>
  812:               <Loader2 className="h-5 w-5 animate-spin" />
  813:               Saving changes...
  814:             </>
  815:           ) : (
  816:             <>
  817:               <Save className="h-5 w-5" />
  818:               Save changes
  819:             </>
  820:           )}
  821:         </button>
  822:       </div>
  823: 
  824:       <section className="rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-700 via-indigo-600 to-sky-600 p-6 text-white shadow-lg sm:p-8">
  825:         <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
  826:           <div className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-white/15">
  827:             <BookOpen className="h-6 w-6" />
  828:           </div>
  829: 
  830:           <div>
  831:             <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight">
  832:               Edit teaching resource
  833:             </h1>
  834: 
  835:             <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl leading-7 text-indigo-50">
  836:               Refine the generated lesson content before publishing, exporting
  837:               or assigning it to a class.
  838:             </p>
  839:           </div>
  840:         </div>
  841:       </section>
  842: 
  843:       {error && (
  844:         <div
  845:           role="alert"
  846:           className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 text-red-800"
  847:         >
  848:           <AlertCircle className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0" />
  849: 
  850:           <div>
  851:             <p className="font-bold">Changes not saved</p>
  852: 
  853:             <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-6">{error}</p>
  854:           </div>
  855:         </div>
  856:       )}
  857: 
  858:       {success && (
  859:         <div
  860:           role="status"
  861:           className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 p-4 text-emerald-800"
  862:         >
  863:           <CheckCircle2 className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0" />
  864: 
  865:           <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{success}</p>
  866:         </div>
  867:       )}
  868: 
  869:       <section className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm sm:p-6">
  870:         <SectionHeader
  871:           icon={<BookOpen className="h-5 w-5" />}
  872:           title="Resource details"
  873:           description="Update the resource title, topic and curriculum information."
  874:         />
  875: 
  876:         <div className="grid gap-5 lg:grid-cols-2">
  877:           <div>
  878:             <FieldLabel htmlFor="resource-title" required>
  879:               Resource title
  880:             </FieldLabel>
  881: 
  882:             <input
  883:               id="resource-title"
  884:               value={resource.title}
  885:               onChange={(event) =>
  886:                 updateTopLevelField("title", event.target.value)
  887:               }
  888:               maxLength={200}
  889:               className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-900 outline-none transition focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100"
  890:             />
  891:           </div>
  892: 
  893:           <div>
  894:             <FieldLabel htmlFor="resource-topic" required>
  895:               Topic
  896:             </FieldLabel>
  897: 
  898:             <input
  899:               id="resource-topic"
  900:               value={resource.topic}
  901:               onChange={(event) =>
  902:                 updateTopLevelField("topic", event.target.value)
  903:               }
  904:               maxLength={150}
  905:               className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-900 outline-none transition focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100"
  906:             />

  908:

  922:               >

  231: export default function TeacherResourcesPage() {
  232:   const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
  233: 
  234:   const [authLoading, setAuthLoading] = useState(true);
  235: 
  236:   const [resources, setResources] = useState<SavedTeacherResource[]>([]);
  237: 
  238:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  239: 
  240:   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  241: 
  242:   const [success, setSuccess] = useState<string | null>(null);
  243: 
  244:   const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  245: 
  246:   const [resourceTypeFilter, setResourceTypeFilter] = useState("all");
  247: 
  248:   const [yearGroupFilter, setYearGroupFilter] = useState("all");
  249: 
  250:   const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<StatusFilter>("all");
  251: 
  252:   const [deletingId, setDeletingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  253: 
  254:   useEffect(() => {
  255:     const unsubscribe = onAuthStateChanged(auth, (user) => {
  256:       setCurrentUser(user);
  257:       setAuthLoading(false);
  258:     });
  259: 
  260:     return unsubscribe;
  261:   }, []);
  262: 
  263:   const loadResources = useCallback(() => {
  264:     if (!currentUser) {
  265:       return Promise.resolve().then(() => {
  266:         setResources([]);
  267:         setError(null);
  268:         setLoading(false);
  269:       });
  270:     }
  271: 
  272:     const teacherId = currentUser.uid;
  273: 
  274:     return Promise.resolve()
  275:       .then(() => {
  276:         setLoading(true);
  277:         setError(null);
  278:         return getTeacherResources(teacherId);
  279:       })
  280:       .then((savedResources) => {
  281:         setResources(savedResources);
  282:       })
  283:       .catch((caughtError) => {
  284:         console.error("Failed to load teacher resources:", caughtError);
  285: 
  286:         setError(
  287:           caughtError instanceof Error
  288:             ? caughtError.message
  289:             : "Your resource library could not be loaded.",
  290:         );
  291:       })
  292:       .finally(() => {
  293:         setLoading(false);
  294:       });
  295:   }, [currentUser]);
  296: 
  297:   useEffect(() => {
  298:     if (!authLoading) {
  299:       void loadResources();
  300:     }
  301:   }, [authLoading, loadResources]);
  302: 
  303:   const resourceTypes = useMemo(() => {
  304:     return Array.from(
  305:       new Set(resources.map((resource) => resource.resourceType)),
  306:     ).sort();
  307:   }, [resources]);
  308: 
  309:   const yearGroups = useMemo(() => {
  310:     return Array.from(
  311:       new Set(resources.map((resource) => resource.yearGroup)),
  312:     ).sort();
  313:   }, [resources]);
  314: 
  315:   const filteredResources = useMemo(() => {
  316:     const normalisedSearch = searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();
  317: 
  318:     return resources.filter((resource) => {
  319:       const matchesSearch =
  320:         !normalisedSearch ||
  321:         resource.title.toLowerCase().includes(normalisedSearch) ||
  322:         resource.topic.toLowerCase().includes(normalisedSearch) ||
  323:         resource.content.overview.toLowerCase().includes(normalisedSearch);
  324: 
  325:       const matchesType =
  326:         resourceTypeFilter === "all" ||
  327:         resource.resourceType === resourceTypeFilter;
  328: 
  329:       const matchesYearGroup =
  330:         yearGroupFilter === "all" || resource.yearGroup === yearGroupFilter;
  331: 
  332:       const matchesStatus =
  333:         statusFilter === "all" || resource.status === statusFilter;
  334: 
  335:       return matchesSearch && matchesType && matchesYearGroup && matchesStatus;
  336:     });
  337:   }, [
  338:     resources,
  339:     searchTerm,
  340:     resourceTypeFilter,
  341:     yearGroupFilter,
  342:     statusFilter,
  343:   ]);
  344: 
  345:   const hasFilters =
  346:     searchTerm.trim().length > 0 ||
  347:     resourceTypeFilter !== "all" ||
  348:     yearGroupFilter !== "all" ||
  349:     statusFilter !== "all";
  350:

  354:     setYearGroupFilter("all");
  355:     setStatusFilter("all");
  356:   }
  357: 
  358:   async function handleDelete(resource: SavedTeacherResource) {
  359:     if (resource.status !== "archived") {
  360:       setError("Archive a resource in Content Hub before deleting it permanently.");
  361:       return;
  362:     }
  363: 
  364:     const confirmed = window.confirm(
  365:       `Permanently delete archived resource "${resource.title}"? This action cannot be undone.`,
  366:     );
  367: 
  368:     if (!confirmed) {
  369:       return;
  370:     }
  371: 
  372:     setDeletingId(resource.id);
  373:     setError(null);
  374:     setSuccess(null);
  375: 
  376:     try {
  377:       await deleteTeacherResource(resource.id);
  378: 
  379:       setResources((current) =>
  380:         current.filter((item) => item.id !== resource.id),
  381:       );
  382: 
  383:       setSuccess(`"${resource.title}" was deleted successfully.`);
  384:     } catch (caughtError) {
  385:       console.error("Failed to delete teacher resource:", caughtError);

  394:     }
  395:   }
  396: 
  397:   if (authLoading) {

  416:               Your teaching resources

  563:             {yearGroups.map((yearGroup) => (
  564:               <option key={yearGroup} value={yearGroup}>
  565:                 {yearGroup}
  566:               </option>
  567:             ))}
  568:           </select>
  569: 
  570:           <select
  571:             aria-label="Filter by status"
  572:             value={statusFilter}
  573:             onChange={(event) =>
  574:               setStatusFilter(event.target.value as StatusFilter)
  575:             }
  576:             className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-900 outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100"
  577:           >
  578:             <option value="all">All statuses</option>
  579:             <option value="draft">Draft</option>
  580:             <option value="published">Published</option>
  581:             <option value="archived">Archived</option>
  582:           </select>
  583:         </div>
  584: 
  585:         <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-sm text-slate-500">
  586:           <p>
  587:             Showing{" "}
  588:             <span className="font-bold text-slate-800">
  589:               {filteredResources.length}
  590:             </span>{" "}
  591:             of{" "}
  592:             <span className="font-bold text-slate-800">{resources.length}</span>{" "}
  593:             resources
  594:           </p>
  595: 
  596:           {hasFilters && (
  597:             <button
  598:               type="button"
  599:               onClick={clearFilters}
  600:               className="font-bold text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-700"
  601:             >
  602:               Clear filters
  603:             </button>
  604:           )}
  605:         </div>
  606:       </section>
  607: 
  608:       {loading ? (
  609:         <ResourceLibrarySkeleton />
  610:       ) : filteredResources.length === 0 ? (
  611:         <EmptyLibrary hasFilters={hasFilters} onClearFilters={clearFilters} />
  612:       ) : (
  613:         <section className="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
  614:           {filteredResources.map((resource) => (
  615:             <ResourceCard
  616:               key={resource.id}
  617:               resource={resource}
  618:               deletingId={deletingId}
  619:               onDelete={handleDelete}
  620:             />
  621:           ))}
  622:         </section>
  623:       )}
  624:     </main>
  625:   );
  626: }

  390:       SchoolMemberRecord[]

  416: 
  417:   const [

  419:     setError,

  421: 
  422:   const [
  423:     searchTerm,

  508:           );
  509:

  530: 
  531:                   return [
  532:                     member.uid,
  533:                     null,
  534:                   ] as const;
  535:                 }
  536:               },
  537:             ),
  538:           );
  539: 
  540:         if (
  541:           !cancelled
  542:         ) {

  545:           );

  552:

  564:

  567:         ) {
  568:           setError(
  569:             caughtError instanceof
  570:               Error

  576:         if (
  577:           !cancelled
  578:         ) {
  579:           setLoading(false);
  580:         }
  581:       }
  582:     }
  583: 
  584:     void load();
  585:

  588:     };

  799:                 ?.streak ??

   30:       }

   77:   const onboardingRoute =
   78:     pathname === "/onboarding";
   79: 
   80:   const curriculumComplete =
   81:     profile?.onboardingComplete ===
   82:       true &&
   83:     Boolean(profile.qualification) &&
   84:     Boolean(profile.examBoard);
   85: 
   86:   const isTeacherApplicant =
   87:     profile?.role === "student" &&
   88:     profile.accountIntent ===
   89:       "teacher";
   90: 
   91:   let redirectTarget:
   92:     | string
   93:     | null = null;
   94: 
   95:   /*
   96:    * ---------------------------------------------------------
   97:    * SIGNED OUT
   98:    * ---------------------------------------------------------
   99:    */
  100: 
  101:   if (
  102:     !loading &&
  103:     !user &&
  104:     !isPublicRoute
  105:   ) {
  106:     redirectTarget = "/login";
  107:   }
  108: 
  109:   /*
  110:    * ---------------------------------------------------------
  111:    * SIGNED IN + PROFILE READY
  112:    * ---------------------------------------------------------
  113:    */
  114: 
  115:   if (
  116:     !loading &&
  117:     user &&
  118:     profileReady &&
  119:     profile
  120:   ) {
  121:     /*
  122:      * -------------------------------------------------------
  123:      * ADMIN
  124:      * -------------------------------------------------------
  125:      */
  126: 
  127:     if (profile.role === "admin") {
  128:       if (!adminRoute) {
  129:         redirectTarget = "/admin";
  130:       }
  131: 
  132:       /*
  133:        * -----------------------------------------------------
  134:        * APPROVED TEACHER
  135:        * -----------------------------------------------------
  136:        */
  137:     } else if (
  138:       profile.role === "teacher"
  139:     ) {
  140:       if (
  141:         isPublicRoute ||
  142:         onboardingRoute ||
  143:         adminRoute
  144:       ) {
  145:         redirectTarget =
  146:           "/teacher";
  147:       }
  148: 
  149:       /*
  150:        * -----------------------------------------------------
  151:        * TEACHER APPLICANT
  152:        *
  153:        * SECURITY:
  154:        *
  155:        * A teacher applicant deliberately keeps role="student"
  156:        * until an administrator approves the request.
  157:        *
  158:        * accountIntent="teacher" therefore takes precedence
  159:        * over normal student curriculum routing.
  160:        *
  161:        * This prevents teacher applicants from ever being
  162:        * forced through GCSE/A-level student onboarding.
  163:        * -----------------------------------------------------
  164:        */
  165:     } else if (
  166:       isTeacherApplicant
  167:     ) {
  168:       if (!teacherAccessRoute) {
  169:         redirectTarget =
  170:           "/teacher-access";
  171:       }
  172: 
  173:       /*
  174:        * -----------------------------------------------------
  175:        * STANDARD STUDENT
  176:        * -----------------------------------------------------
  177:        */
  178:     } else {
  179:       /*
  180:        * A normal student is never allowed into protected
  181:        * teacher or admin routes.
  182:        */
  183:       if (
  184:         teacherRoute ||
  185:         adminRoute
  186:       ) {
  187:         redirectTarget =
  188:           "/dashboard";
  189: 
  190:         /*
  191:          * Keep /teacher-access available to an existing
  192:          * student who deliberately wants to request a
  193:          * teacher-account upgrade.
  194:          */
  195:       } else if (
  196:         teacherAccessRoute
  197:       ) {
  198:         redirectTarget = null;
  199: 
  200:         /*
  201:          * Other public authentication/setup routes should
  202:          * return a signed-in student to the appropriate
  203:          * student destination.
  204:          */
  205:       } else if (isPublicRoute) {
  206:         redirectTarget =
  207:           curriculumComplete
  208:             ? "/dashboard"
  209:             : "/onboarding";
  210: 
  211:         /*
  212:          * Completed students no longer need onboarding.
  213:          */
  214:       } else if (
  215:         onboardingRoute &&
  216:         curriculumComplete
  217:       ) {
  218:         redirectTarget =
  219:           "/dashboard";
  220: 
  221:         /*
  222:          * Incomplete students must complete curriculum setup
  223:          * before using the main student application.
  224:          */
  225:       } else if (
  226:         !onboardingRoute &&
  227:         !curriculumComplete
  228:       ) {
  229:         redirectTarget =
  230:           "/onboarding";
  231:       }
  232:     }
  233:   }
  234: 
  235:   useEffect(() => {
  236:     if (redirectTarget) {
  237:       router.replace(
  238:         redirectTarget,
  239:       );
  240:     }
  241:   }, [
  242:     redirectTarget,
  243:     router,
  244:   ]);
  245: 
  246:   if (loading) {
  247:     return (
  248:       <LoadingScreen message="Loading CS Master..." />
  249:     );
  250:   }
  251: 
  252:   if (profileError) {
  253:     return (
  254:       <main className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-slate-100 px-6">
  255:         <section className="w-full max-w-xl rounded-3xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-8">
  256:           <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-red-950">
  257:             Your account could
  258:             not be loaded
  259:           </h1>
  260: 
  261:           <p className="mt-3 text-red-800">
  262:             {profileError}
  263:           </p>
  264:         </section>
  265:       </main>
  266:     );
  267:   }
  268: 
  269:   if (
  270:     user &&
  271:     (!profileReady || !profile)
  272:   ) {
  273:     return (
  274:       <LoadingScreen message="Preparing your account..." />
  275:     );
  276:   }
  277: 
  278:   /*
  279:    * Never briefly render content belonging to the wrong
  280:    * portal while Next.js completes the redirect.
  281:    */
  282:   if (redirectTarget) {
  283:     return (
  284:       <LoadingScreen message="Opening the correct portal..." />
  285:     );
  286:   }
  287: 
  288:   return <>{children}</>;
  289: }
  290: 
  291: function LoadingScreen({
  292:   message,
  293: }: {
  294:   message: string;
  295: }) {
  296:   return (
  297:     <main className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-slate-100 px-6">
  298:       <div className="text-center">
  299:         <div className="mx-auto h-11 w-11 animate-spin rounded-full border-4 border-blue-100 border-t-blue-600" />
  300: 
  301:         <p className="mt-4 font-bold text-slate-700">
  302:           {message}
  303:         </p>
  304:       </div>
  305:     </main>
  306:   );
  307: }

   10: export default function AppShell({
   11:   children,
   12: }: {
   13:   children: React.ReactNode;
   14: }) {
   15:   const pathname = usePathname();
   16: 
   17:   const [mobileSidebarOpen, setMobileSidebarOpen] =
   18:     useState(false);
   19: 
   20:   const publicPages = [
   21:     "/",
   22:     "/landing",
   23:     "/login",
   24:     "/register",
   25:     "/forgot-password",
   26:     "/onboarding",
   27: 
   28:     /*
   29:      * Teacher applicants use this route before receiving
   30:      * the teacher role, so it must not render the normal
   31:      * authenticated sidebar shell.
   32:      */
   33:     "/teacher-access",
   34:   ];
   35: 
   36:   const isPublicPage =
   37:     publicPages.includes(pathname);
   38: 
   39:   const isTeacherWorkspace =
   40:     pathname === "/teacher" ||
   41:     pathname.startsWith("/teacher/");
   42: 
   43:   const isAdminWorkspace =
   44:     pathname === "/admin" ||
   45:     pathname.startsWith("/admin/");
   46: 
   47:   useEffect(() => {
   48:     void Promise.resolve().then(() => {
   49:       setMobileSidebarOpen(false);
   50:     });
   51:   }, [pathname]);
   52: 
   53:   useEffect(() => {
   54:     if (!mobileSidebarOpen) {
   55:       return;
   56:     }
   57: 
   58:     const previousOverflow =
   59:       document.body.style.overflow;
   60: 
   61:     document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
   62: 
   63:     return () => {
   64:       document.body.style.overflow =
   65:         previousOverflow;
   66:     };
   67:   }, [mobileSidebarOpen]);
   68: 
   69:   if (isPublicPage) {
   70:     return (
   71:       <main className="min-h-screen bg-slate-100">
   72:         {children}
   73:       </main>
   74:     );
   75:   }
   76: 
   77:   const applicationShell = (
   78:     <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-100 xl:flex">
   79:       <Sidebar
   80:         mobileOpen={mobileSidebarOpen}
   81:         onMobileClose={() =>
   82:           setMobileSidebarOpen(false)
   83:         }
   84:       />
   85: 
   86:       <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
   87:         <header className="sticky top-0 z-30 flex h-16 items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 shadow-sm sm:px-6 xl:hidden">
   88:           <div>
   89:             <p className="text-sm font-black tracking-wide text-slate-950">
   90:               CS MASTER
   91:             </p>
   92: 
   93:             <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
   94:               Learning Platform
   95:             </p>
   96:           </div>
   97: 
   98:           <button
   99:             type="button"
  100:             onClick={() =>
  101:               setMobileSidebarOpen(true)
  102:             }
  103:             className="inline-flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-slate-800 transition hover:bg-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-100"
  104:             aria-label="Open navigation"
  105:             aria-expanded={mobileSidebarOpen}
  106:             aria-controls="mobile-navigation"
  107:           >
  108:             <Menu className="h-5 w-5" />
  109:           </button>
  110:         </header>
  111: 
  112:         <main className="min-w-0 p-3 sm:p-4 md:p-6">
  113:           {children}
  114:         </main>
  115:       </div>
  116:     </div>
  117:   );
  118: 
  119:   /*
  120:    * Teacher and administrator workspaces keep their own
  121:    * role-specific protection. Every other authenticated
  122:    * application route is a student workspace and passes
  123:    * through the student production gate.
  124:    */
  125:   if (
  126:     isTeacherWorkspace ||
  127:     isAdminWorkspace
  128:   ) {
  129:     return applicationShell;
  130:   }
  131: 
  132:   return (
  133:     <StudentAccessGate>
  134:       {applicationShell}
  135:     </StudentAccessGate>
  136:   );
  137: }

FILE: components\lesson-engine\InteractiveLessonEngine.tsx

    1: "use client";
    2: 
    3: import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
    4: import toast from "react-hot-toast";
    5: 
    6: import LessonAudioPlayer from "@/components/audio/LessonAudioPlayer";
    7: import CompleteLessonButton from "@/components/lesson/CompleteLessonButton";
    8: import SimulatorRenderer from "@/components/lesson/SimulatorRenderer";
    9: import LessonExamQuestionStep from "@/components/lesson-engine/LessonExamQuestionStep";
   10: import LessonPracticeStep from "@/components/lesson-engine/LessonPracticeStep";
   11: import LessonProgressHeader from "@/components/lesson-engine/LessonProgressHeader";
   12: import LessonStepNavigation from "@/components/lesson-engine/LessonStepNavigation";
   13: import Card from "@/components/ui/Card";
   14: import { useAuth } from "@/contexts/AuthContext";
   15: import { buildInteractiveLesson } from "@/services/interactiveLessonService";
   16: import {
   17:   calculateLessonMasteryImpact,
   18:   calculateLessonReviewDate,
   19:   calculateOverallLessonAccuracy,
   20:   calculateResponseAccuracy,
   21:   createLessonProgressId,
   22:   getLessonProgress,
   23:   saveLessonProgress,
   24: } from "@/services/lessonProgressService";
   25: import type { Lesson, SimulatorType } from "@/types/curriculum";
   26: import type { InteractiveLessonProgress } from "@/types/interactiveLesson";
   27: 
   28: type Props = {
   29:   topicId: string;
   30:   lesson: Lesson;
   31:   nextLessonId?: string;
   32:   topicSimulator?: SimulatorType;
   33: };
   34: 
   35: export default function InteractiveLessonEngine({
   36:   topicId,
   37:   lesson,
   38:   nextLessonId,
   39:   topicSimulator,
   40: }: Props) {
   41:   const { user } = useAuth();
   42: 
   43:   const definition = useMemo(
   44:     () =>
   45:       buildInteractiveLesson(topicId, {
   46:         ...lesson,
   47:         simulator: lesson.simulator ?? topicSimulator,
   48:       }),
   49:     [lesson, topicId, topicSimulator],
   50:   );
   51: 
   52:   const [progress, setProgress] = useState<InteractiveLessonProgress | null>(
   53:     null,
   54:   );
   55: 
   56:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
   57:   const audioSaveTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
   58: 
   59:   useEffect(() => {
   60:     let cancelled = false;
   61: 
   62:     async function loadProgress() {
   63:       if (!user?.uid) {
   64:         setLoading(false);
   65:         return;
   66:       }
   67: 
   68:       try {
   69:         setLoading(true);
   70: 
   71:         const existingProgress = await getLessonProgress(user.uid, lesson.id);
   72: 
   73:         if (cancelled) {
   74:           return;
   75:         }
   76: 
   77:         const initialProgress: InteractiveLessonProgress = existingProgress ?? {
   78:           id: createLessonProgressId(user.uid, lesson.id),
   79:           studentId: user.uid,
   80:           lessonId: lesson.id,
   81:           topicId,
   82: 
   83:           currentStepIndex: 0,
   84:           completedStepIds: [],
   85: 
   86:           practiceResponses: [],
   87:           checkpointResponses: [],
   88: 
   89:           examResponse: "",
   90:           examMarking: null,
   91:           reflection: "",
   92: 
   93:           audioEnabled: false,
   94:           audioRate: 1,
   95:           selectedVoiceName: "",
   96: 
   97:           practiceAccuracy: 0,
   98:           checkpointAccuracy: 0,
   99:           examAccuracy: 0,
  100:           overallAccuracy: 0,
  101:           masteryImpact: 0,
  102:           reviewAt: null,
  103: 
  104:           status: "in_progress",
  105: 
  106:           startedAt: new Date(),
  107:           updatedAt: new Date(),
  108:           completedAt: null,
  109:         };
  110: 
  111:         setProgress(initialProgress);
  112:       } catch (error) {
  113:         console.error("Lesson progress load error:", error);
  114: 
  115:         toast.error("Your saved lesson progress could not be loaded.");
  116:       } finally {
  117:         if (!cancelled) {
  118:           setLoading(false);
  119:         }
  120:       }
  121:     }
  122: 
  123:     void loadProgress();
  124: 
  125:     return () => {
  126:       cancelled = true;
  127: 
  128:       if (audioSaveTimer.current) {
  129:         clearTimeout(audioSaveTimer.current);
  130:       }
  131:     };
  132:   }, [lesson.id, topicId, user?.uid]);
  133: 
  134:   async function persistProgress(nextProgress: InteractiveLessonProgress) {
  135:     setProgress(nextProgress);
  136: 
  137:     if (!user?.uid) {
  138:       return;
  139:     }
  140: 
  141:     try {
  142:       await saveLessonProgress(nextProgress);
  143:     } catch (error) {
  144:       console.error("Lesson progress save error:", error);
  145: 
  146:       toast.error("Your lesson progress could not be saved.");
  147:     }
  148:   }
  149: 
  150:   if (loading) {
  151:     return <div className="h-96 animate-pulse rounded-3xl bg-slate-200" />;
  152:   }
  153: 
  154:   if (!user) {
  155:     return (
  156:       <Card>
  157:         <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-950">Sign in required</h2>
  158: 
  159:         <p className="mt-3 text-slate-600">
  160:           Please sign in to begin this interactive lesson and save your
  161:           progress.
  162:         </p>
  163:       </Card>
  164:     );
  165:   }
  166: 
  167:   if (!progress) {
  168:     return (
  169:       <Card>
  170:         <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-950">
  171:           Lesson progress unavailable
  172:         </h2>
  173: 
  174:         <p className="mt-3 text-slate-600">
  175:           Your lesson progress could not be prepared. Refresh the page and try
  176:           again.
  177:         </p>
  178:       </Card>
  179:     );
  180:   }
  181: 
  182:   /*
  183:    * A stable non-null reference prevents TypeScript from treating
  184:    * progress as possibly null inside nested functions and callbacks.
  185:    */
  186:   const currentProgress = progress;
  187: 
  188:   const safeStepIndex = Math.min(
  189:     Math.max(currentProgress.currentStepIndex, 0),
  190:     Math.max(definition.steps.length - 1, 0),
  191:   );
  192: 
  193:   const currentStep = definition.steps[safeStepIndex];
  194: 
  195:   if (!currentStep) {
  196:     return (
  197:       <Card>
  198:         <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-950">
  199:           Lesson step unavailable
  200:         </h2>
  201: 
  202:         <p className="mt-3 text-slate-600">
  203:           This lesson step could not be loaded. Return to the lesson and try
  204:           again.
  205:         </p>
  206:       </Card>
  207:     );
  208:   }
  209: 
  210:   const nextLessonHref = nextLessonId
  211:     ? `/learn/${topicId}?lesson=${nextLessonId}`
  212:     : undefined;
  213: 
  214:   const checkpointQuestions = lesson.checkpointQuestions?.length
  215:     ? lesson.checkpointQuestions
  216:     : lesson.practiceQuestions.slice(
  217:         0,
  218:         Math.min(3, lesson.practiceQuestions.length),
  219:       );
  220: 
  221:   const practiceCompleted =
  222:     lesson.practiceQuestions.length > 0 &&
  223:     currentProgress.practiceResponses.length ===
  224:       lesson.practiceQuestions.length &&
  225:     currentProgress.practiceResponses.every((response) => response.checked);
  226: 
  227:   const checkpointCompleted =
  228:     checkpointQuestions.length > 0 &&
  229:     currentProgress.checkpointResponses.length === checkpointQuestions.length &&
  230:     currentProgress.checkpointResponses.every((response) => response.checked);
  231: 
  232:   const examResponseCompleted =
  233:     Boolean(currentProgress.examResponse.trim()) &&
  234:     Boolean(currentProgress.examMarking);
  235: 
  236:   const reflectionCompleted = Boolean(currentProgress.reflection.trim());
  237: 
  238:   const canContinue =
  239:     currentStep.type === "practice"
  240:       ? practiceCompleted
  241:       : currentStep.type === "checkpoint"
  242:         ? checkpointCompleted
  243:         : currentStep.type === "exam-question"
  244:           ? examResponseCompleted
  245:           : currentStep.type === "reflection"
  246:             ? reflectionCompleted
  247:             : true;
  248: 
  249:   const completeAudioText =
  250:     lesson.audioTranscript ||
  251:     [
  252:       lesson.title,
  253:       lesson.description,
  254:       ...lesson.objectives,
  255:       lesson.explanation,
  256:       lesson.workedExample,
  257:     ]
  258:       .filter(Boolean)
  259:       .join(". ");
