  261:   function withCalculatedMetrics(
  262:     nextProgress: InteractiveLessonProgress,
  263:   ): InteractiveLessonProgress {
  264:     const practiceAccuracy = calculateResponseAccuracy(

  269:       nextProgress.checkpointResponses,
  270:     );
  271:

  275:       nextProgress.practiceResponses,
  276:       nextProgress.checkpointResponses,
  277:       examAccuracy,
  278:       Boolean(nextProgress.examMarking),
  279:     );

  282:       ...nextProgress,
  283:       practiceAccuracy,
  284:       checkpointAccuracy,
  285:       examAccuracy,
  286:       overallAccuracy,
  287:       masteryImpact: calculateLessonMasteryImpact(overallAccuracy),
  288:       reviewAt: calculateLessonReviewDate(overallAccuracy),

   15: function normaliseAnswer(value: string): string {
   16:   return value
   17:     .trim()
   18:     .toLowerCase()
   19:     .replace(/[.,!?]/g, "")
   20:     .replace(/[-_]/g, " ")
   21:     .replace(/\s+/g, " ");
   22: }
   23: 
   24: function isAcceptedAnswer(
   25:   response: string,
   26:   question: PracticeQuestion,
   27: ): boolean {
   28:   const normalisedResponse = normaliseAnswer(response);
   29: 
   30:   const acceptedAnswers = [
   31:     question.answer,
   32:     ...(question.acceptedAnswers ?? []),
   33:   ].map(normaliseAnswer);
   34: 
   35:   return acceptedAnswers.includes(normalisedResponse);
   36: }
   37: 
   38: function createInitialResponses(
   39:   questions: PracticeQuestion[],
   40:   existingResponses: PracticeResponse[],
   41: ): PracticeResponse[] {
   42:   return questions.map((_, index) => {
   43:     const existingResponse = existingResponses.find(
   44:       (response) => response.questionIndex === index,
   45:     );
   46: 
   47:     return (
   48:       existingResponse ?? {
   49:         questionIndex: index,
   50:         response: "",
   51:         correct: false,
   52:         checked: false,
   53:       }
   54:     );
   55:   });
   56: }
   57: 
   58: export default function LessonPracticeStep({
   59:   questions,
   60:   initialResponses,
   61:   onChange,
   62: }: Props) {
   63:   const [responses, setResponses] = useState<PracticeResponse[]>(() =>
   64:     createInitialResponses(questions, initialResponses),
   65:   );
   66: 
   67:   useEffect(() => {
   68:     void Promise.resolve().then(() => {
   69:       setResponses(createInitialResponses(questions, initialResponses));
   70:     });
   71:   }, [questions, initialResponses]);
   72: 
   73:   function updateResponse(
   74:     questionIndex: number,
   75:     updates: Partial<PracticeResponse>,
   76:   ) {
   77:     const updatedResponses = responses.map((response) =>
   78:       response.questionIndex === questionIndex
   79:         ? {
   80:             ...response,
   81:             ...updates,
   82:           }
   83:         : response,
   84:     );
   85: 
   86:     setResponses(updatedResponses);
   87:     onChange(updatedResponses);
   88:   }
   89: 
   90:   function checkAnswer(questionIndex: number) {
   91:     const question = questions[questionIndex];
   92: 
   93:     const response = responses.find(
   94:       (item) => item.questionIndex === questionIndex,
   95:     );
   96: 
   97:     if (!question || !response) {
   98:       return;
   99:     }
  100: 
  101:     updateResponse(questionIndex, {
  102:       checked: true,
  103:       correct: isAcceptedAnswer(response.response, question),
  104:     });
  105:   }
  106: 
  107:   if (questions.length === 0) {
  108:     return (
  109:       <div className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6">

  115:   }
  116:

  120:         const response = responses.find(
  121:           (item) => item.questionIndex === index,
  122:         ) ?? {
  123:           questionIndex: index,
  124:           response: "",
  125:           correct: false,
  126:           checked: false,
  127:         };

  134:             <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between">

  137:                   Question {index + 1}
  138:                 </p>
  139:

  345:         });
  346: 
  347:       setRunResult(result);
  348: 
  349:       if (result.timedOut) {
  350:         setStatusMessage(
  351:           "Execution stopped because it exceeded the time limit.",
  352:         );
  353:       } else if (
  354:         result.error ||
  355:         result.stderr
  356:       ) {
  357:         setStatusMessage(
  358:           "Python returned an error. Use the console to debug it.",
  359:         );
  360:       } else {
  361:         setStatusMessage(
  362:           "Run complete.",
  363:         );
  364:       }
  365:     } catch (error) {
  366:       setRunResult({
  367:         ...emptyRun,
  368:         error:
  369:           error instanceof Error
  370:             ? error.message
  371:             : "Python could not run.",
  372:       });
  373: 
  374:       setStatusMessage(
  375:         "The Python runtime could not start.",
  376:       );
  377:     } finally {
  378:       setRunning(false);
  379:     }
  380:   }
  381: 
  382:   async function handleCheck() {
  383:     if (
  384:       !challenge ||
  385:       !code.trim()
  386:     ) {
  387:       return;
  388:     }
  389: 
  390:     setChecking(true);
  391:     setEvaluation(null);
  392:     setShowExplanation(false);
  393: 
  394:     setStatusMessage(
  395:       "Checking visible and hidden tests...",
  396:     );
  397: 
  398:     try {
  399:       const result =
  400:         await evaluateProgrammingChallenge(
  401:           challenge,
  402:           code,
  403:         );
  404: 
  405:       setEvaluation(result);
  406: 
  407:       const awarded =
  408:         progress.recordAttempt(
  409:           challenge,
  410:           result.passed,
  411:         );
  412: 
  413:       if (
  414:         assignedMode &&
  415:         assignmentId &&
  416:         user?.uid
  417:       ) {
  418:         await recordProgrammingAssignmentAttempt(
  419:           {
  420:             assignmentId,
  421:             studentId: user.uid,
  422:             code,
  423:             passed: result.passed,
  424:             passedCount:
  425:               result.passedCount,
  426:             totalTests:
  427:               result.totalCount,
  428:             error:
  429:               result.results
  430:                 .filter(
  431:                   (item) =>
  432:                     !item.passed &&
  433:                     item.error,
  434:                 )
  435:                 .map(
  436:                   (item) =>
  437:                     item.error,
  438:                 )
  439:                 .filter(Boolean)
  440:                 .join("\n")
  441:                 .slice(0, 2000),
  442:           },
  443:         );
  444:       }
  445: 
  446:       if (result.passed) {
  447:         setShowExplanation(true);
  448: 
  449:         if (assignedMode) {
  450:           setStatusMessage(
  451:             awarded > 0
  452:               ? `Assignment completed. All tests passed and +${awarded} XP was awarded.`
  453:               : "Assignment completed. All tests passed.",
  454:           );
  455:         } else {
  456:           setStatusMessage(
  457:             awarded > 0
  458:               ? `All tests passed. +${awarded} XP awarded.`
  459:               : "All tests passed. This challenge was already completed for XP.",
  460:           );
  461:         }
  462:       } else {
  463:         setStatusMessage(
  464:           `${result.passedCount}/${result.totalCount} tests passed. Review the feedback and try again.`,
  465:         );
  466:       }
  467:     } catch (error) {
  468:       setStatusMessage(
  469:         error instanceof Error
  470:           ? error.message
  471:           : "The solution could not be checked.",
  472:       );
  473:     } finally {
  474:       setChecking(false);
  475:     }
  476:   }
  477: 
  478:   function resetCurrent() {
  479:     if (
  480:       mode === "explore" &&
  481:       !assignedMode
  482:     ) {
  483:       setCode(exploreStarter);
  484:       setStdin("Ada");

   31:   resourceId: string;
   32:   deliveryMode: QuizDeliveryMode;
   33: };
   34: 
   35: const DEFAULT_QUIZ_DURATION_SECONDS = 8 * 60;
   36: const FULLSCREEN_EXIT_COUNTDOWN_SECONDS = 5;
   37: 
   38: function parseQuizDurationSeconds(value: string): number {
   39:   const normalised = value.trim().toLowerCase();
   40: 
   41:   if (!normalised) {
   42:     return DEFAULT_QUIZ_DURATION_SECONDS;
   43:   }
   44: 
   45:   const hoursMatch = normalised.match(
   46:     /(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:hours?|hrs?|hr|h)\b/,
   47:   );
   48: 
   49:   const minutesMatch = normalised.match(
   50:     /(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:minutes?|mins?|min|m)\b/,
   51:   );
   52: 
   53:   const secondsMatch = normalised.match(
   54:     /(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:seconds?|secs?|sec|s)\b/,
   55:   );
   56: 
   57:   const hours = hoursMatch ? Number(hoursMatch[1]) : 0;
   58:   const minutes = minutesMatch ? Number(minutesMatch[1]) : 0;
   59:   const seconds = secondsMatch ? Number(secondsMatch[1]) : 0;
   60: 
   61:   const totalSeconds = Math.round(
   62:     hours * 60 * 60 +
   63:       minutes * 60 +
   64:       seconds,
   65:   );
   66: 
   67:   return totalSeconds > 0
   68:     ? totalSeconds
   69:     : DEFAULT_QUIZ_DURATION_SECONDS;
   70: }
   71: 
   72: function getGrade(scorePercent: number) {
   73:   if (scorePercent >= 90) return "Grade 9";
   74:   if (scorePercent >= 80) return "Grade 8";
   75:   if (scorePercent >= 70) return "Grade 7";
   76:   if (scorePercent >= 60) return "Grade 6";
   77:   if (scorePercent >= 50) return "Grade 5";
   78:   if (scorePercent >= 40) return "Grade 4";
   79:   if (scorePercent >= 30) return "Grade 3";
   80:   if (scorePercent >= 20) return "Grade 2";
   81:   return "Grade 1";
   82: }
   83: 
   84: function getMessage(scorePercent: number) {
   85:   if (scorePercent >= 90) return "Outstanding performance!";
   86:   if (scorePercent >= 75) return "Excellent work!";
   87:   if (scorePercent >= 60) return "Good progress!";
   88:   if (scorePercent >= 40) return "You are getting there.";
   89:   return "Keep practising. You can improve this.";
   90: }
   91: 
   92: function createIncident(
   93:   type: QuizIntegrityIncident["type"],
   94:   questionNumber: number | null,
   95:   detail: string,
   96: ): QuizIntegrityIncident {
   97:   return {
   98:     id: `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9)}`,
   99:     type,
  100:     occurredAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  101:     questionNumber,
  102:     detail,
  103:   };
  104: }

  156:   const deliveryMode: QuizDeliveryMode =

  159:     Boolean(assignmentId) && deliveryMode === "assessment";
  160: 
  161:   const currentQuestion = quiz.questions[currentIndex];
  162:   const selectedAnswer = currentQuestion
  163:     ? answers[currentQuestion.id] || ""
  164:     : "";
  165: 
  166:   const currentQuestionNumber = currentIndex + 1;
  167: 
  168:   const progress = Math.round(
  169:     ((currentIndex + 1) / Math.max(1, quiz.questions.length)) * 100,
  170:   );
  171: 
  172:   const totalXP = useMemo(() => {
  173:     return quiz.questions.reduce(
  174:       (total, question) => total + question.xpReward,
  175:       0,
  176:     );
  177:   }, [quiz.questions]);
  178: 
  179:   const correctCount = quiz.questions.filter((question) => {
  180:     const userAnswer = answers[question.id]?.trim().toLowerCase();
  181:     const correctAnswer = question.correctAnswer.trim().toLowerCase();
  182:     return userAnswer === correctAnswer;
  183:   }).length;
  184:

  186:     (correctCount / Math.max(1, quiz.questions.length)) * 100,

  188: 
  189:   const earnedXP = quiz.questions.reduce((total, question) => {
  190:     const userAnswer = answers[question.id]?.trim().toLowerCase();
  191:     const correctAnswer = question.correctAnswer.trim().toLowerCase();
  192: 
  193:     return userAnswer === correctAnswer
  194:       ? total + question.xpReward
  195:       : total;
  196:   }, 0);
  197: 
  198:   /*
  199:    * Integrity-terminated assessment attempts retain their raw score for

  201:    */
  202:   const awardedXP = integrityTerminated ? 0 : earnedXP;
  203: 
  204:   const strengths = quiz.questions
  205:     .filter((question) => {
  206:       const userAnswer = answers[question.id]?.trim().toLowerCase();
  207:       const correctAnswer = question.correctAnswer.trim().toLowerCase();
  208:       return userAnswer === correctAnswer;
  209:     })
  210:     .slice(0, 3);
  211: 
  212:   const needsPractice = quiz.questions
  213:     .filter((question) => {
  214:       const userAnswer = answers[question.id]?.trim().toLowerCase();
  215:       const correctAnswer = question.correctAnswer.trim().toLowerCase();
  216:       return userAnswer !== correctAnswer;
  217:     })
  218:     .slice(0, 3);
  219: 
  220:   useEffect(() => {
  221:     let cancelled = false;
  222: 
  223:     async function loadLinkedAssignment() {
  224:       if (!assignmentId) {
  225:         setLinkedAssignment(null);
  226:         setAssignmentLoading(false);
  227:         return;
  228:       }
  229: 
  230:       if (!user?.uid) {
  231:         setLinkedAssignment(null);
  232:         setAssignmentError(
  233:           "Sign in with the student account that received this assignment.",
  234:         );
  235:         setAssignmentLoading(false);
  236:         return;
  237:       }
  238:

  240:         setAssignmentLoading(true);
  241:         setAssignmentError("");
  242:

  244:           doc(db, "assignments", assignmentId),
  245:         );
  246:

  249:             "The linked quiz assignment could not be found.",
  250:           );

  254: 
  255:         if (data.type !== "quiz") {
  256:           throw new Error(

  259:         }

  262:           throw new Error(
  263:             "The assignment is missing its class or teacher information.",
  264:           );
  265:         }
  266: 
  267:         if (data.status === "cancelled") {
  268:           throw new Error(
  269:             "This quiz assignment has been cancelled.",
  270:           );
  271:         }
  272:

  274:           typeof data.resourceId === "string"
  275:             ? data.resourceId.trim()
  276:             : "";
  277: 
  278:         if (
  279:           !assignedResourceId ||
  280:           ![

  284:         ) {

  286:             "This quiz does not match the linked assignment.",
  287:           );
  288:         }
  289: 
  290:         const classSnapshot = await getDoc(
  291:           doc(
  292:             db,
  293:             "classes",
  294:             data.classId,
  295:           ),
  296:         );
  297: 
  298:         if (!classSnapshot.exists()) {
  299:           throw new Error(
  300:             "The class linked to this assignment could not be found.",
  301:           );
  302:         }
  303: 
  304:         const classData =
  305:           classSnapshot.data();
  306: 
  307:         const studentIds =
  308:           Array.isArray(
  309:             classData.studentIds,
  310:           )
  311:             ? classData.studentIds.filter(
  312:                 (
  313:                   value,
  314:                 ): value is string =>
  315:                   typeof value ===
  316:                     "string" &&
  317:                   Boolean(
  318:                     value.trim(),
  319:                   ),
  320:               )
  321:             : [];
  322: 
  323:         if (
  324:           !studentIds.includes(
  325:             user.uid,
  326:           )
  327:         ) {
  328:           throw new Error(
  329:             "You do not have access to this quiz assignment.",
  330:           );
  331:         }
  332: 
  333:         if (!cancelled) {
  334:           setLinkedAssignment({
  335:             id: snapshot.id,
  336:             classId: data.classId,
  337:             teacherId: data.teacherId,
  338:             resourceId:
  339:               assignedResourceId,
  340:             deliveryMode:
  341:               data.deliveryMode ===
  342:               "assessment"
  343:                 ? "assessment"
  344:                 : "practice",
  345:           });
  346:         }
  347:       } catch (error) {
  348:         console.error(
  349:           "Quiz assignment load error:",
  350:           error,
  351:         );
  352: 
  353:         if (!cancelled) {
  354:           setLinkedAssignment(null);
  355:           setAssignmentError(
  356:             error instanceof Error
  357:               ? error.message
  358:               : "The linked quiz assignment could not be loaded.",
  359:           );
  360:         }
  361:       } finally {
  362:         if (!cancelled) {
  363:           setAssignmentLoading(false);
  364:         }
  365:       }
  366:     }
  367: 
  368:     void loadLinkedAssignment();
  369: 
  370:     return () => {
  371:       cancelled = true;
  372:     };

  376:     quiz.topicId,
  377:     user?.uid,
  378:   ]);

  385: 
  386:   useEffect(() => {
  387:     return () => {

  410:   async function leaveFullscreenSafely() {

  416:   async function finishQuiz({
  417:     terminated = false,
  418:     reason = "",
  419:   }: {
  420:     terminated?: boolean;
  421:     reason?: string;
  422:   } = {}) {
  423:     if (finishingRef.current || showResults) {
  424:       return;
  425:     }
  426: 
  427:     finishingRef.current = true;
  428: 
  429:     if (countdownTimerRef.current) {
  430:       clearInterval(countdownTimerRef.current);
  431:       countdownTimerRef.current = null;
  432:     }
  433: 
  434:     fullscreenExitActiveRef.current = false;
  435:     setFullscreenCountdown(null);
  436: 
  437:     if (terminated) {
  438:       /*
  439:        * Set the ref first so save effects see termination synchronously,
  440:        * before React finishes applying the state update.
  441:        */
  442:       integrityTerminatedRef.current = true;
  443:       setIntegrityTerminated(true);
  444:       setIntegrityTerminationReason(reason);
  445: 
  446:       appendIntegrityIncident(
  447:         "auto_submit",
  448:         reason || "The assessment was automatically submitted.",
  449:       );
  450:     }
  451: 
  452:     await leaveFullscreenSafely();
  453:     setShowResults(true);
  454:   }

  456:   const finishQuizFromTimer = useEffectEvent(
  457:     (options: { terminated?: boolean; reason?: string }) => {
  458:       void finishQuiz(options);
  459:     },
  460:   );
  461: 
  462:   useEffect(() => {
  463:     if (
  464:       showResults ||
  465:       assignmentLoading ||
  466:       (assessmentMode && !integrityStarted)
  467:     ) {
  468:       return;
  469:     }
  470: 
  471:     const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
  472:       setTimeLeft((previousTime) => {
  473:         if (previousTime <= 1) {
  474:           window.clearInterval(timer);
  475: 
  476:           finishQuizFromTimer({
  477:             terminated: assessmentMode,
  478:             reason: assessmentMode
  479:               ? "The assessment timer expired and the quiz was automatically submitted."
  480:               : "",
  481:           });
  482: 
  483:           return 0;
  484:         }
  485: 
  486:         return previousTime - 1;
  487:       });
  488:     }, 1000);
  489: 
  490:     return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  491:   }, [
  492:     showResults,
  493:     assignmentLoading,
  494:     assessmentMode,
  495:     integrityStarted,
  496:   ]);

  498:   function beginFullscreenCountdown() {
  499:     if (
  500:       !assessmentMode ||
  501:       !integrityStarted ||
  502:       showResults ||
  503:       finishingRef.current ||
  504:       fullscreenExitActiveRef.current
  505:     ) {
  506:       return;
  507:     }
  508: 
  509:     fullscreenExitActiveRef.current = true;
  510: 
  511:     setFullscreenCountdown(FULLSCREEN_EXIT_COUNTDOWN_SECONDS);
  512: 
  513:     appendIntegrityIncident(
  514:       "fullscreen_exit",
  515:       `Fullscreen was exited. A ${FULLSCREEN_EXIT_COUNTDOWN_SECONDS}-second return countdown started.`,
  516:     );
  517: 
  518:     let remaining = FULLSCREEN_EXIT_COUNTDOWN_SECONDS;
  519: 
  520:     countdownTimerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
  521:       remaining -= 1;
  522:       setFullscreenCountdown(Math.max(remaining, 0));
  523: 
  524:       if (remaining <= 0) {
  525:         if (countdownTimerRef.current) {
  526:           clearInterval(countdownTimerRef.current);
  527:           countdownTimerRef.current = null;
  528:         }
  529: 
  530:         void finishQuiz({
  531:           terminated: true,
  532:           reason:
  533:             "The learner exited fullscreen and did not return within 5 seconds.",
  534:         });
  535:       }
  536:     }, 1000);
  537:   }
  538: 
  539:   function resolveFullscreenExit() {
  540:     if (!fullscreenExitActiveRef.current) {
  541:       return;
  542:     }
  543: 
  544:     fullscreenExitActiveRef.current = false;
  545: 
  546:     if (countdownTimerRef.current) {
  547:       clearInterval(countdownTimerRef.current);
  548:       countdownTimerRef.current = null;
  549:     }
  550: 
  551:     setFullscreenCountdown(null);
  552: 
  553:     appendIntegrityIncident(
  554:       "fullscreen_restored",
  555:       "Fullscreen was restored before the five-second termination countdown expired.",
  556:     );
  557:   }
  558: 
  559:   const handleFullscreenChange = useEffectEvent(() => {
  560:     if (finishingRef.current) {
  561:       return;
  562:     }
  563: 
  564:     if (
  565:       document.fullscreenElement ===
  566:       assessmentRootRef.current
  567:     ) {
  568:       resolveFullscreenExit();
  569:     } else {
  570:       beginFullscreenCountdown();
  571:     }
  572:   });
  573: 
  574:   const handleVisibilityChange = useEffectEvent(() => {
  575:     if (finishingRef.current) {
  576:       return;
  577:     }
  578: 
  579:     if (document.visibilityState === "hidden") {
  580:       appendIntegrityIncident(
  581:         "page_hidden",
  582:         "The assessment page became hidden.",
  583:       );
  584: 
  585:       setIntegrityWarning(
  586:         "The assessment page was hidden. This incident has been recorded.",
  587:       );
  588:     } else {
  589:       appendIntegrityIncident(
  590:         "page_visible",
  591:         "The assessment page became visible again.",
  592:       );
  593:     }
  594:   });
  595: 
  596:   useEffect(() => {
  597:     if (
  598:       !assessmentMode ||
  599:       !integrityStarted ||
  600:       showResults
  601:     ) {
  602:       return;
  603:     }
  604: 
  605:     function onFullscreenChange() {
  606:       handleFullscreenChange();
  607:     }
  608: 
  609:     function onVisibilityChange() {
  610:       handleVisibilityChange();
  611:     }
  612: 
  613:     document.addEventListener(
  614:       "fullscreenchange",
  615:       onFullscreenChange,
  616:     );
  617:     document.addEventListener(
  618:       "visibilitychange",
  619:       onVisibilityChange,
  620:     );
  621: 
  622:     return () => {
  623:       document.removeEventListener(
  624:         "fullscreenchange",
  625:         onFullscreenChange,
  626:       );
  627:       document.removeEventListener(
  628:         "visibilitychange",
  629:         onVisibilityChange,
  630:       );
  631:     };
  632:   }, [
  633:     assessmentMode,
  634:     integrityStarted,
  635:     showResults,
  636:   ]);
  637: 
  638:   async function enterAssessmentMode() {
  639:     if (!assessmentRootRef.current) {
  640:       return;
  641:     }
  642: 
  643:     if (!document.fullscreenEnabled) {
  644:       toast.error(
  645:         "Fullscreen is not available in this browser. Ask your teacher for support.",
  646:       );
  647:       return;
  648:     }
  649: 
  650:     try {
  651:       await assessmentRootRef.current.requestFullscreen();
  652: 
  653:       const startedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  654:       setIntegritySessionStartedAt(startedAt);
  655:       setIntegrityStarted(true);
  656:       setIntegrityWarning("");
  657:       integrityTerminatedRef.current = false;
  658:       setIntegrityTerminated(false);
  659:       setIntegrityTerminationReason("");
  660:       finishingRef.current = false;
  661:       integrityIncidentsRef.current = [];
  662: 
  663:       toast.success("Monitored assessment started.");
  664:     } catch (error) {
  665:       console.error(
  666:         "Unable to enter monitored assessment mode:",
  667:         error,

  671:         "Fullscreen assessment mode could not be started.",
  672:       );
  673:     }
  674:   }

  676:   async function returnToFullscreen() {
  677:     if (!assessmentRootRef.current) {
  678:       return;
  679:     }
  680: 
  681:     try {
  682:       await assessmentRootRef.current.requestFullscreen();
  683:     } catch {
  684:       toast.error(
  685:         "Fullscreen could not be restored. Return before the countdown reaches zero.",
  686:       );
  687:     }
  688:   }
  689: 
  690:   useEffect(() => {
  691:     async function saveNormalQuizResult() {
  692:       if (
  693:         !showResults ||
  694:         resultSaved ||
  695:         !user ||
  696:         quizSaveInProgress.current
  697:       ) {
  698:         return;

  702: 
  703:       try {
  704:         await saveQuizResult({
  705:           uid: user.uid,
  706:           quizId: quiz.id,
  707:           topicId: quiz.topicId,
  708:           title: quiz.title,
  709:           scorePercent,
  710:           correctCount,
  711:           totalQuestions: quiz.questions.length,
  712:           earnedXP:
  713:             integrityTerminatedRef.current
  714:               ? 0
  715:               : awardedXP,
  716:         });
  717: 
  718:         setResultSaved(true);
  719: 
  720:         toast.success(
  721:           integrityTerminated
  722:             ? "Assessment result saved. No XP was awarded."
  723:             : `Quiz result saved! +${awardedXP} XP`,
  724:         );
  725:       } catch (error) {
  726:         console.error("Quiz save error:", error);
  727:         toast.error("Could not save quiz result.");
  728:       } finally {
  729:         quizSaveInProgress.current = false;
  730:       }
  731:     }
  732: 
  733:     void saveNormalQuizResult();
  734:   }, [
  735:     showResults,
  736:     resultSaved,
  737:     user,
  738:     quiz.id,
  739:     quiz.topicId,
  740:     quiz.title,
  741:     quiz.questions.length,
  742:     scorePercent,
  743:     correctCount,
  744:     awardedXP,
  745:     integrityTerminated,
  746:   ]);
  747: 
  748:   useEffect(() => {
  749:     async function saveLinkedAssignmentResult() {
  750:       if (
  751:         !showResults ||
  752:         !assignmentId ||
  753:         !linkedAssignment ||
  754:         assignmentResultSaved ||

    1: "use client";

    3: import { useMemo, useState } from "react";

   33: 
   34: const questionBank: Record<DifficultyLevel, CPUQuestion[]> = {
   35:   foundation: [
   36:     {
   37:       prompt:
   38:         "Which register stores the address of the next instruction to be fetched?",
   39:       options: ["PC", "MDR", "CIR", "ACC"],
   40:       answer: "PC",
   41:       hint: "Think about which register points to the next instruction.",
   42:       working:
   43:         "The Program Counter (PC) stores the address of the next instruction to fetch.",
   44:       examinerTip:
   45:         "Use the full register name if a question asks you to describe its role.",
   46:     },
   47:     {
   48:       prompt:
   49:         "During fetch, which register receives the address copied from the PC?",
   50:       options: ["MAR", "MDR", "ACC", "CIR"],
   51:       answer: "MAR",
   52:       hint: "This register holds the memory address currently being accessed.",
   53:       working:
   54:         "The address in the PC is copied to the Memory Address Register (MAR).",
   55:       examinerTip: "Distinguish addresses (MAR) from data/instructions (MDR).",
   56:     },
   57:   ],
   58:   intermediate: [
   59:     {
   60:       prompt:
   61:         "Which register temporarily stores the instruction read from memory before it moves to the CIR?",
   62:       options: ["MDR", "MAR", "PC", "ACC"],
   63:       answer: "MDR",
   64:       hint: "The value has just travelled from memory into the processor.",
   65:       working:
   66:         "Memory sends the instruction to the Memory Data Register (MDR), then it is copied to the CIR.",
   67:       examinerTip:
   68:         "MDR stores data or instructions being transferred to or from memory.",
   69:     },
   70:     {
   71:       prompt: "Why is the Program Counter incremented during the fetch cycle?",
   72:       options: [
   73:         "To point to the next instruction",
   74:         "To decode the current instruction",
   75:         "To store an arithmetic result",
   76:         "To hold the memory data",
   77:       ],
   78:       answer: "To point to the next instruction",

   80:       working:

   92:       hint: "Decoding acts on the current instruction, not on its memory address.",

  108:     },

  110: };
  111: 
  112: function createQuestion(difficulty: DifficultyLevel): CPUQuestion {
  113:   const bank = questionBank[difficulty];
  114:   return bank[Math.floor(Math.random() * bank.length)];
  115: }
  116: 
  117: export default function CPUSimulator() {
  118:   const { addXP } = useProgress();
  119:   const simulator = useSimulator<CPUQuestion>({
  120:     initialQuestion: createQuestion("foundation"),
  121:     generateQuestion: createQuestion,
  122:     onAwardXP: addXP,
  123:     simulatorId: "cpu",
  124:   });
  125: 
  126:   const [selectedAnswer, setSelectedAnswer] = useState("");
  127:   const [stepIndex, setStepIndex] = useState(0);
  128:   const [registers, setRegisters] = useState<CPURegisters>(initialCPURegisters);
  129:   const [cyclesCompleted, setCyclesCompleted] = useState(0);
  130: 
  131:   const currentStep = cpuCycleSteps[stepIndex];
  132:   const activeMemoryAddress = useMemo(() => {
  133:     if (
  134:       currentStep.stage === "memory-to-mdr" ||
  135:       currentStep.stage === "pc-to-mar"
  136:     ) {
  137:       return registers.MAR;
  138:     }
  139:     return null;
  140:   }, [currentStep.stage, registers.MAR]);
  141: 
  142:   function applyStage(stage: CPUCycleStage) {
  143:     setRegisters((current) => {
  144:       if (stage === "pc-to-mar") return { ...current, MAR: current.PC };
  145:       if (stage === "memory-to-mdr")
  146:         return { ...current, MDR: getMemoryInstruction(current.MAR) };
  147:       if (stage === "mdr-to-cir") return { ...current, CIR: current.MDR };
  148:       if (stage === "increment-pc") return { ...current, PC: current.PC + 1 };
  149:       if (stage === "execute")
  150:         return {
  151:           ...current,
  152:           ACC: executeInstruction(current.CIR, current.ACC),
  153:         };
  154:       return current;
  155:     });
  156:   }
  157: 
  158:   function nextStep() {
  159:     if (stepIndex >= cpuCycleSteps.length - 1) return;
  160:     const nextIndex = stepIndex + 1;
  161:     const nextStage = cpuCycleSteps[nextIndex].stage;
  162:     applyStage(nextStage);
  163:     setStepIndex(nextIndex);
  164:     if (nextStage === "complete") setCyclesCompleted((current) => current + 1);
  165:   }
  166: 
  167:   function previousStep() {
  168:     setStepIndex((current) => Math.max(0, current - 1));
  169:   }
  170: 
  171:   function startNextInstruction() {
  172:     if (registers.PC >= cpuMemory.length) {
  173:       setRegisters(initialCPURegisters);
  174:       setCyclesCompleted(0);
  175:     }
  176:     setStepIndex(0);
  177:   }
  178: 
  179:   function resetExplorer() {
  180:     setRegisters(initialCPURegisters);
  181:     setStepIndex(0);
  182:     setCyclesCompleted(0);
  183:   }
  184: 
  185:   function checkAnswer() {
  186:     if (!selectedAnswer) return;
  187:     simulator.markAnswer(selectedAnswer === simulator.question.answer);
  188:   }
  189: 
  190:   function tryAgain() {
  191:     setSelectedAnswer("");
  192:     simulator.resetQuestion();
  193:   }
  194: 
  195:   function newQuestion() {
  196:     setSelectedAnswer("");
  197:     simulator.newQuestion();
  198:   }
  199: 
  200:   function changeDifficulty(level: DifficultyLevel) {
  201:     setSelectedAnswer("");
  202:     simulator.changeDifficulty(level);
  203:   }
  204: 
  205:   return (
  206:     <Card>
  207:       <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-blue-600">
  208:         CPU laboratory
  209:       </p>
  210:       <h2 className="mt-2 text-3xl font-black text-slate-950">
  211:         Fetchâ€“Decodeâ€“Execute Challenge
  212:       </h2>
  213:       <p className="mt-3 max-w-3xl leading-7 text-slate-600">
  214:         Test your register knowledge, then step through a live
  215:         fetchâ€“decodeâ€“execute cycle and watch data move through the processor.
  216:       </p>
  217: 
  218:       <div className="mt-6">
  219:         <SimulatorDifficulty
  220:           value={simulator.difficulty}
  221:           onChange={changeDifficulty}
  222:         />
  223:       </div>
  224:       <div className="mt-5">
  225:         <SimulatorStats
  226:           attempts={simulator.attempts}
  227:           correct={simulator.correctAnswers}
  228:           accuracy={simulator.accuracy}
  229:           xp={simulator.xp}
  230:           streak={simulator.streak}
  231:         />
  232:       </div>
  233: 
  234:       <section className="mt-5 rounded-2xl border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 p-5">
  235:         <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-blue-600">
  236:           Current challenge
  237:         </p>
  238:         <h3 className="mt-2 text-xl font-black text-slate-950">
  239:           {simulator.question.prompt}
  240:         </h3>
  241:         <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
  242:           {simulator.question.options.map((option) => (

   15:

   18: type Question = {

   21:   unsafe: string;

   23:   working: string;
   24: };
   25: 
   26: type ChoiceOption = readonly [SecurityChoice, string];
   27: 
   28: const BANK: Record<Difficulty, Question[]> = {

   90: function pickQuestion(difficulty: Difficulty): Question {
   91:   const questions = BANK[difficulty];
   92: 
   93:   return questions[Math.floor(Math.random() * questions.length)];
   94: }
   95: 
   96: export default function CyberSecurityScenarioSimulator() {
   97:   const { addXP } = useProgress();
   98: 
   99:   const generateQuestion = useCallback(
  100:     (difficulty: Difficulty) => pickQuestion(difficulty),
  101:     [],
  102:   );
  103: 
  104:   const simulator = useSimulator<Question>({
  105:     initialQuestion: pickQuestion("foundation"),
  106:     generateQuestion,
  107:     onAwardXP: addXP,
  108:   });
  109: 
  110:   const [choice, setChoice] = useState<SecurityChoice | null>(null);
  111: 
  112:   const options = useMemo<ChoiceOption[]>(() => {
  113:     const safe: ChoiceOption = ["safe", simulator.question.safe];
  114:     const unsafe: ChoiceOption = ["unsafe", simulator.question.unsafe];
  115: 
  116:     const orderKey = `${simulator.question.safe}|${simulator.question.unsafe}`
  117:       .split("")
  118:       .reduce((total, character) => total + character.charCodeAt(0), 0);
  119: 
  120:     return orderKey % 2 === 0 ? [safe, unsafe] : [unsafe, safe];
  121:   }, [simulator.question]);
  122: 
  123:   function checkAnswer() {
  124:     simulator.markAnswer(choice === "safe");
  125:   }
  126: 
  127:   function resetQuestion() {
  128:     setChoice(null);
  129:     simulator.resetQuestion();
  130:   }
  131: 
  132:   function newScenario() {
  133:     setChoice(null);
  134:     simulator.newQuestion();
  135:   }
  136: 
  137:   function changeDifficulty(difficulty: Difficulty) {
  138:     setChoice(null);
  139:     simulator.changeDifficulty(difficulty);
  140:   }
  141: 
  142:   return (
  143:     <Card>
  144:       <p className="text-sm font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-blue-600">
  145:         Interactive challenge

  150:       </h2>
  151: 
  152:       <p className="mt-3 text-slate-600">
  153:         Identify the safest response and justify defensive behaviour.
  154:       </p>
  155: 
  156:       <div className="mt-6">
  157:         <SimulatorDifficulty
  158:           value={simulator.difficulty}
  159:           onChange={changeDifficulty}
  160:         />
  161:       </div>
  162: 
  163:       <div className="mt-6">
  164:         <SimulatorStats
  165:           attempts={simulator.attempts}
  166:           correct={simulator.correctAnswers}
  167:           accuracy={simulator.accuracy}
  168:           xp={simulator.xp}
  169:           streak={simulator.streak}
  170:         />
  171:       </div>
  172: 
  173:       <section className="mt-6 rounded-3xl bg-slate-950 p-6 text-white">
  174:         <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400">
  175:           Scenario
  176:         </p>
  177: 
  178:         <p className="mt-3 text-xl font-black leading-8">
  179:           {simulator.question.prompt}
  180:         </p>
  181:       </section>
  182: 
  183:       <div className="mt-5 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">

  185:           <button
  186:             key={value}

  199:       </div>
  200: 
  201:       <div className="mt-5">

   76:         "To hold the memory data",
   77:       ],
   78:       answer: "To point to the next instruction",
   79:       hint: "Consider what must happen after the current instruction has been fetched.",
   80:       working:
   81:         "Incrementing the PC prepares it with the address of the next instruction in sequence.",
   82:       examinerTip:
   83:         "Avoid saying only 'it goes up by one'; explain the purpose.",
   84:     },
   85:   ],
   86:   higher: [
   87:     {
   88:       prompt:
   89:         "A fetched instruction is currently in the MDR. What transfer must occur before decoding?",
   90:       options: ["MDR â†’ CIR", "CIR â†’ MAR", "ACC â†’ MDR", "PC â†’ ACC"],
   91:       answer: "MDR â†’ CIR",
   92:       hint: "Decoding acts on the current instruction, not on its memory address.",
   93:       working:
   94:         "The fetched instruction is copied from the MDR into the Current Instruction Register (CIR), where the control unit can decode it.",
   95:       examinerTip:
   96:         "For sequence questions, state both the source and destination register.",
   97:     },
   98:     {
   99:       prompt:
  100:         "Which register is most likely to change when an arithmetic instruction is executed?",
  101:       options: ["ACC", "MAR", "PC only", "MDR only"],
  102:       answer: "ACC",
  103:       hint: "Think about where intermediate arithmetic and logic results are held.",
  104:       working:
  105:         "The accumulator stores intermediate arithmetic and logic results, so execution can update the ACC.",
  106:       examinerTip:
  107:         "Link the register to its purpose rather than memorising its abbreviation alone.",
  108:     },
  109:   ],
  110: };
  111: 
  112: function createQuestion(difficulty: DifficultyLevel): CPUQuestion {
  113:   const bank = questionBank[difficulty];
  114:   return bank[Math.floor(Math.random() * bank.length)];
  115: }
  116: 
  117: export default function CPUSimulator() {
  118:   const { addXP } = useProgress();
  119:   const simulator = useSimulator<CPUQuestion>({
  120:     initialQuestion: createQuestion("foundation"),
  121:     generateQuestion: createQuestion,
  122:     onAwardXP: addXP,
  123:     simulatorId: "cpu",
  124:   });
  125: 
  126:   const [selectedAnswer, setSelectedAnswer] = useState("");
  127:   const [stepIndex, setStepIndex] = useState(0);
  128:   const [registers, setRegisters] = useState<CPURegisters>(initialCPURegisters);
  129:   const [cyclesCompleted, setCyclesCompleted] = useState(0);
  130: 
  131:   const currentStep = cpuCycleSteps[stepIndex];
  132:   const activeMemoryAddress = useMemo(() => {
  133:     if (
  134:       currentStep.stage === "memory-to-mdr" ||
  135:       currentStep.stage === "pc-to-mar"
  136:     ) {
  137:       return registers.MAR;
  138:     }
  139:     return null;
  140:   }, [currentStep.stage, registers.MAR]);
  141: 
  142:   function applyStage(stage: CPUCycleStage) {
  143:     setRegisters((current) => {
  144:       if (stage === "pc-to-mar") return { ...current, MAR: current.PC };
  145:       if (stage === "memory-to-mdr")
  146:         return { ...current, MDR: getMemoryInstruction(current.MAR) };
  147:       if (stage === "mdr-to-cir") return { ...current, CIR: current.MDR };
  148:       if (stage === "increment-pc") return { ...current, PC: current.PC + 1 };
  149:       if (stage === "execute")
  150:         return {
  151:           ...current,
  152:           ACC: executeInstruction(current.CIR, current.ACC),
  153:         };
  154:       return current;
  155:     });
  156:   }
  157: 
  158:   function nextStep() {
  159:     if (stepIndex >= cpuCycleSteps.length - 1) return;
  160:     const nextIndex = stepIndex + 1;
  161:     const nextStage = cpuCycleSteps[nextIndex].stage;
  162:     applyStage(nextStage);
  163:     setStepIndex(nextIndex);
  164:     if (nextStage === "complete") setCyclesCompleted((current) => current + 1);
  165:   }
  166: 
  167:   function previousStep() {
  168:     setStepIndex((current) => Math.max(0, current - 1));
  169:   }
  170: 
  171:   function startNextInstruction() {
  172:     if (registers.PC >= cpuMemory.length) {
  173:       setRegisters(initialCPURegisters);
  174:       setCyclesCompleted(0);
  175:     }
  176:     setStepIndex(0);
  177:   }
  178: 
  179:   function resetExplorer() {
  180:     setRegisters(initialCPURegisters);
  181:     setStepIndex(0);
  182:     setCyclesCompleted(0);
  183:   }
  184: 
  185:   function checkAnswer() {
  186:     if (!selectedAnswer) return;
  187:     simulator.markAnswer(selectedAnswer === simulator.question.answer);
  188:   }
  189: 
  190:   function tryAgain() {
  191:     setSelectedAnswer("");
  192:     simulator.resetQuestion();
  193:   }
  194: 
  195:   function newQuestion() {
  196:     setSelectedAnswer("");
  197:     simulator.newQuestion();
  198:   }
  199: 
  200:   function changeDifficulty(level: DifficultyLevel) {
  201:     setSelectedAnswer("");
  202:     simulator.changeDifficulty(level);
  203:   }
  204: 
  205:   return (
  206:     <Card>
  207:       <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-blue-600">
  208:         CPU laboratory
  209:       </p>
  210:       <h2 className="mt-2 text-3xl font-black text-slate-950">
  211:         Fetchâ€“Decodeâ€“Execute Challenge
  212:       </h2>
  213:       <p className="mt-3 max-w-3xl leading-7 text-slate-600">
  214:         Test your register knowledge, then step through a live
  215:         fetchâ€“decodeâ€“execute cycle and watch data move through the processor.
  216:       </p>
  217: 
  218:       <div className="mt-6">
  219:         <SimulatorDifficulty
  220:           value={simulator.difficulty}
  221:           onChange={changeDifficulty}
  222:         />
  223:       </div>
  224:       <div className="mt-5">
  225:         <SimulatorStats
  226:           attempts={simulator.attempts}
  227:           correct={simulator.correctAnswers}
  228:           accuracy={simulator.accuracy}
  229:           xp={simulator.xp}
  230:           streak={simulator.streak}
  231:         />
  232:       </div>
  233: 
  234:       <section className="mt-5 rounded-2xl border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 p-5">
  235:         <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-blue-600">
  236:           Current challenge
  237:         </p>
  238:         <h3 className="mt-2 text-xl font-black text-slate-950">
  239:           {simulator.question.prompt}
  240:         </h3>
  241:         <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
  242:           {simulator.question.options.map((option) => (
  243:             <button
  244:               key={option}
  245:               type="button"
  246:               disabled={simulator.checked}
  247:               onClick={() => setSelectedAnswer(option)}
  248:               className={`rounded-xl border-2 p-4 text-left font-black transition ${selectedAnswer === option ? "border-blue-600 bg-white text-blue-700" : "border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-800"}`}
  249:             >
  250:               {option}
  251:             </button>
  252:           ))}
  253:         </div>
  254:         <div className="mt-4">
  255:           <SimulatorControls
  256:             canCheck={Boolean(selectedAnswer)}
  257:             checked={simulator.checked}
  258:             hintVisible={simulator.hintVisible}
  259:             workingVisible={simulator.workingVisible}
  260:             onCheck={checkAnswer}
  261:             onHint={simulator.toggleHint}
  262:             onToggleWorking={simulator.toggleWorking}
  263:             onReset={tryAgain}
  264:             onNewExample={newQuestion}
  265:             newExampleLabel="New question"
  266:           />
  267:         </div>
  268:       </section>
  269: 
  270:       <div className="mt-4">
  271:         <SimulatorFeedback
  272:           checked={simulator.checked}
  273:           correct={simulator.correct}
  274:           successMessage="Correct. You identified the register or transfer accurately."
  275:           errorMessage={`Not quite. The correct answer is ${simulator.question.answer}. Try the same question again or study the live cycle below.`}
  276:           hintVisible={simulator.hintVisible}
  277:           hint={simulator.question.hint}
  278:           workingVisible={simulator.workingVisible}
  279:           working={simulator.question.working}
  280:           examinerTip={simulator.question.examinerTip}
  281:         />
  282:       </div>
  283:

  286:         <div>
  287:           <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-violet-600">
  288:             Hands-on processor explorer
  289:           </p>

  291:             Live CPU Cycle
  292:           </h3>

   16: const bank: Record<Difficulty, Q[]> = {
   17:   foundation: [

   72:         <SimulatorDifficulty
   73:           value={s.difficulty}
   74:           onChange={(d) => {
   75:             setAnswer("");

   77:           }}
   78:         />
   79:       </div>

  124:         />

    8: export default function StudentAccessGate({
    9:   children,
   10: }: {
   11:   children: ReactNode;
   12: }) {
   13:   const router = useRouter();
   14: 
   15:   const {
   16:     user,
   17:     profile,
   18:     loading,
   19:     profileReady,
   20:     profileError,
   21:   } = useAuth();
   22: 
   23:   useEffect(() => {
   24:     if (loading) {
   25:       return;
   26:     }
   27: 
   28:     if (!user) {
   29:       router.replace("/login");
   30:       return;
   31:     }
   32: 
   33:     if (!profileReady || !profile) {
   34:       return;
   35:     }
   36: 
   37:     if (profile.role === "admin") {
   38:       router.replace("/admin");
   39:       return;
   40:     }
   41: 
   42:     if (profile.role === "teacher") {
   43:       router.replace("/teacher");
   44:       return;
   45:     }
   46: 
   47:     if (
   48:       profile.accountIntent === "teacher"
   49:     ) {
   50:       router.replace("/teacher-access");
   51:       return;
   52:     }
   53: 
   54:     if (
   55:       !profile.onboardingComplete ||
   56:       !profile.qualification ||
   57:       !profile.examBoard
   58:     ) {
   59:       router.replace("/onboarding");
   60:     }
   61:   }, [
   62:     loading,
   63:     user,
   64:     profileReady,
   65:     profile,
   66:     router,
   67:   ]);
   68: 
   69:   if (
   70:     loading ||
   71:     (user &&
   72:       !profileReady &&
   73:       !profileError)
   74:   ) {
   75:     return (
   76:       <main className="flex min-h-[70vh] items-center justify-center px-6 py-12">
   77:         <div className="text-center">
   78:           <div className="mx-auto h-12 w-12 animate-spin rounded-full border-4 border-blue-100 border-t-blue-600" />
   79: 
   80:           <p className="mt-4 font-black text-slate-700">
   81:             Preparing your student workspace...
   82:           </p>
   83:         </div>
   84:       </main>
   85:     );
   86:   }
   87: 
   88:   if (profileError) {
   89:     return (
   90:       <main className="mx-auto max-w-2xl px-6 py-12">
   91:         <section className="rounded-3xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-8">
   92:           <p className="text-sm font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-red-700">
   93:             Student workspace
   94:           </p>
   95: 
   96:           <h1 className="mt-2 text-3xl font-black text-red-950">
   97:             Your account profile could not be loaded
   98:           </h1>
   99: 
  100:           <p className="mt-4 leading-7 text-red-800">
  101:             {profileError}
  102:           </p>
  103: 
  104:           <button
  105:             type="button"
  106:             onClick={() =>
  107:               window.location.reload()
  108:             }
  109:             className="mt-6 rounded-xl bg-red-700 px-5 py-3 font-black text-white transition hover:bg-red-800"
  110:           >
  111:             Retry
  112:           </button>
  113:         </section>
  114:       </main>
  115:     );
  116:   }
  117: 
  118:   if (
  119:     !user ||
  120:     !profileReady ||
  121:     !profile ||
  122:     profile.role !== "student" ||
  123:     profile.accountIntent === "teacher" ||
  124:     !profile.onboardingComplete ||
  125:     !profile.qualification ||
  126:     !profile.examBoard
  127:   ) {
  128:     return (
  129:       <main className="flex min-h-[70vh] items-center justify-center px-6 py-12">
  130:         <p className="font-bold text-slate-600">
  131:           Redirecting to the correct workspace...
  132:         </p>
  133:       </main>
  134:     );
  135:   }
  136: 
  137:   return <>{children}</>;
  138: }

  425:         </div>
  426:       </section>
  427: 
  428:       <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
  429:         <PreviewCard
  430:           title="Learning objectives"
  431:           icon={<Target className="h-5 w-5" />}
  432:         >
  433:           <BulletList items={resource.learningObjectives} />
  434:         </PreviewCard>
  435: 
  436:         <PreviewCard
  437:           title="Success criteria"
  438:           icon={<CheckCircle2 className="h-5 w-5" />}
  439:         >
  440:           <BulletList items={resource.successCriteria} />
  441:         </PreviewCard>
  442:       </div>
  443: 
  444:       <PreviewCard
  445:         title="Resource sequence"
  446:         icon={<BookOpen className="h-5 w-5" />}
  447:       >
  448:         <div className="space-y-5">
  449:           {resource.sections.map((section, index) => (
  450:             <article
  451:               key={`${section.title}-${index}`}
  452:               className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200"
  453:             >
  454:               <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-slate-50 px-5 py-4">
  455:                 <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
  456:                   <span className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 text-sm font-bold text-white">
  457:                     {index + 1}
  458:                   </span>
  459: 
  460:                   <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900">{section.title}</h4>
  461:                 </div>
  462: 
  463:                 <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600">
  464:                   {section.duration}
  465:                 </span>
  466:               </div>
  467: 
  468:               <div className="grid gap-5 p-5 lg:grid-cols-2">
  469:                 <div>
  470:                   <h5 className="mb-2 font-bold text-slate-900">
  471:                     Teacher instructions
  472:                   </h5>
  473:                   <p className="whitespace-pre-line text-sm leading-7 text-slate-700">
  474:                     {section.teacherInstructions}
  475:                   </p>
  476:                 </div>
  477: 
  478:                 <div>
  479:                   <h5 className="mb-2 font-bold text-slate-900">
  480:                     Student task
  481:                   </h5>
  482:                   <p className="whitespace-pre-line text-sm leading-7 text-slate-700">
  483:                     {section.studentTask}
  484:                   </p>
  485:                 </div>
  486: 
  487:                 <div>
  488:                   <h5 className="mb-2 font-bold text-slate-900">Assessment</h5>
  489:                   <p className="text-sm leading-7 text-slate-700">
  490:                     {section.assessment}
  491:                   </p>
  492:                 </div>
  493: 
  494:                 <div>
  495:                   <h5 className="mb-2 font-bold text-slate-900">Resources</h5>
  496:                   <BulletList items={section.resources} />
  497:                 </div>
  498:               </div>
  499:             </article>
  500:           ))}
  501:         </div>
  502:       </PreviewCard>
  503: 
  504:       <PreviewCard title="Differentiation" icon={<Users className="h-5 w-5" />}>
  505:         <div className="grid gap-5 lg:grid-cols-3">
  506:           {[
  507:             ["Support", resource.differentiation.support],
  508:             ["Core", resource.differentiation.core],
  509:             ["Stretch", resource.differentiation.stretch],
  510:           ].map(([title, items]) => (
  511:             <div
  512:               key={title as string}
  513:               className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-4"
  514:             >
  515:               <h4 className="mb-3 font-bold text-slate-900">
  516:                 {title as string}
  517:               </h4>
  518:               <BulletList items={items as string[]} />
  519:             </div>
  520:           ))}
  521:         </div>
  522:       </PreviewCard>
  523: 
  524:       <PreviewCard
  525:         title="Common misconceptions"
  526:         icon={<AlertCircle className="h-5 w-5" />}
  527:       >
  528:         <div className="space-y-4">
  529:           {resource.misconceptions.map((item, index) => (
  530:             <div
  531:               key={`${item.misconception}-${index}`}
  532:               className="rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-4"
  533:             >
  534:               <p className="font-bold text-amber-950">{item.misconception}</p>
  535:               <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-700">
  536:                 {item.correction}
  537:               </p>
  538:             </div>
  539:           ))}
  540:         </div>
  541:       </PreviewCard>
  542: 
  543:       <PreviewCard
  544:         title="Assessment questions"
  545:         icon={<FileQuestion className="h-5 w-5" />}
  546:       >
  547:         <div className="space-y-4">
  548:           {resource.assessmentQuestions.map((question, index) => (
  549:             <details
  550:               key={`${question.question}-${index}`}
  551:               className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200"
  552:             >
  553:               <summary className="cursor-pointer bg-slate-50 px-4 py-4 font-semibold text-slate-900">
  554:                 {index + 1}. {question.question} ({question.marks}{" "}
  555:                 {question.marks === 1 ? "mark" : "marks"})
  556:               </summary>
  557: 
  558:               <div className="border-t border-slate-200 px-4 py-4 text-sm leading-7 text-slate-700">
  559:                 <strong>Answer:</strong> {question.answer}
  560:               </div>
  561:             </details>
  562:           ))}
  563:         </div>
  564:       </PreviewCard>
  565: 
  566:       <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
  567:         <PreviewCard
  568:           title="Homework"
  569:           icon={<GraduationCap className="h-5 w-5" />}
  570:         >
  571:           <p className="whitespace-pre-line text-sm leading-7 text-slate-700">
  572:             {resource.homework}
  573:           </p>
  574:         </PreviewCard>
  575: 
  576:         <PreviewCard
  577:           title="Teacher notes"
  578:           icon={<Lightbulb className="h-5 w-5" />}
  579:         >
  580:           <p className="whitespace-pre-line text-sm leading-7 text-slate-700">
  581:             {resource.teacherNotes}
  582:           </p>
  583:         </PreviewCard>
  584:       </div>
  585:     </div>
  586:   );
  587: }
  588: 
  589: export default function ResourceBuilderForm({
  590:   resourceType,
  591:   initialValues = {},
  592:   prefillVersion = 0,
  593: }: ResourceBuilderFormProps) {
  594:   const [form, setForm] = useState<FormState>(DEFAULT_FORM);
  595: 
  596:   const [resource, setResource] = useState<GeneratedTeachingResource | null>(
  597:     null,
  598:   );
  599: 
  600:   const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState(false);
  601: 
  602:   const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  603:   const [isSaved, setIsSaved] = useState(false);
  604: 
  605:   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  606: 
  607:   const [success, setSuccess] = useState<string | null>(null);
  608: 
  609:   const abortControllerRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  610: 
  611:   const previewRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  612: 
  613:   const resolvedResourceType = normaliseResourceType(resourceType);
  614: 
  615:   const resourceLabel = RESOURCE_LABELS[resolvedResourceType];
  616: 
  617:   useEffect(() => {
  618:     void Promise.resolve().then(() => {
  619:       setForm({
  620:         ...DEFAULT_FORM,
  621:         ...initialValues,
  622:         duration: initialValues.duration ?? DEFAULT_FORM.duration,
  623:         difficulty: initialValues.difficulty ?? DEFAULT_FORM.difficulty,
  624:       });
  625: 
  626:       setResource(null);
  627:       setError(null);
  628:       setSuccess(null);
  629:       setIsSaved(false);
  630:     });
  631:   }, [resolvedResourceType, initialValues, prefillVersion]);
  632: 
  633:   useEffect(() => {
  634:     return () => {
  635:       abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
  636:     };
  637:   }, []);
  638: 
  639:   function updateField<K extends keyof FormState>(
  640:     field: K,
  641:     value: FormState[K],
  642:   ) {
  643:     setForm((current) => ({
  644:       ...current,
  645:       [field]: value,
  646:     }));
  647: 
  648:     setError(null);
  649:     setSuccess(null);
  650:   }
  651: 
  652:   function validateForm(): string | null {
  653:     if (form.topic.trim().length < 2) {
  654:       return "Enter a topic with at least two characters.";
  655:     }
  656: 
  657:     const duration = Number(form.duration);
  658: 
  659:     if (!Number.isInteger(duration) || duration < 5 || duration > 180) {
  660:       return "Select a valid duration.";
  661:     }
  662: 
  663:     return null;
  664:   }
  665: 
  666:   async function generateResource() {
  667:     const validationError = validateForm();
  668: 
  669:     if (validationError) {
  670:       setError(validationError);
  671:       return;
  672:     }
  673: 
  674:     abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
  675: 
  676:     const controller = new AbortController();
  677:     abortControllerRef.current = controller;
  678: 
  679:     setIsGenerating(true);
  680:     setError(null);
  681:     setSuccess(null);
  682:     setIsSaved(false);
  683: 
  684:     try {
  685:       const response = await fetch("/api/teacher/assistant", {
  686:         method: "POST",
  687:         headers: {
  688:           "Content-Type": "application/json",
  689:         },
  690:         signal: controller.signal,
  691:         body: JSON.stringify({
  692:           resourceType: resolvedResourceType,
  693:           topic: form.topic.trim(),
  694:           yearGroup: form.yearGroup,
  695:           examBoard: form.examBoard,
  696:           duration: Number(form.duration),
  697:           difficulty: form.difficulty,
  698:           objectives: form.objectives.trim(),
  699:           additionalNotes: form.additionalNotes.trim(),
  700:         }),
  701:       });
  702: 
  703:       const data = (await response.json()) as GenerateResourceResponse;
  704: 
  705:       if (!response.ok) {
  706:         throw new Error(data.error || "The resource could not be generated.");
  707:       }
  708: 
  709:       if (!data.resource) {
  710:         throw new Error("The server did not return a resource.");
  711:       }
  712: 
  713:       setResource(data.resource);
  714: 
  715:       window.setTimeout(() => {
  716:         previewRef.current?.scrollIntoView({
  717:           behavior: "smooth",
  718:           block: "start",
  719:         });
  720:       }, 100);
  721:     } catch (caughtError) {
  722:       if (
  723:         caughtError instanceof DOMException &&
  724:         caughtError.name === "AbortError"
  725:       ) {
  726:         return;
  727:       }
  728: 
  729:       setError(
  730:         caughtError instanceof Error
  731:           ? caughtError.message
  732:           : "The resource could not be generated.",
  733:       );
  734:     } finally {
  735:       setIsGenerating(false);
  736:     }
  737:   }
  738: 
  739:   function loadDemoResource() {
  740:     const demoResource = createDemoResource(resolvedResourceType);
  741: 
  742:     setForm((current) => ({
  743:       ...current,
  744:       topic: "Binary addition",
  745:       yearGroup: "Year 10",
  746:       examBoard: "AQA",
  747:       duration: "60",
  748:       difficulty: "standard",
  749:     }));
  750: 
  751:     setResource(demoResource);
  752:     setError(null);
  753:     setSuccess(
  754:       "Demo resource loaded. You can now test saving it to Firestore.",
  755:     );
  756:     setIsSaved(false);
  757: 
  758:     window.setTimeout(() => {
  759:       previewRef.current?.scrollIntoView({
  760:         behavior: "smooth",
  761:         block: "start",
  762:       });
  763:     }, 100);
  764:   }
  765: 
  766:   async function handleSaveResource() {
  767:     if (!resource) {
  768:       setError("Generate or load a resource first.");
  769:       return;
  770:     }
  771: 
  772:     const teacher = auth.currentUser;
  773: 
  774:     if (!teacher) {
  775:       setError("You must be signed in as a teacher to save resources.");
  776:       return;
  777:     }
  778: 
  779:     setIsSaving(true);
  780:     setError(null);
  781:     setSuccess(null);
  782: 
  783:     try {
  784:       await saveTeacherResource(teacher.uid, resource);
  785: 
  786:       setIsSaved(true);
  787:       setSuccess("Resource saved successfully to your teacher library.");
  788:     } catch (caughtError) {
  789:       setError(
  790:         caughtError instanceof Error
  791:           ? caughtError.message
  792:           : "The resource could not be saved.",
  793:       );
  794:     } finally {
  795:       setIsSaving(false);
  796:     }
  797:   }
  798: 
  799:   async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
  800:     event.preventDefault();
  801:     await generateResource();
  802:   }
  803: 
  804:   return (
  805:     <div className="space-y-8">
  806:       <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
  807:         <div className="rounded-2xl border border-indigo-100 bg-indigo-50 p-4">
  808:           <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
  809:             <div className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 text-white">
  810:               <WandSparkles className="h-5 w-5" />
  811:             </div>
  812: 
  813:             <div>
  814:               <p className="font-bold text-indigo-950">
  815:                 Creating: {resourceLabel}
  816:               </p>
  817: 
  818:               <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-6 text-indigo-800">
  819:                 Generate with GPT-5.6 or load the demo resource to test saving
  820:                 without API credits.
  821:               </p>
  822:             </div>
  823:           </div>
  824:         </div>
  825: 
  826:         <div>
  827:           <FieldLabel htmlFor="assistant-topic" required>
  828:             Topic
  829:           </FieldLabel>
  830: 
  831:           <input
  832:             id="assistant-topic"
  833:             value={form.topic}
  834:             onChange={(event) => updateField("topic", event.target.value)}
  835:             placeholder="For example: Binary addition"
  836:             maxLength={150}
  837:             disabled={isGenerating}
  838:             className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100 disabled:bg-slate-100"
  839:           />
  840:         </div>
  841: 
  842:         <div className="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2">
  843:           <div>
  844:             <FieldLabel htmlFor="assistant-year" required>
  845:               Year group or qualification
  846:             </FieldLabel>
  847: 
  848:             <div className="relative">
  849:               <select
  850:                 id="assistant-year"
  851:                 value={form.yearGroup}
  852:                 onChange={(event) =>
  853:                   updateField("yearGroup", event.target.value)
  854:                 }
  855:                 className="w-full appearance-none rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white px-4 py-3 pr-10 text-sm outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100"
  856:               >
  857:                 {YEAR_GROUPS.map((yearGroup) => (
  858:                   <option key={yearGroup} value={yearGroup}>
  859:                     {yearGroup}
  860:                   </option>
  861:                 ))}
  862:               </select>
  863: 
  864:               <ChevronDown className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
  865:             </div>
  866:           </div>
  867: 
  868:           <div>
  869:             <FieldLabel htmlFor="assistant-board" required>
  870:               Exam board
  871:             </FieldLabel>
  872: 
  873:             <div className="relative">
  874:               <select
  875:                 id="assistant-board"
  876:                 value={form.examBoard}
  877:                 onChange={(event) =>
  878:                   updateField("examBoard", event.target.value)
  879:                 }
  880:                 className="w-full appearance-none rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white px-4 py-3 pr-10 text-sm outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100"
  881:               >
  882:                 {EXAM_BOARDS.map((examBoard) => (
  883:                   <option key={examBoard} value={examBoard}>
  884:                     {examBoard}
  885:                   </option>
  886:                 ))}
  887:               </select>
  888: 
  889:               <ChevronDown className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
  890:             </div>
  891:           </div>
  892:         </div>
  893: 
  894:         <div className="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2">
  895:           <div>
  896:             <FieldLabel htmlFor="assistant-duration" required>
  897:               Duration
  898:             </FieldLabel>
  899: 
  900:             <select
  901:               id="assistant-duration"
  902:               value={form.duration}
  903:               onChange={(event) => updateField("duration", event.target.value)}
  904:               className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100"
  905:             >
  906:               {DURATIONS.map(([value, label]) => (
  907:                 <option key={value} value={value}>
  908:                   {label}
  909:                 </option>
  910:               ))}
  911:             </select>
  912:           </div>
  913: 
  914:           <div>
  915:             <FieldLabel htmlFor="assistant-difficulty" required>
  916:               Difficulty
  917:             </FieldLabel>
  918: 
  919:             <select
  920:               id="assistant-difficulty"
  921:               value={form.difficulty}
  922:               onChange={(event) =>
  923:                 updateField(
  924:                   "difficulty",
  925:                   event.target.value as FormState["difficulty"],
  926:                 )
  927:               }
  928:               className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100"
  929:             >
  930:               <option value="foundation">Foundation</option>
  931:               <option value="standard">Standard</option>
  932:               <option value="higher">Higher</option>
  933:             </select>
  934:           </div>
  935:         </div>
  936: 
  937:         <div>
  938:           <FieldLabel htmlFor="assistant-objectives">
  939:             Learning objectives
  940:           </FieldLabel>
  941: 
  942:           <textarea
  943:             id="assistant-objectives"
  944:             value={form.objectives}
  945:             onChange={(event) => updateField("objectives", event.target.value)}
  946:             rows={4}
  947:             maxLength={1500}
  948:             placeholder="Leave blank to generate suitable objectives."
  949:             className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-3 text-sm leading-6 outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100"
  950:           />
  951:         </div>
  952: 
  953:         <div>
  954:           <FieldLabel htmlFor="assistant-notes">
  955:             Additional instructions
  956:           </FieldLabel>
  957: 
  958:           <textarea
  959:             id="assistant-notes"
  960:             value={form.additionalNotes}
  961:             onChange={(event) =>
  962:               updateField("additionalNotes", event.target.value)
  963:             }
  964:             rows={4}
  965:             maxLength={2000}
  966:             placeholder="For example: Include SEND scaffolding and an exam-style challenge."
  967:             className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-3 text-sm leading-6 outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100"
  968:           />
  969:         </div>
  970: 
  971:         {error && (
  972:           <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 text-red-800">
  973:             <AlertCircle className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0" />
  974: 
  975:             <div>
  976:               <p className="font-bold">Action failed</p>
  977:               <p className="mt-1 text-sm">{error}</p>
  978:             </div>
  979:           </div>
  980:         )}
  981: 
  982:         {success && (
  983:           <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 p-4 text-emerald-800">
  984:             <CheckCircle2 className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0" />
  985: 
  986:             <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{success}</p>
  987:           </div>
  988:         )}
  989: 
  990:         <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row">
  991:           <button
  992:             type="submit"
  993:             disabled={isGenerating || form.topic.trim().length < 2}
  994:             className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 px-5 py-3.5 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-slate-300"
  995:           >
  996:             {isGenerating ? (
  997:               <>
  998:                 <Loader2 className="h-5 w-5 animate-spin" />
  999:                 Generating...
 1000:               </>
 1001:             ) : (
 1002:               <>
 1003:                 <Sparkles className="h-5 w-5" />
 1004:                 Generate {resourceLabel}
 1005:                 <Send className="h-4 w-4" />
 1006:               </>
 1007:             )}
 1008:           </button>
 1009: 
 1010:           <button
 1011:             type="button"
 1012:             onClick={loadDemoResource}
 1013:             disabled={isGenerating}
 1014:             className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 px-5 py-3.5 text-sm font-bold text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-100"
 1015:           >
 1016:             <TestTube2 className="h-5 w-5" />
 1017:             Load Demo Resource
 1018:           </button>
 1019:         </div>
 1020:       </form>
 1021: 
 1022:       <div ref={previewRef} className="scroll-mt-24">
 1023:         {isGenerating && !resource && (
 1024:           <div className="rounded-2xl border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 p-8 text-center">
 1025:             <Loader2 className="mx-auto h-10 w-10 animate-spin text-indigo-600" />
 1026:             <h3 className="mt-4 text-lg font-bold text-slate-950">
 1027:               Creating your resource
 1028:             </h3>
 1029:             <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-600">
 1030:               GPT-5.6 is preparing the lesson content.
 1031:             </p>
 1032:           </div>
 1033:         )}
 1034: 
 1035:         {resource && (
 1036:           <ResourcePreview
 1037:             resource={resource}
 1038:             isSaving={isSaving}
 1039:             isSaved={isSaved}
 1040:             onSave={handleSaveResource}
 1041:             onRegenerate={generateResource}
 1042:           />
 1043:         )}

    1: "use client";

    3: import Link from "next/link";

    5: import {

   16: import type { TeacherAnalyticsPortfolio } from "@/types/teacherAnalytics";
   17: 
   18: export default function TeacherAnalyticsSnapshot() {
   19:   const { user, profile } = useAuth();
   20: 
   21:   const [portfolio, setPortfolio] =
   22:     useState<TeacherAnalyticsPortfolio | null>(null);
   23: 
   24:   useEffect(() => {
   25:     let cancelled = false;
   26: 
   27:     async function load() {
   28:       if (
   29:         !user?.uid ||
   30:         (profile?.role !== "teacher" && profile?.role !== "admin")
   31:       ) {
   32:         return;
   33:       }
   34: 
   35:       try {
   36:         const result = await getTeacherAnalyticsPortfolio(user.uid);
   37: 
   38:         if (!cancelled) setPortfolio(result);
   39:       } catch (error) {
   40:         console.error("Unable to load teacher analytics snapshot:", error);
   41:       }
   42:     }
   43: 
   44:     void load();
   45: 
   46:     return () => {
   47:       cancelled = true;
   48:     };
   49:   }, [profile?.role, user?.uid]);
   50: 
   51:   const totals = useMemo(() => {
   52:     if (!portfolio) return null;
   53: 
   54:     const students = portfolio.classes.flatMap((classItem) => classItem.students);
   55: 
   56:     const targetRows = students.filter(
   57:       (student) => student.targetGrade !== null && student.gradeGap !== null,
   58:     );
   59: 
   60:     const onTarget = targetRows.filter(
   61:       (student) => (student.gradeGap ?? -99) >= 0,
   62:     ).length;
   63: 
   64:     return {
   65:       highPriority: students.filter(
   66:         (student) => student.interventionPriority === "high",
   67:       ).length,
   68:       targetsMissing: students.filter(
   69:         (student) => student.targetGrade === null,
   70:       ).length,
   71:       onTargetPercentage:
   72:         targetRows.length > 0
   73:           ? Math.round((onTarget / targetRows.length) * 100)
   74:           : 0,
   75:     };
   76:   }, [portfolio]);
   77: 
   78:   if (!portfolio || !totals) return null;
   79: 
   80:   return (
   81:     <Card className="overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-slate-200">
   82:       <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-700 via-teal-700 to-cyan-700 p-6 text-white">
   83:         <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
   84:           <div>
   85:             <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
   86:               <BarChart3 className="h-5 w-5" />
   87:               <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-white/80">
   88:                 Class intelligence
   89:               </p>
   90:             </div>
   91: 
   92:             <h2 className="mt-2 text-2xl font-black">
   93:               Attainment and intervention overview
   94:             </h2>
   95:           </div>
   96: 
   97:           <Link
   98:             href="/teacher/analytics"
   99:             className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-white px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-black text-teal-800 hover:bg-slate-100"
  100:           >
  101:             Open analytics
  102:             <ArrowUpRight className="h-4 w-4" />
  103:           </Link>
  104:         </div>
  105:       </div>
  106: 
  107:       <div className="grid gap-4 p-6 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
  108:         <Metric
  109:           label="Classes"
  110:           value={String(portfolio.classCount)}
  111:           icon={<BarChart3 className="h-5 w-5" />}
  112:         />
  113:         <Metric
  114:           label="Students"
  115:           value={String(portfolio.uniqueStudentCount)}
  116:           icon={<Users className="h-5 w-5" />}
  117:         />
  118:         <Metric
  119:           label="On / above target"
  120:           value={`${totals.onTargetPercentage}%`}
  121:           icon={<Target className="h-5 w-5" />}
  122:         />
  123:         <Metric
  124:           label="High priority"
  125:           value={String(totals.highPriority)}
  126:           detail={`${totals.targetsMissing} target grades not set`}
  127:           icon={<AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5" />}
  128:         />
  129:       </div>
  130:     </Card>
  131:   );
  132: }
  133: 
  134: function Metric({
  135:   label,

  139: }: {

  158:         </div>

  160:           {icon}
  161:         </div>
  162:       </div>
  163:     </div>
  164:   );

   24:
