   26:     return (
   27:       <div className="flex min-h-[55vh] items-center justify-center">
   28:         <div className="text-center">
   29:           <Loader2 className="mx-auto h-9 w-9 animate-spin text-teal-600" />
   30:           <p className="mt-4 font-bold text-slate-700">Loading teacher workspace...</p>
   31:         </div>
   32:       </div>
   33:     );
   34:   }
   35: 
   36:   if (!user) return null;
   37: 
   38:   if (profileError) {
   39:     return (
   40:       <Card className="mx-auto max-w-2xl rounded-3xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-7">
   41:         <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
   42:           <AlertTriangle className="mt-1 h-6 w-6 shrink-0 text-red-700" />
   43:           <div>
   44:             <h1 className="text-xl font-black text-red-950">Teacher profile unavailable</h1>
   45:             <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-red-800">{profileError}</p>
   46:             <Link href="/login" className="mt-5 inline-flex rounded-xl bg-red-700 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-black text-white">
   47:               Return to sign in
   48:             </Link>
   49:           </div>
   50:         </div>
   51:       </Card>
   52:     );
   53:   }
   54: 
   55:   if (!authorised) {
   56:     return (
   57:       <Card className="mx-auto max-w-2xl rounded-3xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-7">
   58:         <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
   59:           <ShieldCheck className="mt-1 h-6 w-6 shrink-0 text-amber-700" />
   60:           <div>
   61:             <h1 className="text-xl font-black text-amber-950">Teacher access required</h1>
   62:             <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-amber-800">
   63:               This workspace is available only to approved teacher or administrator accounts.
   64:             </p>
   65:             <Link href="/dashboard" className="mt-5 inline-flex rounded-xl bg-amber-700 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-black text-white">
   66:               Return to dashboard
   67:             </Link>
   68:           </div>
   69:         </div>
   70:       </Card>
   71:     );
   72:   }
   73: 
   74:   return <>{children}</>;
   75: }

FILE: components\tutor\TutorChat.tsx
==============================================================================================================
    1: "use client";
    2: import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
    3: import toast from "react-hot-toast";
    4: import {
    5:   clearTutorConversation,
    6:   createTutorConversation,
    7:   requestTutorResponse,
    8:   saveTutorExchange,
    9: } from "@/services/studentTutorService";
   10: import type {
   11:   TutorMessage,
   12:   TutorResponse,
   13:   TutorStudentContext,
   14: } from "@/types/studentTutor";
   15: 
   16: export default function TutorChat({
   17:   studentId,
   18:   context,
   19: }: {
   20:   studentId: string;
   21:   context: TutorStudentContext;
   22: }) {
   23:   const [conversationId, setConversationId] = useState("");
   24:   const [messages, setMessages] = useState<TutorMessage[]>([]);
   25:   const [last, setLast] = useState<TutorResponse | null>(null);
   26:   const [text, setText] = useState("");
   27:   const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
   28:   useEffect(() => {
   29:     void createTutorConversation(studentId)
   30:       .then(setConversationId)
   31:       .catch(() => toast.error("Tutor conversation could not start."));
   32:   }, [studentId]);
   33:   const history = useMemo(
   34:     () => messages.map((m) => ({ role: m.role, content: m.content })),
   35:     [messages],
   36:   );
   37:   async function send(value: string) {
   38:     const message = value.trim();
   39:     if (!message || !conversationId || sending) return;
   40:     setText("");
   41:     setMessages((x) => [
   42:       ...x,
   43:       {
   44:         id: `s-${Date.now()}`,
   45:         role: "student",
   46:         content: message,
   47:         createdAt: new Date(),
   48:       },
   49:     ]);
   50:     setSending(true);
   51:     try {
   52:       const r = await requestTutorResponse({
   53:         studentId,
   54:         conversationId,
   55:         message,
   56:         history,
   57:         context,
   58:       });
   59:       setMessages((x) => [
   60:         ...x,
   61:         {
   62:           id: `a-${Date.now()}`,
   63:           role: "assistant",
   64:           content: r.reply,
   65:           createdAt: new Date(),
   66:           mode: r.mode,
   67:         },
   68:       ]);
   69:       setLast(r);
   70:       await saveTutorExchange({
   71:         conversationId,
   72:         studentId,
   73:         studentMessage: message,
   74:         tutorResponse: r,
   75:       });
   76:       if (r.warning) toast(r.warning);
   77:     } catch (e) {
   78:       toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Tutor failed.");
   79:     } finally {
   80:       setSending(false);
   81:     }
   82:   }
   83:   async function reset() {
   84:     if (!conversationId) return;
   85:     await clearTutorConversation(conversationId, studentId);
   86:     setMessages([]);
   87:     setLast(null);
   88:     toast.success("Conversation cleared.");
   89:   }
   90:   const topic = context.priorityTopics[0]?.topic || "Computer Science";
   91:   return (
   92:     <div className="space-y-5">
   93:       <div className="flex justify-end">
   94:         <button
   95:           onClick={() => void reset()}
   96:           className="rounded-xl border bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold"
   97:         >
   98:           Clear conversation
   99:         </button>
  100:       </div>
  101:       {messages.length === 0 && (
  102:         <div className="rounded-3xl border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 p-6">
  103:           <p className="text-sm font-bold uppercase text-blue-600">
  104:             Personal AI tutor
  105:           </p>
  106:           <h2 className="mt-2 text-2xl font-black">
  107:             Hi {context.name.split(" ")[0]}, what are we learning today?
  108:           </h2>
  109:           <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
  110:             {[
  111:               `Explain ${topic} simply`,
  112:               `Quiz me on ${topic}`,
  113:               "Create a 25-minute revision plan",
  114:               "How can I reach the next grade?",
  115:             ].map((p) => (
  116:               <button
  117:                 key={p}
  118:                 onClick={() => void send(p)}
  119:                 className="rounded-xl border border-blue-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-blue-700"
  120:               >
  121:                 {p}
  122:               </button>
  123:             ))}
  124:           </div>
  125:         </div>
  126:       )}
  127:       <div className="min-h-[420px] space-y-4 rounded-3xl bg-slate-100 p-5">
  128:         {messages.map((m) => (
  129:           <div
  130:             key={m.id}
  131:             className={`flex ${m.role === "assistant" ? "justify-start" : "justify-end"}`}
  132:           >
  133:             <div
  134:               className={`max-w-3xl rounded-3xl px-5 py-4 ${m.role === "assistant" ? "bg-white text-slate-800" : "bg-blue-600 text-white"}`}
  135:             >
  136:               <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm leading-7">
  137:                 {m.content}
  138:               </p>
  139:             </div>
  140:           </div>
  141:         ))}
  142:         {sending && (
  143:           <div className="rounded-3xl bg-white px-5 py-4 text-sm font-bold text-slate-500">
  144:             CS Master Tutor is thinking...
  145:           </div>
  146:         )}
  147:       </div>
  148:       {last && last.recommendations.length > 0 && (
  149:         <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">
  150:           {last.recommendations.map((r, i) => (
  151:             <a
  152:               key={`${r.href}-${i}`}
  153:               href={r.href}
  154:               className="rounded-2xl border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 p-4"
  155:             >
  156:               <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-blue-600">
  157:                 {r.type}
  158:               </p>
  159:               <p className="mt-1 font-black">{r.title}</p>
  160:               <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-600">{r.description}</p>
  161:             </a>
  162:           ))}
  163:         </div>
  164:       )}
  165:       <form
  166:         onSubmit={(e) => {
  167:           e.preventDefault();
  168:           void send(text);
  169:         }}
  170:         className="rounded-3xl border bg-white p-4 shadow-lg"
  171:       >
  172:         <textarea
  173:           rows={3}
  174:           value={text}
  175:           onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)}
  176:           placeholder="Ask about a topic, paste an answer, or request a revision plan..."
  177:           className="w-full resize-none rounded-2xl px-3 py-2 outline-none"
  178:         />
  179:         <div className="mt-3 flex justify-end">
  180:           <button
  181:             disabled={sending || !text.trim()}
  182:             className="rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-5 py-3 font-bold text-white disabled:bg-slate-300"
  183:           >
  184:             {sending ? "Thinking..." : "Send"}
  185:           </button>
  186:         </div>
  187:       </form>
  188:     </div>
  189:   );
  190: }

  402: export function getCurriculumDefinition(
  403:   qualification: Qualification,
  404:   examBoard: ExamBoard,
  405: ): CurriculumDefinition | undefined {
  406:   return curriculumDefinitions.find(
  407:     (curriculum) =>
  408:       curriculum.qualification === qualification &&
  409:       curriculum.examBoard === examBoard,
  410:   );

==============================================================================================================
FILE: data\programming\challenges\helpers.ts
==============================================================================================================
    1: import type {
    2:   ProgrammingChallenge,
    3:   ProgrammingDifficulty,
    4:   ProgrammingExamBoard,
    5:   ProgrammingQualification,
    6:   ProgrammingSkill,
    7:   ProgrammingTestCase,
    8: } from "@/types/programming";
    9: 
   10: type ChallengeInput = {
   11:   id: string;
   12:   title: string;
   13:   description: string;
   14:   topicId: string;
   15:   curriculumTopicIds?: string[];
   16:   skills: ProgrammingSkill[];
   17:   mode?: "practice" | "debug";
   18:   difficulty: ProgrammingDifficulty;
   19:   qualifications: ProgrammingQualification[];
   20:   examBoards?: ProgrammingExamBoard[];
   21:   starterCode: string;
   22:   stdin?: string;
   23:   visibleTests: ProgrammingTestCase[];
   24:   hiddenTests?: ProgrammingTestCase[];
   25:   hint: string;
   26:   secondHint?: string;
   27:   explanation: string;
   28:   examinerTip: string;
   29:   xpReward: number;
   30:   estimatedMinutes?: number;
   31: };
   32: 
   33: export function challenge(input: ChallengeInput): ProgrammingChallenge {
   34:   return {
   35:     ...input,
   36:     curriculumTopicIds: input.curriculumTopicIds ?? [input.topicId],
   37:     mode: input.mode ?? "practice",
   38:     hiddenTests: input.hiddenTests ?? [],
   39:     estimatedMinutes: input.estimatedMinutes ?? 8,
   40:   };
   41: }
   42: 
   43: export function visible(id: string, label: string, input: string, expectedOutput: string): ProgrammingTestCase {
   44:   return { id, label, input, expectedOutput };
   45: }
   46: 
   47: export function hidden(id: string, label: string, input: string, expectedOutput: string): ProgrammingTestCase {
   48:   return { id, label, input, expectedOutput, hidden: true };
   49: }

  299:     (
  300:       currentUserId() == userId ||

  302:       (
  303:         isTeacher() &&
  304:         sameSchoolUser(userId)

  312:         isTeacher() &&
  313:         currentUserHasSchool() &&
  314:         resource.data.schoolId == currentSchoolId()
  315:       )

  319:     currentUserId() == userId &&
  320:     request.resource.data.uid == currentUserId() &&
  321:     request.resource.data.role == "student" &&
  322:     request.resource.data.email ==
  323:       request.auth.token.email &&
  324:     (
  325:       !("accountIntent" in request.resource.data) ||
  326:       request.resource.data.accountIntent == "student" ||
  327:       request.resource.data.accountIntent == "teacher"

  329:     (

  331:       request.resource.data.teacherAccessStatus == "not_submitted" ||
  332:       request.resource.data.teacherAccessStatus == "pending"
  333:     ) &&
  334:     validQualification(request.resource.data) &&
  335:     validExamBoard(request.resource.data) &&
  336:     validOnboardingStatus(request.resource.data) &&
  337:     validAccountType(request.resource.data) &&
  338:     validPersonalPlan(request.resource.data) &&
  339:     validEffectivePlan(request.resource.data) &&
  340:     validSchoolIdField(request.resource.data) &&
  341:     userAccountType(request.resource.data) == "individual" &&
  342:     userEffectivePlan(request.resource.data) == "free" &&
  343:     userSchoolId(request.resource.data) == "";
  344: 
  345:   /*
  346:    * Self-service profile update.
  347:    *
  348:    * This version is intentionally legacy-safe:
  349:    * old accounts that pre-date schoolId/accountType/personalPlan
  350:    * are interpreted as:
  351:    *
  352:    *   schoolId     = ""
  353:    *   accountType  = "individual"
  354:    *   personalPlan = "free"
  355:    *
  356:    * That lets an authenticated teacher move into a school account
  357:    * only when the matching active school membership exists after
  358:    * the same atomic write.
  359:    */
  360:    /*
  361:  * Legacy approved teacher -> school account migration.
  362:  *
  363:  * Older development teacher accounts can pre-date schoolId,
  364:  * accountType and plan fields. This permits only the one-time
  365:  * transition into an active school membership created in the
  366:  * same atomic batch.
  367:  */
  368: allow update: if signedIn() &&
  369:   currentUserId() == userId &&
  370: 
  371:   (
  372:     resource.data.role == "teacher" ||
  373:     resource.data.role == "admin"
  374:   ) &&
  375:

  434:         resource.data.teacherAccessStatus ||
  435:       request.resource.data.teacherAccessStatus == "not_submitted" ||
  436:       request.resource.data.teacherAccessStatus == "pending"
  437:     ) &&

  443:     validEffectivePlan(request.resource.data) &&
  444:     validSchoolIdField(request.resource.data) &&

  541:       .hasOnly([

  701:     match /assignmentProgress/{progressId} {
  702: 
  703:   /*
  704:    * Students can read their own progress.
  705:    * The teacher who owns the corresponding class assignment

  707:    * Admins can read all progress.

  709:    * A missing progress document may still be read directly by

  714:     (

  724:           ) ||
  725:           isAdmin()
  726:         )
  727:       ) ||
  728: 
  729:       /*
  730:        * Allows the app to check a student's own missing document.

  732:       progressId.matches(
  733:         "^.*_" + currentUserId() + "$"
  734:       ) ||
  735: 
  736:       /*
  737:        * A teacher-side analytics loader may directly check an expected
  738:        * progress document before the student has created it. Returning
  739:        * "not found" for a missing document does not expose student data.
  740:        */
  741:       (resource == null && isTeacher())
  742:     );
  743: 
  744:   allow list: if signedIn() &&
  745:     (
  746:       resource.data.studentId == currentUserId() ||

  748:         resource.data.assignmentId
  749:       ) ||
  750:       isAdmin()

  756:     request.resource.data.assignmentId is string &&

  758:       "not_started",
  759:       "in_progress",
  760:       "completed"
  761:     ];
  762: 
  763:   allow update: if signedIn() &&
  764:     resource.data.studentId ==
  765:       currentUserId() &&
  766:     request.resource.data.studentId ==
  767:       resource.data.studentId &&
  768:     request.resource.data.assignmentId ==
  769:       resource.data.assignmentId &&
  770:     request.resource.data.status in [
  771:       "not_started",
  772:       "in_progress",
  773:       "completed"
  774:     ] &&
  775:     request.resource.data

  779:         "status",

  782:         "updatedAt"

  791:  *
  792:  * Assignment identity, student identity, class/teacher ownership
  793:  * and assignment configuration cannot be changed here.
  794:  */

  796: 
  797:   // This must remain the student's own progress document.

  799:   request.resource.data.studentId == resource.data.studentId &&
  800:   request.resource.data.assignmentId == resource.data.assignmentId &&
  801:

  814:     /databases/$(database)/documents/classAssignments/$(resource.data.assignmentId)
  815:   ).data.studentIds &&
  816:

  819:     get(
  820:       /databases/$(database)/documents/classAssignments/$(resource.data.assignmentId)
  821:     ).data.resourceId &&

  824:   request.resource.data.programmingCode is string &&
  825:   request.resource.data.programmingAttempts is int &&

  827:   request.resource.data.programmingPassedCount is int &&
  828:   request.resource.data.programmingPassedCount >= 0 &&
  829:   request.resource.data.programmingTotalTests is int &&
  830:   request.resource.data.programmingTotalTests >= 0 &&
  831:   request.resource.data.programmingPassedCount <=

    4:   applicationDefault,

    6:   getApps,
    7:   initializeApp,
    8:   type App,
    9: } from "firebase-admin/app";

   12: import {
   13:   getFirestore,
   14:   type Firestore,
   15: } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
   16: 
   17: let cachedApp: App | null = null;
   18: let cachedAuth: Auth | null = null;
   19: let cachedDb: Firestore | null = null;
   20: 
   21: function initialiseFirebaseAdmin(): App {
   22:   if (cachedApp) {
   23:     return cachedApp;
   24:   }
   25: 
   26:   const existingApps = getApps();
   27: 
   28:   if (existingApps.length > 0) {
   29:     cachedApp = existingApps[0];
   30:     return cachedApp;
   31:   }
   32: 
   33:   const projectId =
   34:     process.env.FIREBASE_ADMIN_PROJECT_ID?.trim();
   35: 
   36:   const clientEmail =
   37:     process.env.FIREBASE_ADMIN_CLIENT_EMAIL?.trim();
   38: 
   39:   const privateKeyBase64 =
   40:     process.env.FIREBASE_ADMIN_PRIVATE_KEY_BASE64?.trim();
   41: 
   42:   if (
   43:     projectId &&
   44:     clientEmail &&
   45:     privateKeyBase64
   46:   ) {
   47:     const privateKey = Buffer.from(
   48:       privateKeyBase64,
   49:       "base64",
   50:     ).toString("utf8");
   51: 
   52:     if (
   53:       !privateKey.includes(
   54:         "-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----",
   55:       ) ||
   56:       !privateKey.includes(
   57:         "-----END PRIVATE KEY-----",
   58:       )
   59:     ) {
   60:       throw new Error(
   61:         "FIREBASE_ADMIN_PRIVATE_KEY_BASE64 did not decode to a valid PEM private key.",
   62:       );
   63:     }
   64: 
   65:     cachedApp = initializeApp({
   66:       projectId,
   67:       credential: cert({
   68:         projectId,
   69:         clientEmail,
   70:         privateKey,
   71:       }),
   72:     });
   73: 
   74:     return cachedApp;
   75:   }
   76: 
   77:   if (
   78:     process.env.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
   79:   ) {
   80:     cachedApp = initializeApp({
   81:       credential: applicationDefault(),
   82:       projectId:
   83:         projectId ||
   84:         process.env.GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT ||
   85:         process.env.GCLOUD_PROJECT,
   86:     });
   87: 
   88:     return cachedApp;
   89:   }
   90: 
   91:   throw new Error(
   92:     [
   93:       "Firebase Admin is not configured.",
   94:       "",
   95:       "For local development, set:",
   96:       "GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS",
   97:       "",
   98:       "Or configure these server-only variables:",
   99:       "FIREBASE_ADMIN_PROJECT_ID",
  100:       "FIREBASE_ADMIN_CLIENT_EMAIL",
  101:       "FIREBASE_ADMIN_PRIVATE_KEY_BASE64",
  102:       "",
  103:       "Do not prefix Admin variables with NEXT_PUBLIC_.",
  104:     ].join("\n"),
  105:   );
  106: }
  107: 
  108: function getAdminAuth(): Auth {
  109:   if (!cachedAuth) {
  110:     cachedAuth = getAuth(
  111:       initialiseFirebaseAdmin(),
  112:     );
  113:   }
  114: 
  115:   return cachedAuth;
  116: }
  117: 
  118: function getAdminDb(): Firestore {
  119:   if (!cachedDb) {
  120:     cachedDb = getFirestore(
  121:       initialiseFirebaseAdmin(),
  122:     );
  123:   }
  124: 
  125:   return cachedDb;
  126: }
  127: 
  128: /*
  129:  * Lazy proxies are deliberate.
  130:  *
  131:  * API routes can import adminAuth/adminDb during `next build`
  132:  * without immediately initialising Firebase Admin. Credentials
  133:  * are required only when a route actually performs an Admin SDK
  134:  * operation at request time.
  135:  */
  136: export const adminAuth = new Proxy(
  137:   {} as Auth,
  138:   {
  139:     get(_target, property, receiver) {
  140:       return Reflect.get(
  141:         getAdminAuth(),
  142:         property,
  143:         receiver,
  144:       );
  145:     },
  146:   },
  147: );
  148: 
  149: export const adminDb = new Proxy(
  150:   {} as Firestore,
  151:   {
  152:     get(_target, property, receiver) {
  153:       return Reflect.get(
  154:         getAdminDb(),
  155:         property,
  156:         receiver,
  157:       );
  158:     },
  159:   },
  160: );

   30:   fallback = "",

   58: function groupEvidence(
   59:   evidence: AdaptiveEvidence[],
   60: ) {
   61:   const groups =
   62:     new Map<
   63:       string,
   64:       AdaptiveEvidence[]
   65:     >();
   66: 
   67:   evidence.forEach((item) => {
   68:     const normalised =
   69:       normaliseTopic(item.topic);
   70: 
   71:     const existing =
   72:       groups.get(
   73:         normalised.topicTitle,
   74:       ) || [];
   75: 
   76:     groups.set(
   77:       normalised.topicTitle,
   78:       [
   79:         ...existing,
   80:         {
   81:           ...item,
   82:           topic:
   83:             normalised.topicTitle,
   84:         },
   85:       ],
   86:     );
   87:   });
   88: 
   89:   return Array.from(
   90:     groups.entries(),
   91:   ).map(
   92:     ([topic, items]) => ({
   93:       topic,
   94:       evidence: items,
   95:     }),
   96:   );
   97: }

   99: function resolveRawTopic(
  100:   data: Record<string, unknown>,
  101:   fallback = "",
  102: ): string {
  103:   return (
  104:     safeString(
  105:       data.topicTitle,
  106:     ) ||
  107:     safeString(
  108:       data.topic,
  109:     ) ||
  110:     safeString(
  111:       data.curriculumTopic,
  112:     ) ||
  113:     safeString(
  114:       data.quizTitle,
  115:     ) ||
  116:     safeString(
  117:       data.title,
  118:       fallback,
  119:     )
  120:   );
  121: }

  123: /*
  124:  * Generic labels describe an assessment type rather than
  125:  * an actual Computer Science curriculum topic.
  126:  *
  127:  * These must never become mastery topics.
  128:  */
  129: function isGenericAssessmentTopic(
  130:   value: string,
  131: ): boolean {
  132:   const normalised = value
  133:     .trim()
  134:     .toLowerCase()
  135:     .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, " ")
  136:     .trim();
  137: 
  138:   return [
  139:     "",
  140:     "quiz",
  141:     "assigned quiz",
  142:     "ai quiz",
  143:     "assessment",
  144:     "assigned assessment",
  145:     "practice quiz",
  146:     "exam",
  147:     "written exam",
  148:   ].includes(normalised);
  149: }
  150: 
  151: /*
  152:  * Assignment titles frequently contain presentational suffixes,
  153:  * for example:
  154:  *
  155:  * "character encoding Demo Quiz"
  156:  * "memory and storage Demo Quiz"
  157:  * "merge sort Demo Quiz"
  158:  *
  159:  * Removing those suffixes gives topicNormalisationService a much
  160:  * cleaner curriculum phrase to resolve.
  161:  */
  162: function cleanAssignmentTitle(
  163:   value: string,
  164: ): string {
  165:   return value
  166:     .trim()
  167:     .replace(
  168:       /\s+(demo\s+)?quiz$/i,
  169:       "",
  170:     )
  171:     .replace(
  172:       /\s+practice\s+quiz$/i,
  173:       "",
  174:     )
  175:     .replace(
  176:       /\s+assessment$/i,
  177:       "",
  178:     )
  179:     .trim();
  180: }

  182: type AssignmentTopicMetadata = {
  183:   topic: string;
  184:   title: string;
  185: };
  186: 
  187: async function loadAssignmentTopicMetadata(
  188:   assignmentIds: string[],
  189: ): Promise<
  190:   Map<
  191:     string,
  192:     AssignmentTopicMetadata
  193:   >
  194: > {
  195:   const uniqueIds =
  196:     Array.from(
  197:       new Set(
  198:         assignmentIds
  199:           .map((id) =>
  200:             id.trim(),
  201:           )
  202:           .filter(Boolean),
  203:       ),
  204:     );
  205: 
  206:   const entries =
  207:     await Promise.all(
  208:       uniqueIds.map(
  209:         async (
  210:           assignmentId,
  211:         ) => {
  212:           try {
  213:             const snapshot =
  214:               await getDoc(
  215:                 doc(
  216:                   db,
  217:                   "assignments",
  218:                   assignmentId,
  219:                 ),
  220:               );
  221: 
  222:             if (
  223:               !snapshot.exists()
  224:             ) {
  225:               return [
  226:                 assignmentId,
  227:                 {
  228:                   topic: "",
  229:                   title: "",
  230:                 },
  231:               ] as const;
  232:             }
  233: 
  234:             const data =
  235:               snapshot.data();
  236: 
  237:             return [
  238:               assignmentId,
  239:               {
  240:                 topic:
  241:                   resolveRawTopic(
  242:                     data,
  243:                   ),
  244:                 title:
  245:                   safeString(
  246:                     data.title,
  247:                   ),
  248:               },
  249:             ] as const;
  250:           } catch (
  251:             caughtError
  252:           ) {
  253:             /*
  254:              * A missing/legacy assignment should not prevent the
  255:              * rest of the student's adaptive plan from loading.
  256:              */
  257:             console.warn(
  258:               `Unable to resolve adaptive topic for assignment ${assignmentId}:`,
  259:               caughtError,
  260:             );
  261: 
  262:             return [
  263:               assignmentId,
  264:               {
  265:                 topic: "",
  266:                 title: "",
  267:               },
  268:             ] as const;
  269:           }
  270:         },
  271:       ),
  272:     );
  273: 
  274:   return new Map(entries);
  275: }

  277: function resolveAssignedQuizTopic({
  278:   resultData,

  281:   resultData: Record<

  284:   >;

  286:   assignmentMetadata:

  289:   /*
  290:    * First preference:
  291:    * explicit curriculum/topic metadata stored directly on
  292:    * the result.
  293:    */
  294:   const resultTopic =
  295:     resolveRawTopic(
  296:       resultData,
  297:     );
  298: 
  299:   if (
  300:     resultTopic &&
  301:     !isGenericAssessmentTopic(
  302:       resultTopic,
  303:     )
  304:   ) {
  305:     return cleanAssignmentTitle(
  306:       resultTopic,
  307:     );
  308:   }
  309: 
  310:   /*
  311:    * Second preference:
  312:    * topic metadata on the original assignment.
  313:    */
  314:   const assignmentTopic =
  315:     assignmentMetadata?.topic ||
  316:     "";
  317: 
  318:   if (
  319:     assignmentTopic &&
  320:     !isGenericAssessmentTopic(
  321:       assignmentTopic,
  322:     )
  323:   ) {
  324:     return cleanAssignmentTitle(
  325:       assignmentTopic,
  326:     );
  327:   }
  328: 
  329:   /*
  330:    * Third preference:
  331:    * derive the curriculum topic from the original assignment
  332:    * title.
  333:    *
  334:    * Example:
  335:    * "character encoding Demo Quiz"
  336:    *          ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Â Ã¢â‚¬Å“
  337:    * "character encoding"
  338:    *          ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Â Ã¢â‚¬Å“
  339:    * topicNormalisationService
  340:    */
  341:   const assignmentTitle =
  342:     cleanAssignmentTitle(
  343:       assignmentMetadata?.title ||
  344:         "",
  345:     );
  346: 
  347:   if (
  348:     assignmentTitle &&
  349:     !isGenericAssessmentTopic(
  350:       assignmentTitle,
  351:     )
  352:   ) {
  353:     return assignmentTitle;
  354:   }
  355: 
  356:   /*
  357:    * Do NOT create fake mastery evidence such as "Assigned Quiz".
  358:    *
  359:    * The result remains stored normally in Firestore and can still
  360:    * contribute to assignment history/markbooks. It simply cannot
  361:    * be attributed to curriculum mastery until a real topic can be
  362:    * identified.
  363:    */
  364:   return null;
  365: }
  366: 
  367: export async function getAdaptiveLearningPlan(
  368:   studentId: string,
  369: ): Promise<AdaptiveLearningPlan> {
  370:   const id =
  371:     studentId.trim();
  372: 
  373:   if (!id) {
  374:     throw new Error(
  375:       "A valid student account is required.",
  376:     );
  377:   }
  378: 
  379:   const [
  380:     profile,
  381:     quizSnapshot,
  382:     assignedQuizSnapshot,
  383:     examAssignments,
  384:     interventions,
  385:   ] = await Promise.all([
  386:     getUserProfile(id),
  387: 
  388:     getDocs(
  389:       query(
  390:         collection(
  391:           db,
  392:           "users",
  393:           id,
  394:           "quizResults",
  395:         ),
  396:         orderBy(
  397:           "createdAt",
  398:           "desc",
  399:         ),
  400:       ),
  401:     ),
  402: 
  403:     getDocs(
  404:       query(
  405:         collection(
  406:           db,
  407:           "assignmentResults",
  408:         ),
  409:         where(
  410:           "studentId",
  411:           "==",
  412:           id,
  413:         ),
  414:       ),
  415:     ),
  416: 
  417:     getStudentExamAssignments(
  418:       id,
  419:     ),
  420: 
  421:     getStudentInterventions(
  422:       id,
  423:     ),
  424:   ]);
  425: 
  426:   if (!profile) {
  427:     throw new Error(
  428:       "The student profile could not be loaded.",
  429:     );
  430:   }
  431: 
  432:   const evidence:
  433:     AdaptiveEvidence[] = [];
  434: 
  435:   /*
  436:    * ------------------------------------------------------------
  437:    * NORMAL QUIZ EVIDENCE
  438:    * ------------------------------------------------------------
  439:    */
  440:   quizSnapshot.docs.forEach(
  441:     (document) => {
  442:       const data =
  443:         document.data();
  444: 
  445:       const topic =
  446:         resolveRawTopic(
  447:           data,
  448:           "Quiz",
  449:         );
  450: 
  451:       /*
  452:        * Avoid producing a generic "Quiz" mastery topic.
  453:        */
  454:       if (
  455:         isGenericAssessmentTopic(
  456:           topic,
  457:         )
  458:       ) {
  459:         return;
  460:       }
  461: 
  462:       evidence.push({
  463:         id:
  464:           `quiz-${document.id}`,
  465: 
  466:         topic:
  467:           cleanAssignmentTitle(
  468:             topic,
  469:           ),
  470: 
  471:         source: "quiz",
  472: 
  473:         score:
  474:           safeNumber(
  475:             data.scorePercent,
  476:           ),
  477: 
  478:         completedAt:
  479:           data.createdAt instanceof
  480:           Timestamp
  481:             ? data.createdAt.toDate()
  482:             : null,
  483: 
  484:         weight: 1,
  485:       });
  486:     },
  487:   );
  488: 
  489:   /*
  490:    * ------------------------------------------------------------
  491:    * ASSIGNED QUIZ EVIDENCE
  492:    * ------------------------------------------------------------
  493:    *
  494:    * assignmentResults often contain score/result information but
  495:    * not enough curriculum metadata. Resolve the original assignment
  496:    * so its real topic/title can be used.
  497:    */
  498:   const assignedQuizAssignmentIds =
  499:     assignedQuizSnapshot.docs
  500:       .map((document) =>
  501:         safeString(
  502:           document.data()
  503:             .assignmentId,
  504:         ),
  505:       )
  506:       .filter(Boolean);
  507: 
  508:   const assignmentMetadata =
  509:     await loadAssignmentTopicMetadata(
  510:       assignedQuizAssignmentIds,
  511:     );
  512: 
  513:   assignedQuizSnapshot.docs.forEach(
  514:     (document) => {
  515:       const data =
  516:         document.data();
  517: 
  518:       const assignmentId =
  519:         safeString(
  520:           data.assignmentId,
  521:         );
  522: 
  523:       const topic =
  524:         resolveAssignedQuizTopic({
  525:           resultData: data,
  526: 
  527:           assignmentMetadata:
  528:             assignmentMetadata.get(
  529:               assignmentId,
  530:             ) || null,
  531:         });
  532: 
  533:       if (!topic) {
  534:         console.warn(
  535:           `Assigned quiz result ${document.id} has no resolvable curriculum topic and was excluded from topic mastery.`,
  536:         );
  537: 
  538:         return;
  539:       }
  540: 
  541:       evidence.push({
  542:         id:
  543:           `assigned-quiz-${document.id}`,
  544: 
  545:         topic,
  546: 
  547:         source: "quiz",
  548: 
  549:         score:
  550:           safeNumber(
  551:             data.percentage,
  552:           ),
  553: 
  554:         completedAt:
  555:           data.completedAt instanceof
  556:           Timestamp
  557:             ? data.completedAt.toDate()
  558:             : null,
  559: 
  560:         weight: 1.1,
  561:       });
  562:     },
  563:   );
  564: 
  565:   /*
  566:    * ------------------------------------------------------------
  567:    * WRITTEN EXAM EVIDENCE
  568:    * ------------------------------------------------------------
  569:    */
  570:   const submissions =
  571:     await Promise.all(
  572:       examAssignments.map(
  573:         (assignment) =>
  574:           getExamSubmission(
  575:             assignment.id,
  576:             id,
  577:           ),
  578:       ),
  579:     );
  580: 
  581:   examAssignments.forEach(
  582:     (
  583:       assignment,
  584:       index,
  585:     ) => {
  586:       const submission =
  587:         submissions[index];
  588: 
  589:       if (
  590:         !submission ||
  591:         submission.status !==
  592:           "marked"
  593:       ) {
  594:         return;
  595:       }
  596: 
  597:       const examTopic =
  598:         assignment
  599:           .questionSetSnapshot
  600:           .topic ||
  601:         assignment
  602:           .questionSetTitle ||
  603:         assignment.title;
  604: 
  605:       if (
  606:         isGenericAssessmentTopic(
  607:           examTopic,
  608:         )
  609:       ) {
  610:         return;
  611:       }
  612: 
  613:       evidence.push({
  614:         id:
  615:           `exam-${assignment.id}`,
  616: 
  617:         topic:
  618:           cleanAssignmentTitle(
  619:             examTopic,
  620:           ),
  621: 
  622:         source: "exam",
  623: 
  624:         score:
  625:           submission.percentage,
  626: 
  627:         completedAt:
  628:           submission.markedAt,
  629: 
  630:         weight: 1.4,
  631:       });
  632:     },
  633:   );
  634: 
  635:   /*
  636:    * ------------------------------------------------------------
  637:    * INTERVENTION EVIDENCE
  638:    * ------------------------------------------------------------
  639:    */
  640:   interventions.forEach(
  641:     (intervention) => {
  642:       const completedSteps =
  643:         intervention.steps.filter(
  644:           (step) =>
  645:             step.status ===
  646:             "completed",
  647:         ).length;
  648: 
  649:       if (!completedSteps) {
  650:         return;
  651:       }
  652: 
  653:       if (
  654:         isGenericAssessmentTopic(
  655:           intervention.topic,
  656:         )
  657:       ) {
  658:         return;
  659:       }
  660: 
  661:       evidence.push({
  662:         id:
  663:           `intervention-${intervention.id}`,
  664: 
  665:         topic:
  666:           intervention.topic,
  667: 
  668:         source:
  669:           "intervention",
  670: 
  671:         score:
  672:           intervention.currentScore ||
  673:           intervention.baselineScore,
  674: 
  675:         completedAt:
  676:           intervention.updatedAt ||
  677:           intervention.completedAt,
  678: 
  679:         weight: 0.8,
  680:       });
  681:     },
  682:   );
  683: 
  684:   /*
  685:    * ------------------------------------------------------------
  686:    * LESSON EVIDENCE
  687:    * ------------------------------------------------------------
  688:    */
  689:   profile.completedLessons.forEach(
  690:     (
  691:       lessonId,
  692:       index,
  693:     ) => {
  694:       if (
  695:         !lessonId.trim()
  696:       ) {
  697:         return;
  698:       }
  699: 
  700:       evidence.push({
  701:         id:
  702:           `lesson-${index}-${lessonId}`,
  703: 
  704:         topic: lessonId,
  705: 
  706:         source: "lesson",
  707: 
  708:         score: 60,
  709: 
  710:         completedAt: null,
  711: 
  712:         weight: 0.25,
  713:       });
  714:     },
  715:   );
  716: 
  717:   /*
  718:    * ------------------------------------------------------------
  719:    * MASTERY + RECOMMENDATIONS
  720:    * ------------------------------------------------------------
  721:    */
  722:   const topics =
  723:     buildTopicMastery(
  724:       groupEvidence(
  725:         evidence,
  726:       ),
  727:     );
  728: 
  729:   const actions =
  730:     buildAdaptiveActions(
  731:       topics,
  732:     );
  733: 
  734:   const assessedTopics =
  735:     topics.filter(
  736:       (topic) =>
  737:         topic.attempts > 0,
  738:     );
  739: 
  740:   const overallMastery =
  741:     average(
  742:       assessedTopics.map(
  743:         (topic) =>
  744:           topic.masteryScore,
  745:       ),
  746:     );
  747: 
  748:   const confidence =
  749:     average(
  750:       assessedTopics.map(
  751:         (topic) =>
  752:           topic.confidenceScore,
  753:       ),
  754:     );
  755: 
  756:   const examReadiness =
  757:     average(
  758:       assessedTopics.map(
  759:         (topic) =>
  760:           Math.round(
  761:             topic.masteryScore *
  762:               0.75 +
  763:               topic.confidenceScore *
  764:                 0.25,
  765:           ),
  766:       ),
  767:     );
  768: 
  769:   const recentTrend =
  770:     average(
  771:       assessedTopics.map(
  772:         (topic) =>
  773:           topic.trend,
  774:       ),
  775:     );
  776: 
  777:   const predictedScore =
  778:     Math.max(
  779:       0,
  780:       Math.min(
  781:         100,
  782:         examReadiness +
  783:           Math.round(
  784:             recentTrend *
  785:               0.25,
  786:           ),
  787:       ),
  788:     );
  789: 
  790:   return {
  791:     studentId: id,
  792: 
  793:     generatedAt:
  794:       new Date(),
  795: 
  796:     overallMastery,
  797: 
  798:     examReadiness,
  799: 
  800:     confidence,
  801: 
  802:     currentGrade:
  803:       indicativeGradeFromPercentage(
  804:         examReadiness,
  805:         profile?.qualification,
  806:       ),
  807: 
  808:     predictedGrade:
  809:       indicativeGradeFromPercentage(
  810:         predictedScore,
  811:         profile?.qualification,
  812:       ),
  813: 
  814:     dueForReviewCount:
  815:       topics.filter(
  816:         (topic) =>
  817:           topic.nextReviewAt.getTime() <=
  818:           Date.now(),
  819:       ).length,
  820: 
  821:     priorityTopicCount:
  822:       topics.filter(
  823:         (topic) =>
  824:           topic.state ===
  825:             "priority" ||
  826:           topic.state ===
  827:             "forgetting-risk",
  828:       ).length,
  829: 
  830:     secureTopicCount:
  831:       topics.filter(
  832:         (topic) =>
  833:           topic.state ===
  834:             "secure" ||
  835:           topic.state ===
  836:             "mastered",
  837:       ).length,
  838: 
  839:     nextAction:
  840:       actions[0] || null,
  841: 
  842:     actions,
  843: 
  844:     topics,
  845:   };
  846: }

    1: import type {
    2:   AnalyticsEvidence,
    3:   EvidenceConfidenceAnalytics,
    4: } from "@/types/analytics";
    5: 
    6: export function calculateEvidenceConfidence({
    7:   evidence,
    8:   totalActivityCount,
    9:   completedActivityCount,
   10: }: {
   11:   evidence: AnalyticsEvidence[];
   12:   totalActivityCount: number;
   13:   completedActivityCount: number;
   14: }): EvidenceConfidenceAnalytics {
   15:   const graded = evidence.filter(
   16:     (item) =>
   17:       item.graded &&
   18:       typeof item.percentage === "number",
   19:   );
   20: 
   21:   const writtenExamCount = graded.filter(
   22:     (item) => item.type === "written_exam",
   23:   ).length;
   24: 
   25:   const quizCount = graded.filter(
   26:     (item) =>
   27:       item.type === "quiz" ||
   28:       item.type === "ai_quiz",
   29:   ).length;
   30: 
   31:   const curriculumCoverage =
   32:     totalActivityCount > 0
   33:       ? Math.round(
   34:           (completedActivityCount /
   35:             totalActivityCount) *
   36:             100,
   37:         )
   38:       : 0;
   39: 
   40:   let score = 0;
   41: 
   42:   score += Math.min(40, graded.length * 8);
   43:   score += Math.min(30, writtenExamCount * 15);
   44:   score += Math.min(15, quizCount * 3);
   45:   score += Math.min(
   46:     15,
   47:     Math.round(curriculumCoverage * 0.15),
   48:   );
   49: 
   50:   let level: EvidenceConfidenceAnalytics["level"] =
   51:     "insufficient";
   52: 
   53:   if (graded.length >= 1) level = "low";
   54:   if (score >= 45) level = "medium";
   55:   if (
   56:     score >= 70 &&
   57:     writtenExamCount >= 2 &&
   58:     graded.length >= 5
   59:   ) {
   60:     level = "high";
   61:   }
   62: 
   63:   const explanation =
   64:     level === "high"
   65:       ? "The working grade is supported by multiple graded activities, including written assessment evidence."
   66:       : level === "medium"
   67:         ? "The working grade has a reasonable evidence base but would benefit from more written assessment evidence."
   68:         : level === "low"
   69:           ? "The current grade estimate is based on limited graded evidence and should be treated cautiously."
   70:           : "There is not yet enough graded evidence to calculate a reliable working grade.";
   71: 
   72:   return {
   73:     level,
   74:     score: Math.min(100, score),
   75:     gradedEvidenceCount: graded.length,
   76:     writtenExamCount,
   77:     quizCount,
   78:     curriculumCoverage,
   79:     explanation,
   80:   };
   81: }

    1: import { buildInterventionReviewCycle } from "@/services/analytics/interventionReviewCycleService";
    2: import type { InterventionImpact } from "@/types/interventionImpact";
    3: import type {
    4:   InterventionEffectivenessItem,
    5:   InterventionEffectivenessStatus,
    6:   InterventionEffectivenessSummary,
    7: } from "@/types/interventionEffectiveness";
    8: 
    9: export type InterventionEffectivenessSource = {
   10:   id: string;
   11:   studentName: string;
   12:   topic: string;
   13:   status: string;
   14: };
   15: 
   16: function effectivenessStatus(
   17:   impact: InterventionImpact,
   18: ): InterventionEffectivenessStatus {
   19:   if (!impact.baseline) {
   20:     return "baseline_needed";
   21:   }
   22: 
   23:   if (impact.impactStatus === "awaiting_new_evidence") {
   24:     return "awaiting_evidence";
   25:   }
   26: 
   27:   if (impact.impactStatus === "improving") {
   28:     return "improving";
   29:   }
   30: 
   31:   if (impact.impactStatus === "declining") {
   32:     return "declining";
   33:   }
   34: 
   35:   return "limited_change";
   36: }
   37: 
   38: function headlineForStatus(
   39:   status: InterventionEffectivenessStatus,
   40: ): string {
   41:   switch (status) {
   42:     case "improving":
   43:       return "Improving";
   44:     case "declining":
   45:       return "Declining";
   46:     case "awaiting_evidence":
   47:       return "Awaiting reassessment";
   48:     case "baseline_needed":
   49:       return "Baseline required";
   50:     default:
   51:       return "Limited / mixed change";
   52:   }
   53: }
   54: 
   55: function statusRank(
   56:   status: InterventionEffectivenessStatus,
   57: ): number {
   58:   switch (status) {
   59:     case "declining":
   60:       return 0;
   61:     case "baseline_needed":
   62:       return 1;
   63:     case "awaiting_evidence":
   64:       return 2;
   65:     case "limited_change":
   66:       return 3;
   67:     case "improving":
   68:       return 4;
   69:   }
   70: }
   71: 
   72: export function buildInterventionEffectivenessItem({
   73:   source,
   74:   impact,
   75: }: {
   76:   source: InterventionEffectivenessSource;
   77:   impact: InterventionImpact;
   78: }): InterventionEffectivenessItem {
   79:   const status = effectivenessStatus(impact);
   80:   const review = buildInterventionReviewCycle(impact);
   81: 
   82:   return {
   83:     interventionId: source.id,
   84:     studentId: impact.studentId,
   85:     studentName: source.studentName,
   86:     topic: impact.topic || source.topic,
   87:     interventionStatus: source.status,
   88:     effectivenessStatus: status,
   89:     headline: headlineForStatus(status),
   90:     summary: impact.summary,
   91:     evidenceChange: impact.evidenceChange,
   92:     attainmentChange: impact.attainmentChange,
   93:     topicMasteryChange: impact.topicMasteryChange,
   94:     completionChange: impact.completionChange,
   95:     workingGradeChange: impact.workingGradeChange,
   96:     recommendedAction: review.explanation,
   97:     reviewHref: `/teacher/interventions/${encodeURIComponent(source.id)}`,
   98:   };
   99: }
  100: 
  101: export function buildInterventionEffectivenessSummary(
  102:   items: InterventionEffectivenessItem[],
  103: ): InterventionEffectivenessSummary {
  104:   const improving = items.filter(
  105:     (item) => item.effectivenessStatus === "improving",
  106:   ).length;
  107: 
  108:   const limitedChange = items.filter(
  109:     (item) => item.effectivenessStatus === "limited_change",
  110:   ).length;
  111: 
  112:   const declining = items.filter(
  113:     (item) => item.effectivenessStatus === "declining",
  114:   ).length;
  115: 
  116:   const awaitingEvidence = items.filter(
  117:     (item) => item.effectivenessStatus === "awaiting_evidence",
  118:   ).length;
  119: 
  120:   const baselineNeeded = items.filter(
  121:     (item) => item.effectivenessStatus === "baseline_needed",
  122:   ).length;
  123: 
  124:   const reviewReady = improving + limitedChange + declining;
  125: 
  126:   const successfulRate =
  127:     reviewReady > 0
  128:       ? Math.round((improving / reviewReady) * 100)
  129:       : null;
  130: 
  131:   return {
  132:     total: items.length,
  133:     improving,
  134:     limitedChange,
  135:     declining,
  136:     awaitingEvidence,
  137:     baselineNeeded,
  138:     reviewReady,
  139:     successfulRate,
  140:     items: [...items].sort((first, second) => {
  141:       const statusDifference =
  142:         statusRank(first.effectivenessStatus) -
  143:         statusRank(second.effectivenessStatus);
  144: 
  145:       if (statusDifference !== 0) {
  146:         return statusDifference;
  147:       }
  148: 
  149:       return first.studentName.localeCompare(second.studentName);
  150:     }),
  151:   };
  152: }

    1: import {
    2:   doc,

    7: import { db } from "@/lib/firebase";

    9: import type {
   10:   InterventionReviewCycle,

   13: 
   14: function changeText(
   15:   label: string,
   16:   value: number | null,
   17:   suffix = "",
   18: ): string | null {
   19:   if (value === null || value === 0) {
   20:     return null;
   21:   }
   22: 
   23:   const direction =
   24:     value > 0 ? "increased" : "decreased";
   25: 
   26:   return `${label} ${direction} by ${Math.abs(value)}${suffix}.`;
   27: }
   28: 
   29: export function buildInterventionReviewCycle(
   30:   impact: InterventionImpact,
   31: ): InterventionReviewCycle {
   32:   const allChanges = [
   33:     changeText("Attainment", impact.attainmentChange, "%"),
   34:     changeText("Completion", impact.completionChange, "%"),
   35:     changeText("Topic mastery", impact.topicMasteryChange, "%"),
   36:     changeText("Working grade", impact.workingGradeChange),
   37:   ].filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value));
   38: 
   39:   const successSignals = allChanges.filter(
   40:     (value) => value.includes("increased"),
   41:   );
   42: 
   43:   const concernSignals = allChanges.filter(
   44:     (value) => value.includes("decreased"),
   45:   );
   46: 
   47:   if (!impact.baseline) {
   48:     return {
   49:       phase: "baseline_needed",
   50:       headline: "Capture a baseline before judging impact",
   51:       explanation:
   52:         "This intervention does not yet have a reliable before-intervention comparison point.",
   53:       evidenceReady: false,
   54:       reassessmentRecommended: false,
   55:       canCloseSuccessful: false,
   56:       recommendedDecision: "continue",
   57:       successSignals,
   58:       concernSignals,
   59:     };
   60:   }
   61: 
   62:   if (impact.impactStatus === "awaiting_new_evidence") {
   63:     return {
   64:       phase: "awaiting_evidence",
   65:       headline: "The intervention needs a reassessment",
   66:       explanation:
   67:         "The baseline exists, but there is no new graded evidence yet. Assign a focused reassessment before deciding whether the intervention worked.",
   68:       evidenceReady: false,
   69:       reassessmentRecommended: true,
   70:       canCloseSuccessful: false,
   71:       recommendedDecision: "continue",
   72:       successSignals,
   73:       concernSignals,
   74:     };
   75:   }
   76: 
   77:   if (impact.impactStatus === "improving") {
   78:     return {
   79:       phase: "successful",
   80:       headline: "Evidence indicates that the intervention is working",
   81:       explanation:
   82:         "Multiple post-intervention indicators have improved. The teacher can continue briefly for consolidation or close the intervention as successful.",
   83:       evidenceReady: true,
   84:       reassessmentRecommended: false,
   85:       canCloseSuccessful: true,
   86:       recommendedDecision: "close_successful",
   87:       successSignals,
   88:       concernSignals,
   89:     };
   90:   }
   91: 
   92:   if (impact.impactStatus === "declining") {
   93:     return {
   94:       phase: "escalation_recommended",
   95:       headline: "The current support is not producing the required improvement",
   96:       explanation:
   97:         "Multiple indicators have weakened since the baseline. Review the misconception, change the support strategy and use a focused reassessment.",
   98:       evidenceReady: true,
   99:       reassessmentRecommended: true,
  100:       canCloseSuccessful: false,
  101:       recommendedDecision: "escalate",
  102:       successSignals,
  103:       concernSignals,
  104:     };
  105:   }
  106: 
  107:   if (impact.impactStatus === "mixed") {
  108:     return {
  109:       phase: "needs_retargeting",
  110:       headline: "Some evidence improved, but the intervention needs retargeting",
  111:       explanation:
  112:         "The response is mixed. Keep the successful elements, retarget the weak area and collect another meaningful assessment.",
  113:       evidenceReady: true,
  114:       reassessmentRecommended: true,
  115:       canCloseSuccessful: false,
  116:       recommendedDecision: "retarget",
  117:       successSignals,
  118:       concernSignals,
  119:     };
  120:   }
  121: 
  122:   return {
  123:     phase: "ready_to_review",
  124:     headline: "New evidence is available for teacher review",
  125:     explanation:
  126:       "There is post-intervention evidence, but the overall change is not yet large enough to classify as improving or declining.",
  127:     evidenceReady: true,
  128:     reassessmentRecommended: true,
  129:     canCloseSuccessful: false,
  130:     recommendedDecision: "continue",
  131:     successSignals,
  132:     concernSignals,
  133:   };
  134: }

  149: export async function saveInterventionReviewDecision({
  150:   interventionId,
  151:   teacherId,
  152:   decision,
  153:   note,
  154: }: {
  155:   interventionId: string;
  156:   teacherId: string;
  157:   decision: InterventionReviewDecision;
  158:   note: string;
  159: }): Promise<void> {
  160:   const reference = doc(
  161:     db,
  162:     "interventions",
  163:     interventionId,
  164:   );
  165: 
  166:   const update: Record<string, unknown> = {
  167:     reviewDecision: decision,
  168:     reviewNote: note.trim(),
  169:     reviewedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  170:     reviewedBy: teacherId.trim(),
  171:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  172:   };
  173: 
  174:   if (decision === "close_successful") {
  175:     update.status = "completed";
  176:     update.completedAt = serverTimestamp();
  177:   }
  178: 
  179:   if (decision === "escalate") {
  180:     update.status = "active";
  181:     update.escalatedAt = serverTimestamp();
  182:   }
  183: 
  184:   if (decision === "retarget") {
  185:     update.status = "active";
  186:     update.retargetedAt = serverTimestamp();
  187:   }
  188: 
  189:   await updateDoc(reference, update);
  190: }

   40: function safeString(
   41:   value: unknown,
   42: ): string {
   43:   return typeof value === "string"

   45:     : "";

   48: function safeNumber(
   49:   value: unknown,
   50: ): number | null {
   51:   return typeof value === "number" &&
   52:     Number.isFinite(value)
   53:     ? value
   54:     : null;
   55: }

   57: function extractYearNumber(
   58:   value: unknown,
   59: ): number | null {
   60:   const text = safeString(value);
   61: 
   62:   if (!text) {
   63:     return null;
   64:   }
   65: 
   66:   const match = text.match(
   67:     /\b(?:year\s*)?(7|8|9|10|11|12|13)\b/i,
   68:   );
   69: 
   70:   if (!match) {
   71:     return null;
   72:   }
   73: 
   74:   const year = Number(match[1]);
   75: 
   76:   return Number.isFinite(year)
   77:     ? year
   78:     : null;
   79: }

   81: function qualificationFromYear(
   82:   year: number | null,
   83: ): AnalyticsQualification | null {
   84:   if (year === null) {
   85:     return null;
   86:   }
   87: 
   88:   if (year <= 11) {
   89:     return "GCSE";
   90:   }
   91: 
   92:   if (year >= 12) {
   93:     return "A_LEVEL";
   94:   }
   95: 
   96:   return null;
   97: }

   99: function inferQualificationFromAssignments(
  100:   assignments: UnifiedAssignment[],
  101: ): AnalyticsQualification | null {
  102:   const years = assignments
  103:     .map((assignment) =>
  104:       extractYearNumber(
  105:         assignment.className,
  106:       ),
  107:     )
  108:     .filter(
  109:       (year): year is number =>
  110:         year !== null,
  111:     );
  112: 
  113:   if (
  114:     years.some(
  115:       (year) => year <= 11,
  116:     )
  117:   ) {
  118:     return "GCSE";
  119:   }
  120: 
  121:   if (
  122:     years.some(
  123:       (year) => year >= 12,
  124:     )
  125:   ) {
  126:     return "A_LEVEL";
  127:   }
  128: 
  129:   return null;
  130: }

  132: function normaliseQualification(
  133:   profile: Record<string, unknown>,
  134:   assignments: UnifiedAssignment[],
  135: ): AnalyticsQualification {
  136:   /*
  137:    * Canonical student curriculum selection takes precedence.
  138:    *
  139:    * A learner can remain enrolled in legacy or mixed-year class records,
  140:    * so inferring qualification from class year before reading the canonical
  141:    * users/{uid}.qualification field can incorrectly downgrade an A-level
  142:    * learner to GCSE (or vice versa).
  143:    *
  144:    * The profile field is the student's explicit CS Master curriculum choice
  145:    * and is already validated during onboarding/profile updates.
  146:    */
  147:   const explicitQualification =
  148:     safeString(
  149:       profile.qualification,
  150:     )
  151:       .trim()
  152:       .toUpperCase();
  153: 
  154:   if (
  155:     explicitQualification === "GCSE"
  156:   ) {
  157:     return "GCSE";
  158:   }
  159: 
  160:   if (
  161:     explicitQualification ===
  162:       "A_LEVEL" ||
  163:     explicitQualification ===
  164:       "A-LEVEL" ||
  165:     explicitQualification ===
  166:       "A LEVEL" ||
  167:     explicitQualification ===
  168:       "ALEVEL"
  169:   ) {
  170:     return "A_LEVEL";
  171:   }
  172: 
  173:   /*
  174:    * Legacy fallback only.
  175:    *
  176:    * Older profiles may pre-date the canonical qualification field. In that
  177:    * case, infer from year/class evidence, then from older course/level fields.
  178:    */
  179:   for (const value of [
  180:     profile.yearGroup,
  181:     profile.year,
  182:     profile.schoolYear,
  183:     profile.classYear,
  184:   ]) {
  185:     const result =
  186:       qualificationFromYear(
  187:         extractYearNumber(value),
  188:       );
  189: 
  190:     if (result) {
  191:       return result;
  192:     }
  193:   }
  194: 
  195:   const fromAssignments =
  196:     inferQualificationFromAssignments(
  197:       assignments,
  198:     );
  199: 
  200:   if (fromAssignments) {
  201:     return fromAssignments;
  202:   }
  203: 
  204:   const raw =
  205:     safeString(
  206:       profile.course,
  207:     ) ||
  208:     safeString(
  209:       profile.level,
  210:     ) ||
  211:     safeString(
  212:       profile.keyStage,
  213:     );
  214: 
  215:   const normalised =
  216:     raw.toLowerCase();
  217: 
  218:   if (
  219:     normalised.includes("gcse") ||
  220:     normalised.includes("ks4") ||
  221:     normalised.includes(
  222:       "key stage 4",
  223:     )
  224:   ) {
  225:     return "GCSE";
  226:   }
  227: 
  228:   if (
  229:     normalised.includes(
  230:       "a level",
  231:     ) ||
  232:     normalised.includes(
  233:       "a-level",
  234:     ) ||
  235:     normalised === "alevel" ||
  236:     normalised === "a_level" ||
  237:     normalised.includes("ks5") ||
  238:     normalised.includes(
  239:       "key stage 5",
  240:     )
  241:   ) {
  242:     return "A_LEVEL";
  243:   }
  244: 
  245:   return "GCSE";
  246: }

  248: function normaliseLegacyTargetGrade(
  249:   value: unknown,
  250:   qualification:

  270:       : [

  272:           "8",
  273:           "7",

  277:           "3",

  320: function isGenericTopicLabel(
  321:   value: string,
  322: ): boolean {
  323:   const cleaned = value
  324:     .trim()
  325:     .toLowerCase()
  326:     .replace(
  327:       /[^a-z0-9]+/g,
  328:       " ",
  329:     )
  330:     .trim();

  333:     "",
  334:     "quiz",

  339:     "practice quiz",
  340:     "written exam",
  341:     "exam",
  342:   ].includes(cleaned);
  343: }

  350:     .replace(

  365: /*
  366:  * Use the same canonical topic-normalisation
  367:  * service that Adaptive Learning already uses.

  369: function resolveAnalyticsTopic(
  370:   ...candidates: Array<
  371:     string | null | undefined
  372:   >
  373: ): string | null {
  374:   for (
  375:     const candidate of candidates
  376:   ) {
  377:     const raw =
  378:       cleanAssessmentTitle(
  379:         safeString(candidate),
  380:       );
  381: 
  382:     if (
  383:       !raw ||
  384:       isGenericTopicLabel(raw)
  385:     ) {
  386:       continue;
  387:     }
  388: 
  389:     const normalised =
  390:       normaliseTopic(raw);
  391: 
  392:     const topicTitle =
  393:       safeString(
  394:         normalised.topicTitle,
  395:       );
  396: 
  397:     if (
  398:       topicTitle &&
  399:       !isGenericTopicLabel(
  400:         topicTitle,
  401:       )
  402:     ) {
  403:       return topicTitle;
  404:     }
  405:   }
  406: 
  407:   return null;
  408: }

  486:           : null,

  489:       assignment.completedAt,
  490: 
  491:     dueDate:

  493: 
  494:     weight:
  495:       ANALYTICS_EVIDENCE_WEIGHTS[
  496:         type
  497:       ],
  498:

  500:

  503:

  513:       type === "written_exam"

  520: /*

  529: async function getIndependentQuizEvidence(
  530:   studentId: string,
  531: ): Promise<AnalyticsEvidence[]> {
  532:   const snapshot =
  533:     await getDocs(
  534:       query(
  535:         collection(
  536:           db,
  537:           "users",
  538:           studentId,
  539:           "quizResults",
  540:         ),
  541:         orderBy(
  542:           "createdAt",
  543:           "desc",
  544:         ),
  545:       ),
  546:     );
  547: 
  548:   const evidence:
  549:     AnalyticsEvidence[] = [];
  550: 
  551:   snapshot.docs.forEach(
  552:     (document) => {
  553:       const data =
  554:         document.data();
  555: 
  556:       const rawTitle =
  557:         safeString(
  558:           data.quizTitle,
  559:         ) ||
  560:         safeString(
  561:           data.title,
  562:         ) ||
  563:         safeString(
  564:           data.topicTitle,
  565:         ) ||
  566:         safeString(
  567:           data.topic,
  568:         ) ||
  569:         "Quiz";
  570: 
  571:       const topic =
  572:         resolveAnalyticsTopic(
  573:           safeString(
  574:             data.topicTitle,
  575:           ),
  576:           safeString(
  577:             data.topic,
  578:           ),
  579:           rawTitle,
  580:         );
  581: 
  582:       if (!topic) {
  583:         console.warn(
  584:           `Independent quiz result ${document.id} has no resolvable curriculum topic and was excluded from Analytics.`,
  585:         );
  586:

  588:       }
  589: 
  590:       const percentage =
  591:         safeNumber(
  592:           data.scorePercent,
  593:         );
  594: 
  595:       const rawScore =
  596:         safeNumber(
  597:           data.score,
  598:         );
  599: 
  600:       const totalQuestions =
  601:         safeNumber(
  602:           data.totalQuestions,
  603:         );
  604: 
  605:       const completedAt =
  606:         data.createdAt instanceof
  607:         Timestamp
  608:           ? data.createdAt.toDate()
  609:           : null;
  610: 
  611:       evidence.push({
  612:         id:
  613:           `practice-quiz-${document.id}`,
  614: 
  615:         type: "quiz",
  616: 
  617:         title:
  618:           rawTitle,
  619: 
  620:         topic,
  621: 
  622:         percentage,
  623: 
  624:         rawScore,
  625: 
  626:         totalMarks:
  627:           totalQuestions,
  628: 
  629:         completedAt,
  630: 
  631:         dueDate: null,
  632: 
  633:         weight:
  634:           ANALYTICS_EVIDENCE_WEIGHTS.quiz,
  635: 
  636:         graded:
  637:           percentage !== null,
  638: 
  639:         /*
  640:          * This is not a teacher assignment,
  641:          * so there is deliberately no assignment ID.
  642:          */
  643:         sourceAssignmentId:
  644:           null,
  645: 
  646:         sourceAssessmentId:
  647:           document.id,
  648: 
  649:         sourceQuestionId:
  650:           null,
  651: 
  652:         sourceQuestionNumber:
  653:           null,
  654: 
  655:         sourceLabel:
  656:           "Independent practice quiz",
  657:       });
  658:     },
  659:   );
  660: 
  661:   return evidence;
  662: }
  663: 
  664: function buildMasteryEvidence(
  665:   evidence:
  666:     AnalyticsEvidence[],
  667:   examQuestionEvidence:
  668:     AnalyticsEvidence[],
  669: ): AnalyticsEvidence[] {
  670:   const examsWithQuestionEvidence =
  671:     new Set(
  672:       examQuestionEvidence
  673:         .map(
  674:           (item) =>
  675:             item.sourceAssignmentId,
  676:         )
  677:         .filter(
  678:           (
  679:             value,
  680:           ): value is string =>
  681:             Boolean(value),
  682:         ),
  683:     );
  684: 
  685:   return [
  686:     ...evidence.filter(
  687:       (item) => {
  688:         if (
  689:           item.type !==
  690:           "written_exam"
  691:         ) {
  692:           return true;
  693:         }
  694: 
  695:         if (
  696:           !item.sourceAssignmentId
  697:         ) {
  698:           return true;
  699:         }
  700: 
  701:         return !examsWithQuestionEvidence.has(
  702:           item.sourceAssignmentId,
  703:         );
  704:       },
  705:     ),
  706: 
  707:     ...examQuestionEvidence,
  708:   ];
  709: }
  710: 
  711: function countEvidenceSources(
  712:   evidence:
  713:     AnalyticsEvidence[],
  714: ): AnalyticsEvidenceSourceCounts {
  715:   const counts:
  716:     AnalyticsEvidenceSourceCounts =
  717:     {
  718:       written_exam: 0,
  719:       quiz: 0,
  720:       ai_quiz: 0,
  721:       programming: 0,
  722:       lesson: 0,
  723:     };
  724: 
  725:   const ids =
  726:     new Map<
  727:       AnalyticsEvidenceType,
  728:       Set<string>
  729:     >();
  730: 
  731:   for (
  732:     const item of evidence
  733:   ) {
  734:     const key =
  735:       item.sourceAssignmentId ||
  736:       item.id;
  737: 
  738:     const current =
  739:       ids.get(item.type) ||
  740:       new Set<string>();
  741: 
  742:     current.add(key);
  743: 
  744:     ids.set(
  745:       item.type,
  746:       current,
  747:     );
  748:   }
  749: 
  750:   for (
  751:     const [
  752:       type,
  753:       values,
  754:     ] of ids.entries()
  755:   ) {
  756:     counts[type] =
  757:       values.size;
  758:   }
  759: 
  760:   return counts;
  761: }

  763: export async function getRichStudentAnalytics(
  764:   studentId: string,
  765: ): Promise<RichStudentAnalytics> {
  766:   const cleanedStudentId =
  767:     studentId.trim();
  768: 
  769:   if (!cleanedStudentId) {
  770:     throw new Error(
  771:       "A valid student account is required.",
  772:     );
  773:   }
  774: 
  775:   const [
  776:     profileSnapshot,
  777:     assignments,
  778:     storedTarget,
  779:     independentQuizEvidence,
  780:   ] = await Promise.all([
  781:     getDoc(
  782:       doc(
  783:         db,
  784:         "users",
  785:         cleanedStudentId,
  786:       ),
  787:     ),
  788: 
  789:     getUnifiedStudentAssignments(
  790:       cleanedStudentId,
  791:     ),
  792: 
  793:     getStudentTargetGrade(
  794:       cleanedStudentId,
  795:     ).catch(
  796:       () => null,
  797:     ),
  798: 
  799:     getIndependentQuizEvidence(
  800:       cleanedStudentId,
  801:     ).catch(
  802:       (error) => {
  803:         console.warn(
  804:           "Independent quiz evidence could not be loaded:",
  805:           error,
  806:         );
  807: 
  808:         return [];
  809:       },
  810:     ),
  811:   ]);
  812: 
  813:   const profile =
  814:     profileSnapshot.exists()
  815:       ? (
  816:           profileSnapshot.data() as
  817:             Record<
  818:               string,
  819:               unknown
  820:             >
  821:         )
  822:       : {};
  823: 
  824:   const qualification =
  825:     normaliseQualification(
  826:       profile,
  827:       assignments,
  828:     );
  829: 
  830:   const examBoard =
  831:     safeString(
  832:       profile.examBoard,
  833:     ) || null;
  834: 
  835:   const targetGrade =
  836:     storedTarget?.qualification ===
  837:     qualification
  838:       ? storedTarget.targetGrade
  839:       : normaliseLegacyTargetGrade(
  840:           profile.targetGrade,
  841:           qualification,
  842:         );
  843: 
  844:   const boundarySet =
  845:     getDefaultBoundarySet(
  846:       qualification,
  847:     );
  848: 
  849:   /*
  850:    * Teacher-assigned evidence.
  851:    */
  852:   const assignmentEvidence =
  853:     assignments
  854:       .map(
  855:         assignmentToEvidence,
  856:       )
  857:       .filter(
  858:         (
  859:           item,
  860:         ): item is AnalyticsEvidence =>
  861:           item !== null,
  862:       );
  863: 
  864:   /*
  865:    * Combine teacher-assigned and independent
  866:    * student-practice evidence.
  867:    */
  868:   const evidence = [
  869:     ...assignmentEvidence,
  870:     ...independentQuizEvidence,
  871:   ];
  872: 
  873:   const examQuestionEvidence =
  874:     await getWrittenExamQuestionEvidence(
  875:       cleanedStudentId,
  876:     ).catch(
  877:       (error) => {
  878:         console.warn(
  879:           "Written exam question evidence could not be loaded:",
  880:           error,
  881:         );
  882: 
  883:         return [];
  884:       },
  885:     );
  886: 
  887:   /*
  888:    * Canonicalise any question-level exam topics
  889:    * before they enter mastery calculations.
  890:    */
  891:   const normalisedExamQuestionEvidence =
  892:     examQuestionEvidence
  893:       .map(
  894:         (
  895:           item,
  896:         ): AnalyticsEvidence | null => {
  897:           const topic =
  898:             resolveAnalyticsTopic(
  899:               item.topic,
  900:               item.title,
  901:             );
  902: 
  903:           if (!topic) {
  904:             return null;
  905:           }
  906: 
  907:           return {
  908:             ...item,
  909:             topic,
  910:           };
  911:         },
  912:       )
  913:       .filter(
  914:         (
  915:           item,
  916:         ): item is AnalyticsEvidence =>
  917:           item !== null,
  918:       );
  919: 
  920:   const masteryEvidence =
  921:     buildMasteryEvidence(
  922:       evidence,
  923:       normalisedExamQuestionEvidence,
  924:     );
  925: 
  926:   /*
  927:    * Independent quizzes are genuine completed
  928:    * learning activities even though they are not
  929:    * teacher assignments.
  930:    */
  931:   const completedAssignmentCount =
  932:     assignments.filter(
  933:       isUnifiedAssignmentComplete,
  934:     ).length;
  935: 
  936:   const completedActivityCount =
  937:     completedAssignmentCount +
  938:     independentQuizEvidence.length;
  939: 
  940:   const totalActivityCount =
  941:     assignments.length +
  942:     independentQuizEvidence.length;
  943: 
  944:   const completionRate =
  945:     totalActivityCount > 0
  946:       ? Math.round(
  947:           (
  948:             completedActivityCount /
  949:             totalActivityCount
  950:           ) *
  951:             100,
  952:         )
  953:       : 0;
  954: 
  955:   const grade =
  956:     calculateGradeProgress({
  957:       evidence,
  958:       targetGrade,
  959:       boundarySet,
  960:     });
  961: 
  962:   const topics =
  963:     buildTopicMastery(
  964:       masteryEvidence,
  965:     );
  966: 
  967:   const strongestTopics =
  968:     topics.slice(0, 3);
  969: 
  970:   const weakestTopics = [
  971:     ...topics,
  972:   ]
  973:     .sort(
  974:       (a, b) =>
  975:         a.weightedPercentage -
  976:         b.weightedPercentage,
  977:     )
  978:     .slice(0, 3);
  979: 
  980:   const trendResult =
  981:     buildTrend(evidence);
  982: 
  983:   const confidence =
  984:     calculateEvidenceConfidence({
  985:       evidence,
  986:       totalActivityCount,
  987:       completedActivityCount,
  988:     });
  989: 
  990:   const interpretation =
  991:     buildAnalyticsInterpretation({
  992:       grade,
  993:       trend:
  994:         trendResult.trend,
  995:       strongestTopics,
  996:       weakestTopics,
  997:     });
  998: 
  999:   return {
 1000:     studentId:
 1001:       cleanedStudentId,
 1002: 
 1003:     qualification,
 1004: 
 1005:     examBoard,
 1006: 
 1007:     targetGrade,
 1008: 
 1009:     grade,
 1010: 
 1011:     confidence,
 1012: 
 1013:     trend:
 1014:       trendResult.trend,
 1015: 
 1016:     trendChange:
 1017:       trendResult.change,
 1018: 
 1019:     trendPoints:
 1020:       trendResult.points,
 1021: 
 1022:     topics,
 1023: 
 1024:     strongestTopics,
 1025: 
 1026:     weakestTopics,
 1027: 
 1028:     evidence,
 1029: 
 1030:     masteryEvidence,
 1031: 
 1032:     evidenceSourceCounts:
 1033:       countEvidenceSources(
 1034:         masteryEvidence,
 1035:       ),
 1036: 
 1037:     completedActivityCount,
 1038: 
 1039:     totalActivityCount,
 1040: 
 1041:     completionRate,
 1042: 
 1043:     interpretation,
 1044:   };
 1045: }

  104: function weakestTopicForStudent(
  105:   student: TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow,
  106: ): {

  159: function classTopics(
  160:   classItem: TeacherClassAnalytics,
  161: ): {
  162:   priority: ClassTopicAnalytics[];
  163:   strongest: ClassTopicAnalytics[];
  164: } {
  165:   const withEvidence = classItem.topicAnalytics.filter(
  166:     (topic) => topic.evidenceCount > 0,
  167:   );
  168: 
  169:   return {
  170:     /*
  171:      * "Priority" must mean that evidence actually needs attention.
  172:      * Secure topics must never be pulled into this list merely to fill
  173:      * four display slots.
  174:      *
  175:      * <50  = priority
  176:      * 50-69 = developing / watch
  177:      * 70+  = secure
  178:      *
  179:      * The action centre includes priority + developing topics (<70).
  180:      */
  181:     priority: [...withEvidence]
  182:       .filter(
  183:         (topic) =>
  184:           topic.weightedPercentage <
  185:           70,
  186:       )
  187:       .sort(
  188:         (first, second) =>
  189:           first.weightedPercentage -
  190:           second.weightedPercentage,
  191:       )
  192:       .slice(0, 4),
  193: 
  194:     strongest: [...withEvidence]
  195:       .filter(
  196:         (topic) =>
  197:           topic.weightedPercentage >=
  198:           70,
  199:       )
  200:       .sort(
  201:         (first, second) =>
  202:           second.weightedPercentage -
  203:           first.weightedPercentage,
  204:       )
  205:       .slice(0, 4),
  206:   };
  207: }

  209: function normaliseClass(

  220:     averageWorkingGrade: classItem.averageWorkingGrade || "â€”",
  221:     averageTargetGrade: classItem.averageTargetGrade || "Not set",
  222:     averageWeightedPercentage: classItem.averageWeightedPercentage,
  223:     averageCompletionRate: classItem.averageCompletionRate,
  224:     onOrAboveTargetPercentage: classItem.onOrAboveTargetPercentage,
  225:     highPriorityCount: classItem.highPriorityCount,
  226:     decliningCount: classItem.decliningCount,

  233: function aggregateTopics(
  234:   portfolio: TeacherAnalyticsPortfolio,
  235: ): ClassTopicAnalytics[] {
  236:   const groups = new Map<
  237:     string,
  238:     {
  239:       values: number[];
  240:       evidenceCount: number;
  241:       studentCount: number;
  242:     }
  243:   >();
  244: 
  245:   portfolio.classes
  246:     .flatMap((classItem) => classItem.topicAnalytics)
  247:     .forEach((topic) => {
  248:       if (topic.evidenceCount <= 0) return;
  249: 
  250:       const current = groups.get(topic.topic) || {
  251:         values: [],
  252:         evidenceCount: 0,
  253:         studentCount: 0,
  254:       };
  255: 
  256:       current.values.push(topic.weightedPercentage);
  257:       current.evidenceCount += topic.evidenceCount;
  258:       current.studentCount += topic.studentCount;
  259: 
  260:       groups.set(topic.topic, current);
  261:     });
  262: 
  263:   return Array.from(groups.entries()).map(([topic, group]) => {
  264:     const percentage =
  265:       group.values.length > 0
  266:         ? Math.round(
  267:             group.values.reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0) /
  268:               group.values.length,
  269:           )
  270:         : 0;
  271: 
  272:     return {
  273:       topic,
  274:       weightedPercentage: percentage,
  275:       recentPercentage: percentage,
  276:       evidenceCount: group.evidenceCount,
  277:       studentCount: group.studentCount,
  278:       status:
  279:         percentage >= 70
  280:           ? "secure"
  281:           : percentage >= 50
  282:             ? "developing"
  283:             : "priority",
  284:     };
  285:   });
  286: }
