  288: export async function getTeacherAnalyticsActionCentre(
  289:   teacherId: string,
  290: ): Promise<TeacherAnalyticsActionCentre> {
  291:   const cleanedTeacherId = teacherId.trim();
  292: 
  293:   if (!cleanedTeacherId) {
  294:     throw new Error("A teacher account is required.");
  295:   }
  296: 
  297:   const [portfolio, interventions] = await Promise.all([
  298:     getTeacherAnalyticsPortfolio(cleanedTeacherId),
  299:     getTeacherInterventions(cleanedTeacherId),
  300:   ]);
  301: 
  302:   const allStudentRows = portfolio.classes.flatMap((classItem) =>
  303:     classItem.students.map((student) => ({
  304:       student,
  305:       classItem,
  306:     })),
  307:   );
  308: 
  309:   /*
  310:    * A learner can be in more than one class in the same school.
  311:    * Use the highest-priority class row when calculating unique-student
  312:    * headline metrics, while keeping class-specific rows for action lists.
  313:    */
  314:   const uniqueStudents = new Map<string, TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow>();
  315: 
  316:   allStudentRows.forEach(({ student }) => {
  317:     const current = uniqueStudents.get(student.studentId);
  318: 
  319:     if (
  320:       !current ||
  321:       priorityRank(student.interventionPriority) >
  322:         priorityRank(current.interventionPriority)
  323:     ) {
  324:       uniqueStudents.set(student.studentId, student);
  325:     }
  326:   });
  327: 
  328:   const uniqueRows = Array.from(uniqueStudents.values());
  329: 
  330:   const studentsWithEvidence = uniqueRows.filter(
  331:     (student) => student.workingGrade !== null,
  332:   ).length;
  333: 
  334:   const studentsWithTargets = uniqueRows.filter(
  335:     (student) => student.targetGrade !== null,
  336:   );
  337: 
  338:   const studentsBelowTarget = studentsWithTargets.filter(
  339:     (student) =>
  340:       student.gradeGap !== null && student.gradeGap < 0,
  341:   ).length;
  342: 
  343:   const studentsOnOrAboveTarget = studentsWithTargets.filter(
  344:     (student) =>
  345:       student.gradeGap !== null && student.gradeGap >= 0,
  346:   ).length;
  347: 
  348:   const priorityStudents = allStudentRows
  349:     .map(({ student, classItem }) =>
  350:       normaliseStudent({
  351:         student,
  352:         classItem,
  353:       }),
  354:     )
  355:     .filter(
  356:       (student) =>
  357:         student.priority !== "none" ||
  358:         student.gradeGap === null ||
  359:         student.gradeGap < 0 ||
  360:         student.trend === "declining" ||
  361:         student.completionRate < 80 ||
  362:         student.confidence === "low" ||
  363:         student.confidence === "insufficient",
  364:     )
  365:     .sort((first, second) => {
  366:       const priorityDifference =
  367:         priorityRank(second.priority) - priorityRank(first.priority);
  368: 
  369:       if (priorityDifference !== 0) return priorityDifference;
  370: 
  371:       const firstGap = first.gradeGap ?? 0;
  372:       const secondGap = second.gradeGap ?? 0;
  373: 
  374:       if (firstGap !== secondGap) return firstGap - secondGap;
  375: 
  376:       return first.completionRate - second.completionRate;
  377:     });
  378: 
  379:   const classRows = portfolio.classes.map(normaliseClass);
  380:   const allTopics = aggregateTopics(portfolio);
  381: 
  382:   return {
  383:     teacherId: cleanedTeacherId,
  384:     classCount: portfolio.classCount,
  385:     studentCount: portfolio.uniqueStudentCount,
  386:     studentsWithEvidence,
  387:     studentsWithoutEvidence: Math.max(
  388:       0,
  389:       portfolio.uniqueStudentCount - studentsWithEvidence,
  390:     ),
  391:     highPriorityCount: uniqueRows.filter(
  392:       (student) => student.interventionPriority === "high",
  393:     ).length,
  394:     decliningCount: uniqueRows.filter(
  395:       (student) => student.trend === "declining",
  396:     ).length,
  397:     lowEvidenceCount: uniqueRows.filter(
  398:       (student) =>
  399:         student.confidence === "low" ||
  400:         student.confidence === "insufficient",
  401:     ).length,
  402:     studentsWithTargets: studentsWithTargets.length,
  403:     studentsBelowTarget,
  404:     studentsOnOrAboveTarget,
  405:     studentsWithoutTargets: Math.max(
  406:       0,
  407:       portfolio.uniqueStudentCount - studentsWithTargets.length,
  408:     ),
  409:     averageCompletionRate:
  410:       uniqueRows.length > 0
  411:         ? Math.round(
  412:             uniqueRows.reduce(
  413:               (total, student) => total + student.completionRate,
  414:               0,
  415:             ) / uniqueRows.length,
  416:           )
  417:         : 0,
  418:     activeInterventions: interventions.filter(
  419:       (intervention) => intervention.status === "active",
  420:     ).length,
  421:     completedInterventions: interventions.filter(
  422:       (intervention) => intervention.status === "completed",
  423:     ).length,
  424:     priorityStudents,
  425:     classes: classRows,
  426:     priorityTopics: [...allTopics]
  427:       .filter(
  428:         (topic) =>
  429:           topic.weightedPercentage <
  430:           70,
  431:       )
  432:       .sort(
  433:         (first, second) =>
  434:           first.weightedPercentage -
  435:           second.weightedPercentage,
  436:       )
  437:       .slice(0, 6),
  438: 
  439:     strongestTopics: [...allTopics]
  440:       .filter(
  441:         (topic) =>
  442:           topic.weightedPercentage >=
  443:           70,
  444:       )
  445:       .sort(
  446:         (first, second) =>
  447:           second.weightedPercentage -
  448:           first.weightedPercentage,
  449:       )
  450:       .slice(0, 6),
  451:   };
  452: }

   58: function toDate(value: FirestoreDate): Date | null {
   59:   if (!value) return null;
   60: 
   61:   if (value instanceof Date) {
   62:     return value;
   63:   }
   64: 
   65:   if (value instanceof Timestamp) {
   66:     return value.toDate();
   67:   }
   68: 
   69:   if (typeof value === "string") {
   70:     const parsed = new Date(value);
   71: 
   72:     return Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())
   73:       ? null
   74:       : parsed;
   75:   }
   76: 
   77:   return null;
   78: }
   79: 
   80: function safeString(
   81:   value: unknown,
   82:   fallback = "",

   84:   return typeof value === "string" &&
   85:     value.trim()
   86:     ? value.trim()
   87:     : fallback;
   88: }

   90: function safeNumber(
   91:   value: unknown,
   92: ): number | null {
   93:   return typeof value === "number" &&
   94:     Number.isFinite(value)
   95:     ? value
   96:     : null;
   97: }

   99: function safeStringArray(
  100:   value: unknown,
  101: ): string[] {
  102:   if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
  103:     return [];
  104:   }
  105: 
  106:   return value.filter(
  107:     (item): item is string =>
  108:       typeof item === "string",
  109:   );
  110: }

  112: function safeRecordArray(
  113:   value: unknown,
  114: ): Record<string, unknown>[] {
  115:   if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
  116:     return [];
  117:   }
  118: 
  119:   return value.filter(
  120:     (
  121:       item,
  122:     ): item is Record<string, unknown> =>
  123:       Boolean(item) &&
  124:       typeof item === "object" &&
  125:       !Array.isArray(item),
  126:   );
  127: }

  149: function countEvidenceSources(

  188: function qualificationFromClass(

  193:       (classItem.yearGroup || "")
  194:         .match(/\d+/)?.[0] || 0,

  202: function normaliseLegacyTargetGrade(
  203:   value: unknown,
  204:   qualification: AnalyticsQualification,
  205: ): GradeLabel | null {
  206:   const grade =
  207:     safeString(value).toUpperCase();
  208: 
  209:   if (!grade) {
  210:     return null;
  211:   }
  212: 
  213:   const options =
  214:     qualification === "A_LEVEL"
  215:       ? ["A*", "A", "B", "C", "D", "E"]
  216:       : [
  217:           "9",
  218:           "8",
  219:           "7",
  220:           "6",
  221:           "5",
  222:           "4",
  223:           "3",
  224:           "2",
  225:           "1",
  226:         ];
  227: 
  228:   return options.includes(grade)
  229:     ? (grade as GradeLabel)
  230:     : null;
  231: }

  233: function isPlaceholderStudentName(value: string): boolean {
  234:   const normalised = value.trim().toLowerCase();
  235: 
  236:   return (
  237:     !normalised ||
  238:     normalised === "student" ||
  239:     normalised === "unnamed student" ||
  240:     normalised === "unknown student"
  241:   );
  242: }

  244: async function getStudentIdentity(
  245:   studentId: string,
  246:   classItem: TeacherClass,
  247: ): Promise<StudentIdentity> {
  248:   const embedded =
  249:     classItem.students?.find(
  250:       (student) =>
  251:         student.studentId === studentId,
  252:     );
  253: 
  254:   /*
  255:    * Prefer the canonical user profile. Older class records can contain
  256:    * placeholder names such as "Unnamed Student", so the embedded class
  257:    * snapshot is only used as a fallback.
  258:    */
  259:   try {
  260:     const snapshot =
  261:       await getDoc(
  262:         doc(db, "users", studentId),
  263:       );
  264: 
  265:     if (snapshot.exists()) {
  266:       const data = snapshot.data();
  267: 
  268:       const profileName =
  269:         safeString(data.name);
  270: 
  271:       const profileEmail =
  272:         safeString(data.email);
  273: 
  274:       if (
  275:         !isPlaceholderStudentName(
  276:           profileName,
  277:         )
  278:       ) {
  279:         return {
  280:           id: studentId,
  281:           name: profileName,
  282:           email:
  283:             profileEmail ||
  284:             embedded?.email ||
  285:             "",
  286:         };
  287:       }
  288:     }
  289:   } catch {
  290:     /*
  291:      * A teacher may legitimately be denied a direct read of users/{studentId}
  292:      * by tenant rules. Identity is already embedded in the teacher-owned class
  293:      * snapshot, so permission denial is a normal fallback rather than an error.
  294:      */
  295:   }
  296: 
  297:   const embeddedName =
  298:     embedded?.displayName || "";
  299: 
  300:   return {
  301:     id: studentId,
  302:     name:
  303:       !isPlaceholderStudentName(
  304:         embeddedName,
  305:       )
  306:         ? embeddedName
  307:         : "Student",
  308:     email:
  309:       embedded?.email || "",
  310:   };
  311: }

  313: /*
  314:  * IMPORTANT:
  315:  *
  316:  * Teacher analytics must NOT call the student-facing
  317:  * getUnifiedStudentAssignments()/getRichStudentAnalytics()
  318:  * pipeline.
  319:  *
  320:  * That pipeline performs direct student-context reads
  321:  * (including "not yet created" result/progress documents).
  322:  * Those are valid for the student, but some are correctly
  323:  * rejected when another account performs the same get.
  324:  *

  326:  * with queries constrained by teacherId, then filters the

  329: async function getTeacherOwnedStudentAnalytics({
  330:   teacherId,
  331:   studentId,

  346:     /*
  347:      * Student profile reads are optional for teacher analytics.
  348:      * Firestore may correctly deny this direct user-document read while still
  349:      * allowing the teacher to analyse teacher-owned class/assignment evidence.
  350:      * Returning null preserves the class snapshot + target-grade fallback.

  352:     getDoc(

  357:       query(
  358:         collection(db, "assignments"),

  360:           "teacherId",

  364:       ),
  365:     ),
  366:

  369:         collection(
  370:           db,
  371:           "assignmentResults",

  383:         collection(
  384:           db,
  385:           "examAssignments",
  386:         ),
  387:         where(
  388:           "teacherId",
  389:           "==",
  390:           teacherId,
  391:         ),
  392:       ),
  393:     ),
  394: 
  395:     getDocs(
  396:       query(
  397:         collection(
  398:           db,
  399:           "examSubmissions",
  400:         ),
  401:         where(
  402:           "teacherId",
  403:           "==",
  404:           teacherId,
  405:         ),
  406:       ),
  407:     ),
  408: 
  409:     getDocs(
  410:       query(
  411:         collection(
  412:           db,
  413:           "classAssignments",
  414:         ),
  415:         where(
  416:           "teacherId",
  417:           "==",
  418:           teacherId,
  419:         ),
  420:       ),
  421:     ),
  422:   ]);
  423: 
  424:   const profile =
  425:     profileSnapshot?.exists()
  426:       ? profileSnapshot.data()
  427:       : {};
  428: 
  429:   const qualification =
  430:     qualificationFromClass(
  431:       classItem,

  433: 
  434:   const storedTarget =
  435:     await getStudentTargetGrade(
  436:       studentId,

  449:     getDefaultBoundarySet(

  454:     new Map<

  464:       resultDocument.data();

  467:       safeString(data.studentId) !==
  468:       studentId

  471:     }

  480:         assignmentId,
  481:         data,

  494:     [];
  495: 
  496:   let totalActivityCount = 0;
  497:   let completedActivityCount = 0;
  498: 
  499:   /*
  500:    * QUIZ / AI QUIZ EVIDENCE

  635:       submissionDocument.data();

  638:       safeString(data.studentId) !==
  639:       studentId
  640:     ) {
  641:       continue;
  642:     }

  645:       safeString(
  646:         data.assignmentId,
  647:       );

  685:       submissionByAssignment.get(

  730:         "object"
  731:         ? (assignment.questionSetSnapshot as Record<
  732:             string,
  733:             unknown
  734:           >)
  735:         : {};
  736: 
  737:     const fallbackExamTopic =
  738:       safeString(

  743:       ) ||

  752:       type: "written_exam",
  753:       title:
  754:         safeString(
  755:           assignment.title,
  756:           "Written assessment",
  757:         ),
  758:       topic: fallbackExamTopic,
  759:       percentage,
  760:       rawScore,
  761:       totalMarks,
  762:       completedAt:
  763:         toDate(
  764:           (
  765:             submission
  766:               ?.markedAt ??
  767:             submission
  768:               ?.submittedAt
  769:           ) as FirestoreDate,
  770:         ),
  771:       dueDate:
  772:         toDate(
  773:           assignment.dueDate as
  774:             FirestoreDate,
  775:         ),
  776:       weight:
  777:         ANALYTICS_EVIDENCE_WEIGHTS
  778:           .written_exam,
  779:       graded:
  780:         marked &&
  781:         percentage !== null,
  782:       sourceAssignmentId:
  783:         assignmentDocument.id,
  784:       sourceAssessmentId:
  785:         safeString(
  786:           assignment.questionSetId,
  787:         ) || null,
  788:       sourceQuestionId: null,
  789:       sourceQuestionNumber: null,
  790:       sourceLabel:
  791:         "Teacher-assigned written exam",
  792:     });
  793: 
  794:     /*
  795:      * A marked paper contributes question-level topic evidence.
  796:      * Each question receives only its share of the paper's written-exam
  797:      * weight, so one paper is not treated as several full exams.
  798:      */
  799:     if (marked) {
  800:       const questions =
  801:         safeRecordArray(
  802:           questionSetSnapshot.questions,
  803:         );
  804: 
  805:       const answers =
  806:         safeRecordArray(
  807:           submission?.answers,
  808:         );
  809: 
  810:       const paperMarks =
  811:         totalMarks && totalMarks > 0
  812:           ? totalMarks
  813:           : questions.reduce(
  814:               (sum, question) =>
  815:                 sum +
  816:                 (safeNumber(
  817:                   question.marks,
  818:                 ) || 0),
  819:               0,
  820:             );
  821: 
  822:       for (const question of questions) {
  823:         const questionId =
  824:           safeString(question.id);
  825: 
  826:         if (!questionId) {
  827:           continue;
  828:         }
  829: 
  830:         const answer =
  831:           answers.find(
  832:             (item) =>
  833:               safeString(
  834:                 item.questionId,
  835:               ) === questionId,
  836:           );
  837: 
  838:         const availableMarks =
  839:           safeNumber(question.marks);
  840: 
  841:         const awardedMarks =
  842:           safeNumber(
  843:             answer?.awardedMarks,
  844:           );
  845: 
  846:         if (
  847:           availableMarks === null ||
  848:           availableMarks <= 0 ||
  849:           awardedMarks === null
  850:         ) {
  851:           continue;
  852:         }
  853: 
  854:         const clampedAwardedMarks =
  855:           Math.max(
  856:             0,
  857:             Math.min(
  858:               availableMarks,
  859:               awardedMarks,
  860:             ),
  861:           );
  862: 
  863:         const questionNumber =
  864:           safeNumber(
  865:             question.questionNumber,
  866:           );
  867: 
  868:         const weightShare =
  869:           paperMarks > 0
  870:             ? availableMarks /
  871:               paperMarks
  872:             : 1 /
  873:               Math.max(
  874:                 1,
  875:                 questions.length,
  876:               );
  877: 
  878:         examQuestionEvidence.push({
  879:           id:
  880:             `written-exam-question-${assignmentDocument.id}-${questionId}`,
  881:           type: "written_exam",
  882:           title:
  883:             `${safeString(
  884:               assignment.title,
  885:               "Written assessment",
  886:             )} Â· ${
  887:               questionNumber === null
  888:                 ? "Question"
  889:                 : `Q${questionNumber}`
  890:             }`,
  891:           topic:
  892:             examQuestionTopic(
  893:               question,
  894:               fallbackExamTopic,
  895:             ),
  896:           percentage:
  897:             Math.round(
  898:               (
  899:                 clampedAwardedMarks /
  900:                 availableMarks
  901:               ) * 100,
  902:             ),
  903:           rawScore:
  904:             clampedAwardedMarks,
  905:           totalMarks:
  906:             availableMarks,
  907:           completedAt:
  908:             toDate(
  909:               (
  910:                 submission
  911:                   ?.markedAt ??
  912:                 submission
  913:                   ?.submittedAt
  914:               ) as FirestoreDate,
  915:             ),
  916:           dueDate:
  917:             toDate(
  918:               assignment.dueDate as
  919:                 FirestoreDate,
  920:             ),
  921:           weight:
  922:             ANALYTICS_EVIDENCE_WEIGHTS
  923:               .written_exam *
  924:             weightShare,
  925:           graded: true,
  926:           sourceAssignmentId:
  927:             assignmentDocument.id,
  928:           sourceAssessmentId:
  929:             safeString(
  930:               assignment.questionSetId,
  931:             ) || null,
  932:           sourceQuestionId:
  933:             questionId,
  934:           sourceQuestionNumber:
  935:             questionNumber,
  936:           sourceLabel:
  937:             "Teacher-marked written exam question",
  938:         });
  939:       }
  940:     }
  941:   }
  942: 
  943:   /*
  944:    * RESOURCE / PROGRAMMING ASSIGNMENTS
  945:    *
  946:    * We count teacher-owned assigned resources in completion
  947:    * coverage but do not perform student-context direct reads.
  948:    * Their ungraded status therefore cannot distort the
  949:    * working-grade calculation.
  950:    */
  951:   for (
  952:     const assignmentDocument of
  953:     resourceAssignmentsSnapshot.docs
  954:   ) {
  955:     const assignment =
  956:       assignmentDocument.data();
  957: 
  958:     const studentIds =
  959:       safeStringArray(
  960:         assignment.studentIds,
  961:       );
  962: 
  963:     if (
  964:       safeString(
  965:         assignment.classId,
  966:       ) !== classItem.id ||
  967:       !studentIds.includes(
  968:         studentId,
  969:       ) ||
  970:       assignment.status ===
  971:         "cancelled"
  972:     ) {
  973:       continue;
  974:     }
  975: 
  976:     totalActivityCount += 1;
  977:   }
  978: 
  979:   const completionRate =
  980:     totalActivityCount > 0
  981:       ? Math.round(
  982:           (
  983:             completedActivityCount /
  984:             totalActivityCount
  985:           ) * 100,
  986:         )
  987:       : 0;
  988: 
  989:   const grade =
  990:     calculateGradeProgress({
  991:       evidence,
  992:       targetGrade,
  993:       boundarySet,
  994:     });
  995: 
  996:   /*
  997:    * Keep one whole-paper record for grade/trend/confidence, but replace the
  998:    * aggregate exam topic with question-level evidence for mastery when those
  999:    * question marks are available.
 1000:    */
 1001:   const examsWithQuestionEvidence =
 1002:     new Set(
 1003:       examQuestionEvidence
 1004:         .map(
 1005:           (item) =>
 1006:             item.sourceAssignmentId,
 1007:         )
 1008:         .filter(
 1009:           (
 1010:             value,
 1011:           ): value is string =>
 1012:             Boolean(value),
 1013:         ),
 1014:     );
 1015: 
 1016:   const masteryEvidence = [
 1017:     ...evidence.filter((item) => {
 1018:       if (
 1019:         item.type !==
 1020:         "written_exam"
 1021:       ) {
 1022:         return true;
 1023:       }
 1024: 
 1025:       if (
 1026:         !item.sourceAssignmentId
 1027:       ) {
 1028:         return true;
 1029:       }
 1030: 
 1031:       return !examsWithQuestionEvidence.has(
 1032:         item.sourceAssignmentId,
 1033:       );
 1034:     }),
 1035:     ...examQuestionEvidence,
 1036:   ];
 1037: 
 1038:   const topics =
 1039:     buildTopicMastery(
 1040:       masteryEvidence,
 1041:     );
 1042: 
 1043:   const strongestTopics =
 1044:     topics.slice(0, 3);
 1045: 
 1046:   const weakestTopics =
 1047:     [...topics]
 1048:       .sort(
 1049:         (first, second) =>
 1050:           first
 1051:             .weightedPercentage -
 1052:           second
 1053:             .weightedPercentage,
 1054:       )
 1055:       .slice(0, 3);
 1056: 
 1057:   const trendResult =
 1058:     buildTrend(evidence);
 1059: 
 1060:   const confidence =
 1061:     calculateEvidenceConfidence({
 1062:       evidence,
 1063:       totalActivityCount,
 1064:       completedActivityCount,
 1065:     });
 1066: 
 1067:   const interpretation =
 1068:     buildAnalyticsInterpretation({
 1069:       grade,
 1070:       trend: trendResult.trend,
 1071:       strongestTopics,
 1072:       weakestTopics,
 1073:     });
 1074: 
 1075:   return {
 1076:     studentId,
 1077:     qualification,
 1078:     examBoard:
 1079:       safeString(
 1080:         profile.examBoard,
 1081:       ) || null,
 1082:     targetGrade,
 1083:     grade,
 1084:     confidence,
 1085:     trend: trendResult.trend,
 1086:     trendChange:
 1087:       trendResult.change,
 1088:     trendPoints:
 1089:       trendResult.points,
 1090:     topics,
 1091:     strongestTopics,
 1092:     weakestTopics,
 1093:     evidence,
 1094:     masteryEvidence,
 1095:     evidenceSourceCounts:
 1096:       countEvidenceSources(
 1097:         masteryEvidence,
 1098:       ),
 1099:     completedActivityCount,
 1100:     totalActivityCount,
 1101:     completionRate,
 1102:     interpretation,
 1103:   };
 1104: }
 1105: 
 1106: function interventionFor(
 1107:   analytics: RichStudentAnalytics,
 1108: ): {
 1109:   priority:
 1110:     TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow[
 1111:       "interventionPriority"
 1112:     ];
 1113:   reasons: string[];
 1114: } {
 1115:   const reasons: string[] = [];
 1116:   let score = 0;
 1117: 
 1118:   if (
 1119:     analytics.grade.gradeGap !==
 1120:       null &&
 1121:     analytics.grade.gradeGap <= -2
 1122:   ) {
 1123:     reasons.push(
 1124:       "Two or more grade steps below target",
 1125:     );
 1126:     score += 4;
 1127:   } else if (
 1128:     analytics.grade.gradeGap !==
 1129:       null &&
 1130:     analytics.grade.gradeGap < 0
 1131:   ) {
 1132:     reasons.push(
 1133:       "Below target grade",
 1134:     );
 1135:     score += 2;
 1136:   }
 1137: 
 1138:   if (
 1139:     analytics.trend ===
 1140:     "declining"
 1141:   ) {
 1142:     reasons.push(
 1143:       "Recent performance is declining",
 1144:     );
 1145:     score += 3;
 1146:   }
 1147: 
 1148:   if (
 1149:     analytics.confidence.level ===
 1150:       "insufficient" ||
 1151:     analytics.confidence.level ===
 1152:       "low"
 1153:   ) {
 1154:     reasons.push(
 1155:       "Insufficient assessment evidence",
 1156:     );
 1157:     score += 2;
 1158:   }
 1159: 
 1160:   if (
 1161:     analytics.completionRate < 70
 1162:   ) {
 1163:     reasons.push(
 1164:       "Assignment completion is below 70%",
 1165:     );
 1166:     score += 2;
 1167:   }
 1168: 
 1169:   const priorityTopic =
 1170:     analytics.weakestTopics.find(
 1171:       (topic) =>
 1172:         topic.status ===
 1173:         "priority",
 1174:     );
 1175: 
 1176:   if (priorityTopic) {
 1177:     reasons.push(
 1178:       `${priorityTopic.topic} mastery is ${priorityTopic.weightedPercentage}%`,
 1179:     );
 1180:     score += 2;
 1181:   }
 1182: 
 1183:   if (score >= 6) {
 1184:     return {
 1185:       priority: "high",
 1186:       reasons,
 1187:     };
 1188:   }
 1189: 
 1190:   if (score >= 3) {
 1191:     return {
 1192:       priority: "medium",
 1193:       reasons,
 1194:     };
 1195:   }
 1196: 
 1197:   if (score >= 1) {
 1198:     return {
 1199:       priority: "monitor",
 1200:       reasons,
 1201:     };
 1202:   }
 1203: 
 1204:   return {
 1205:     priority: "none",
 1206:     reasons: [],
 1207:   };
 1208: }
 1209: 
 1210: function gradeDistribution(
 1211:   rows:
 1212:     TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow[],
 1213:   qualification:
 1214:     AnalyticsQualification,
 1215: ): GradeDistributionItem[] {
 1216:   const order =
 1217:     [
 1218:       ...getGradeOrder(
 1219:         qualification,
 1220:       ),
 1221:     ].reverse();
 1222: 
 1223:   return order.map((grade) => ({
 1224:     grade,
 1225:     count: rows.filter(
 1226:       (row) =>
 1227:         row.workingGrade === grade,
 1228:     ).length,
 1229:   }));
 1230: }
 1231: 
 1232: function averageGrade(
 1233:   grades:
 1234:     (GradeLabel | null)[],
 1235:   qualification:
 1236:     AnalyticsQualification,
 1237: ): GradeLabel | null {
 1238:   const order =
 1239:     getGradeOrder(
 1240:       qualification,
 1241:     );
 1242: 
 1243:   const indexes =
 1244:     grades
 1245:       .filter(
 1246:         (
 1247:           grade,
 1248:         ): grade is GradeLabel =>
 1249:           grade !== null,
 1250:       )
 1251:       .map((grade) =>
 1252:         order.indexOf(grade),
 1253:       )
 1254:       .filter(
 1255:         (index) =>
 1256:           index >= 0,
 1257:       );
 1258: 
 1259:   if (indexes.length === 0) {
 1260:     return null;
 1261:   }
 1262: 
 1263:   const averageIndex =
 1264:     Math.round(
 1265:       indexes.reduce(
 1266:         (sum, index) =>
 1267:           sum + index,
 1268:         0,
 1269:       ) / indexes.length,
 1270:     );
 1271: 
 1272:   return order[
 1273:     Math.max(
 1274:       0,
 1275:       Math.min(
 1276:         order.length - 1,
 1277:         averageIndex,
 1278:       ),
 1279:     )
 1280:   ];
 1281: }
 1282: 
 1283: function aggregateTopics(
 1284:   rows:
 1285:     TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow[],
 1286: ): ClassTopicAnalytics[] {
 1287:   const groups =
 1288:     new Map<
 1289:       string,
 1290:       {
 1291:         percentages: number[];
 1292:         evidence: number;
 1293:         recent: number[];
 1294:       }
 1295:     >();
 1296: 
 1297:   for (const row of rows) {
 1298:     for (
 1299:       const topic of
 1300:       row.analytics.topics
 1301:     ) {
 1302:       const current =
 1303:         groups.get(
 1304:           topic.topic,
 1305:         ) || {
 1306:           percentages: [],
 1307:           evidence: 0,
 1308:           recent: [],
 1309:         };
 1310: 
 1311:       current.percentages.push(
 1312:         topic.weightedPercentage,
 1313:       );
 1314: 
 1315:       current.recent.push(
 1316:         topic.recentPercentage,
 1317:       );
 1318: 
 1319:       current.evidence +=
 1320:         topic.evidenceCount;
 1321: 
 1322:       groups.set(
 1323:         topic.topic,
 1324:         current,
 1325:       );
 1326:     }
 1327:   }
 1328: 
 1329:   return [
 1330:     ...groups.entries(),
 1331:   ]
 1332:     .map(
 1333:       ([topic, group]) => {
 1334:         const weightedPercentage =
 1335:           Math.round(
 1336:             group.percentages.reduce(
 1337:               (
 1338:                 sum,
 1339:                 value,
 1340:               ) =>
 1341:                 sum + value,
 1342:               0,
 1343:             ) /
 1344:               group
 1345:                 .percentages
 1346:                 .length,
 1347:           );
 1348: 
 1349:         const recentPercentage =
 1350:           Math.round(
 1351:             group.recent.reduce(
 1352:               (
 1353:                 sum,
 1354:                 value,
 1355:               ) =>
 1356:                 sum + value,
 1357:               0,
 1358:             ) /
 1359:               group.recent.length,
 1360:           );
 1361: 
 1362:         return {
 1363:           topic,
 1364:           evidenceCount:
 1365:             group.evidence,
 1366:           studentCount:
 1367:             group
 1368:               .percentages
 1369:               .length,
 1370:           weightedPercentage,
 1371:           recentPercentage,
 1372:           status:
 1373:             weightedPercentage >=
 1374:             70
 1375:               ? "secure"
 1376:               : weightedPercentage >=
 1377:                   50
 1378:                 ? "developing"
 1379:                 : "priority",
 1380:         } satisfies ClassTopicAnalytics;
 1381:       },
 1382:     )
 1383:     .sort(
 1384:       (first, second) =>
 1385:         first
 1386:           .weightedPercentage -
 1387:         second
 1388:           .weightedPercentage,
 1389:     );
 1390: }
 1391: 
 1392: async function buildClassAnalytics(
 1393:   classItem: TeacherClass,
 1394:   teacherId: string,
 1395: ): Promise<TeacherClassAnalytics> {
 1396:   const qualification =
 1397:     qualificationFromClass(
 1398:       classItem,
 1399:     );
 1400: 
 1401:   const studentIds =
 1402:     Array.from(
 1403:       new Set(
 1404:         classItem.studentIds ||
 1405:           [],
 1406:       ),
 1407:     );
 1408: 
 1409:   /*
 1410:    * Every enrolled student gets a row.
 1411:    * We no longer discard a student merely because one
 1412:    * analytics evidence source is unavailable.
 1413:    */
 1414:   const students =
 1415:     await Promise.all(
 1416:       studentIds.map(
 1417:         async (studentId) => {
 1418:           const identity =
 1419:             await getStudentIdentity(
 1420:               studentId,
 1421:               classItem,
 1422:             );
 1423: 
 1424:           const analytics =
 1425:             await getTeacherOwnedStudentAnalytics({
 1426:               teacherId,
 1427:               studentId,
 1428:               classItem,
 1429:             });
 1430: 
 1431:           const intervention =
 1432:             interventionFor(
 1433:               analytics,
 1434:             );
 1435: 
 1436:           return {
 1437:             studentId,
 1438:             studentName:
 1439:               identity.name,
 1440:             studentEmail:
 1441:               identity.email,
 1442:             classId:
 1443:               classItem.id,
 1444:             className:
 1445:               classItem.name,
 1446:             qualification:
 1447:               analytics.qualification,
 1448:             workingGrade:
 1449:               analytics.grade
 1450:                 .workingGrade,
 1451:             targetGrade:
 1452:               analytics.grade
 1453:                 .targetGrade,
 1454:             workingPercentage:
 1455:               analytics.grade
 1456:                 .workingPercentage,
 1457:             gradeGap:
 1458:               analytics.grade
 1459:                 .gradeGap,
 1460:             nextGrade:
 1461:               analytics.grade
 1462:                 .nextGrade,
 1463:             marksToNextGrade:
 1464:               analytics.grade
 1465:                 .marksToNextGrade,
 1466:             trend:
 1467:               analytics.trend,
 1468:             trendChange:
 1469:               analytics.trendChange,
 1470:             confidence:
 1471:               analytics.confidence
 1472:                 .level,
 1473:             completionRate:
 1474:               analytics
 1475:                 .completionRate,
 1476:             interventionPriority:
 1477:               intervention.priority,
 1478:             interventionReasons:
 1479:               intervention.reasons,
 1480:             analytics,
 1481:           } satisfies TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow;
 1482:         },
 1483:       ),
 1484:     );
 1485: 
 1486:   const percentages =
 1487:     students
 1488:       .map(
 1489:         (student) =>
 1490:           student
 1491:             .workingPercentage,
 1492:       )
 1493:       .filter(
 1494:         (
 1495:           value,
 1496:         ): value is number =>
 1497:           value !== null,
 1498:       );
 1499: 
 1500:   const averageWeightedPercentage =
 1501:     percentages.length > 0
 1502:       ? Math.round(
 1503:           percentages.reduce(
 1504:             (
 1505:               sum,
 1506:               value,
 1507:             ) =>
 1508:               sum + value,
 1509:             0,
 1510:           ) /
 1511:             percentages.length,
 1512:         )
 1513:       : null;
 1514: 
 1515:   const studentsWithEvidence =
 1516:     students.filter(
 1517:       (student) =>
 1518:         student
 1519:           .workingGrade !==
 1520:         null,
 1521:     ).length;
 1522: 
 1523:   const targetRows =
 1524:     students.filter(
 1525:       (student) =>
 1526:         student.targetGrade !==
 1527:           null &&
 1528:         student.gradeGap !==
 1529:           null,
 1530:     );
 1531: 
 1532:   const onOrAboveTargetCount =
 1533:     targetRows.filter(
 1534:       (student) =>
 1535:         (
 1536:           student.gradeGap ??
 1537:           -99
 1538:         ) >= 0,
 1539:     ).length;
 1540: 
 1541:   const belowTargetCount =
 1542:     targetRows.filter(
 1543:       (student) =>
 1544:         (
 1545:           student.gradeGap ??
 1546:           0
 1547:         ) < 0,
 1548:     ).length;
 1549: 
 1550:   const targetNotSetCount =
 1551:     students.filter(
 1552:       (student) =>
 1553:         student.targetGrade ===
 1554:         null,
 1555:     ).length;
 1556: 
 1557:   return {
 1558:     classId: classItem.id,
 1559:     className: classItem.name,
 1560:     yearGroup:
 1561:       classItem.yearGroup,
 1562:     qualification,
 1563:     studentCount:
 1564:       studentIds.length,
 1565:     studentsWithEvidence,
 1566:     averageWeightedPercentage,
 1567:     averageWorkingGrade:
 1568:       averageGrade(
 1569:         students.map(
 1570:           (student) =>
 1571:             student
 1572:               .workingGrade,
 1573:         ),
 1574:         qualification,
 1575:       ),
 1576:     averageTargetGrade:
 1577:       averageGrade(
 1578:         students.map(
 1579:           (student) =>
 1580:             student.targetGrade,
 1581:         ),
 1582:         qualification,
 1583:       ),
 1584:     onOrAboveTargetCount,
 1585:     belowTargetCount,
 1586:     targetNotSetCount,
 1587:     onOrAboveTargetPercentage:
 1588:       targetRows.length > 0
 1589:         ? Math.round(
 1590:             (
 1591:               onOrAboveTargetCount /
 1592:               targetRows.length
 1593:             ) * 100,
 1594:           )
 1595:         : 0,
 1596:     averageCompletionRate:
 1597:       students.length > 0
 1598:         ? Math.round(
 1599:             students.reduce(
 1600:               (
 1601:                 sum,
 1602:                 student,
 1603:               ) =>
 1604:                 sum +
 1605:                 student
 1606:                   .completionRate,
 1607:               0,
 1608:             ) /
 1609:               students.length,
 1610:           )
 1611:         : 0,
 1612:     highPriorityCount:
 1613:       students.filter(
 1614:         (student) =>
 1615:           student
 1616:             .interventionPriority ===
 1617:           "high",
 1618:       ).length,
 1619:     decliningCount:
 1620:       students.filter(
 1621:         (student) =>
 1622:           student.trend ===
 1623:           "declining",
 1624:       ).length,
 1625:     lowEvidenceCount:
 1626:       students.filter(
 1627:         (student) =>
 1628:           student.confidence ===
 1629:             "insufficient" ||
 1630:           student.confidence ===
 1631:             "low",
 1632:       ).length,
 1633:     gradeDistribution:
 1634:       gradeDistribution(
 1635:         students,
 1636:         qualification,
 1637:       ),
 1638:     topicAnalytics:
 1639:       aggregateTopics(
 1640:         students,
 1641:       ),
 1642:     students:
 1643:       students.sort(
 1644:         (first, second) =>
 1645:           first.studentName.localeCompare(
 1646:             second.studentName,
 1647:             "en-GB",
 1648:             {
 1649:               sensitivity:
 1650:                 "base",
 1651:             },
 1652:           ),
 1653:       ),
 1654:   };
 1655: }
 1656: 
 1657: export async function getTeacherAnalyticsPortfolio(
 1658:   teacherId: string,
 1659: ): Promise<TeacherAnalyticsPortfolio> {
 1660:   const cleanedTeacherId =
 1661:     teacherId.trim();
 1662: 
 1663:   if (!cleanedTeacherId) {
 1664:     throw new Error(
 1665:       "A teacher account is required.",
 1666:     );
 1667:   }
 1668: 
 1669:   const classes =
 1670:     (
 1671:       await getTeacherClasses(
 1672:         cleanedTeacherId,
 1673:       )
 1674:     ).filter(
 1675:       (classItem) =>
 1676:         classItem.status !==
 1677:         "archived",
 1678:     );
 1679: 
 1680:   const classAnalytics =
 1681:     await Promise.all(
 1682:       classes.map(
 1683:         (classItem) =>
 1684:           buildClassAnalytics(
 1685:             classItem,
 1686:             cleanedTeacherId,
 1687:           ),
 1688:       ),
 1689:     );
 1690: 
 1691:   const uniqueStudentIds =
 1692:     new Set(
 1693:       classes.flatMap(
 1694:         (classItem) =>
 1695:           classItem.studentIds ||
 1696:           [],
 1697:       ),
 1698:     );
 1699: 
 1700:   return {
 1701:     teacherId:
 1702:       cleanedTeacherId,
 1703:     classCount:
 1704:       classAnalytics.length,
 1705:     uniqueStudentCount:
 1706:       uniqueStudentIds.size,
 1707:     classes:
 1708:       classAnalytics,
 1709:   };
 1710: }
 1711: 
 1712: export async function getTeacherStudentAnalytics({
 1713:   teacherId,
 1714:   studentId,
 1715: }: {
 1716:   teacherId: string;
 1717:   studentId: string;
 1718: }): Promise<TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow | null> {
 1719:   const portfolio =
 1720:     await getTeacherAnalyticsPortfolio(
 1721:       teacherId,
 1722:     );
 1723: 
 1724:   for (
 1725:     const classItem of
 1726:     portfolio.classes
 1727:   ) {
 1728:     const row =
 1729:       classItem.students.find(
 1730:         (student) =>
 1731:           student.studentId ===
 1732:           studentId,
 1733:       );
 1734: 
 1735:     if (row) {
 1736:       return row;
 1737:     }
 1738:   }
 1739: 
 1740:   return null;
 1741: }

   21: function validateRegistration(
   22:   name: string,
   23:   email: string,
   24:   password: string,
   25: ): void {
   26:   if (!name.trim()) {
   27:     throw new Error("Please enter your full name.");
   28:   }
   29: 
   30:   if (!email.trim()) {
   31:     throw new Error("Please enter your email address.");
   32:   }
   33: 
   34:   if (password.length < 6) {
   35:     throw new Error(
   36:       "Your password must contain at least 6 characters.",
   37:     );

   41: export async function registerAccount(
   42:   name: string,
   43:   email: string,
   44:   password: string,
   45:   accountType: RegistrationAccountType,
   46: ): Promise<UserCredential> {
   47:   const cleanedName = name.trim();
   48:   const cleanedEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();
   49: 
   50:   validateRegistration(
   51:     cleanedName,
   52:     cleanedEmail,
   53:     password,
   54:   );
   55: 
   56:   const userCredential =
   57:     await createUserWithEmailAndPassword(
   58:       auth,
   59:       cleanedEmail,
   60:       password,
   61:     );
   62: 
   63:   try {
   64:     await updateProfile(userCredential.user, {
   65:       displayName: cleanedName,
   66:     });
   67: 
   68:     /*
   69:      * SECURITY:
   70:      *
   71:      * Teacher applicants do NOT receive the teacher role here.
   72:      *
   73:      * They remain at the normal low-privilege student-level role
   74:      * until an administrator approves the teacher request.
   75:      *
   76:      * accountIntent tells the UI which onboarding journey to use.
   77:      */
   78:     await setDoc(
   79:       doc(db, "users", userCredential.user.uid),
   80:       {
   81:         uid: userCredential.user.uid,
   82:         name: cleanedName,
   83:         email: cleanedEmail,
   84: 
   85:         role: "student",
   86: 
   87:         accountIntent: accountType,
   88: 
   89:         teacherAccessStatus:
   90:           accountType === "teacher"
   91:             ? "not_submitted"
   92:             : null,
   93: 
   94:         qualification: null,
   95:         examBoard: null,
   96:         onboardingComplete: false,
   97: 
   98:         createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
   99:         updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  100:       },
  101:     );
  102: 
  103:     return userCredential;
  104:   } catch (error) {
  105:     console.error(
  106:       "Unable to create the account profile:",
  107:       error,
  108:     );
  109: 
  110:     try {
  111:       await deleteUser(userCredential.user);
  112:     } catch (cleanupError) {
  113:       console.error(
  114:         "Unable to remove the incomplete Authentication account:",
  115:         cleanupError,
  116:       );
  117: 
  118:       await signOut(auth);
  119:     }
  120: 
  121:     throw error;
  122:   }
  123: }
  124:

FILE: services\classKnowledgeMapService.ts
==============================================================================================================
    1: import { curriculumRegistry } from "@/data/curriculum/curriculumRegistry";
    2: import { getTeacherAnalyticsPortfolio } from "@/services/analytics/teacherAnalyticsService";
    3: import { normaliseTopic } from "@/services/topicNormalisationService";
    4: 
    5: import type {
    6:   ClassKnowledgeMap,
    7:   ClassKnowledgeMapTopic,
    8: } from "@/types/knowledgeMap";
    9: 
   10: type TopicAccumulator = {
   11:   percentages: number[];
   12:   evidenceCount: number;
   13:   studentCount: number;
   14: };
   15: 
   16: function average(values: number[]): number {
   17:   return values.length
   18:     ? Math.round(values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / values.length)
   19:     : 0;
   20: }
   21: 
   22: /*
   23:  * IMPORTANT:
   24:  *
   25:  * The old Class Knowledge Map service loaded every student profile and then
   26:  * called getAdaptiveLearningPlan(studentId) while a TEACHER was signed in.
   27:  *
   28:  * That adaptive-learning pipeline contains student-context Firestore reads,
   29:  * which is why /teacher/knowledge-map could fail with:
   30:  *
   31:  * FirebaseError: Missing or insufficient permissions.
   32:  *
   33:  * The Teacher Analytics pipeline is already tested and working with the
   34:  * teacher's existing Firestore permissions. This service therefore consumes
   35:  * the same teacher analytics portfolio rather than opening a second,
   36:  * permission-sensitive student analytics path.
   37:  */
   38: export async function getClassKnowledgeMap(
   39:   teacherId: string,
   40: ): Promise<ClassKnowledgeMap> {
   41:   const id = teacherId.trim();
   42: 
   43:   if (!id) {
   44:     return {
   45:       teacherId: "",
   46:       generatedAt: new Date(),
   47:       studentCount: 0,
   48:       topics: [],
   49:     };
   50:   }
   51: 
   52:   const portfolio = await getTeacherAnalyticsPortfolio(id);
   53: 
   54:   if (portfolio.classes.length === 0) {
   55:     return {
   56:       teacherId: id,
   57:       generatedAt: new Date(),
   58:       studentCount: 0,
   59:       topics: curriculumRegistry.map((definition) => ({
   60:         topicId: definition.id,
   61:         topicTitle: definition.title,
   62:         unitId: definition.unitId,
   63:         unitTitle: definition.unitTitle,
   64:         classAverage: 0,
   65:         averageConfidence: 0,
   66:         assessedStudents: 0,
   67:         priorityStudents: 0,
   68:         secureStudents: 0,
   69:       })),
   70:     };
   71:   }
   72: 
   73:   const accumulators = new Map<string, TopicAccumulator>();
   74: 
   75:   for (const classItem of portfolio.classes) {
   76:     for (const student of classItem.students) {
   77:       for (const topic of student.analytics.topics) {
   78:         const normalised = normaliseTopic(topic.topic);
   79:         const topicId = normalised.topicId;
   80: 
   81:         if (!topicId) {
   82:           continue;
   83:         }
   84: 
   85:         const current = accumulators.get(topicId) || {
   86:           percentages: [],
   87:           evidenceCount: 0,
   88:           studentCount: 0,
   89:         };
   90: 
   91:         current.percentages.push(topic.weightedPercentage);
   92:         current.evidenceCount += topic.evidenceCount;
   93:         current.studentCount += 1;
   94: 
   95:         accumulators.set(topicId, current);
   96:       }
   97:     }
   98:   }
   99: 
  100:   const topics: ClassKnowledgeMapTopic[] = curriculumRegistry.map(
  101:     (definition) => {
  102:       const evidence = accumulators.get(definition.id);
  103: 
  104:       const classAverage = evidence
  105:         ? average(evidence.percentages)
  106:         : 0;
  107: 
  108:       const assessedStudents = evidence?.studentCount ?? 0;
  109: 
  110:       /*
  111:        * Confidence here is intentionally derived from the quantity of
  112:        * assessment evidence backing the topic rather than from the old
  113:        * adaptive-learning confidence service.
  114:        *
  115:        * 1 evidence item  -> 40
  116:        * 2 evidence items -> 55
  117:        * 3 evidence items -> 70
  118:        * 4+               -> 85-100
  119:        */
  120:       const evidenceCount = evidence?.evidenceCount ?? 0;
  121: 
  122:       const averageConfidence =
  123:         evidenceCount === 0
  124:           ? 0
  125:           : Math.min(100, 25 + evidenceCount * 15);
  126: 
  127:       /*
  128:        * The current ClassKnowledgeMap type stores class-level counts.
  129:        * We derive the counts consistently from the same thresholds used
  130:        * throughout CS Master's teacher analytics:
  131:        *
  132:        * priority   < 50%
  133:        * developing 50-69%
  134:        * secure     >= 70%
  135:        *
  136:        * With multiple students, each student's topic mastery is counted.
  137:        */
  138:       let priorityStudents = 0;
  139:       let secureStudents = 0;
  140: 
  141:       for (const classItem of portfolio.classes) {
  142:         for (const student of classItem.students) {
  143:           const studentTopic = student.analytics.topics.find(
  144:             (topic) =>
  145:               normaliseTopic(topic.topic).topicId === definition.id,
  146:           );
  147: 
  148:           if (!studentTopic) {
  149:             continue;
  150:           }
  151: 
  152:           if (studentTopic.weightedPercentage < 50) {
  153:             priorityStudents += 1;
  154:           }
  155: 
  156:           if (studentTopic.weightedPercentage >= 70) {
  157:             secureStudents += 1;
  158:           }
  159:         }
  160:       }
  161: 
  162:       return {
  163:         topicId: definition.id,
  164:         topicTitle: definition.title,
  165:         unitId: definition.unitId,
  166:         unitTitle: definition.unitTitle,
  167:         classAverage,
  168:         averageConfidence,
  169:         assessedStudents,
  170:         priorityStudents,
  171:         secureStudents,
  172:       };
  173:     },
  174:   );
  175: 
  176:   return {
  177:     teacherId: id,
  178:     generatedAt: new Date(),
  179:     studentCount: portfolio.uniqueStudentCount,
  180:     topics,
  181:   };
  182: }

  281: /*
  282:  * Loads the freshest name/email directly from users/{studentId}.
  283:  * Embedded class student details remain a fallback.
  284:  */
  285: async function hydrateClassStudents(
  286:   teacherClass:
  287:     TeacherClass,
  288: ): Promise<TeacherClass> {
  289:   const embeddedById =
  290:     new Map(
  291:       (
  292:         teacherClass.students ??
  293:         []
  294:       ).map(
  295:         (student) => [
  296:           student.studentId,
  297:           student,
  298:         ],
  299:       ),
  300:     );
  301: 
  302:   const studentIds =
  303:     Array.from(
  304:       new Set(
  305:         [
  306:           ...teacherClass.studentIds,
  307: 
  308:           ...(
  309:             teacherClass.students ??
  310:             []
  311:           ).map(
  312:             (student) =>
  313:               student.studentId,
  314:           ),
  315:         ]
  316:           .map(
  317:             (studentId) =>
  318:               studentId.trim(),
  319:           )
  320:           .filter(Boolean),
  321:       ),
  322:     );
  323: 
  324:   if (
  325:     studentIds.length === 0
  326:   ) {
  327:     return {
  328:       ...teacherClass,
  329:       studentIds: [],
  330:       students: [],
  331:     };
  332:   }
  333: 
  334:   const hydrated =
  335:     await Promise.all(
  336:       studentIds.map(
  337:         async (
  338:           studentId,
  339:         ): Promise<ClassStudent> => {
  340:           const embedded =
  341:             embeddedById.get(
  342:               studentId,
  343:             );
  344: 
  345:           try {
  346:             const snapshot =
  347:               await getDoc(
  348:                 doc(
  349:                   db,
  350:                   "users",
  351:                   studentId,
  352:                 ),
  353:               );
  354: 
  355:             if (
  356:               !snapshot.exists()
  357:             ) {
  358:               return {
  359:                 studentId,
  360:                 displayName:
  361:                   embedded
  362:                     ?.displayName ||
  363:                   "Unnamed Student",
  364:                 email:
  365:                   embedded
  366:                     ?.email ||
  367:                   "",
  368:               };
  369:             }
  370: 
  371:             const data =
  372:               snapshot.data() as
  373:                 FirestoreStudentProfile;
  374: 
  375:             return {
  376:               studentId,
  377: 
  378:               displayName:
  379:                 normaliseString(
  380:                   data.name,
  381:                 ) ||
  382:                 embedded
  383:                   ?.displayName ||
  384:                 "Unnamed Student",
  385: 
  386:               email:
  387:                 normaliseEmail(
  388:                   data.email,
  389:                 ) ||
  390:                 embedded
  391:                   ?.email ||
  392:                 "",
  393:             };
  394:           } catch (
  395:             error
  396:           ) {
  397:             console.warn(
  398:               `Unable to hydrate student profile ${studentId}:`,
  399:               error,
  400:             );
  401: 
  402:             return {
  403:               studentId,
  404:               displayName:
  405:                 embedded
  406:                   ?.displayName ||
  407:                 "Unnamed Student",
  408:               email:
  409:                 embedded?.email ||
  410:                 "",
  411:             };
  412:           }
  413:         },
  414:       ),
  415:     );
  416: 
  417:   return {
  418:     ...teacherClass,
  419:     studentIds,
  420:     students:
  421:       hydrated,
  422:   };
  423: }

  425: export async function createTeacherClass(
  426:   input:
  427:     CreateClassInput,
  428: ): Promise<string> {
  429:   const className =
  430:     normaliseClassName(
  431:       input.name,
  432:     );
  433: 
  434:   if (!className) {
  435:     throw new Error(
  436:       "Enter a valid class name.",
  437:     );
  438:   }
  439: 
  440:   const teacherId =
  441:     input.teacherId.trim();
  442: 
  443:   if (!teacherId) {
  444:     throw new Error(
  445:       "A teacher account is required.",
  446:     );
  447:   }
  448: 
  449:   if (
  450:     !input.yearGroup.trim()
  451:   ) {
  452:     throw new Error(
  453:       "Select or enter a year group.",
  454:     );
  455:   }
  456: 
  457:   if (
  458:     !input.academicYear.trim()
  459:   ) {
  460:     throw new Error(
  461:       "Enter an academic year.",
  462:     );
  463:   }
  464: 
  465:   if (
  466:     !input.qualification
  467:   ) {
  468:     throw new Error(
  469:       "Select a qualification.",
  470:     );
  471:   }
  472: 
  473:   if (
  474:     !input.examBoard
  475:   ) {
  476:     throw new Error(
  477:       "Select an exam board.",
  478:     );
  479:   }
  480: 
  481:   const teacherReference =
  482:     doc(
  483:       db,
  484:       "users",
  485:       teacherId,
  486:     );
  487: 
  488:   const teacherSnapshot =
  489:     await getDoc(
  490:       teacherReference,
  491:     );
  492: 
  493:   if (
  494:     !teacherSnapshot.exists()
  495:   ) {
  496:     throw new Error(
  497:       "The teacher account could not be found.",
  498:     );
  499:   }
  500: 
  501:   const teacherData =
  502:     teacherSnapshot.data();
  503: 
  504:   const schoolId =
  505:     input.schoolId
  506:       ?.trim() ||
  507:     normaliseString(
  508:       teacherData.schoolId,
  509:     );
  510: 
  511:   if (!schoolId) {
  512:     throw new Error(
  513:       "Your teacher account must be linked to a school before creating classes.",
  514:     );
  515:   }
  516: 
  517:   const classReference =
  518:     await addDoc(
  519:       collection(
  520:         db,
  521:         "classes",
  522:       ),
  523:       {
  524:         name:
  525:           className,
  526: 
  527:         subject:
  528:           input.subject.trim() ||
  529:           "Computer Science",
  530: 
  531:         yearGroup:
  532:           input.yearGroup.trim(),
  533: 
  534:         academicYear:
  535:           input.academicYear.trim(),
  536: 
  537:         qualification:
  538:           input.qualification,
  539: 
  540:         examBoard:
  541:           input.examBoard,
  542: 
  543:         teacherId,
  544: 
  545:         teacherName:
  546:           input.teacherName
  547:             ?.trim() ||
  548:           normaliseString(
  549:             teacherData.name,
  550:           ) ||
  551:           "Teacher",
  552: 
  553:         schoolId,
  554: 
  555:         studentIds: [],
  556:         students: [],
  557:         assignmentIds: [],
  558: 
  559:         status:
  560:           "active",
  561: 
  562:         createdAt:
  563:           serverTimestamp(),
  564: 
  565:         updatedAt:
  566:           serverTimestamp(),
  567:       },
  568:     );
  569: 
  570:   return classReference.id;
  571: }

  573: export async function getTeacherClasses(
  574:   teacherId: string,
  575: ): Promise<TeacherClass[]> {
  576:   const cleanedTeacherId =
  577:     teacherId.trim();
  578: 
  579:   if (!cleanedTeacherId) {
  580:     return [];
  581:   }
  582: 
  583:   const classesQuery =
  584:     query(
  585:       collection(
  586:         db,
  587:         "classes",
  588:       ),
  589:       where(
  590:         "teacherId",
  591:         "==",
  592:         cleanedTeacherId,
  593:       ),
  594:       orderBy(
  595:         "createdAt",
  596:         "desc",
  597:       ),
  598:     );
  599: 
  600:   const snapshot =
  601:     await getDocs(
  602:       classesQuery,
  603:     );
  604: 
  605:   return snapshot.docs.map(
  606:     (
  607:       classDocument,
  608:     ) =>
  609:       convertClassDocument(
  610:         classDocument.id,
  611:         classDocument.data() as
  612:           Partial<FirestoreTeacherClass>,
  613:       ),
  614:   );
  615: }

  622:

  665: export async function updateTeacherClass(
  666:   classId: string,
  667:   updates:
  668:     UpdateTeacherClassInput,
  669: ): Promise<void> {
  670:   const cleanedClassId =
  671:     classId.trim();
  672: 
  673:   if (!cleanedClassId) {
  674:     throw new Error(
  675:       "A valid class is required.",
  676:     );
  677:   }
  678: 
  679:   const updateData:
  680:     Record<
  681:       string,
  682:       unknown
  683:     > = {};
  684: 
  685:   if (
  686:     updates.name !==
  687:     undefined
  688:   ) {
  689:     const name =
  690:       normaliseClassName(
  691:         updates.name,
  692:       );
  693: 
  694:     if (!name) {
  695:       throw new Error(
  696:         "Enter a valid class name.",
  697:       );
  698:     }
  699: 
  700:     updateData.name =
  701:       name;
  702:   }
  703: 
  704:   if (
  705:     updates.subject !==
  706:     undefined
  707:   ) {
  708:     updateData.subject =
  709:       updates.subject.trim() ||
  710:       "Computer Science";
  711:   }
  712: 
  713:   if (
  714:     updates.yearGroup !==
  715:     undefined
  716:   ) {
  717:     if (
  718:       !updates.yearGroup.trim()
  719:     ) {
  720:       throw new Error(
  721:         "Enter a year group.",
  722:       );
  723:     }
  724: 
  725:     updateData.yearGroup =
  726:       updates.yearGroup.trim();
  727:   }
  728: 
  729:   if (
  730:     updates.academicYear !==
  731:     undefined
  732:   ) {
  733:     if (
  734:       !updates.academicYear.trim()
  735:     ) {
  736:       throw new Error(
  737:         "Enter an academic year.",
  738:       );
  739:     }
  740: 
  741:     updateData.academicYear =
  742:       updates.academicYear.trim();
  743:   }
  744: 
  745:   if (
  746:     updates.qualification !==
  747:     undefined
  748:   ) {
  749:     if (
  750:       updates.qualification !==
  751:         "GCSE" &&
  752:       updates.qualification !==
  753:         "A_LEVEL"
  754:     ) {
  755:       throw new Error(
  756:         "Select GCSE or A Level.",
  757:       );
  758:     }
  759: 
  760:     updateData.qualification =
  761:       updates.qualification;
  762:   }
  763: 
  764:   if (
  765:     updates.examBoard !==
  766:     undefined
  767:   ) {
  768:     if (
  769:       updates.examBoard !==
  770:         "AQA" &&
  771:       updates.examBoard !==
  772:         "OCR" &&
  773:       updates.examBoard !==
  774:         "EDEXCEL"
  775:     ) {
  776:       throw new Error(
  777:         "Select AQA, OCR or Edexcel.",
  778:       );
  779:     }
  780: 
  781:     updateData.examBoard =
  782:       updates.examBoard;
  783:   }
  784: 
  785:   if (
  786:     updates.status !==
  787:     undefined
  788:   ) {
  789:     updateData.status =
  790:       updates.status;
  791:   }
  792: 
  793:   const classReference =
  794:     doc(
  795:       db,
  796:       "classes",
  797:       cleanedClassId,
  798:     );
  799: 
  800:   const classSnapshot =
  801:     await getDoc(
  802:       classReference,
  803:     );
  804: 
  805:   if (
  806:     !classSnapshot.exists()
  807:   ) {
  808:     throw new Error(
  809:       "The class could not be found.",
  810:     );
  811:   }
  812: 
  813:   const existingClass =
  814:     classSnapshot.data() as
  815:       Partial<FirestoreTeacherClass>;
  816: 
  817:   /*
  818:    * T1A -> T1B compatibility:
  819:    * legacy classes created before school tenancy may still lack schoolId.
  820:    * Adopt the owning teacher's current school during the first settings
  821:    * update so the tenant security rule remains satisfied.
  822:    */
  823:   if (
  824:     !normaliseString(
  825:       existingClass.schoolId,
  826:     )
  827:   ) {
  828:     const ownerId =
  829:       normaliseString(
  830:         existingClass.teacherId,
  831:       );
  832: 
  833:     if (ownerId) {
  834:       const ownerSnapshot =
  835:         await getDoc(
  836:           doc(
  837:             db,
  838:             "users",
  839:             ownerId,
  840:           ),
  841:         );
  842: 
  843:       const ownerSchoolId =
  844:         ownerSnapshot.exists()
  845:           ? normaliseString(
  846:               ownerSnapshot.data()
  847:                 .schoolId,
  848:             )
  849:           : "";
  850: 
  851:       if (ownerSchoolId) {
  852:         updateData.schoolId =
  853:           ownerSchoolId;
  854:       }
  855:     }
  856:   }
  857: 
  858:   await updateDoc(
  859:     classReference,
  860:     {
  861:       ...updateData,
  862:       updatedAt:
  863:         serverTimestamp(),
  864:     },
  865:   );
  866: }
  867: 
  868: /*
  869:  * Enrolment updates both the class and student profile atomically.
  870:  * Same-school membership is verified inside the transaction.
  871:  */
  872: export async function addStudentToClass(
  873:   classId: string,
  874:   student:
  875:     ClassStudent,
  876: ): Promise<void> {
  877:   const cleanedClassId =
  878:     classId.trim();
  879: 
  880:   const cleanedStudent =
  881:     normaliseStudent(
  882:       student,
  883:     );
  884: 
  885:   if (!cleanedClassId) {
  886:     throw new Error(
  887:       "A valid class is required.",
  888:     );
  889:   }
  890: 
  891:   if (
  892:     !cleanedStudent.studentId
  893:   ) {
  894:     throw new Error(
  895:       "A valid student account is required.",
  896:     );
  897:   }
  898: 
  899:   const classReference =
  900:     doc(
  901:       db,
  902:       "classes",
  903:       cleanedClassId,
  904:     );
  905: 
  906:   const studentReference =
  907:     doc(
  908:       db,
  909:       "users",
  910:       cleanedStudent.studentId,
  911:     );
  912: 
  913:   await runTransaction(
  914:     db,
  915:     async (
  916:       transaction,
  917:     ) => {
  918:       const [
  919:         classSnapshot,
  920:         studentSnapshot,
  921:       ] =
  922:         await Promise.all([
  923:           transaction.get(
  924:             classReference,
  925:           ),
  926:           transaction.get(
  927:             studentReference,
  928:           ),
  929:         ]);
  930: 
  931:       if (
  932:         !classSnapshot.exists()
  933:       ) {
  934:         throw new Error(
  935:           "The selected class could not be found.",
  936:         );
  937:       }
  938: 
  939:       if (
  940:         !studentSnapshot.exists()
  941:       ) {
  942:         throw new Error(
  943:           "The selected student account could not be found.",
  944:         );
  945:       }
  946: 
  947:       const classData =
  948:         classSnapshot.data() as
  949:           Partial<FirestoreTeacherClass>;
  950: 
  951:       const studentData =
  952:         studentSnapshot.data() as
  953:           FirestoreStudentProfile;
  954: 
  955:       if (
  956:         studentData.role !==
  957:         "student"
  958:       ) {
  959:         throw new Error(
  960:           "Only student accounts can be enrolled.",
  961:         );
  962:       }
  963: 
  964:       let classSchoolId =
  965:         normaliseString(
  966:           classData.schoolId,
  967:         );
  968: 
  969:       /*
  970:        * Legacy classes created before schoolId existed can adopt their
  971:        * owning teacher's current school on the next enrolment.
  972:        */
  973:       if (!classSchoolId) {
  974:         const ownerId =
  975:           normaliseString(
  976:             classData.teacherId,
  977:           );
  978: 
  979:         if (ownerId) {
  980:           const teacherSnapshot =
  981:             await transaction.get(
  982:               doc(
  983:                 db,
  984:                 "users",
  985:                 ownerId,
  986:               ),
  987:             );
  988: 
  989:           if (
  990:             teacherSnapshot.exists()
  991:           ) {
  992:             classSchoolId =
  993:               normaliseString(
  994:                 teacherSnapshot.data()
  995:                   .schoolId,
  996:               );
  997:           }
  998:         }
  999:       }
 1000: 
 1001:       const studentSchoolId =
 1002:         normaliseString(
 1003:           studentData.schoolId,
 1004:         );
 1005: 
 1006:       if (!classSchoolId) {
 1007:         throw new Error(
 1008:           "This class is not linked to a school yet.",
 1009:         );
 1010:       }
 1011: 
 1012:       if (!studentSchoolId) {
 1013:         throw new Error(
 1014:           "This student is not linked to your school.",
 1015:         );
 1016:       }
 1017: 
 1018:       if (
 1019:         studentSchoolId !==
 1020:         classSchoolId
 1021:       ) {
 1022:         throw new Error(
 1023:           "This student belongs to a different school and cannot be enrolled in this class.",
 1024:         );
 1025:       }
 1026: 
 1027:       const verifiedStudent:
 1028:         ClassStudent = {
 1029:         studentId:
 1030:           cleanedStudent.studentId,
 1031: 
 1032:         displayName:
 1033:           normaliseString(
 1034:             studentData.name,
 1035:           ) ||
 1036:           cleanedStudent.displayName ||
 1037:           "Unnamed Student",
 1038: 
 1039:         email:
 1040:           normaliseEmail(
 1041:             studentData.email,
 1042:           ) ||
 1043:           cleanedStudent.email ||
 1044:           "",
 1045:       };
 1046: 
 1047:       const existingStudentIds =
 1048:         normaliseStringArray(
 1049:           classData.studentIds,
 1050:         );
 1051: 
 1052:       const existingStudents =
 1053:         Array.isArray(
 1054:           classData.students,
 1055:         )
 1056:           ? classData.students
 1057:           : [];
 1058: 
 1059:       if (
 1060:         existingStudentIds.includes(
 1061:           verifiedStudent.studentId,
 1062:         )
 1063:       ) {
 1064:         throw new Error(
 1065:           "This student is already enrolled in the class.",
 1066:         );
 1067:       }
 1068: 
 1069:       const updatedStudents =
 1070:         [
 1071:           ...existingStudents.filter(
 1072:             (
 1073:               existingStudent,
 1074:             ) =>
 1075:               existingStudent.studentId !==
 1076:               verifiedStudent.studentId,
 1077:           ),
 1078:           verifiedStudent,
 1079:         ];
 1080: 
 1081:       const currentClassIds =
 1082:         normaliseStringArray(
 1083:           studentData.classIds,
 1084:         );
 1085: 
 1086:       transaction.update(
 1087:         classReference,
 1088:         {
 1089:           schoolId:
 1090:             classSchoolId,
 1091: 
 1092:           studentIds: [
 1093:             ...existingStudentIds,
 1094:             verifiedStudent.studentId,
 1095:           ],
 1096: 
 1097:           students:
 1098:             updatedStudents,
 1099: 
 1100:           updatedAt:
 1101:             serverTimestamp(),
 1102:         },
 1103:       );
 1104: 
 1105:       transaction.update(
 1106:         studentReference,
 1107:         {
 1108:           classIds:
 1109:             Array.from(
 1110:               new Set([
 1111:                 ...currentClassIds,
 1112:                 cleanedClassId,
 1113:               ]),
 1114:             ),
 1115: 
 1116:           updatedAt:
 1117:             serverTimestamp(),
 1118:         },
 1119:       );
 1120:     },
 1121:   );
 1122: }
 1123: 
 1124: export async function removeStudentFromClass(
 1125:   classId: string,
 1126:   student:
 1127:     ClassStudent,
 1128: ): Promise<void> {
 1129:   const cleanedClassId =
 1130:     classId.trim();
 1131: 
 1132:   const cleanedStudent =
 1133:     normaliseStudent(
 1134:       student,
 1135:     );
 1136: 
 1137:   if (
 1138:     !cleanedClassId ||
 1139:     !cleanedStudent.studentId
 1140:   ) {
 1141:     throw new Error(
 1142:       "A valid class and student are required.",
 1143:     );
 1144:   }
 1145: 
 1146:   const classReference =
 1147:     doc(
 1148:       db,
 1149:       "classes",
 1150:       cleanedClassId,
 1151:     );
 1152: 
 1153:   const studentReference =
 1154:     doc(
 1155:       db,
 1156:       "users",
 1157:       cleanedStudent.studentId,
 1158:     );
 1159: 
 1160:   await runTransaction(
 1161:     db,
 1162:     async (
 1163:       transaction,
 1164:     ) => {
 1165:       const [
 1166:         classSnapshot,
 1167:         studentSnapshot,
 1168:       ] =
 1169:         await Promise.all([
 1170:           transaction.get(
 1171:             classReference,
 1172:           ),
 1173:           transaction.get(
 1174:             studentReference,
 1175:           ),
 1176:         ]);
 1177: 
 1178:       if (
 1179:         !classSnapshot.exists()
 1180:       ) {
 1181:         throw new Error(
 1182:           "The selected class could not be found.",
 1183:         );
 1184:       }
 1185: 
 1186:       const classData =
 1187:         classSnapshot.data() as
 1188:           Partial<FirestoreTeacherClass>;
 1189: 
 1190:       const updatedStudentIds =
 1191:         normaliseStringArray(
 1192:           classData.studentIds,
 1193:         ).filter(
 1194:           (
 1195:             studentId,
 1196:           ) =>
 1197:             studentId !==
 1198:             cleanedStudent.studentId,
 1199:         );
 1200: 
 1201:       const updatedStudents =
 1202:         (
 1203:           Array.isArray(
 1204:             classData.students,
 1205:           )
 1206:             ? classData.students
 1207:             : []
 1208:         ).filter(
 1209:           (
 1210:             classStudent,
 1211:           ) =>
 1212:             classStudent.studentId !==
 1213:             cleanedStudent.studentId,
 1214:         );
 1215: 
 1216:       transaction.update(
 1217:         classReference,
 1218:         {
 1219:           studentIds:
 1220:             updatedStudentIds,
 1221: 
 1222:           students:
 1223:             updatedStudents,
 1224: 
 1225:           updatedAt:
 1226:             serverTimestamp(),
 1227:         },
 1228:       );
 1229: 
 1230:       if (
 1231:         studentSnapshot.exists()
 1232:       ) {
 1233:         const studentData =
 1234:           studentSnapshot.data() as
 1235:             FirestoreStudentProfile;
 1236: 
 1237:         const currentClassIds =
 1238:           normaliseStringArray(
 1239:             studentData.classIds,
 1240:           );
 1241: 
 1242:         transaction.update(
 1243:           studentReference,
 1244:           {
 1245:             classIds:
 1246:               currentClassIds.filter(
 1247:                 (
 1248:                   studentClassId,
 1249:                 ) =>
 1250:                   studentClassId !==
 1251:                   cleanedClassId,
 1252:               ),
 1253: 
 1254:             updatedAt:
 1255:               serverTimestamp(),
 1256:           },
 1257:         );
 1258:       }
 1259:     },
 1260:   );
 1261: }
 1262: 
 1263: export async function archiveTeacherClass(
 1264:   classId: string,
 1265: ): Promise<void> {
 1266:   await updateTeacherClass(
 1267:     classId,
 1268:     {
 1269:       status:
 1270:         "archived",
 1271:     },
 1272:   );
 1273: }
 1274: 
 1275: export async function restoreTeacherClass(
 1276:   classId: string,
 1277: ): Promise<void> {
 1278:   await updateTeacherClass(
 1279:     classId,
 1280:     {
 1281:       status:
 1282:         "active",
 1283:     },
 1284:   );
 1285: }
 1286: 
 1287: /*
 1288:  * Permanent deletion is intentionally conservative.
 1289:  * Classes with students or assignment references should be archived
 1290:  * instead so school history is not accidentally severed.
 1291:  */
 1292: export async function deleteTeacherClass(
 1293:   classId: string,
 1294: ): Promise<void> {
 1295:   const cleanedClassId =
 1296:     classId.trim();
 1297: 
 1298:   if (!cleanedClassId) {
 1299:     throw new Error(
 1300:       "A valid class is required.",
 1301:     );
 1302:   }
 1303: 
 1304:   const reference =
 1305:     doc(
 1306:       db,
 1307:       "classes",
 1308:       cleanedClassId,
 1309:     );
 1310: 
 1311:   const snapshot =
 1312:     await getDoc(
 1313:       reference,
 1314:     );
 1315: 
 1316:   if (
 1317:     !snapshot.exists()
 1318:   ) {
 1319:     return;
 1320:   }
 1321: 
 1322:   const teacherClass =
 1323:     convertClassDocument(
 1324:       snapshot.id,
 1325:       snapshot.data() as
 1326:         Partial<FirestoreTeacherClass>,
 1327:     );
 1328: 
 1329:   if (
 1330:     teacherClass.studentIds
 1331:       .length > 0
 1332:   ) {
 1333:     throw new Error(
 1334:       "Remove students before permanently deleting this class. Archive it instead if you need to preserve history.",
 1335:     );
 1336:   }
 1337: 
 1338:   if (
 1339:     teacherClass.assignmentIds
 1340:       .length > 0
 1341:   ) {
 1342:     throw new Error(
 1343:       "This class has assignment history and cannot be permanently deleted. Archive it instead.",
 1344:     );
 1345:   }
 1346: 
 1347:   await deleteDoc(
 1348:     reference,
 1349:   );
 1350: }

    3: 
    4: export async function addStudentToClass(classId: string, studentId: string) {
    5:   const classRef = doc(db, "classes", classId);
    6:   const studentRef = doc(db, "users", studentId);
    7: 
    8:   const [classSnapshot, studentSnapshot] = await Promise.all([
    9:     getDoc(classRef),
   10:     getDoc(studentRef),
   11:   ]);
   12: 
   13:   if (!classSnapshot.exists()) {
   14:     throw new Error("Class not found.");
   15:   }
   16: 
   17:   if (!studentSnapshot.exists()) {
   18:     throw new Error("Student not found.");
   19:   }
   20: 
   21:   const studentData = studentSnapshot.data();
   22: 
   23:   if (studentData.role !== "student") {
   24:     throw new Error("Only student accounts can be added to a class.");
   25:   }
   26: 
   27:   await Promise.all([
   28:     updateDoc(classRef, {
   29:       studentIds: arrayUnion(studentId),
   30:     }),
   31: 
   32:     updateDoc(studentRef, {
   33:       classIds: arrayUnion(classId),
   34:     }),
   35:   ]);
   36: }

   98: export function getCycleStep(stage: CPUCycleStage): CPUCycleStep {
   99:   return cpuCycleSteps.find((step) => step.stage === stage) ?? cpuCycleSteps[0];

  102: export function getMemoryInstruction(address: number): string {
  103:   return (
  104:     cpuMemory.find((location) => location.address === address)?.instruction ??
  105:     "NO INSTRUCTION"
  106:   );
  107: }
  108: 
  109: export function executeInstruction(
  110:   instruction: string,
  111:   accumulator: number,
  112: ): number {
  113:   const [operation, rawValue] = instruction.split(" ");
  114:   const value = Number(rawValue);
  115: 
  116:   if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {
  117:     return accumulator;
  118:   }
  119: 
  120:   if (operation === "LOAD") {
  121:     return value;
  122:   }
  123: 
  124:   if (operation === "ADD") {
  125:     return accumulator + value;
  126:   }
  127: 
  128:   if (operation === "SUB") {
  129:     return accumulator - value;
  130:   }
  131: 
  132:   return accumulator;
  133: }

FILE: services\interventionService.ts
