    1: import {
    2:   addDoc,
    3:   collection,
    4:   doc,
    5:   getDoc,
    6:   getDocs,
    7:   orderBy,
    8:   query,
    9:   serverTimestamp,
   10:   Timestamp,
   11:   updateDoc,
   12:   where,
   13: } from "firebase/firestore";
   14: import { db } from "@/lib/firebase";
   15: import type {
   16:   CreateInterventionInput,
   17:   Intervention,
   18:   InterventionStep,
   19:   InterventionStepStatus,
   20:   InterventionStatus,
   21: } from "@/types/intervention";
   22: 
   23: type FirestoreStep = Omit<InterventionStep, "completedAt"> & {
   24:   completedAt?: Timestamp | null;
   25: };
   26: type FirestoreIntervention = Omit<
   27:   Intervention,
   28:   "id" | "dueDate" | "steps" | "createdAt" | "updatedAt" | "completedAt"
   29: > & {
   30:   dueDate?: Timestamp;
   31:   steps?: FirestoreStep[];
   32:   createdAt?: Timestamp;
   33:   updatedAt?: Timestamp;
   34:   completedAt?: Timestamp | null;
   35: };
   36: 
   37: const toDate = (value?: Timestamp | null) =>
   38:   value?.toDate ? value.toDate() : null;
   39: const clamp = (value: number) => Math.min(100, Math.max(0, value));
   40: 
   41: function convert(id: string, data: FirestoreIntervention): Intervention {
   42:   return {
   43:     id,
   44:     ...data,
   45:     teacherName: data.teacherName || "Teacher",
   46:     studentName: data.studentName || "Student",
   47:     studentEmail: data.studentEmail || "",
   48:     classId: data.classId || "",
   49:     className: data.className || "",
   50:     reason: data.reason || "",
   51:     priority: data.priority || "medium",
   52:     status: data.status || "active",
   53:     baselineScore: clamp(data.baselineScore || 0),
   54:     currentScore: clamp(data.currentScore || 0),
   55:     impact: typeof data.impact === "number" ? data.impact : 0,
   56:     dueDate: toDate(data.dueDate),
   57:     steps: (data.steps || []).map((step) => ({
   58:       ...step,
   59:       completedAt: toDate(step.completedAt),
   60:     })),
   61:     createdAt: toDate(data.createdAt),
   62:     updatedAt: toDate(data.updatedAt),
   63:     completedAt: toDate(data.completedAt),
   64:   };
   65: }
   66: 
   67: function buildSteps(input: CreateInterventionInput): InterventionStep[] {
   68:   const xp = Math.max(0, input.xpPerStep || 25);
   69:   const steps: InterventionStep[] = [];
   70:   const add = (
   71:     type: InterventionStep["type"],
   72:     title: string,
   73:     description: string,
   74:     href: string,
   75:     sourceId = "",
   76:     sourceCollection: InterventionStep["sourceCollection"] = "",
   77:   ) => {
   78:     steps.push({
   79:       id: `${type}-${Date.now()}-${steps.length}`,
   80:       type,
   81:       title,
   82:       description,
   83:       href,
   84:       sourceId,
   85:       sourceCollection,
   86:       status: "not_started",
   87:       xpReward: xp,
   88:       completedAt: null,
   89:     });
   90:   };
   91:   if (input.pathway === "lesson" || input.pathway === "complete")
   92:     add(
   93:       "lesson",
   94:       `Review ${input.topic}`,
   95:       "Revisit the core knowledge and examples.",
   96:       input.lessonHref?.trim() ||
   97:         `/learn?search=${encodeURIComponent(input.topic)}`,
   98:     );
   99:   if (input.pathway === "quiz" || input.pathway === "complete")
  100:     add(
  101:       "quiz",
  102:       `Retrieval quiz: ${input.topic}`,
  103:       "Complete retrieval practice and correct misconceptions.",
  104:       input.quizAssignmentId?.trim()
  105:         ? `/assignments/quiz/${input.quizAssignmentId.trim()}`
  106:         : `/quiz?topic=${encodeURIComponent(input.topic)}`,
  107:       input.quizAssignmentId?.trim() || "",
  108:       input.quizAssignmentId?.trim() ? "assignments" : "",
  109:     );
  110:   if (input.pathway === "exam" || input.pathway === "complete")
  111:     add(
  112:       "exam",
  113:       `Exam practice: ${input.topic}`,
  114:       "Attempt an exam-style question and review the mark scheme.",
  115:       input.examAssignmentId?.trim()
  116:         ? `/assignments/exam/${input.examAssignmentId.trim()}`
  117:         : "/assignments?filter=exams",
  118:       input.examAssignmentId?.trim() || "",
  119:       input.examAssignmentId?.trim() ? "examAssignments" : "",
  120:     );
  121:   if (input.pathway === "complete")
  122:     add(
  123:       "review",
  124:       "Review progress",
  125:       "Reflect on feedback and agree the next target.",
  126:       "/revision-plan",
  127:     );
  128:   return steps;
  129: }
  130: 
  131: export async function createIntervention(
  132:   input: CreateInterventionInput,
  133: ): Promise<string> {
  134:   if (
  135:     !input.teacherId.trim() ||
  136:     !input.studentId.trim() ||
  137:     !input.title.trim() ||
  138:     !input.topic.trim()
  139:   )
  140:     throw new Error("Teacher, student, title and topic are required.");
  141:   if (!(input.dueDate instanceof Date) || Number.isNaN(input.dueDate.getTime()))
  142:     throw new Error("Select a valid due date.");
  143:   const existing = await getDocs(
  144:     query(
  145:       collection(db, "interventions"),
  146:       where("teacherId", "==", input.teacherId.trim()),
  147:       where("studentId", "==", input.studentId.trim()),
  148:     ),
  149:   );
  150:   if (
  151:     existing.docs.some(
  152:       (d) =>
  153:         d.data().status === "active" &&
  154:         String(d.data().topic || "").toLowerCase() ===
  155:           input.topic.trim().toLowerCase(),
  156:     )
  157:   )
  158:     throw new Error(
  159:       "An active intervention already exists for this student and topic.",
  160:     );
  161:   const baselineScore = clamp(input.baselineScore);
  162:   const ref = await addDoc(collection(db, "interventions"), {
  163:     teacherId: input.teacherId.trim(),
  164:     teacherName: input.teacherName?.trim() || "Teacher",
  165:     studentId: input.studentId.trim(),
  166:     studentName: input.studentName.trim(),
  167:     studentEmail: input.studentEmail?.trim() || "",
  168:     classId: input.classId?.trim() || "",
  169:     className: input.className?.trim() || "",
  170:     title: input.title.trim(),
  171:     topic: input.topic.trim(),
  172:     reason: input.reason.trim(),
  173:     priority: input.priority,
  174:     status: "active",
  175:     baselineScore,
  176:     currentScore: baselineScore,
  177:     impact: 0,
  178:     dueDate: Timestamp.fromDate(input.dueDate),
  179:     steps: buildSteps(input),
  180:     createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
  181:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  182:     completedAt: null,
  183:   });
  184:   return ref.id;
  185: }

  187: export async function getInterventionById(
  188:   id: string,
  189: ): Promise<Intervention | null> {
  190:   const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, "interventions", id));
  191:   return snap.exists()
  192:     ? convert(snap.id, snap.data() as FirestoreIntervention)
  193:     : null;
  194: }

  196: export async function getTeacherInterventions(
  197:   teacherId: string,
  198: ): Promise<Intervention[]> {
  199:   if (!teacherId.trim()) return [];
  200:   const snap = await getDocs(
  201:     query(
  202:       collection(db, "interventions"),
  203:       where("teacherId", "==", teacherId.trim()),
  204:       orderBy("createdAt", "desc"),
  205:     ),
  206:   );
  207:   return snap.docs.map((d) => convert(d.id, d.data() as FirestoreIntervention));
  208: }
  209: 
  210: async function linkedStatus(
  211:   intervention: Intervention,
  212:   step: InterventionStep,
  213: ): Promise<InterventionStepStatus> {
  214:   if (!step.sourceId || !step.sourceCollection) return step.status;
  215:   if (step.sourceCollection === "assignments") {
  216:     const snap = await getDoc(
  217:       doc(
  218:         db,
  219:         "assignmentResults",
  220:         `${step.sourceId}_${intervention.studentId}`,
  221:       ),
  222:     );
  223:     return snap.exists() && snap.data().status === "completed"
  224:       ? "completed"
  225:       : step.status;
  226:   }
  227:   if (step.sourceCollection === "examAssignments") {
  228:     const snap = await getDoc(
  229:       doc(db, "examSubmissions", `${step.sourceId}_${intervention.studentId}`),
  230:     );
  231:     if (!snap.exists()) return step.status;
  232:     const status = snap.data().status;
  233:     if (status === "marked") return "completed";
  234:     if (["in_progress", "submitted", "marking"].includes(status))
  235:       return "in_progress";
  236:   }
  237:   return step.status;
  238: }
  239: 
  240: export async function getStudentInterventions(
  241:   studentId: string,
  242: ): Promise<Intervention[]> {
  243:   if (!studentId.trim()) return [];
  244:   const snap = await getDocs(
  245:     query(
  246:       collection(db, "interventions"),
  247:       where("studentId", "==", studentId.trim()),
  248:       orderBy("createdAt", "desc"),
  249:     ),
  250:   );
  251:   const items = snap.docs.map((d) =>
  252:     convert(d.id, d.data() as FirestoreIntervention),
  253:   );
  254:   return Promise.all(
  255:     items.map(async (item) => ({
  256:       ...item,
  257:       steps: await Promise.all(
  258:         item.steps.map(async (step) => ({
  259:           ...step,
  260:           status: await linkedStatus(item, step),
  261:         })),
  262:       ),
  263:     })),
  264:   );
  265: }
  266: 
  267: export async function updateInterventionStep(
  268:   interventionId: string,
  269:   studentId: string,
  270:   stepId: string,
  271:   status: InterventionStepStatus,
  272: ): Promise<void> {
  273:   const item = await getInterventionById(interventionId);
  274:   if (!item || item.studentId !== studentId)
  275:     throw new Error("Intervention not found for this student.");
  276:   const steps = item.steps.map((step) =>
  277:     step.id === stepId
  278:       ? {
  279:           ...step,
  280:           status,
  281:           completedAt: status === "completed" ? new Date() : null,
  282:         }
  283:       : step,
  284:   );
  285:   const allCompleted = steps.every((step) => step.status === "completed");
  286:   await updateDoc(doc(db, "interventions", interventionId), {
  287:     steps: steps.map((step) => ({
  288:       ...step,
  289:       completedAt: step.completedAt
  290:         ? Timestamp.fromDate(step.completedAt)
  291:         : null,
  292:     })),
  293:     status: allCompleted ? "completed" : "active",
  294:     completedAt: allCompleted ? serverTimestamp() : null,
  295:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  296:   });
  297: }
  298: 
  299: export async function updateInterventionStatus(
  300:   id: string,
  301:   status: InterventionStatus,
  302: ): Promise<void> {
  303:   await updateDoc(doc(db, "interventions", id), {
  304:     status,
  305:     completedAt: status === "completed" ? serverTimestamp() : null,
  306:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  307:   });
  308: }
  309: 
  310: export async function updateInterventionImpact(
  311:   id: string,
  312:   currentScore: number,
  313: ): Promise<void> {
  314:   const item = await getInterventionById(id);
  315:   if (!item) throw new Error("Intervention not found.");
  316:   const score = clamp(currentScore);
  317:   await updateDoc(doc(db, "interventions", id), {
  318:     currentScore: score,
  319:     impact: score - item.baselineScore,
  320:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  321:   });
  322: }

    1: import { curriculumRegistry } from "@/data/curriculum/curriculumRegistry";

    6:   KnowledgeMap,
    7:   KnowledgeMapTopic,
    8:   KnowledgeMapUnit,
    9: } from "@/types/knowledgeMap";
   10: import type {
   11:   AnalyticsEvidence,
   12:   AnalyticsEvidenceType,
   13:   TopicMastery,
   14: } from "@/types/analytics";
   15: 
   16: function evidenceSources(
   17:   evidence: AnalyticsEvidence[],
   18: ): AnalyticsEvidenceType[] {
   19:   return Array.from(new Set(evidence.map((item) => item.type)));
   20: }
   21: 
   22: export async function getKnowledgeMap(
   23:   studentId: string,
   24: ): Promise<KnowledgeMap> {
   25:   const id = studentId.trim();
   26: 
   27:   if (!id) {
   28:     throw new Error("A valid student account is required.");
   29:   }
   30: 
   31:   const [plan, analytics] = await Promise.all([
   32:     getAdaptiveLearningPlan(id),
   33:     getRichStudentAnalytics(id),
   34:   ]);
   35: 
   36:   const masteryByTopicId = new Map(
   37:     plan.topics.map((mastery) => [
   38:       normaliseTopic(mastery.topic).topicId,
   39:       mastery,
   40:     ]),
   41:   );
   42: 
   43:   const analyticsMasteryByTopicId = new Map<string, TopicMastery>(
   44:     analytics.topics.map((mastery) => [
   45:       normaliseTopic(mastery.topic).topicId,
   46:       mastery,
   47:     ]),
   48:   );
   49: 
   50:   const analyticsEvidenceByTopicId =
   51:     new Map<string, AnalyticsEvidence[]>();
   52: 
   53:   for (const evidence of analytics.masteryEvidence) {
   54:     const topicId = normaliseTopic(evidence.topic).topicId;
   55:     const current = analyticsEvidenceByTopicId.get(topicId) || [];
   56:     current.push(evidence);
   57:     analyticsEvidenceByTopicId.set(topicId, current);
   58:   }
   59: 
   60:   const unitsById = new Map<string, KnowledgeMapUnit>();
   61: 
   62:   curriculumRegistry.forEach((definition) => {
   63:     const mastery = masteryByTopicId.get(definition.id) || null;
   64: 
   65:     const nextAction =
   66:       plan.actions.find(
   67:         (action) =>
   68:           normaliseTopic(action.topic).topicId === definition.id,
   69:       ) || null;
   70: 
   71:     const analyticsMastery =
   72:       analyticsMasteryByTopicId.get(definition.id) || null;
   73: 
   74:     const analyticsEvidence =
   75:       analyticsEvidenceByTopicId.get(definition.id) || [];
   76: 
   77:     const mapTopic: KnowledgeMapTopic = {
   78:       definition,
   79:       mastery,
   80:       nextAction,
   81:       analyticsMastery,
   82:       analyticsEvidence,
   83:       evidenceSources: evidenceSources(analyticsEvidence),
   84:       writtenExamEvidenceCount: analyticsEvidence.filter(
   85:         (item) => item.type === "written_exam",
   86:       ).length,
   87:     };
   88: 
   89:     const existing = unitsById.get(definition.unitId);
   90: 
   91:     if (existing) {
   92:       existing.topics.push(mapTopic);
   93:     } else {
   94:       unitsById.set(definition.unitId, {
   95:         id: definition.unitId,
   96:         title: definition.unitTitle,
   97:         topics: [mapTopic],
   98:       });
   99:     }
  100:   });
  101: 
  102:   const knownTopicIds = new Set(
  103:     curriculumRegistry.map((topic) => topic.id),
  104:   );
  105: 
  106:   const unclassifiedTopics = plan.topics.filter(
  107:     (mastery) =>
  108:       !knownTopicIds.has(normaliseTopic(mastery.topic).topicId),
  109:   );
  110: 
  111:   const units = Array.from(unitsById.values()).map((unit) => ({
  112:     ...unit,
  113:     topics: [...unit.topics].sort(
  114:       (a, b) =>
  115:         a.definition.displayOrder - b.definition.displayOrder,
  116:     ),
  117:   }));
  118: 
  119:   return {
  120:     studentId: id,
  121:     generatedAt: new Date(),
  122:     units,
  123:     unclassifiedTopics,
  124:   };
  125: }

FILE: services\reporting\interventionCohortCsvService.ts

    1: import type {
    2:   TeacherInterventionPlan,
    3: } from "@/types/teacherInterventionPlanning";
    4: 
    5: function csvCell(value: unknown): string {
    6:   const text = String(value ?? "");
    7: 
    8:   if (
    9:     text.includes(",") ||
   10:     text.includes('"') ||
   11:     text.includes("\n")
   12:   ) {
   13:     return `"${text.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
   14:   }
   15: 
   16:   return text;
   17: }
   18: 
   19: export function buildInterventionCohortCsv(
   20:   plan: TeacherInterventionPlan,
   21: ): string {
   22:   const rows: string[][] = [
   23:     [
   24:       "Topic",
   25:       "Priority",
   26:       "Strategy",
   27:       "Student",
   28:       "Student score",
   29:       "Group average",
   30:       "Lowest score",
   31:       "Rationale",
   32:       "Evidence caution",
   33:       "Recommended sequence",
   34:     ],
   35:   ];
   36: 
   37:   plan.groups.forEach((group) => {
   38:     const sequence = group.steps
   39:       .map((step) => `${step.order}. ${step.label}: ${step.description}`)
   40:       .join(" | ");
   41: 
   42:     group.students.forEach((student) => {
   43:       rows.push([
   44:         group.topic,
   45:         group.priority,
   46:         group.strategy,
   47:         student.name,
   48:         `${student.averageScore}%`,
   49:         `${group.averageScore}%`,
   50:         `${group.lowestScore}%`,
   51:         group.rationale,
   52:         group.evidenceCaution,
   53:         sequence,
   54:       ]);
   55:     });
   56:   });
   57: 
   58:   return rows
   59:     .map((row) => row.map(csvCell).join(","))
   60:     .join("\n");
   61: }
   62: 
   63: export function interventionCohortFilename(): string {
   64:   const date = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
   65:   return `cs-master-intervention-cohorts-${date}.csv`;
   66: }

   15: function normaliseCode(value: string): string {
   16:   return value
   17:     .trim()
   18:     .toUpperCase()
   19:     .replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, "");
   20: }
   21: 
   22: function generateCode(): string {
   23:   const alphabet =
   24:     "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789";
   25: 
   26:   let value = "";
   27: 
   28:   for (
   29:     let index = 0;
   30:     index < 8;
   31:     index += 1
   32:   ) {
   33:     value +=
   34:       alphabet[
   35:         Math.floor(
   36:           Math.random() *
   37:             alphabet.length,
   38:         )
   39:       ];
   40:   }
   41: 
   42:   return value;
   43: }
   44: 
   45: function timestampToDate(
   46:   value: unknown,
   47: ): Date | null {
   48:   return value instanceof Timestamp
   49:     ? value.toDate()
   50:     : null;
   51: }

   53: export async function createSchoolInvite({
   54:   schoolId,
   55:   createdBy,
   56:   role,
   57: }: {
   58:   schoolId: string;
   59:   createdBy: string;
   60:   role: SchoolInviteRole;
   61: }): Promise<string> {
   62:   const cleanedSchoolId =
   63:     schoolId.trim();
   64: 
   65:   const cleanedCreatedBy =
   66:     createdBy.trim();
   67: 
   68:   if (
   69:     !cleanedSchoolId ||
   70:     !cleanedCreatedBy
   71:   ) {
   72:     throw new Error(
   73:       "A valid school and teacher account are required.",
   74:     );
   75:   }
   76: 
   77:   /*
   78:    * Do NOT pre-read the randomly generated invite document.
   79:    * Firestore rules correctly deny arbitrary reads of non-existent
   80:    * invite documents, which causes the permissions error before
   81:    * creation. The random 8-character code space is extremely large.
   82:    */
   83:   const code =
   84:     generateCode();
   85: 
   86:   const expiresAt =
   87:     new Date();
   88: 
   89:   expiresAt.setDate(
   90:     expiresAt.getDate() + 14,
   91:   );
   92: 
   93:   const inviteRef =
   94:     doc(
   95:       db,
   96:       "schoolInvites",
   97:       code,
   98:     );
   99: 
  100:   const batch =
  101:     writeBatch(db);
  102: 
  103:   batch.set(
  104:     inviteRef,
  105:     {
  106:       code,
  107:       schoolId:
  108:         cleanedSchoolId,
  109:       role,
  110:       createdBy:
  111:         cleanedCreatedBy,
  112:       status:
  113:         "active",
  114:       expiresAt:
  115:         Timestamp.fromDate(
  116:           expiresAt,
  117:         ),
  118:       usedBy:
  119:         "",
  120:       createdAt:
  121:         serverTimestamp(),
  122:       updatedAt:
  123:         serverTimestamp(),
  124:     },
  125:   );
  126: 
  127:   await batch.commit();
  128: 
  129:   return code;
  130: }

  132: export async function acceptSchoolInvite({
  133:   code,
  134:   userId,
  135: }: {
  136:   code: string;
  137:   userId: string;
  138: }): Promise<{
  139:   schoolId: string;
  140:   role: SchoolInviteRole;
  141: }> {
  142:   const cleanedCode =
  143:     normaliseCode(code);
  144: 
  145:   const cleanedUserId =
  146:     userId.trim();
  147: 
  148:   if (
  149:     !cleanedCode ||
  150:     !cleanedUserId
  151:   ) {
  152:     throw new Error(
  153:       "Enter a valid school join code.",
  154:     );
  155:   }
  156: 
  157:   const inviteRef =
  158:     doc(
  159:       db,
  160:       "schoolInvites",
  161:       cleanedCode,
  162:     );
  163: 
  164:   const inviteSnapshot =
  165:     await getDoc(
  166:       inviteRef,
  167:     );
  168: 
  169:   if (
  170:     !inviteSnapshot.exists()
  171:   ) {
  172:     throw new Error(
  173:       "That school join code could not be found.",
  174:     );
  175:   }
  176: 
  177:   const invite =
  178:     inviteSnapshot.data();
  179: 
  180:   if (
  181:     invite.status !==
  182:     "active"
  183:   ) {
  184:     throw new Error(
  185:       "This school join code is no longer active.",
  186:     );
  187:   }
  188: 
  189:   const expiresAt =
  190:     timestampToDate(
  191:       invite.expiresAt,
  192:     );
  193: 
  194:   if (
  195:     expiresAt &&
  196:     expiresAt.getTime() <
  197:       Date.now()
  198:   ) {
  199:     throw new Error(
  200:       "This school join code has expired.",
  201:     );
  202:   }
  203: 
  204:   const schoolId =
  205:     typeof invite.schoolId ===
  206:     "string"
  207:       ? invite.schoolId.trim()
  208:       : "";
  209: 
  210:   const role:
  211:     SchoolInviteRole =
  212:     invite.role ===
  213:     "teacher"
  214:       ? "teacher"
  215:       : "student";
  216: 
  217:   if (!schoolId) {
  218:     throw new Error(
  219:       "This school invitation is invalid.",
  220:     );
  221:   }
  222: 
  223:   const userRef =
  224:     doc(
  225:       db,
  226:       "users",
  227:       cleanedUserId,
  228:     );
  229: 
  230:   const userSnapshot =
  231:     await getDoc(
  232:       userRef,
  233:     );
  234: 
  235:   if (
  236:     !userSnapshot.exists()
  237:   ) {
  238:     throw new Error(
  239:       "Your CS Master profile could not be found.",
  240:     );
  241:   }
  242: 
  243:   const userData =
  244:     userSnapshot.data();
  245: 
  246:   const existingSchoolId =
  247:     typeof userData.schoolId ===
  248:     "string"
  249:       ? userData.schoolId.trim()
  250:       : "";
  251: 
  252:   if (
  253:     existingSchoolId &&
  254:     existingSchoolId !==
  255:       schoolId
  256:   ) {
  257:     throw new Error(
  258:       "Your account already belongs to another school. Use the school transfer process instead.",
  259:     );
  260:   }
  261: 
  262:   if (
  263:     role === "teacher" &&
  264:     userData.role !==
  265:       "teacher" &&
  266:     userData.role !==
  267:       "admin"
  268:   ) {
  269:     throw new Error(
  270:       "This join code is for an approved teacher account.",
  271:     );
  272:   }
  273: 
  274:   const membershipRef =
  275:     doc(
  276:       db,
  277:       "schools",
  278:       schoolId,
  279:       "members",
  280:       cleanedUserId,
  281:     );
  282: 
  283:   const batch =
  284:     writeBatch(db);
  285: 
  286:   batch.set(
  287:     membershipRef,
  288:     {
  289:       schoolId,
  290:       userId:
  291:         cleanedUserId,
  292:       role,
  293:       status:
  294:         "active",
  295:       inviteId:

    1: import {
    2:   collection,

    7: } from "firebase/firestore";
    8: 
    9: import { db } from "@/lib/firebase";
   10: 
   11: export type SchoolMemberRecord = {
   12:   uid: string;
   13:   name: string;
   14:   email: string;
   15: 
   16:   role: string;
   17:   membershipRole: string;
   18:   status: string;
   19: 
   20:   qualification: string;
   21:   examBoard: string;
   22:   currentCourse: string;
   23: 
   24:   classIds: string[];
   25: 
   26:   joinedAt: Date | null;
   27: };
   28: 
   29: function safeString(
   30:   value: unknown,
   31: ): string {
   32:   return typeof value === "string"
   33:     ? value.trim()
   34:     : "";
   35: }
   36: 
   37: function safeStringArray(
   38:   value: unknown,
   39: ): string[] {
   40:   return Array.isArray(value)
   41:     ? value.filter(
   42:         (item): item is string =>
   43:           typeof item === "string",
   44:       )
   45:     : [];
   46: }
   47: 
   48: function timestampToDate(
   49:   value: unknown,
   50: ): Date | null {
   51:   return value instanceof Timestamp
   52:     ? value.toDate()
   53:     : null;
   54: }
   55: 
   56: /*
   57:  * T1H tenant-safe directory rule:
   58:  *
   59:  * A school membership document is the authoritative proof that a user belongs
   60:  * to the requested school. A direct users/{uid} read is useful enrichment, but
   61:  * it must not be required for the directory to load because Firestore may
   62:  * correctly restrict cross-profile reads.
   63:  *
   64:  * If the user document cannot be read, the service falls back to identity and
   65:  * course fields stored on the school membership document.
   66:  */
   67: export async function getSchoolMembers(
   68:   schoolId: string,
   69: ): Promise<SchoolMemberRecord[]> {
   70:   const cleanedSchoolId =
   71:     schoolId.trim();
   72: 
   73:   if (!cleanedSchoolId) {
   74:     return [];
   75:   }
   76: 
   77:   const membershipSnapshot =
   78:     await getDocs(
   79:       collection(
   80:         db,
   81:         "schools",
   82:         cleanedSchoolId,
   83:         "members",
   84:       ),
   85:     );
   86: 
   87:   const members =
   88:     await Promise.all(
   89:       membershipSnapshot.docs.map(
   90:         async (
   91:           membershipDocument,
   92:         ) => {
   93:           const membership =
   94:             membershipDocument.data();
   95: 
   96:           const userSnapshot =
   97:             await getDoc(
   98:               doc(
   99:                 db,
  100:                 "users",
  101:                 membershipDocument.id,
  102:               ),
  103:             ).catch(() => null);
  104: 
  105:           const user =
  106:             userSnapshot?.exists()
  107:               ? userSnapshot.data()
  108:               : {};
  109: 
  110:           return {
  111:             uid:
  112:               membershipDocument.id,
  113: 
  114:             name:
  115:               safeString(
  116:                 user.name,
  117:               ) ||
  118:               safeString(
  119:                 membership.name,
  120:               ) ||
  121:               safeString(
  122:                 membership.displayName,
  123:               ) ||
  124:               "Unnamed member",
  125: 
  126:             email:
  127:               (
  128:                 safeString(
  129:                   user.email,
  130:                 ) ||
  131:                 safeString(
  132:                   membership.email,
  133:                 )
  134:               ).toLowerCase(),
  135: 
  136:             role:
  137:               safeString(
  138:                 user.role,
  139:               ) ||
  140:               safeString(
  141:                 membership.userRole,
  142:               ),
  143: 
  144:             membershipRole:
  145:               safeString(
  146:                 membership.role,
  147:               ),
  148: 
  149:             status:
  150:               safeString(
  151:                 membership.status,
  152:               ) ||
  153:               "active",
  154: 
  155:             qualification:
  156:               safeString(
  157:                 user.qualification,
  158:               ) ||
  159:               safeString(
  160:                 membership.qualification,
  161:               ),
  162: 
  163:             examBoard:
  164:               safeString(
  165:                 user.examBoard,
  166:               ) ||
  167:               safeString(
  168:                 membership.examBoard,
  169:               ),
  170: 
  171:             currentCourse:
  172:               safeString(
  173:                 user.currentCourse,
  174:               ) ||
  175:               safeString(
  176:                 membership.currentCourse,
  177:               ),
  178: 
  179:             classIds:
  180:               safeStringArray(
  181:                 user.classIds,
  182:               ).length > 0
  183:                 ? safeStringArray(
  184:                     user.classIds,
  185:                   )
  186:                 : safeStringArray(
  187:                     membership.classIds,
  188:                   ),
  189: 
  190:             joinedAt:
  191:               timestampToDate(
  192:                 membership.joinedAt,
  193:               ),
  194:           };
  195:         },
  196:       ),
  197:     );
  198: 
  199:   return members.sort(
  200:     (
  201:       first,
  202:       second,
  203:     ) =>
  204:       first.name.localeCompare(
  205:         second.name,
  206:         "en-GB",
  207:         {
  208:           sensitivity: "base",
  209:         },
  210:       ),
  211:   );
  212: }

   14: export async function assignUserToSchool({
   15:   schoolId,
   16:   userId,
   17:   role,
   18: }: {
   19:   schoolId: string;
   20:   userId: string;
   21:   role: SchoolMemberRole;
   22: }): Promise<void> {
   23:   const cleanedSchoolId = schoolId.trim();
   24:   const cleanedUserId = userId.trim();
   25: 
   26:   if (!cleanedSchoolId || !cleanedUserId) {
   27:     throw new Error("A valid school and user are required.");
   28:   }
   29: 
   30:   const schoolRef = doc(db, "schools", cleanedSchoolId);
   31:   const userRef = doc(db, "users", cleanedUserId);
   32: 
   33:   const [schoolSnapshot, userSnapshot] = await Promise.all([
   34:     getDoc(schoolRef),
   35:     getDoc(userRef),
   36:   ]);
   37: 
   38:   if (!schoolSnapshot.exists()) {
   39:     throw new Error("The selected school could not be found.");
   40:   }
   41: 
   42:   if (!userSnapshot.exists()) {
   43:     throw new Error("The selected user account could not be found.");
   44:   }
   45: 
   46:   const memberRef = doc(
   47:     db,
   48:     "schools",
   49:     cleanedSchoolId,
   50:     "members",
   51:     cleanedUserId,
   52:   );
   53: 
   54:   const batch = writeBatch(db);
   55: 
   56:   batch.set(
   57:     memberRef,
   58:     {
   59:       schoolId: cleanedSchoolId,
   60:       userId: cleanedUserId,
   61:       role,
   62:       status: "active",
   63:       joinedAt: serverTimestamp(),
   64:       leftAt: null,
   65:       updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
   66:     },
   67:     { merge: true },
   68:   );
   69: 
   70:   batch.update(userRef, {
   71:     schoolId: cleanedSchoolId,
   72:     accountType: "school",
   73:     plan: "school",
   74:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
   75:   });

    1: import {
    2:   collection,

   18: type FirestoreSchool = {
   19:   name?: unknown;
   20:   slug?: unknown;
   21:   status?: unknown;
   22:   ownerUserId?: unknown;
   23:   createdAt?: Timestamp;
   24:   updatedAt?: Timestamp;
   25: };
   26: 
   27: function safeString(
   28:   value: unknown,
   29: ): string {
   30:   return typeof value === "string"
   31:     ? value.trim()
   32:     : "";
   33: }
   34: 
   35: function safeStatus(
   36:   value: unknown,
   37: ): SchoolStatus {
   38:   return value === "suspended" ||
   39:     value === "archived"
   40:     ? value
   41:     : "active";
   42: }
   43: 
   44: function slugify(
   45:   value: string,
   46: ): string {
   47:   return value
   48:     .toLowerCase()
   49:     .trim()
   50:     .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
   51:     .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "")
   52:     .slice(0, 60);
   53: }
   54: 
   55: function timestampToDate(
   56:   value: unknown,
   57: ): Date | null {
   58:   return value instanceof Timestamp
   59:     ? value.toDate()
   60:     : null;
   61: }
   62: 
   63: function convertSchool(
   64:   id: string,
   65:   data: FirestoreSchool,
   66: ): School {
   67:   return {
   68:     id,
   69:     name:
   70:       safeString(data.name) ||
   71:       "Unnamed school",
   72:     slug:
   73:       safeString(data.slug),
   74:     status:
   75:       safeStatus(data.status),
   76:     ownerUserId:
   77:       safeString(
   78:         data.ownerUserId,
   79:       ),
   80:     createdAt:
   81:       timestampToDate(
   82:         data.createdAt,
   83:       ),
   84:     updatedAt:
   85:       timestampToDate(
   86:         data.updatedAt,
   87:       ),
   88:   };
   89: }
   90: 
   91: export async function getSchoolById(
   92:   schoolId: string,
   93: ): Promise<School | null> {
   94:   const cleanedSchoolId =
   95:     schoolId.trim();
   96: 
   97:   if (!cleanedSchoolId) {
   98:     return null;
   99:   }
  100: 
  101:   const snapshot =
  102:     await getDoc(
  103:       doc(
  104:         db,
  105:         "schools",
  106:         cleanedSchoolId,
  107:       ),
  108:     );
  109: 
  110:   if (!snapshot.exists()) {
  111:     return null;
  112:   }
  113: 
  114:   return convertSchool(
  115:     snapshot.id,
  116:     snapshot.data(),
  117:   );
  118: }

  120: export async function createSchool({
  121:   name,
  122:   ownerUserId,
  123: }: CreateSchoolInput): Promise<string> {
  124:   const cleanedName =
  125:     name
  126:       .trim()
  127:       .replace(/\s+/g, " ");
  128: 
  129:   const cleanedOwnerUserId =
  130:     ownerUserId.trim();
  131: 
  132:   if (!cleanedName) {
  133:     throw new Error(
  134:       "Enter a valid school name.",
  135:     );
  136:   }
  137: 
  138:   if (!cleanedOwnerUserId) {
  139:     throw new Error(
  140:       "A valid school owner account is required.",
  141:     );
  142:   }
  143: 
  144:   /*
  145:    * Read the authenticated teacher profile before creating
  146:    * any tenant records.
  147:    */
  148:   const ownerRef =
  149:     doc(
  150:       db,
  151:       "users",
  152:       cleanedOwnerUserId,
  153:     );
  154: 
  155:   const ownerSnapshot =
  156:     await getDoc(ownerRef);
  157: 
  158:   if (!ownerSnapshot.exists()) {
  159:     throw new Error(
  160:       "The school owner account could not be found.",
  161:     );
  162:   }
  163: 
  164:   const ownerData =
  165:     ownerSnapshot.data();
  166: 
  167:   const ownerRole =
  168:     safeString(
  169:       ownerData.role,
  170:     );
  171: 
  172:   if (
  173:     ownerRole !== "teacher" &&
  174:     ownerRole !== "admin"
  175:   ) {
  176:     throw new Error(
  177:       "Only an approved teacher or administrator can create a school.",
  178:     );
  179:   }
  180: 
  181:   const existingSchoolId =
  182:     safeString(
  183:       ownerData.schoolId,
  184:     );
  185: 
  186:   if (existingSchoolId) {
  187:     throw new Error(
  188:       "This account is already linked to a school.",
  189:     );
  190:   }
  191: 
  192:   /*
  193:    * Firestore generates the school ID locally before the
  194:    * batch is committed. This allows all three tenant records
  195:    * to reference exactly the same school ID.
  196:    */
  197:   const schoolRef =
  198:     doc(
  199:       collection(
  200:         db,
  201:         "schools",
  202:       ),
  203:     );
  204: 
  205:   const membershipRef =
  206:     doc(
  207:       db,
  208:       "schools",
  209:       schoolRef.id,
  210:       "members",
  211:       cleanedOwnerUserId,
  212:     );
  213: 
  214:   const batch =
  215:     writeBatch(db);
  216: 
  217:   /*
  218:    * 1. Create the school organisation.
  219:    */
  220:   batch.set(
  221:     schoolRef,
  222:     {
  223:       name:
  224:         cleanedName,
  225: 
  226:       slug:
  227:         `${slugify(
  228:           cleanedName,
  229:         )}-${schoolRef.id.slice(
  230:           0,
  231:           6,
  232:         )}`,
  233: 
  234:       status:
  235:         "active",
  236: 
  237:       ownerUserId:
  238:         cleanedOwnerUserId,
  239: 
  240:       createdAt:
  241:         serverTimestamp(),
  242: 
  243:       updatedAt:
  244:         serverTimestamp(),
  245:     },
  246:   );
  247: 
  248:   /*
  249:    * 2. Create the owner's active school-admin membership.
  250:    *
  251:    * Firestore's school creation rule checks this with
  252:    * existsAfter()/getAfter(), so it MUST be part of the
  253:    * same batch as the school creation.
  254:    */
  255:   batch.set(
  256:     membershipRef,
  257:     {
  258:       schoolId:
  259:         schoolRef.id,
  260: 
  261:       userId:
  262:         cleanedOwnerUserId,
  263: 
  264:       role:
  265:         "school_admin",
  266: 
  267:       status:
  268:         "active",
  269: 
  270:       joinedAt:
  271:         serverTimestamp(),
  272: 
  273:       leftAt:
  274:         null,
  275: 
  276:       updatedAt:
  277:         serverTimestamp(),
  278:     },
  279:   );
  280: 
  281:   /*
  282:    * 3. Link the teacher profile to the school.
  283:    *
  284:    * IMPORTANT:
  285:    * Some early development/test accounts pre-date the
  286:    * canonical uid field. Firestore's user update rule
  287:    * requires request.resource.data.uid to equal the
  288:    * authenticated user's UID.
  289:    *
  290:    * Writing uid here safely repairs those legacy profiles
  291:    * while performing the school tenancy transition.
  292:    */
  293:   batch.update(
  294:     ownerRef,
  295:     {
  296:       uid:
  297:         cleanedOwnerUserId,
  298: 
  299:       schoolId:
  300:         schoolRef.id,
  301: 
  302:       accountType:
  303:         "school",
  304: 
  305:       plan:
  306:         "school",
  307: 
  308:       updatedAt:
  309:         serverTimestamp(),
  310:     },
  311:   );
  312: 
  313:   /*
  314:    * All three writes must succeed or none of them does.
  315:    */
  316:   await batch.commit();
  317: 
  318:   return schoolRef.id;
  319: }

  146: function safeNumber(value: unknown): number {
  147:   return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0;
  148: }
  149: 
  150: function safeString(value: unknown, fallback = ""): string {
  151:   return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? value.trim() : fallback;
  152: }
  153: 
  154: function safeStringArray(value: unknown): string[] {
  155:   return Array.isArray(value)
  156:     ? value.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === "string")
  157:     : [];

  160: function toDate(value: FirestoreDate): Date | null {
  161:   if (!value) return null;
  162:   if (value instanceof Date) {
  163:     return value;
  164:   }
  165:   if (value instanceof Timestamp) {
  166:     return value.toDate();
  167:   }
  168: 
  169:   if (typeof value === "string") {
  170:     const parsed = new Date(value);
  171:     return Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()) ? null : parsed;
  172:   }
  173: 
  174:   return null;
  175: }
  176: 
  177: function average(values: number[]): number {
  178:   if (values.length === 0) {
  179:     return 0;
  180:   }
  181: 
  182:   return Math.round(
  183:     values.reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0) / values.length,
  184:   );
  185: }
  186: 
  187: function isOverdue(dueDate: Date | null, completed: boolean): boolean {
  188:   if (!dueDate || completed) {
  189:     return false;
  190:   }
  191: 
  192:   const endOfDueDate = new Date(dueDate);
  193: 
  194:   endOfDueDate.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
  195: 
  196:   return endOfDueDate.getTime() < Date.now();
  197: }

  199: function buildRecommendations(
  200:   metrics: StudentAnalyticsMetrics,
  201:   weakestTopics: StudentTopicPerformance[],
  202: ): StudentAnalyticsRecommendation[] {
  203:   const recommendations: StudentAnalyticsRecommendation[] = [];
  204: 
  205:   if (metrics.overdueAssignments > 0) {
  206:     recommendations.push({
  207:       id: "overdue",
  208:       priority: "high",
  209:       title: "Address overdue work",
  210:       description: `${metrics.overdueAssignments} assignment${
  211:         metrics.overdueAssignments === 1 ? " is" : "s are"
  212:       } overdue. Agree a completion plan with the student.`,
  213:       actionType: "completion",
  214:     });
  215:   }
  216: 
  217:   if (metrics.awaitingMarkingExamAssignments > 0) {
  218:     recommendations.push({
  219:       id: "awaiting-marking",
  220:       priority: "medium",
  221:       title: "Release written feedback",
  222:       description: `${metrics.awaitingMarkingExamAssignments} written assessment${
  223:         metrics.awaitingMarkingExamAssignments === 1 ? " is" : "s are"
  224:       } submitted and awaiting marking.`,
  225:       actionType: "exam",
  226:     });
  227:   }
  228: 
  229:   if (metrics.completedQuizAssignments > 0 && metrics.quizAverage < 50) {
  230:     recommendations.push({
  231:       id: "quiz-support",
  232:       priority: "high",
  233:       title: "Provide targeted quiz support",
  234:       description: `The quiz average is ${metrics.quizAverage}%. Revisit misconceptions before reassessment.`,
  235:       actionType: "quiz",
  236:     });
  237:   }
  238: 
  239:   if (metrics.completedExamAssignments > 0 && metrics.examAverage < 50) {
  240:     recommendations.push({
  241:       id: "exam-support",
  242:       priority: "high",
  243:       title: "Model written exam responses",
  244:       description: `The written exam average is ${metrics.examAverage}%. Use model answers and guided practice to improve exam technique.`,
  245:       actionType: "exam",
  246:     });
  247:   }
  248: 
  249:   if (weakestTopics.length > 0) {
  250:     recommendations.push({
  251:       id: "weakest-topic",
  252:       priority: "medium",
  253:       title: `Revisit ${weakestTopics[0].topic}`,
  254:       description: `This is currently the weakest assessed area at ${weakestTopics[0].averageScore}%. Recommend a lesson review, retrieval quiz and one exam-style question.`,
  255:       actionType: "lesson",
  256:       topic: weakestTopics[0].topic,
  257:     });
  258:   }
  259: 
  260:   if (metrics.totalAssignments > 0 && metrics.completionRate < 75) {
  261:     recommendations.push({
  262:       id: "completion",
  263:       priority: "medium",
  264:       title: "Improve assignment completion",
  265:       description: `Completion is currently ${metrics.completionRate}%. Review deadlines and barriers to completion.`,
  266:       actionType: "completion",
  267:     });
  268:   }
  269: 
  270:   if (metrics.improvementTrend >= 10) {
  271:     recommendations.push({
  272:       id: "improvement",
  273:       priority: "positive",
  274:       title: "Recognise recent improvement",
  275:       description: `Recent assessment performance has improved by approximately ${metrics.improvementTrend} percentage points.`,
  276:     });
  277:   }
  278: 
  279:   if (recommendations.length === 0) {
  280:     recommendations.push({
  281:       id: "maintain",
  282:       priority: "positive",
  283:       title: "Maintain current progress",
  284:       description:
  285:         "Continue regular retrieval practice, written exam practice and appropriately challenging work.",
  286:     });
  287:   }
  288: 
  289:   return recommendations;
  290: }
  291: 
  292: export async function getStudentAnalytics(
  293:   studentId: string,
  294:   teacherId: string,
  295: ): Promise<StudentAnalyticsData | null> {
  296:   const cleanedStudentId = studentId.trim();
  297: 
  298:   const cleanedTeacherId = teacherId.trim();
  299: 
  300:   if (!cleanedStudentId || !cleanedTeacherId) {
  301:     return null;
  302:   }
  303: 
  304:   const student = await getStudentById(cleanedStudentId);
  305: 
  306:   if (!student) {
  307:     return null;
  308:   }
  309: 
  310:   const [
  311:     classesSnapshot,
  312:     resourceAssignmentsSnapshot,
  313:     quizAssignmentsSnapshot,
  314:     quizResultsSnapshot,
  315:     examAssignmentsSnapshot,
  316:     examSubmissionsSnapshot,
  317:   ] = await Promise.all([
  318:     getDocs(
  319:       query(
  320:         collection(db, "classes"),
  321:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  322:       ),
  323:     ),
  324: 
  325:     getDocs(
  326:       query(
  327:         collection(db, "classAssignments"),
  328:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  329:       ),
  330:     ),
  331: 
  332:     getDocs(
  333:       query(
  334:         collection(db, "assignments"),
  335:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  336:       ),
  337:     ),
  338: 
  339:     getDocs(
  340:       query(
  341:         collection(db, "assignmentResults"),
  342:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  343:       ),
  344:     ),
  345: 
  346:     getDocs(
  347:       query(
  348:         collection(db, "examAssignments"),
  349:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  350:       ),
  351:     ),
  352: 
  353:     getDocs(
  354:       query(
  355:         collection(db, "examSubmissions"),
  356:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  357:       ),
  358:     ),
  359:   ]);
  360: 
  361:   const studentClassIdSet = new Set(student.classIds);
  362: 
  363:   const classes: StudentClassSummary[] = classesSnapshot.docs
  364:     .filter((classDocument) => studentClassIdSet.has(classDocument.id))
  365:     .map((classDocument) => {
  366:       const data = classDocument.data();
  367: 
  368:       return {
  369:         id: classDocument.id,
  370:         name: safeString(data.name, "Untitled class"),
  371:       };
  372:     });
  373: 
  374:   if (student.classIds.length > 0 && classes.length === 0) {
  375:     return null;
  376:   }
  377: 
  378:   const classNameById = new Map(
  379:     classes.map((studentClass) => [studentClass.id, studentClass.name]),
  380:   );
  381: 
  382:   const resourceAssignments = resourceAssignmentsSnapshot.docs.filter(
  383:     (assignmentDocument) => {
  384:       const data = assignmentDocument.data();
  385: 
  386:       return (
  387:         safeStringArray(data.studentIds).includes(cleanedStudentId) &&
  388:         data.status !== "cancelled"
  389:       );
  390:     },
  391:   );
  392: 
  393:   const resourceActivities = await Promise.all(
  394:     resourceAssignments.map(async (assignmentDocument) => {
  395:       const data = assignmentDocument.data();
  396: 
  397:       const dueDate = toDate(data.dueDate);
  398: 
  399:       const progressId = `${assignmentDocument.id}_${cleanedStudentId}`;
  400: 
  401:       const progressSnapshot = await getDoc(
  402:         doc(db, "assignmentProgress", progressId),
  403:       );
  404: 
  405:       const progress = progressSnapshot.exists()
  406:         ? progressSnapshot.data()
  407:         : null;
  408: 
  409:       const completed = progress?.status === "completed";
  410: 
  411:       const status: AnalyticsAssignmentStatus = completed
  412:         ? "completed"
  413:         : isOverdue(dueDate, false)
  414:           ? "overdue"
  415:           : progress?.status === "in_progress"
  416:             ? "in_progress"
  417:             : "not_started";
  418: 
  419:       return {
  420:         id: `resource-${assignmentDocument.id}`,
  421:         assignmentId: assignmentDocument.id,
  422:         type: "resource" as const,
  423:         title:
  424:           safeString(data.resourceTitle) ||
  425:           safeString(data.title, "Assigned resource"),
  426:         topic: safeString(data.resourceTopic, "Resource"),
  427:         className:
  428:           safeString(data.className) ||
  429:           classNameById.get(safeString(data.classId)) ||
  430:           "Assigned class",
  431:         status,
  432:         dueDate,
  433:         completedAt: toDate(progress?.completedAt),
  434:         score: null,
  435:         totalQuestions: null,
  436:         totalMarks: null,
  437:         percentage: null,
  438:         earnedXP: 0,
  439:         timeTakenSeconds: 0,
  440:       } satisfies StudentAnalyticsActivity;
  441:     }),
  442:   );
  443: 
  444:   const quizAssignments = quizAssignmentsSnapshot.docs.filter(
  445:     (assignmentDocument) => {
  446:       const data = assignmentDocument.data();
  447: 
  448:       return (
  449:         data.type === "quiz" &&
  450:         studentClassIdSet.has(safeString(data.classId)) &&
  451:         data.status !== "cancelled"
  452:       );
  453:     },
  454:   );
  455: 
  456:   const quizResultByAssignmentId = new Map(
  457:     quizResultsSnapshot.docs
  458:       .map((resultDocument) => {
  459:         const data = resultDocument.data();
  460: 
  461:         return {
  462:           assignmentId: safeString(data.assignmentId),
  463:           studentId: safeString(data.studentId),
  464:           assignmentType: safeString(data.assignmentType),
  465:           score: safeNumber(data.score),
  466:           totalQuestions: safeNumber(data.totalQuestions),
  467:           percentage: safeNumber(data.percentage),
  468:           earnedXP: safeNumber(data.earnedXP),
  469:           timeTakenSeconds: safeNumber(data.timeTakenSeconds),
  470:           status: safeString(data.status, "completed"),
  471:           completedAt: toDate(data.completedAt),
  472:         };
  473:       })
  474:       .filter(
  475:         (result) =>
  476:           result.studentId === cleanedStudentId &&
  477:           result.assignmentType === "quiz",
  478:       )
  479:       .map((result) => [result.assignmentId, result] as const),
  480:   );
  481: 
  482:   const quizActivities: StudentAnalyticsActivity[] = quizAssignments.map(
  483:     (assignmentDocument) => {
  484:       const data = assignmentDocument.data();
  485: 
  486:       const result = quizResultByAssignmentId.get(assignmentDocument.id);
  487: 
  488:       const dueDate = toDate(data.dueDate);
  489: 
  490:       const completed = result?.status === "completed";
  491: 
  492:       const status: AnalyticsAssignmentStatus = completed
  493:         ? "completed"
  494:         : isOverdue(dueDate, false)
  495:           ? "overdue"
  496:           : "not_started";
  497: 
  498:       return {
  499:         id: `quiz-${assignmentDocument.id}`,
  500:         assignmentId: assignmentDocument.id,
  501:         type: "quiz",
  502:         title: safeString(data.title, "Assigned quiz"),
  503:         topic: safeString(data.topic) || safeString(data.title, "Quiz"),
  504:         className:
  505:           classNameById.get(safeString(data.classId)) || "Assigned class",
  506:         status,
  507:         dueDate,
  508:         completedAt: result?.completedAt || null,
  509:         score: result?.score ?? null,
  510:         totalQuestions: result?.totalQuestions ?? null,
  511:         totalMarks: null,
  512:         percentage: result?.percentage ?? null,
  513:         earnedXP: result?.earnedXP ?? 0,
  514:         timeTakenSeconds: result?.timeTakenSeconds ?? 0,
  515:       };
  516:     },
  517:   );
  518: 
  519:   const examAssignments: ExamAssignmentRecord[] = examAssignmentsSnapshot.docs
  520:     .map((assignmentDocument) => {
  521:       const data = assignmentDocument.data();
  522: 
  523:       const snapshot =
  524:         data.questionSetSnapshot && typeof data.questionSetSnapshot === "object"
  525:           ? (data.questionSetSnapshot as Record<string, unknown>)
  526:           : {};
  527: 
  528:       return {
  529:         id: assignmentDocument.id,
  530:         teacherId: safeString(data.teacherId),
  531:         classId: safeString(data.classId),
  532:         className:
  533:           safeString(data.className) ||
  534:           classNameById.get(safeString(data.classId)) ||
  535:           "Assigned class",
  536:         title: safeString(data.title, "Written assessment"),
  537:         topic:
  538:           safeString(snapshot.topic) ||
  539:           safeString(data.questionSetTitle, "Written assessment"),
  540:         studentIds: safeStringArray(data.studentIds),
  541:         dueDate: toDate(data.dueDate),
  542:         totalMarks: safeNumber(data.totalMarks),
  543:         questionCount: safeNumber(data.questionCount),
  544:         status: safeString(data.status, "active"),
  545:       };
  546:     })
  547:     .filter(
  548:       (assignment) =>
  549:         assignment.studentIds.includes(cleanedStudentId) &&
  550:         assignment.status !== "cancelled",
  551:     );
  552: 
  553:   const examSubmissionByAssignmentId = new Map<string, ExamSubmissionRecord>(
  554:     examSubmissionsSnapshot.docs
  555:       .map((submissionDocument) => {
  556:         const data = submissionDocument.data();
  557: 
  558:         return {
  559:           id: submissionDocument.id,
  560:           assignmentId: safeString(data.assignmentId),
  561:           studentId: safeString(data.studentId),
  562:           status: safeString(data.status, "not_started"),
  563:           totalAwardedMarks: safeNumber(data.totalAwardedMarks),
  564:           totalAvailableMarks: safeNumber(data.totalAvailableMarks),
  565:           percentage: safeNumber(data.percentage),
  566:           submittedAt: toDate(data.submittedAt),
  567:           markedAt: toDate(data.markedAt),
  568:           updatedAt: toDate(data.updatedAt),
  569:         };
  570:       })
  571:       .filter((submission) => submission.studentId === cleanedStudentId)
  572:       .map((submission) => [submission.assignmentId, submission]),
  573:   );
  574: 
  575:   const examActivities: StudentAnalyticsActivity[] = examAssignments.map(
  576:     (assignment) => {
  577:       const submission = examSubmissionByAssignmentId.get(assignment.id);
  578: 
  579:       const marked = submission?.status === "marked";
  580: 
  581:       const submitted =
  582:         submission?.status === "submitted" || submission?.status === "marking";
  583: 
  584:       const inProgress = submission?.status === "in_progress";
  585: 
  586:       const status: AnalyticsAssignmentStatus = marked
  587:         ? "completed"
  588:         : isOverdue(assignment.dueDate, false)
  589:           ? "overdue"
  590:           : submitted || inProgress
  591:             ? "in_progress"
  592:             : "not_started";
  593: 
  594:       return {
  595:         id: `exam-${assignment.id}`,
  596:         assignmentId: assignment.id,
  597:         type: "exam",
  598:         title: assignment.title,
  599:         topic: assignment.topic,
  600:         className: assignment.className,
  601:         status,
  602:         dueDate: assignment.dueDate,
  603:         completedAt: submission?.markedAt || submission?.submittedAt || null,
  604:         score: marked ? submission.totalAwardedMarks : null,
  605:         totalQuestions: assignment.questionCount,
  606:         totalMarks: assignment.totalMarks,
  607:         percentage: marked ? submission.percentage : null,
  608:         earnedXP: 0,
  609:         timeTakenSeconds: 0,
  610:       };
  611:     },
  612:   );
  613: 
  614:   const activities = [
  615:     ...resourceActivities,
  616:     ...quizActivities,
  617:     ...examActivities,
  618:   ].sort((first, second) => {
  619:     const firstDate =
  620:       first.completedAt?.getTime() || first.dueDate?.getTime() || 0;
  621: 
  622:     const secondDate =
  623:       second.completedAt?.getTime() || second.dueDate?.getTime() || 0;
  624: 
  625:     return secondDate - firstDate;
  626:   });
  627: 
  628:   const completedActivities = activities.filter(
  629:     (activity) => activity.status === "completed",
  630:   );
  631: 
  632:   const outstandingActivities = activities.filter(
  633:     (activity) => activity.status !== "completed",
  634:   );
  635: 
  636:   const completedQuizActivities = quizActivities.filter(
  637:     (activity) =>
  638:       activity.status === "completed" && activity.percentage !== null,
  639:   );
  640: 
  641:   const completedExamActivities = examActivities.filter(
  642:     (activity) =>
  643:       activity.status === "completed" && activity.percentage !== null,
  644:   );
  645: 
  646:   const quizScores = completedQuizActivities.map(
  647:     (activity) => activity.percentage || 0,
  648:   );
  649: 
  650:   const examScores = completedExamActivities.map(
  651:     (activity) => activity.percentage || 0,
  652:   );
  653: 
  654:   const assessedActivities = [
  655:     ...completedQuizActivities,
  656:     ...completedExamActivities,
  657:   ];
  658: 
  659:   const topicGroups = new Map<
  660:     string,
  661:     {
  662:       scores: number[];
  663:       sources: Set<AnalyticsActivityType>;
  664:     }
  665:   >();
  666: 
  667:   assessedActivities.forEach((activity) => {
  668:     const topic = activity.topic || activity.title || "Other";
  669: 
  670:     const group = topicGroups.get(topic) || {
  671:       scores: [],
  672:       sources: new Set<AnalyticsActivityType>(),
  673:     };
  674: 
  675:     group.scores.push(activity.percentage || 0);
  676: 
  677:     group.sources.add(activity.type);
  678: 
  679:     topicGroups.set(topic, group);
  680:   });
  681: 
  682:   const topicPerformance: StudentTopicPerformance[] = Array.from(
  683:     topicGroups.entries(),
  684:   )
  685:     .map(([topic, group], index): StudentTopicPerformance => {
  686:       const averageScore = average(group.scores);
  687: 
  688:       const classification: StudentTopicPerformance["classification"] =
  689:         averageScore >= 70
  690:           ? "strength"
  691:           : averageScore < 50
  692:             ? "support"
  693:             : "developing";
  694: 
  695:       return {
  696:         id: `topic-${index}`,
  697:         topic,
  698:         attempts: group.scores.length,
  699:         averageScore,
  700:         highestScore: Math.max(...group.scores),
  701:         lowestScore: Math.min(...group.scores),
  702:         classification,
  703:         sources: Array.from(group.sources),
  704:       };
  705:     })
  706:     .sort((first, second) => second.averageScore - first.averageScore);
  707: 
  708:   const chronologicalScores = assessedActivities
  709:     .filter((activity) => activity.completedAt)
  710:     .sort(
  711:       (first, second) =>
  712:         (first.completedAt?.getTime() || 0) -
  713:         (second.completedAt?.getTime() || 0),
  714:     )
  715:     .map((activity) => activity.percentage || 0);
  716: 
  717:   let improvementTrend = 0;
  718: 
  719:   if (chronologicalScores.length >= 2) {
  720:     const midpoint = Math.ceil(chronologicalScores.length / 2);
  721: 
  722:     improvementTrend =
  723:       average(chronologicalScores.slice(midpoint)) -
  724:       average(chronologicalScores.slice(0, midpoint));
  725:   }
  726: 
  727:   const totalAssignments = activities.length;
  728: 
  729:   const completedAssignments = completedActivities.length;
  730: 
  731:   const quizAverage = average(quizScores);
  732: 
  733:   const examAverage = average(examScores);
  734: 
  735:   const combinedAssessmentAverage = average([...quizScores, ...examScores]);
  736: 
  737:   const metrics: StudentAnalyticsMetrics = {
  738:     totalAssignments,
  739:     completedAssignments,
  740:     outstandingAssignments: outstandingActivities.length,
  741:     overdueAssignments: activities.filter(
  742:       (activity) => activity.status === "overdue",
  743:     ).length,
  744:     completionRate:
  745:       totalAssignments > 0
  746:         ? Math.round((completedAssignments / totalAssignments) * 100)
  747:         : 0,
  748: 
  749:     totalResourceAssignments: resourceActivities.length,
  750:     completedResourceAssignments: resourceActivities.filter(
  751:       (activity) => activity.status === "completed",
  752:     ).length,
  753: 
  754:     totalQuizAssignments: quizActivities.length,
  755:     completedQuizAssignments: completedQuizActivities.length,
  756:     quizAverage,
  757:     highestQuizScore: quizScores.length > 0 ? Math.max(...quizScores) : 0,
  758:     lowestQuizScore: quizScores.length > 0 ? Math.min(...quizScores) : 0,
  759: 
  760:     totalExamAssignments: examActivities.length,
  761:     completedExamAssignments: completedExamActivities.length,
  762:     submittedExamAssignments: examAssignments.filter((assignment) => {
  763:       const submission = examSubmissionByAssignmentId.get(assignment.id);
  764: 
  765:       return ["submitted", "marking", "marked"].includes(
  766:         submission?.status || "",
  767:       );
  768:     }).length,
  769:     awaitingMarkingExamAssignments: examAssignments.filter((assignment) => {
  770:       const submission = examSubmissionByAssignmentId.get(assignment.id);
  771: 
  772:       return (
  773:         submission?.status === "submitted" || submission?.status === "marking"
  774:       );
  775:     }).length,
  776:     examAverage,
  777:     highestExamScore: examScores.length > 0 ? Math.max(...examScores) : 0,
  778:     lowestExamScore: examScores.length > 0 ? Math.min(...examScores) : 0,
  779: 
  780:     combinedAssessmentAverage,
  781:     currentGrade: indicativeGradeFromPercentage(
  782:       combinedAssessmentAverage,
  783:       student.qualification === "A_LEVEL" ? "A_LEVEL" : "GCSE",
  784:     ),
  785:     predictedGrade: indicativeGradeFromPercentage(
  786:       Math.max(
  787:         0,
  788:         Math.min(
  789:           100,
  790:           combinedAssessmentAverage + Math.round(improvementTrend * 0.4),
  791:         ),
  792:       ),
  793:       student.qualification === "A_LEVEL" ? "A_LEVEL" : "GCSE",
  794:     ),
  795: 
  796:     totalXP: student.xp,
  797:     assignmentXP: completedQuizActivities.reduce(
  798:       (total, activity) => total + activity.earnedXP,
  799:       0,
  800:     ),
  801:     streak: student.streak,
  802:     completedLessons: student.completedLessons.length,
  803:     completedTopics: student.completedTopics.length,
  804:     completedUnits: student.completedUnits.length,
  805:     averageTimeTakenSeconds: average(
  806:       completedQuizActivities
  807:         .map((activity) => activity.timeTakenSeconds)
  808:         .filter((time) => time > 0),
  809:     ),
  810:     improvementTrend,
  811:   };
  812: 
  813:   const strongestTopics = topicPerformance
  814:     .filter((topic) => topic.classification === "strength")
  815:     .slice(0, 3);
  816: 
  817:   const weakestTopics = [...topicPerformance]
  818:     .filter((topic) => topic.classification === "support")
  819:     .sort((first, second) => first.averageScore - second.averageScore)
  820:     .slice(0, 3);
  821: 
  822:   const recentActivities = completedActivities
  823:     .filter((activity) => activity.completedAt)
  824:     .sort(
  825:       (first, second) =>
  826:         (second.completedAt?.getTime() || 0) -
  827:         (first.completedAt?.getTime() || 0),
  828:     )
  829:     .slice(0, 8);
  830: 
  831:   return {
  832:     student,
  833:     classes,
  834:     metrics,
  835:     activities,
  836:     recentActivities,
  837:     outstandingActivities,
  838:     topicPerformance,
  839:     strongestTopics,
  840:     weakestTopics,
  841:     recommendations: buildRecommendations(metrics, weakestTopics),
  842:   };
  843: }

   17: export type StudentDirectoryRecord = {
   18:   uid: string;
   19:   name: string;
   20:   email: string;
   21:   role: "student";
   22: 
   23:   schoolId: string;
   24:   accountType: "individual" | "school";
   25:   plan: "free" | "premium" | "school";
   26: 
   27:   qualification: string;
   28:   examBoard: string;
   29:   currentCourse: string;
   30: 
   31:   xp: number;
   32:   streak: number;
   33: 
   34:   classIds: string[];
   35: 
   36:   completedLessons: string[];
   37:   completedTopics: string[];
   38:   completedUnits: string[];
   39: };
   40: 
   41: function normaliseString(value: unknown): string {
   42:   return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
   43: }
   44: 
   45: function normaliseStringArray(value: unknown): string[] {
   46:   if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
   47:     return [];
   48:   }
   49: 
   50:   return value.filter(
   51:     (item): item is string => typeof item === "string",
   52:   );
   53: }
   54: 
   55: function convertToStudentRecord(
   56:   profile: Partial<UserProfile>,
   57:   fallbackUid: string,
   58: ): StudentDirectoryRecord {
   59:   const schoolId = normaliseString(profile.schoolId);
   60: 
   61:   return {
   62:     uid: normaliseString(profile.uid) || fallbackUid,
   63:     name: normaliseString(profile.name) || "Unnamed Student",
   64:     email: normaliseString(profile.email).toLowerCase(),
   65:     role: "student",
   66: 
   67:     schoolId,
   68: 
   69:     accountType: schoolId ? "school" : "individual",
   70: 
   71:     plan: schoolId
   72:       ? "school"
   73:       : profile.plan === "premium"
   74:         ? "premium"
   75:         : "free",
   76: 
   77:     qualification: normaliseString(profile.qualification),
   78:     examBoard: normaliseString(profile.examBoard),
   79:     currentCourse: normaliseString(profile.currentCourse),
   80: 
   81:     xp: typeof profile.xp === "number" ? profile.xp : 0,
   82:     streak: typeof profile.streak === "number" ? profile.streak : 0,
   83: 
   84:     classIds: normaliseStringArray(profile.classIds),
   85: 
   86:     completedLessons: normaliseStringArray(profile.completedLessons),
   87:     completedTopics: normaliseStringArray(profile.completedTopics),
   88:     completedUnits: normaliseStringArray(profile.completedUnits),
   89:   };
   90: }
   91: 
   92: /**
   93:  * Returns only students belonging to one school.
   94:  *
   95:  * A missing schoolId deliberately returns [].
   96:  * There is no global student-directory fallback.
   97:  */
   98: export async function getAllStudents(
   99:   schoolId?: string,
  100: ): Promise<StudentDirectoryRecord[]> {
  101:   const cleanedSchoolId = schoolId?.trim() || "";
  102: 
  103:   if (!cleanedSchoolId) {
  104:     return [];
  105:   }
  106: 
  107:   const studentsQuery = query(
  108:     collection(db, "users"),
  109:     where("role", "==", "student"),
  110:     where("schoolId", "==", cleanedSchoolId),
  111:   );
  112: 
  113:   const snapshot = await getDocs(studentsQuery);
  114: 
  115:   return snapshot.docs
  116:     .map((studentDocument) =>
  117:       convertToStudentRecord(
  118:         studentDocument.data() as Partial<UserProfile>,
  119:         studentDocument.id,
  120:       ),
  121:     )
  122:     .sort((studentA, studentB) =>
  123:       studentA.name.localeCompare(studentB.name, "en-GB", {
  124:         sensitivity: "base",
  125:       }),
  126:     );
  127: }
  128: 
  129: export async function getStudentsForSchool(
  130:   schoolId: string,
  131: ): Promise<StudentDirectoryRecord[]> {
  132:   return getAllStudents(schoolId);
  133: }

  135: export async function getStudentById(
  136:   studentId: string,
  137:   expectedSchoolId?: string,

  139:   const cleanedStudentId = studentId.trim();

  141:   if (!cleanedStudentId) {
  142:     return null;
  143:   }

  145:   const snapshot = await getDoc(
  146:     doc(db, "users", cleanedStudentId),
  147:   );

  149:   if (!snapshot.exists()) {
  150:     return null;
  151:   }
  152: 
  153:   const profile = snapshot.data() as Partial<UserProfile>;
  154: 
  155:   if (profile.role !== "student") {
  156:     return null;
  157:   }
  158: 
  159:   const student = convertToStudentRecord(
  160:     profile,
  161:     snapshot.id,
  162:   );
  163: 
  164:   const cleanedExpectedSchoolId =
  165:     expectedSchoolId?.trim() || "";
  166: 
  167:   if (
  168:     cleanedExpectedSchoolId &&
  169:     student.schoolId !== cleanedExpectedSchoolId
  170:   ) {
  171:     return null;
  172:   }
  173: 
  174:   return student;
  175: }

  208: export function searchStudents(
  209:   students: StudentDirectoryRecord[],
  210:   searchTerm: string,
  211: ): StudentDirectoryRecord[] {
  212:   const cleanedSearchTerm = searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();
  213: 
  214:   if (!cleanedSearchTerm) {
  215:     return students;
  216:   }
  217: 
  218:   return students.filter((student) => {
  219:     const values = [
  220:       student.name,
  221:       student.email,
  222:       student.qualification,
  223:       student.examBoard,
  224:       student.currentCourse,
  225:     ].map((value) => value.toLowerCase());
  226: 
  227:     return values.some((value) =>
  228:       value.includes(cleanedSearchTerm),
  229:     );
  230:   });
  231: }

  233: export async function addClassToStudent(
  234:   studentId: string,
  235:   classId: string,
  236: ): Promise<void> {
  237:   const cleanedStudentId = studentId.trim();
  238:   const cleanedClassId = classId.trim();
  239: 
  240:   if (!cleanedStudentId) {
  241:     throw new Error("A valid student account is required.");
  242:   }
  243: 
  244:   if (!cleanedClassId) {
  245:     throw new Error("A valid class is required.");
  246:   }
  247: 
  248:   const studentReference = doc(db, "users", cleanedStudentId);
  249:   const snapshot = await getDoc(studentReference);
  250: 
  251:   if (!snapshot.exists()) {
  252:     throw new Error(
  253:       "The selected student account could not be found.",
  254:     );
  255:   }
  256: 
  257:   const profile = snapshot.data() as Partial<UserProfile>;
  258: 
  259:   if (profile.role !== "student") {
  260:     throw new Error(
  261:       "Only student accounts can be enrolled in a class.",
  262:     );
  263:   }
  264: 
  265:   await updateDoc(studentReference, {
  266:     classIds: arrayUnion(cleanedClassId),
  267:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  268:   });
  269: }

  271: export async function removeClassFromStudent(
  272:   studentId: string,
  273:   classId: string,
  274: ): Promise<void> {
  275:   const cleanedStudentId = studentId.trim();
  276:   const cleanedClassId = classId.trim();
  277: 
  278:   if (!cleanedStudentId || !cleanedClassId) {
  279:     throw new Error(
  280:       "A valid student and class are required.",
  281:     );
  282:   }
  283: 
  284:   await updateDoc(
  285:     doc(db, "users", cleanedStudentId),
  286:     {
  287:       classIds: arrayRemove(cleanedClassId),
  288:       updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  289:     },
  290:   );
  291: }

   18: type FMsg = Omit<TutorMessage, "createdAt"> & { createdAt?: Timestamp };
   19: type FConv = {
   20:   studentId: string;
   21:   title: string;
   22:   messages?: FMsg[];

   24:   updatedAt?: Timestamp;
   25: };
   26: const toDate = (v?: Timestamp | null) => (v?.toDate ? v.toDate() : null);
   27: const convert = (id: string, d: FConv): TutorConversation => ({
   28:   id,
   29:   studentId: d.studentId,
   30:   title: d.title || "Tutor conversation",
   31:   messages: (d.messages || []).map((m) => ({
   32:     ...m,
   33:     createdAt: toDate(m.createdAt),
   34:   })),
   35:   createdAt: toDate(d.createdAt),
   36:   updatedAt: toDate(d.updatedAt),
   37: });
   38: const mid = () =>
   39:   `message-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
   40: export async function createTutorConversation(studentId: string) {
   41:   const r = await addDoc(collection(db, "studentTutorConversations"), {
   42:     studentId: studentId.trim(),
   43:     title: "New tutor conversation",
   44:     messages: [],
   45:     createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
   46:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
   47:   });

   50: export async function getTutorConversation(id: string) {

   54: export async function saveTutorExchange(input: {
   55:   conversationId: string;
   56:   studentId: string;
   57:   studentMessage: string;
   58:   tutorResponse: TutorResponse;
   59: }) {
   60:   const c = await getTutorConversation(input.conversationId);
   61:   if (!c || c.studentId !== input.studentId)
   62:     throw new Error("Tutor conversation unavailable.");
   63:   const now = new Date();
   64:   const messages = [
   65:     ...c.messages,
   66:     {
   67:       id: mid(),
   68:       role: "student" as const,
   69:       content: input.studentMessage.trim(),
   70:       createdAt: now,
   71:     },
   72:     {
   73:       id: mid(),
   74:       role: "assistant" as const,
   75:       content: input.tutorResponse.reply,
   76:       createdAt: now,
   77:       mode: input.tutorResponse.mode,
   78:     },
   79:   ];
   80:   await updateDoc(doc(db, "studentTutorConversations", input.conversationId), {
   81:     title: c.messages.length
   82:       ? c.title
   83:       : input.studentMessage.trim().slice(0, 60),
   84:     messages: messages.map((m) => ({
   85:       ...m,
   86:       createdAt: Timestamp.fromDate(m.createdAt || now),
   87:     })),
   88:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
   89:   });
   90: }
   91: export async function clearTutorConversation(id: string, studentId: string) {
   92:   const c = await getTutorConversation(id);
   93:   if (!c || c.studentId !== studentId)
   94:     throw new Error("Tutor conversation unavailable.");
   95:   await updateDoc(doc(db, "studentTutorConversations", id), {
   96:     title: "New tutor conversation",
   97:     messages: [],
   98:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
   99:   });
  100: }
  101: export async function requestTutorResponse(input: {
  102:   studentId: string;
  103:   conversationId: string;
  104:   message: string;
  105:   history: { role: "student" | "assistant"; content: string }[];
  106:   context: TutorStudentContext;
  107: }): Promise<TutorResponse> {
  108:   const currentUser = auth.currentUser;
  109: 
  110:   if (!currentUser || currentUser.uid !== input.studentId) {
  111:     throw new Error(
  112:       "Sign in with the student account using the AI Tutor.",
  113:     );
  114:   }
  115: 
  116:   const idToken = await currentUser.getIdToken();
  117: 
  118:   const r = await fetch("/api/ai/student-tutor", {
  119:     method: "POST",
  120:     headers: {
  121:       "Content-Type": "application/json",
  122:       Authorization: `Bearer ${idToken}`,
  123:     },
  124:     body: JSON.stringify(input),
  125:   });
  126: 
  127:   const j = await r.json();
  128: 
  129:   if (!r.ok) {
  130:     throw new Error(
  131:       j.error || "The tutor could not respond.",
  132:     );
  133:   }
  134: 
  135:   return j as TutorResponse;
  136: }

  150: function safeNumber(value: unknown): number {
  151:   return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0;
  152: }
  153:

  156: }

  164: function formatActivityTime(timestamp?: Timestamp): string {
  165:   if (!timestamp) {
  166:     return "Recently";
  167:   }
  168: 
  169:   const activityDate = timestamp.toDate();
  170: 
  171:   const difference = Date.now() - activityDate.getTime();
  172: 
  173:   const minutes = Math.floor(difference / 60000);
  174: 
  175:   if (minutes < 1) {
  176:     return "Just now";
  177:   }
  178: 
  179:   if (minutes < 60) {
  180:     return `${minutes} minute${minutes === 1 ? "" : "s"} ago`;
  181:   }
  182: 
  183:   const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  184: 
  185:   if (hours < 24) {
  186:     return `${hours} hour${hours === 1 ? "" : "s"} ago`;
  187:   }
  188: 
  189:   const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
  190: 
  191:   return `${days} day${days === 1 ? "" : "s"} ago`;
  192: }
  193: 
  194: function isToday(timestamp?: Timestamp): boolean {
  195:   if (!timestamp) {
  196:     return false;
  197:   }
  198: 
  199:   const date = timestamp.toDate();
  200: 
  201:   const today = new Date();
  202: 
  203:   return (
  204:     date.getFullYear() === today.getFullYear() &&
  205:     date.getMonth() === today.getMonth() &&
  206:     date.getDate() === today.getDate()
  207:   );
  208: }
  209: 
  210: function calculateAverage(values: number[]): number {
  211:   if (values.length === 0) {
  212:     return 0;
  213:   }
  214: 
  215:   return Math.round(
  216:     values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / values.length,
  217:   );
  218: }
