  237:     getDocs(
  238:       query(
  239:         collection(db, "classes"),
  240:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  241:       ),
  242:     ),
  243: 
  244:     getDocs(
  245:       query(
  246:         collection(db, "assignments"),
  247:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  248:       ),
  249:     ),
  250: 
  251:     getDocs(
  252:       query(
  253:         collection(db, "assignmentResults"),
  254:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  255:       ),
  256:     ),
  257: 
  258:     getDocs(
  259:       query(
  260:         collection(db, "classAssignments"),
  261:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  262:       ),
  263:     ),
  264: 
  265:     getDocs(
  266:       query(
  267:         collection(db, "examAssignments"),
  268:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  269:       ),
  270:     ),
  271: 
  272:     getDocs(
  273:       query(
  274:         collection(db, "examSubmissions"),
  275:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  276:       ),
  277:     ),
  278:   ]);
  279: 
  280:   /*
  281:    * DATA ISOLATION:
  282:    *
  283:    * A teacher's dashboard must be built only from students explicitly
  284:    * enrolled in classes owned by that teacher.
  285:    *
  286:    * Never fall back to every platform student when a teacher has no classes.
  287:    * That would expose another teacher's learners and evidence.
  288:    */
  289:   const teacherStudentIds = new Set<string>();
  290: 
  291:   classesSnapshot.docs.forEach((classDocument) => {
  292:     const data = classDocument.data();
  293: 
  294:     safeStringArray(data.studentIds).forEach((studentId) => {
  295:       teacherStudentIds.add(studentId);
  296:     });
  297:   });
  298: 
  299:   const studentSnapshots = await Promise.all(
  300:     Array.from(teacherStudentIds).map((studentId) =>
  301:       getDoc(doc(db, "users", studentId)),
  302:     ),
  303:   );
  304: 
  305:   const relevantStudents: UserRecord[] = studentSnapshots
  306:     .filter((studentSnapshot) => studentSnapshot.exists())
  307:     .map((studentSnapshot) => {
  308:       const data = studentSnapshot.data();
  309: 
  310:       return {
  311:         id: studentSnapshot.id,
  312:         name: safeString(data.name, "Student"),
  313:         role: safeString(data.role, "student"),
  314:         xp: safeNumber(data.xp),
  315:         streak: safeNumber(data.streak),
  316:         badges: safeStringArray(data.badges),
  317:         completedLessons: safeStringArray(data.completedLessons),
  318:       };
  319:     })
  320:     .filter((student) => student.role === "student");
  321: 
  322:   const relevantStudentIds = new Set(
  323:     relevantStudents.map((student) => student.id),
  324:   );
  325: 
  326:   /*
  327:    * Fetch quiz evidence only from students who belong to this teacher's
  328:    * classes. This avoids downloading platform-wide quiz results and then
  329:    * filtering them in the browser.
  330:    */
  331:   const quizResultSnapshots = await Promise.all(
  332:     Array.from(relevantStudentIds).map((studentId) =>
  333:       getDocs(collection(db, "users", studentId, "quizResults")),
  334:     ),
  335:   );
  336: 
  337:   const quizResultDocuments = quizResultSnapshots.flatMap(
  338:     (snapshot) => snapshot.docs,
  339:   );
  340: 
  341:   const assignments: AssignmentRecord[] = assignmentsSnapshot.docs.map(
  342:     (assignmentDocument) => {
  343:       const data = assignmentDocument.data();
  344: 
  345:       return {
  346:         id: assignmentDocument.id,
  347:         status: safeString(data.status, "active"),
  348:       };
  349:     },
  350:   );
  351: 
  352:   const resourceAssignments: ResourceAssignmentRecord[] =
  353:     resourceAssignmentsSnapshot.docs.map((assignmentDocument) => {
  354:       const data = assignmentDocument.data();
  355:       const studentIds = safeStringArray(data.studentIds).filter((studentId) =>
  356:         relevantStudentIds.has(studentId),
  357:       );
  358: 
  359:       const storedStudentCount = safeNumber(data.studentCount);
  360:       const storedCompletedCount = safeNumber(data.completedCount);
  361: 
  362:       return {
  363:         id: assignmentDocument.id,
  364:         status: safeString(data.status, "active"),
  365:         studentIds,
  366:         studentCount:
  367:           storedStudentCount > 0 ? storedStudentCount : studentIds.length,
  368:         completedCount: Math.min(
  369:           storedCompletedCount,
  370:           storedStudentCount > 0 ? storedStudentCount : studentIds.length,
  371:         ),
  372:       };
  373:     });
  374: 
  375:   /*
  376:    * Resource/lesson assignments store per-student completion in
  377:    * assignmentProgress/{assignmentId}_{studentId}.
  378:    *
  379:    * Read only the expected progress documents for this teacher's own
  380:    * assignments and currently enrolled learners. This keeps the dashboard
  381:    * isolated and lets Completed Today include lesson/resource completions.
  382:    */
  383:   const resourceProgressSnapshots = await Promise.all(
  384:     resourceAssignments.flatMap((assignment) =>
  385:       assignment.studentIds.map((studentId) =>
  386:         getDoc(
  387:           doc(
  388:             db,
  389:             "assignmentProgress",
  390:             `${assignment.id}_${studentId}`,
  391:           ),
  392:         ),
  393:       ),
  394:     ),
  395:   );
  396: 
  397:   const resourceAssignmentProgress: ResourceAssignmentProgressRecord[] =
  398:     resourceProgressSnapshots
  399:       .filter((progressSnapshot) => progressSnapshot.exists())
  400:       .map((progressSnapshot) => {
  401:         const data = progressSnapshot.data();
  402: 
  403:         return {
  404:           id: progressSnapshot.id,
  405:           assignmentId: safeString(data.assignmentId),
  406:           studentId: safeString(data.studentId),
  407:           status: safeString(data.status, "not_started"),
  408:           completedAt:
  409:             data.completedAt instanceof Timestamp
  410:               ? data.completedAt
  411:               : undefined,
  412:         };
  413:       })
  414:       .filter(
  415:         (progress) =>
  416:           relevantStudentIds.has(progress.studentId) &&
  417:           resourceAssignments.some(
  418:             (assignment) => assignment.id === progress.assignmentId,
  419:           ),
  420:       );
  421: 
  422:   const assignmentResults: AssignmentResultRecord[] =
  423:     assignmentResultsSnapshot.docs
  424:       .map((resultDocument) => {
  425:         const data = resultDocument.data();
  426: 
  427:         return {
  428:           id: resultDocument.id,
  429:           studentId: safeString(data.studentId),
  430:           assignmentId: safeString(data.assignmentId),
  431:           percentage: safeNumber(data.percentage),
  432:           status: safeString(data.status, "completed"),
  433:           completedAt:
  434:             data.completedAt instanceof Timestamp
  435:               ? data.completedAt
  436:               : undefined,
  437:         };
  438:       })
  439:       .filter((result) => relevantStudentIds.has(result.studentId));
  440: 
  441:   const quizResults: QuizResultRecord[] = quizResultDocuments
  442:     .map((resultDocument) => {
  443:       const data = resultDocument.data();
  444: 
  445:       return {
  446:         id: resultDocument.id,
  447:         uid: safeString(data.uid) || resultDocument.ref.parent.parent?.id || "",
  448:         studentName: safeString(data.studentName),
  449:         title: safeString(data.title, "Quiz"),
  450:         topicId: safeString(data.topicId, "Other"),
  451:         scorePercent: safeNumber(data.scorePercent),
  452:         createdAt:
  453:           data.createdAt instanceof Timestamp ? data.createdAt : undefined,
  454:       };
  455:     })
  456:     .filter(
  457:       (result) =>
  458:         Boolean(result.uid) &&
  459:         relevantStudentIds.has(result.uid),
  460:     );
  461: 
  462:   const examAssignments: ExamAssignmentRecord[] =
  463:     examAssignmentsSnapshot.docs.map((assignmentDocument) => {
  464:       const data = assignmentDocument.data();
  465: 
  466:       return {
  467:         id: assignmentDocument.id,
  468:         status: safeString(data.status, "active"),
  469:         studentIds: safeStringArray(data.studentIds),
  470:       };
  471:     });
  472: 
  473:   const examAssignmentIdSet = new Set(
  474:     examAssignments.map((assignment) => assignment.id),
  475:   );
  476: 
  477:   const examSubmissions: ExamSubmissionRecord[] = examSubmissionsSnapshot.docs
  478:     .map((submissionDocument) => {
  479:       const data = submissionDocument.data();
  480: 
  481:       return {
  482:         id: submissionDocument.id,
  483:         studentId: safeString(data.studentId),
  484:         studentName: safeString(data.studentName),
  485:         assignmentId: safeString(data.assignmentId),
  486:         status: safeString(data.status, "not_started"),
  487:         percentage: safeNumber(data.percentage),
  488:         topic: safeString(data.topic, "Written assessment"),
  489:         markedAt:
  490:           data.markedAt instanceof Timestamp ? data.markedAt : undefined,
  491:         submittedAt:
  492:           data.submittedAt instanceof Timestamp ? data.submittedAt : undefined,
  493:       };
  494:     })
  495:     .filter(
  496:       (submission) =>
  497:         relevantStudentIds.has(submission.studentId) &&
  498:         examAssignmentIdSet.has(submission.assignmentId),
  499:     );
  500: 
  501:   const markedExamSubmissions = examSubmissions.filter(
  502:     (submission) => submission.status === "marked",
  503:   );
  504: 
  505:   const awaitingMarkingCount = examSubmissions.filter(
  506:     (submission) =>
  507:       submission.status === "submitted" || submission.status === "marking",
  508:   ).length;
  509: 
  510:   const quizScores = quizResults.map((result) => result.scorePercent);
  511: 
  512:   const examScores = markedExamSubmissions.map(
  513:     (submission) => submission.percentage,
  514:   );
  515: 
  516:   const quizAverage = calculateAverage(quizScores);
  517: 
  518:   const examAverage = calculateAverage(examScores);
  519: 
  520:   const averageScore = calculateAverage([...quizScores, ...examScores]);
  521: 
  522:   const lessonsCompleted = relevantStudents.reduce(
  523:     (total, student) => total + student.completedLessons.length,
  524:     0,
  525:   );
  526: 
  527:   const expectedQuizSubmissions = assignments.length * relevantStudents.length;
  528: 
  529:   const expectedResourceCompletions = resourceAssignments.reduce(
  530:     (total, assignment) => total + assignment.studentCount,
  531:     0,
  532:   );
  533: 
  534:   const completedResourceCompletions = resourceAssignments.reduce(
  535:     (total, assignment) => total + assignment.completedCount,
  536:     0,
  537:   );
  538: 
  539:   const expectedExamSubmissions = examAssignments.reduce(
  540:     (total, assignment) =>
  541:       total +
  542:       assignment.studentIds.filter((studentId) =>
  543:         relevantStudentIds.has(studentId),
  544:       ).length,
  545:     0,
  546:   );
  547: 
  548:   const completedAssignmentResults = assignmentResults.filter(
  549:     (result) => result.status === "completed",
  550:   );
  551: 
  552:   const completedExamSubmissions = examSubmissions.filter(
  553:     (submission) => submission.status === "marked",
  554:   );
  555: 
  556:   const expectedSubmissions =
  557:     expectedQuizSubmissions +
  558:     expectedResourceCompletions +
  559:     expectedExamSubmissions;
  560: 
  561:   const completedSubmissions =
  562:     completedAssignmentResults.length +
  563:     completedResourceCompletions +
  564:     completedExamSubmissions.length;
  565: 
  566:   const completionRate =
  567:     expectedSubmissions > 0
  568:       ? Math.min(
  569:           100,
  570:           Math.round((completedSubmissions / expectedSubmissions) * 100),
  571:         )
  572:       : 0;
  573: 
  574:   const completedResourceProgressToday = resourceAssignmentProgress.filter(
  575:     (progress) =>
  576:       progress.status === "completed" &&
  577:       isToday(progress.completedAt),
  578:   ).length;
  579: 
  580:   const completedToday =
  581:     completedAssignmentResults.filter((result) => isToday(result.completedAt))
  582:       .length +
  583:     completedResourceProgressToday +
  584:     completedExamSubmissions.filter((submission) =>
  585:       isToday(submission.markedAt),
  586:     ).length;
  587: 
  588:   const topStudents: TopStudent[] = [...relevantStudents]
  589:     .sort((first, second) => second.xp - first.xp)
  590:     .slice(0, 5)
  591:     .map((student) => ({
  592:       id: student.id,
  593:       name: student.name,
  594:       xp: student.xp,
  595:       streak: student.streak,
  596:       badges: student.badges.length,
  597:     }));
  598: 
  599:   const quizActivities: RecentTeacherActivity[] = quizResults
  600:     .slice(0, 8)
  601:     .map((result) => {
  602:       const matchedStudent = relevantStudents.find(
  603:         (student) => student.id === result.uid,
  604:       );
  605: 
  606:       return {
  607:         id: `quiz-${result.id}`,
  608:         studentName: result.studentName || matchedStudent?.name || "Student",
  609:         activity: `Completed ${result.title}`,
  610:         result: `${result.scorePercent}%`,
  611:         time: formatActivityTime(result.createdAt),
  612:         type: "quiz" as const,
  613:       };
  614:     });
  615: 
  616:   const examActivities: RecentTeacherActivity[] = markedExamSubmissions.map(
  617:     (submission) => {
  618:       const matchedStudent = relevantStudents.find(
  619:         (student) => student.id === submission.studentId,
  620:       );
  621: 
  622:       return {
  623:         id: `exam-${submission.id}`,
  624:         studentName:
  625:           submission.studentName || matchedStudent?.name || "Student",
  626:         activity: "Completed written assessment",
  627:         result: `${submission.percentage}%`,
  628:         time: formatActivityTime(submission.markedAt || submission.submittedAt),
  629:         type: "exam" as const,
  630:       };
  631:     },
  632:   );
  633: 
  634:   const recentActivities = [...quizActivities, ...examActivities].slice(0, 8);
  635: 
  636:   const scoresByStudent = new Map<string, number[]>();
  637: 
  638:   quizResults.forEach((result) => {
  639:     if (!result.uid) {
  640:       return;
  641:     }
  642: 
  643:     const scores = scoresByStudent.get(result.uid) || [];
  644: 
  645:     scores.push(result.scorePercent);
  646: 
  647:     scoresByStudent.set(result.uid, scores);
  648:   });
  649: 
  650:   markedExamSubmissions.forEach((submission) => {
  651:     const scores = scoresByStudent.get(submission.studentId) || [];
  652: 
  653:     scores.push(submission.percentage);
  654: 
  655:     scoresByStudent.set(submission.studentId, scores);
  656:   });
  657: 
  658:   const atRiskStudents: AtRiskStudent[] = relevantStudents
  659:     .map((student) => {
  660:       const scores = scoresByStudent.get(student.id) || [];
  661: 
  662:       return {
  663:         id: student.id,
  664:         name: student.name,
  665:         weakTopic: "Combined Assessment Performance",
  666:         averageScore: calculateAverage(scores),
  667:         recommendedAction:
  668:           "Review quiz and written exam evidence, then assign targeted revision.",
  669:         hasResults: scores.length > 0,
  670:       };
  671:     })
  672:     .filter((student) => student.hasResults && student.averageScore < 50)
  673:     .sort((first, second) => first.averageScore - second.averageScore)
  674:     .slice(0, 5)
  675:     .map((student) => ({
  676:       id: student.id,
  677:       name: student.name,
  678:       weakTopic: student.weakTopic,
  679:       averageScore: student.averageScore,
  680:       recommendedAction: student.recommendedAction,
  681:     }));
  682: 
  683:   const topicGroups = new Map<string, number[]>();
  684: 
  685:   quizResults.forEach((result) => {
  686:     const topic = result.title || result.topicId || "Other";
  687: 
  688:     const scores = topicGroups.get(topic) || [];
  689: 
  690:     scores.push(result.scorePercent);
  691: 
  692:     topicGroups.set(topic, scores);
  693:   });
  694: 
  695:   markedExamSubmissions.forEach((submission) => {
  696:     const topic = submission.topic || "Written assessment";
  697: 
  698:     const scores = topicGroups.get(topic) || [];
  699: 
  700:     scores.push(submission.percentage);
  701: 
  702:     topicGroups.set(topic, scores);
  703:   });
  704: 
  705:   const classPerformance: TopicPerformance[] = Array.from(topicGroups.entries())
  706:     .map(([topic, scores], index) => ({
  707:       id: `topic-${index}`,
  708:       topic,
  709:       averageScore: calculateAverage(scores),
  710:     }))
  711:     .sort((first, second) => second.averageScore - first.averageScore);
  712: 
  713:   return {
  714:     studentCount: relevantStudents.length,
  715:     classCount: classesSnapshot.size,
  716:     assignmentCount:
  717:       assignments.length + resourceAssignments.length + examAssignments.length,
  718:     activeAssignmentCount:
  719:       assignments.filter((assignment) => assignment.status === "active")
  720:         .length +
  721:       resourceAssignments.filter((assignment) => assignment.status === "active")
  722:         .length +
  723:       examAssignments.filter((assignment) => assignment.status === "active")
  724:         .length,
  725:     examAssignmentCount: examAssignments.length,
  726:     awaitingMarkingCount,
  727:     averageScore,
  728:     quizAverage,
  729:     examAverage,
  730:     completionRate,
  731:     lessonsCompleted,
  732:     completedToday,
  733:     recentActivities,
  734:     atRiskStudents,
  735:     topStudents,
  736:     classPerformance,
  737:   };
  738: }

    1: import type {
    2:   InterventionPlanningGroup,
    3:   InterventionPlanningPriority,
    4:   InterventionPlanningStudent,
    5:   InterventionStrategy,
    6:   TeacherInterventionPlan,
    7: } from "@/types/teacherInterventionPlanning";
    8: 
    9: function normaliseTopic(value: string): string {
   10:   const cleaned = value.trim();
   11:   return cleaned || "Combined Assessment Performance";
   12: }
   13: 
   14: function average(values: number[]): number {
   15:   if (!values.length) return 0;
   16: 
   17:   return Math.round(
   18:     values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / values.length,
   19:   );
   20: }
   21: 
   22: function priorityForGroup({
   23:   averageScore,
   24:   lowestScore,
   25:   studentCount,
   26: }: {
   27:   averageScore: number;
   28:   lowestScore: number;
   29:   studentCount: number;
   30: }): InterventionPlanningPriority {
   31:   if (lowestScore < 30 || averageScore < 35 || studentCount >= 4) {
   32:     return "high";
   33:   }
   34: 
   35:   if (averageScore < 50 || studentCount >= 2) {
   36:     return "medium";
   37:   }
   38: 
   39:   return "monitor";
   40: }
   41: 
   42: function strategyForGroup({
   43:   averageScore,
   44:   lowestScore,
   45:   studentCount,
   46: }: {
   47:   averageScore: number;
   48:   lowestScore: number;
   49:   studentCount: number;
   50: }): InterventionStrategy {
   51:   if (lowestScore < 30 || averageScore < 35) {
   52:     return "reteach_then_reassess";
   53:   }
   54: 
   55:   if (averageScore < 50 || studentCount >= 2) {
   56:     return "targeted_practice";
   57:   }
   58: 
   59:   return "monitor_with_evidence";
   60: }
   61: 
   62: function rationaleForGroup({
   63:   topic,
   64:   averageScore,
   65:   lowestScore,
   66:   studentCount,
   67: }: {
   68:   topic: string;
   69:   averageScore: number;
   70:   lowestScore: number;
   71:   studentCount: number;
   72: }): string {
   73:   if (lowestScore < 30) {
   74:     return `${studentCount} learner${studentCount === 1 ? "" : "s"} need support in ${topic}; the lowest current score is ${lowestScore}%.`;
   75:   }
   76: 
   77:   if (averageScore < 50) {
   78:     return `${topic} is a shared weakness for ${studentCount} learner${studentCount === 1 ? "" : "s"}, with an average of ${averageScore}%.`;
   79:   }
   80: 
   81:   return `${studentCount} learner${studentCount === 1 ? "" : "s"} have been flagged for monitoring in ${topic}.`;
   82: }
   83: 
   84: function evidenceCaution({
   85:   studentCount,
   86:   averageScore,
   87: }: {
   88:   studentCount: number;
   89:   averageScore: number;
   90: }): string {
   91:   if (studentCount === 1) {
   92:     return "This is an individual signal rather than a class-wide pattern. Review the learner's underlying evidence before changing whole-class teaching.";
   93:   }
   94: 
   95:   if (studentCount < 3) {
   96:     return "This is a small support cohort. Check whether the weakness is repeated across more than one assessed activity.";
   97:   }
   98: 
   99:   if (averageScore < 35) {
  100:     return "The group signal is strong, but the teacher should still review question-level and topic evidence before deciding the intervention.";
  101:   }
  102: 
  103:   return "Use this grouping as a planning aid and confirm it against recent assessment evidence.";
  104: }
  105: 
  106: function stepsForStrategy(
  107:   strategy: InterventionStrategy,
  108:   topic: string,
  109: ) {
  110:   if (strategy === "reteach_then_reassess") {
  111:     return [
  112:       {
  113:         id: "review",
  114:         order: 1,
  115:         label: "Review evidence",
  116:         description: `Check the Knowledge Map and recent assessment evidence for ${topic}.`,
  117:       },
  118:       {
  119:         id: "reteach",
  120:         order: 2,
  121:         label: "Reteach",
  122:         description: `Deliver a focused explanation, worked example or misconception check for ${topic}.`,
  123:       },
  124:       {
  125:         id: "reassess",
  126:         order: 3,
  127:         label: "Reassess",
  128:         description: `Assign a short targeted task or written reassessment on ${topic}.`,
  129:       },
  130:       {
  131:         id: "impact",
  132:         order: 4,
  133:         label: "Review impact",
  134:         description:
  135:           "Use the Intervention Centre to compare new evidence against the baseline.",
  136:       },
  137:     ];
  138:   }
  139: 
  140:   if (strategy === "targeted_practice") {
  141:     return [
  142:       {
  143:         id: "review",
  144:         order: 1,
  145:         label: "Check evidence",
  146:         description: `Confirm the recurring gap in ${topic}.`,
  147:       },
  148:       {
  149:         id: "practice",
  150:         order: 2,
  151:         label: "Targeted practice",
  152:         description: `Assign focused practice that isolates ${topic}.`,
  153:       },
  154:       {
  155:         id: "check",
  156:         order: 3,
  157:         label: "Check improvement",
  158:         description:
  159:           "Review the next graded evidence before escalating support.",
  160:       },
  161:     ];
  162:   }
  163: 
  164:   return [
  165:     {
  166:       id: "monitor",
  167:       order: 1,
  168:       label: "Monitor",
  169:       description: `Collect another piece of assessed evidence for ${topic}.`,
  170:     },
  171:     {
  172:       id: "review",
  173:       order: 2,
  174:       label: "Review trend",
  175:       description:
  176:         "Only create a formal intervention if the weakness is repeated or worsens.",
  177:     },
  178:   ];
  179: }
  180: 
  181: function groupQuery(
  182:   students: InterventionPlanningStudent[],
  183: ): string {
  184:   const ids = students
  185:     .map((student) => student.id)
  186:     .filter(Boolean)
  187:     .join(",");
  188: 
  189:   const names = students
  190:     .map((student) => student.name)
  191:     .filter(Boolean)
  192:     .join(",");
  193: 
  194:   return `studentIds=${encodeURIComponent(ids)}&studentNames=${encodeURIComponent(names)}`;
  195: }
  196: 
  197: export function buildTeacherInterventionPlan(
  198:   students: InterventionPlanningStudent[],
  199: ): TeacherInterventionPlan {
  200:   const grouped = new Map<string, InterventionPlanningStudent[]>();
  201: 
  202:   students.forEach((student) => {
  203:     const topic = normaliseTopic(student.weakTopic);
  204:     const current = grouped.get(topic) || [];
  205: 
  206:     current.push({
  207:       ...student,
  208:       weakTopic: topic,
  209:     });
  210: 
  211:     grouped.set(topic, current);
  212:   });
  213: 
  214:   const groups: InterventionPlanningGroup[] = Array.from(grouped.entries())
  215:     .map(([topic, members]) => {
  216:       const scores = members.map((student) => student.averageScore);
  217:       const averageScore = average(scores);
  218:       const lowestScore = scores.length ? Math.min(...scores) : 0;
  219:       const priority = priorityForGroup({
  220:         averageScore,
  221:         lowestScore,
  222:         studentCount: members.length,
  223:       });
  224:       const strategy = strategyForGroup({
  225:         averageScore,
  226:         lowestScore,
  227:         studentCount: members.length,
  228:       });
  229:       const cohort = groupQuery(members);
  230: 
  231:       return {
  232:         id:
  233:           topic
  234:             .toLowerCase()
  235:             .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
  236:             .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "") || "support-group",
  237:         topic,
  238:         studentCount: members.length,
  239:         students: [...members].sort(
  240:           (first, second) => first.averageScore - second.averageScore,
  241:         ),
  242:         averageScore,
  243:         lowestScore,
  244:         priority,
  245:         strategy,
  246:         rationale: rationaleForGroup({
  247:           topic,
  248:           averageScore,
  249:           lowestScore,
  250:           studentCount: members.length,
  251:         }),
  252:         evidenceCaution: evidenceCaution({
  253:           studentCount: members.length,
  254:           averageScore,
  255:         }),
  256:         steps: stepsForStrategy(strategy, topic),
  257:         knowledgeMapHref:
  258:           `/teacher/knowledge-map?topic=${encodeURIComponent(topic)}` +
  259:           `&source=intervention-cohort&${cohort}`,
  260:         assignmentHref:
  261:           `/teacher/assignment-wizard?topic=${encodeURIComponent(topic)}` +
  262:           `&source=intervention-cohort&mode=targeted-reassessment&${cohort}`,
  263:         interventionHref:
  264:           `/teacher/interventions?topic=${encodeURIComponent(topic)}` +
  265:           `&source=intervention-cohort&${cohort}`,
  266:       };
  267:     })
  268:     .sort((first, second) => {
  269:       const priorityRank = {
  270:         high: 0,
  271:         medium: 1,
  272:         monitor: 2,
  273:       };
  274: 
  275:       const difference =
  276:         priorityRank[first.priority] - priorityRank[second.priority];
  277: 
  278:       if (difference !== 0) return difference;
  279: 
  280:       if (first.averageScore !== second.averageScore) {
  281:         return first.averageScore - second.averageScore;
  282:       }
  283: 
  284:       return second.studentCount - first.studentCount;
  285:     });
  286: 
  287:   return {
  288:     totalStudentsRequiringSupport: students.length,
  289:     highPriorityGroups: groups.filter((group) => group.priority === "high")
  290:       .length,
  291:     groupedTopics: groups.length,
  292:     averageAtRiskScore: average(
  293:       students.map((student) => student.averageScore),
  294:     ),
  295:     groups,
  296:   };
  297: }

   24: type ExistingTeacherRequest = {
   25:   id: string;
   26:   status:
   27:     | "pending"
   28:     | "approved"
   29:     | "rejected";
   30: };
   31: 
   32: async function findExistingRequest(
   33:   userId: string,
   34: ): Promise<ExistingTeacherRequest | null> {
   35:   const snapshot = await getDocs(
   36:     query(
   37:       collection(
   38:         db,
   39:         "teacherRequests",
   40:       ),
   41:       where(
   42:         "userId",
   43:         "==",
   44:         userId,
   45:       ),
   46:       limit(10),
   47:     ),
   48:   );
   49: 
   50:   if (snapshot.empty) {
   51:     return null;
   52:   }
   53: 
   54:   const requests =
   55:     snapshot.docs.map(
   56:       (requestDocument) => {
   57:         const data =
   58:           requestDocument.data();
   59: 
   60:         const status =
   61:           data.status === "approved" ||
   62:           data.status === "rejected"
   63:             ? data.status
   64:             : "pending";
   65: 
   66:         return {
   67:           id: requestDocument.id,
   68:           status,
   69:         } satisfies ExistingTeacherRequest;
   70:       },
   71:     );
   72: 
   73:   return (
   74:     requests.find(
   75:       (request) =>
   76:         request.status === "pending",
   77:     ) ||
   78:     requests.find(
   79:       (request) =>
   80:         request.status === "approved",
   81:     ) ||
   82:     requests[0] ||
   83:     null
   84:   );
   85: }

   87: export async function createTeacherRequest({
   88:   userId,
   89:   name,
   90:   email,
   91:   schoolName,
   92:   jobTitle,
   93:   message,
   94: }: CreateTeacherRequestInput): Promise<string> {
   95:   const cleanedUserId =
   96:     userId.trim();
   97: 
   98:   const cleanedName =
   99:     name.trim();
  100: 
  101:   const cleanedEmail =
  102:     email.trim().toLowerCase();
  103: 
  104:   const cleanedSchool =
  105:     schoolName.trim();
  106: 
  107:   const cleanedJobTitle =
  108:     jobTitle.trim();
  109: 
  110:   if (
  111:     !cleanedUserId ||
  112:     !cleanedName ||
  113:     !cleanedSchool ||
  114:     !cleanedJobTitle
  115:   ) {
  116:     throw new Error(
  117:       "Please complete all required fields.",
  118:     );
  119:   }
  120: 
  121:   const existing =
  122:     await findExistingRequest(
  123:       cleanedUserId,
  124:     );
  125: 
  126:   if (
  127:     existing?.status === "pending"
  128:   ) {
  129:     await setDoc(
  130:       doc(
  131:         db,
  132:         "users",
  133:         cleanedUserId,
  134:       ),
  135:       {
  136:         accountIntent: "teacher",
  137:         teacherAccessStatus:
  138:           "pending",
  139:         updatedAt:
  140:           serverTimestamp(),
  141:       },
  142:       {
  143:         merge: true,
  144:       },
  145:     );
  146: 
  147:     return existing.id;
  148:   }
  149: 
  150:   if (
  151:     existing?.status === "approved"
  152:   ) {
  153:     throw new Error(
  154:       "Teacher access has already been approved for this account.",
  155:     );
  156:   }
  157: 
  158:   const requestReference =
  159:     await addDoc(
  160:       collection(
  161:         db,
  162:         "teacherRequests",
  163:       ),
  164:       {
  165:         userId: cleanedUserId,
  166:         name: cleanedName,
  167:         email: cleanedEmail,
  168:         schoolName:
  169:           cleanedSchool,
  170:         jobTitle:
  171:           cleanedJobTitle,
  172:         message:
  173:           message.trim(),
  174: 
  175:         status: "pending",
  176: 
  177:         createdAt:
  178:           serverTimestamp(),
  179: 
  180:         updatedAt:
  181:           serverTimestamp(),
  182:       },
  183:     );
  184: 
  185:   await setDoc(
  186:     doc(
  187:       db,
  188:       "users",
  189:       cleanedUserId,
  190:     ),
  191:     {
  192:       accountIntent: "teacher",
  193: 
  194:       teacherAccessStatus:
  195:         "pending",
  196: 
  197:       updatedAt:
  198:         serverTimestamp(),
  199:     },
  200:     {
  201:       merge: true,
  202:     },
  203:   );
  204: 
  205:   return requestReference.id;
  206: }

  211: function normaliseAccountIntent(

  213:   role: UserRole,
  214: ): AccountIntent {

  217:     value === "teacher"
  218:   ) {
  219:     return value;
  220:   }
  221: 
  222:   /*
  223:    * Existing teacher accounts pre-date accountIntent.

  226:   if (
  227:     role === "teacher" ||
  228:     role === "admin"
  229:   ) {
  230:     return "teacher";
  231:   }

  233:   return "student";

  236: function normaliseTeacherAccessStatus(
  237:   value: unknown,

  239:   accountIntent: AccountIntent,

  241:   if (
  242:     value === "not_submitted" ||
  243:     value === "pending" ||

  245:     value === "rejected"
  246:   ) {
  247:     return value;
  248:   }
  249: 
  250:   if (
  251:     role === "teacher" ||
  252:     role === "admin"

  254:     return "approved";
  255:   }
  256: 
  257:   if (
  258:     accountIntent === "teacher"
  259:   ) {
  260:     return "not_submitted";
  261:   }
  262: 
  263:   return "";

  266: function convertUserProfile(
  267:   documentId: string,

  289:   const accountIntent =
  290:     normaliseAccountIntent(

  292:       role,
  293:     );

  296:     normaliseTeacherAccessStatus(
  297:       data.teacherAccessStatus,

  303:     normaliseString(

  308:     normaliseAccountType(

  311:     );

  314:     normalisePersonalPlan(
  315:       data.personalPlan,
  316:     );
  317:

  319:     normalisePlan(

  379:         ? data.xp
  380:         : 0,
  381:

  383:       typeof data.streak ===

  425: export async function createUserProfile({
  426:   uid,
  427:   name,
  428:   email,
  429:   role,
  430:   accountIntent,
  431: }: CreateUserProfileInput): Promise<void> {
  432:   const cleanedUid =
  433:     uid.trim();
  434: 
  435:   const cleanedName =
  436:     name.trim();
  437: 
  438:   const cleanedEmail =
  439:     email.trim().toLowerCase();
  440: 
  441:   if (!cleanedUid) {
  442:     throw new Error(
  443:       "A valid user ID is required.",
  444:     );
  445:   }
  446: 
  447:   if (!cleanedName) {
  448:     throw new Error(
  449:       "A full name is required.",
  450:     );
  451:   }
  452: 
  453:   if (!cleanedEmail) {
  454:     throw new Error(
  455:       "A valid email address is required.",
  456:     );
  457:   }
  458: 
  459:   const resolvedIntent =
  460:     accountIntent ??
  461:     (role === "teacher" ||
  462:     role === "admin"
  463:       ? "teacher"
  464:       : "student");
  465: 
  466:   await setDoc(
  467:     doc(
  468:       db,
  469:       "users",
  470:       cleanedUid,
  471:     ),
  472:     {
  473:       uid: cleanedUid,
  474:       name: cleanedName,
  475:       email: cleanedEmail,
  476:       role,
  477: 
  478:       accountIntent:
  479:         resolvedIntent,
  480: 
  481:       teacherAccessStatus:
  482:         role === "teacher" ||
  483:         role === "admin"
  484:           ? "approved"
  485:           : resolvedIntent ===
  486:               "teacher"
  487:             ? "not_submitted"
  488:             : null,
  489: 
  490:       accountType: "individual",
  491:       plan: "free",
  492:       personalPlan: "free",
  493:       schoolId: null,
  494: 
  495:       classIds: [],
  496: 
  497:       qualification: null,
  498:       examBoard: null,
  499:       currentCourse: "",
  500: 
  501:       onboardingComplete:
  502:         role !== "student",
  503: 
  504:       xp: 0,
  505:       streak: 0,
  506: 
  507:       completedLessons: [],
  508:       completedTopics: [],
  509:       completedUnits: [],
  510:       completedPapers: [],
  511: 
  512:       badges: [],
  513: 
  514:       createdAt:
  515:         serverTimestamp(),
  516: 
  517:       updatedAt:
  518:         serverTimestamp(),
  519:     },
  520:   );
  521: }

  541: export async function updateUserCourseSelection(
  542:   uid: string,
  543:   selectionOrQualification:
  544:     | UserCourseSelection
  545:     | string,
  546:   examBoard?: string,
  547:   currentCourse?: string,
  548: ): Promise<void> {
  549:   const cleanedUid =
  550:     uid.trim();
  551: 
  552:   if (!cleanedUid) {
  553:     throw new Error(
  554:       "A valid user ID is required.",
  555:     );
  556:   }
  557: 
  558:   /*
  559:    * Prevent a pending teacher applicant from accidentally
  560:    * completing student curriculum onboarding.
  561:    */
  562:   const existingProfile =
  563:     await getUserProfile(
  564:       cleanedUid,
  565:     );
  566: 
  567:   if (
  568:     existingProfile?.accountIntent ===
  569:       "teacher" &&
  570:     existingProfile.role ===
  571:       "student"
  572:   ) {
  573:     throw new Error(
  574:       "Teacher applicants do not need to select a student curriculum.",
  575:     );
  576:   }
  577: 
  578:   const selection =
  579:     typeof selectionOrQualification ===
  580:     "string"
  581:       ? {
  582:           qualification:
  583:             selectionOrQualification,
  584: 
  585:           examBoard:
  586:             examBoard || "",
  587: 
  588:           currentCourse:
  589:             currentCourse || "",
  590:         }
  591:       : selectionOrQualification;
  592: 
  593:   const cleanedQualification =
  594:     selection.qualification.trim();
  595: 
  596:   const cleanedExamBoard =
  597:     selection.examBoard.trim();
  598: 
  599:   const cleanedCurrentCourse =
  600:     selection.currentCourse?.trim() ||
  601:     "";
  602: 
  603:   if (
  604:     cleanedQualification !==
  605:       "GCSE" &&
  606:     cleanedQualification !==
  607:       "A_LEVEL"
  608:   ) {
  609:     throw new Error(
  610:       "Select either GCSE or A-level.",
  611:     );
  612:   }
  613: 
  614:   if (
  615:     cleanedExamBoard !== "AQA" &&
  616:     cleanedExamBoard !== "OCR" &&
  617:     cleanedExamBoard !== "EDEXCEL"
  618:   ) {
  619:     throw new Error(
  620:       "Select AQA, OCR or Pearson Edexcel.",
  621:     );
  622:   }
  623: 
  624:   const updateData: Record<
  625:     string,
  626:     unknown
  627:   > = {
  628:     qualification:
  629:       cleanedQualification,
  630: 
  631:     examBoard:
  632:       cleanedExamBoard,
  633: 
  634:     onboardingComplete: true,
  635: 
  636:     updatedAt:
  637:       serverTimestamp(),
  638:   };
  639: 
  640:   if (cleanedCurrentCourse) {
  641:     updateData.currentCourse =
  642:       cleanedCurrentCourse;
  643:   }
  644: 
  645:   await updateDoc(
  646:     doc(
  647:       db,
  648:       "users",
  649:       cleanedUid,
  650:     ),
  651:     updateData,
  652:   );
  653: }

  655: export async function ensureUserProfile(
  656:   firebaseUser: User,
  657: ): Promise<UserProfile> {
  658:   const reference = doc(
  659:     db,
  660:     "users",
  661:     firebaseUser.uid,
  662:   );
  663: 
  664:   const snapshot =
  665:     await getDoc(reference);
  666: 
  667:   const authenticationEmail =
  668:     normaliseEmail(
  669:       firebaseUser.email,
  670:     );
  671: 
  672:   const authenticationName =
  673:     normaliseString(
  674:       firebaseUser.displayName,
  675:     );
  676: 
  677:   if (!snapshot.exists()) {
  678:     const fallbackName =
  679:       authenticationName ||
  680:       inferNameFromEmail(
  681:         authenticationEmail,
  682:       );
  683: 
  684:     await createUserProfile({
  685:       uid: firebaseUser.uid,
  686:       name: fallbackName,
  687:       email: authenticationEmail,
  688:       role: "student",
  689:       accountIntent: "student",
  690:     });
  691: 
  692:     const createdSnapshot =
  693:       await getDoc(reference);
  694: 
  695:     if (!createdSnapshot.exists()) {
  696:       throw new Error(
  697:         "The user profile could not be created.",
  698:       );
  699:     }
  700: 
  701:     return convertUserProfile(
  702:       createdSnapshot.id,
  703:       createdSnapshot.data() as Partial<FirestoreUserProfile>,
  704:     );
  705:   }
  706: 
  707:   const existing =
  708:     snapshot.data() as Partial<FirestoreUserProfile>;
  709: 
  710:   const existingRole =
  711:     isUserRole(existing.role)
  712:       ? existing.role
  713:       : "student";
  714: 
  715:   const existingIntent =
  716:     normaliseAccountIntent(
  717:       existing.accountIntent,
  718:       existingRole,
  719:     );
  720: 
  721:   const existingStatus =
  722:     normaliseTeacherAccessStatus(
  723:       existing.teacherAccessStatus,
  724:       existingRole,
  725:       existingIntent,
  726:     );
  727: 
  728:   const existingEmail =
  729:     normaliseEmail(
  730:       existing.email,
  731:     );
  732: 
  733:   const existingName =
  734:     normaliseString(
  735:       existing.name,
  736:     );
  737: 
  738:   const repairedEmail =
  739:     existingEmail ||
  740:     authenticationEmail;
  741: 
  742:   const repairedName =
  743:     existingName ||
  744:     authenticationName ||
  745:     inferNameFromEmail(
  746:       repairedEmail,
  747:     );
  748: 
  749:   const repairData: Record<
  750:     string,
  751:     unknown
  752:   > = {};
  753: 
  754:   if (
  755:     normaliseString(
  756:       existing.uid,
  757:     ) !== firebaseUser.uid
  758:   ) {
  759:     repairData.uid =
  760:       firebaseUser.uid;
  761:   }
  762: 
  763:   if (!existingName) {
  764:     repairData.name =
  765:       repairedName;
  766:   }
  767: 
  768:   if (!existingEmail) {
  769:     repairData.email =
  770:       repairedEmail;
  771:   }
  772: 
  773:   if (
  774:     !isUserRole(
  775:       existing.role,
  776:     )
  777:   ) {
  778:     repairData.role =
  779:       "student";
  780:   }
  781: 
  782:   if (
  783:     existing.accountIntent !==
  784:       "student" &&
  785:     existing.accountIntent !==
  786:       "teacher"
  787:   ) {
  788:     repairData.accountIntent =
  789:       existingIntent;
  790:   }
  791: 
  792:   if (
  793:     existing.teacherAccessStatus !==
  794:       "not_submitted" &&
  795:     existing.teacherAccessStatus !==
  796:       "pending" &&
  797:     existing.teacherAccessStatus !==
  798:       "approved" &&
  799:     existing.teacherAccessStatus !==
  800:       "rejected"
  801:   ) {
  802:     repairData.teacherAccessStatus =
  803:       existingStatus || null;
  804:   }
  805: 
  806:   const existingSchoolId =
  807:     normaliseString(
  808:       existing.schoolId,
  809:     );
  810: 
  811:   const resolvedAccountType =
  812:     normaliseAccountType(
  813:       existing.accountType,
  814:       existingSchoolId,
  815:     );
  816: 
  817:   const resolvedPersonalPlan =
  818:     normalisePersonalPlan(
  819:       existing.personalPlan,
  820:     );
  821: 
  822:   const resolvedPlan =
  823:     normalisePlan(
  824:       existing.plan,
  825:       resolvedAccountType,
  826:       resolvedPersonalPlan,
  827:     );
  828: 
  829:   if (
  830:     existing.schoolId ===
  831:     undefined
  832:   ) {
  833:     repairData.schoolId = null;
  834:   }
  835: 
  836:   if (
  837:     existing.accountType !== "individual" &&
  838:     existing.accountType !== "school"
  839:   ) {
  840:     repairData.accountType =
  841:       resolvedAccountType;
  842:   }
  843: 
  844:   if (
  845:     existing.personalPlan !== "free" &&
  846:     existing.personalPlan !== "premium"
  847:   ) {
  848:     repairData.personalPlan =
  849:       resolvedPersonalPlan;
  850:   }
  851: 
  852:   if (
  853:     existing.plan !== "free" &&
  854:     existing.plan !== "premium" &&
  855:     existing.plan !== "school"
  856:   ) {
  857:     repairData.plan =
  858:       resolvedPlan;
  859:   }
  860: 
  861:   if (
  862:     !Array.isArray(
  863:       existing.classIds,
  864:     )
  865:   ) {
  866:     repairData.classIds = [];
  867:   }
  868: 
  869:   if (
  870:     existing.qualification ===
  871:     undefined
  872:   ) {
  873:     repairData.qualification =
  874:       null;
  875:   }
  876: 
  877:   if (
  878:     existing.examBoard ===
  879:     undefined
  880:   ) {
  881:     repairData.examBoard =
  882:       null;
  883:   }
  884: 
  885:   if (
  886:     typeof existing.currentCourse !==
  887:     "string"
  888:   ) {
  889:     repairData.currentCourse =
  890:       "";
  891:   }
  892: 
  893:   if (
  894:     typeof existing.onboardingComplete !==
  895:     "boolean"
  896:   ) {
  897:     const hasCourse =
  898:       Boolean(
  899:         normaliseString(
  900:           existing.qualification,
  901:         ),
  902:       ) &&
  903:       Boolean(
  904:         normaliseString(
  905:           existing.examBoard,
  906:         ),
  907:       );
  908: 
  909:     repairData.onboardingComplete =
  910:       existingRole === "teacher" ||
  911:       existingRole === "admin" ||
  912:       hasCourse;
  913:   }
  914: 
  915:   if (
  916:     typeof existing.xp !==
  917:     "number"
  918:   ) {
  919:     repairData.xp = 0;
  920:   }
  921: 
  922:   if (
  923:     typeof existing.streak !==
  924:     "number"
  925:   ) {
  926:     repairData.streak = 0;
  927:   }
  928: 
  929:   if (
  930:     !Array.isArray(
  931:       existing.completedLessons,
  932:     )
  933:   ) {
  934:     repairData.completedLessons =
  935:       [];
  936:   }
  937: 
  938:   if (
  939:     !Array.isArray(
  940:       existing.completedTopics,
  941:     )
  942:   ) {
  943:     repairData.completedTopics =
  944:       [];
  945:   }
  946: 
  947:   if (
  948:     !Array.isArray(
  949:       existing.completedUnits,
  950:     )
  951:   ) {
  952:     repairData.completedUnits =
  953:       [];
  954:   }
  955: 
  956:   if (
  957:     !Array.isArray(
  958:       existing.completedPapers,
  959:     )
  960:   ) {
  961:     repairData.completedPapers =
  962:       [];
  963:   }
  964: 
  965:   if (
  966:     !Array.isArray(
  967:       existing.badges,
  968:     )
  969:   ) {
  970:     repairData.badges = [];
  971:   }
  972: 
  973:   if (
  974:     Object.keys(
  975:       repairData,
  976:     ).length > 0
  977:   ) {
  978:     await setDoc(
  979:       reference,
  980:       {
  981:         ...repairData,
  982: 
  983:         updatedAt:
  984:           serverTimestamp(),
  985:       },
  986:       {
  987:         merge: true,
  988:       },
  989:     );
  990:   }
  991: 
  992:   return convertUserProfile(
  993:     snapshot.id,
  994:     {
  995:       ...existing,
  996:       ...repairData,
  997:     },
  998:   );
  999: }

 1001: export async function updatePersonalPlan(
 1002:   uid: string,
 1003:   personalPlan: PersonalPlan,
 1004: ): Promise<void> {
 1005:   const cleanedUid = uid.trim();
 1006: 
 1007:   if (!cleanedUid) {
 1008:     throw new Error("A valid user account is required.");
 1009:   }
 1010: 
 1011:   const profile = await getUserProfile(cleanedUid);
 1012: 
 1013:   if (!profile) {
 1014:     throw new Error("The user profile could not be found.");
 1015:   }
 1016: 
 1017:   await updateDoc(
 1018:     doc(db, "users", cleanedUid),
 1019:     {
 1020:       personalPlan,
 1021:       plan:
 1022:         profile.accountType === "school"
 1023:           ? "school"
 1024:           : personalPlan,
 1025:       updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
 1026:     },
 1027:   );
 1028: }

 1030: export async function getUserProfile(
 1031:   uid: string,
 1032: ): Promise<UserProfile | null> {
 1033:   const cleanedUid =
 1034:     uid.trim();
 1035: 
 1036:   if (!cleanedUid) {
 1037:     return null;
 1038:   }
 1039: 
 1040:   const snapshot =
 1041:     await getDoc(
 1042:       doc(
 1043:         db,
 1044:         "users",
 1045:         cleanedUid,
 1046:       ),
 1047:     );
 1048: 
 1049:   if (!snapshot.exists()) {
 1050:     return null;
 1051:   }
 1052: 
 1053:   return convertUserProfile(
 1054:     snapshot.id,
 1055:     snapshot.data() as Partial<FirestoreUserProfile>,
 1056:   );
